## (Don't Fear) The Reaper
引文：Time to party like it's 2023.（Johnny at the beginning of (Don't Fear) The Reaper）

(Don't Fear) The Reaper is a Main Job in . It is the "secret ending" of the game, leading to slightly modified versions of either the "The Sun"/Path of Glory or the "Temperance"/New Dawn Fades scenarios.

Walkthrough
In order to unlock this ending, the player is required to make specific choices at the end of Chippin' In.

On the rooftop towards the end of Nocturne Op55N1, V needs to be indecisive in making a decision on who to call for help. After about five minutes of doing nothing and simply leaving the dialogue choice open, Johnny will comment that it is tough to decide who "will die for you", and proposes they enter Arasaka Tower alone, making this a suicide mission. This echoes Dexter DeShawn's question in the beginning:

"Would you rather live in peace as Mr. Nobody... or go down for all times in a blaze of glory?"

Two factors make this mission uniquely difficult:
*Saving is not allowed throughout the entire mission. However, the game still autosaves at checkpoints, the first being at the start of the mission, the second after descending to the mainframe level, and the third immediately before the confrontation with Adam Smasher.
*V's max Health will be lowered by 25% at the start of the mission and gradually decreases by an additional 1% at certain intervals, indicated by the "Relic Malfunction Detected" notification. The longer it takes to complete the mission, the harder it gets to survive.

Dying at any point will result in a credit roll, which will prompt video messages identical to the "easy way out"/suicide ending. Although the game will not offer to "load last save" and cut to credits instantly, it can be resumed from the autosave points mentioned above.

Choosing Johnny's "suicide run" option will result in an immediate cut right to the front entrance of Arasaka Tower. In the entrance area, V will have to fight two Arasaka Samurais and three Arasaka Special Agents who are all at maximum level. After defeating the guards along with two Arasaka mechs, Johnny leads V to the elevator for which an access token is needed. More guards will spawn, and they will have to be defeated in order for the token to be looted. As V obtains the access token, they will have to call for the lift, which will only arrive after a significant amount of time, leaving V in the lobby having to defend against guards that will spawn from time to time, including Juggernauts. Enter the elevator immediately after the door opens and select the Netrunner floor. Another Mech will spawn in front of the elevator before its doors close.

The final enemy will be Adam Smasher, who will also summon reinforcements at preset points during the fight: 6 Arasaka Snipers appear on the balcony around the room and three Juggernauts on the ground level.

Once Alt is successfully uploaded to the access point and is connected to Mikoshi, she will offer V a choice to either give their body to Johnny, or to keep it. Choosing Johnny results in the New Dawn Fades (Temperance) ending, whereas choosing V will result in the Path of Glory (The Sun) ending, albeit modified by the fact that Rogue is still alive in both.

Journal Entry
This job does not have a journal entry.

Objectives
*Find a way to the level with Mikoshi.
*Defeat all enemies in the lobby.
*Gain access to the elevators.
*Defeat all enemies in the lobby.
*Loot the access token.
*Take the elevator to Mikoshi.
*Find the Mikoshi Access Point.
*Defeat all the enemies in the control room.
*Find a way to connect Alt to the mainframe.
*Defeat all enemies in the mainframe room.
*Expose the mainframe.
*Connect Alt to the mainframe.
*Defeat Adam Smasher.
**(Optional) Decide Adam Smasher's fate.
*Enter the well to return your body.
*Cross the bridge and enter Cyberspace forever. [Optional]

Trivia
*The title of the job comes from the Blue Öyster Cult song (Don't Fear) The Reaper.
**The exact time the player must wait on the rooftop at the end of Nocturne Op55N1 is 5:08, which is the same as the length of the song.

## 1R-0NC-LAD
- status：Dependent
- home：Dogtown, Night City
- location：EBM Petrochem Stadium
- affiliation：BARGHEST (formerly)

1R-0NC-LAD is a robot in .

Biography

Inside the EBM Petrochem Stadium, there will be a green shipping crate located near and above the Autofixer terminal, where sparks can be seen inside it. Inside will be a damaged combat robot which is the source of the sparks. Accessing the laptop beside the robot will add 1R-0NC-LAD as a new contact, and it will then begin to send V on a scavenger hunt throughout the EBM Petrochem Stadium for "Robot Software". 1R-0NC-LAD will give out photos that show the location of the Software it needs, which will be contained inside white containers. V must glean clues on where the containers are from the photos. Once they find the Robot Software and send it via the messaging system, 1R-0NC-LAD will give V a recorded message from its creator, Erwin Kirsch, alongside a photo for the next data.

*The first Robot Software can be found just outside the Food Vendor beside Sammy Taylor's Netrunner Vendor shop.
*The second one is found by Saki Seo's shop (Meds Vendor).
*The third one is found on some ammo crates beside Herold Lowe's place.
*The fourth one can be found by a narrow nook beside and behind Sophia Dupont's place (Weapon Vendor).
*The final Software is found on an unmarked noodle stall near the Autofixer terminal, with the container hidden beside the stairs behind the vendor's stall.

The final Software requires V to physically upload it directly to the laptop, after which they have three choices: wipe the robot's memory, leave it alone, or reprogram it (requires 15 Intelligence).

:After a few days pass, 1R-0NC-LAD will send a final message to V, with an image showing them the location of some loot. This location is also found within the EBM Petrochem Stadium, but is only accessible during the Gig: Roads to Redemption quest. The chest with the reward can be found near a maintenance bay with three combat robots in it.

:Once an undetermined amount of time has passed, a message will be sent by 1R-0NC-LAD that reveals its firewall has been updated, cutting off its contact. Players can return to 1R-0NC-LAD's location to find the body of Erwin Kirsch dead by the foot of a now armed 1R-0NC-LAD. Kirsch's body can be looted for weapons, along with a shard message revealing that 1R-0NC-LAD had lured Erwin to it. If players leave the area, 1R-0NC-LAD will disappear from its location.

:V will take a few seconds to reprogram 1R-0NC-LAD, after which 1R-0NC-LAD will begin to play the guitar. After a few days, 1R-0NC-LAD will send another image clue, along with a message saying that they're going to become a guitarist. The image leads to one of the stalls in the stadium's long outer hall overlooking the stadium shipwreck, where a stash can be found containing a Skill Shard and some Eurodollars.

Associated Shards

## 7th Hell
- type：Nightclub
- owner：Jack Mausser
- city：Night City
- district：City Center
- sub_district：Downtown
- street：Corporation
- gangs：Animals

7th Hell is a nightclub located in Downtown, in the City Center district of Night City.

Overview
The nightclub is owned by former merc Jack Mausser. Animals gang members can be seen providing security for the 7th Hell.

Database Entry

Layout
The club has two entrances, a front entrance that is guarded by a duo of Bouncers that will charge €$ 500 for entrance, and a back entrance elevator, most likely meant for employees. The back entrance can be opened with 9 Technical Ability.

1st Floor
After paying the entrance fee, a staircase corridor will lead down to the club level. Straight ahead, you can find the security room that is locked behind a 14 Technical Ability door. Inside the security room there is one Bouncer and a computer terminal.

To either sides there is a lounge area with seats and tables.

On the east side, a staircase leading down to the basement can be found. Further down the lounge, a door locked with 19 Technical Ability can be found, leading the artist room where a mirror and Access Point can be found. The door leading the DJ booth cannot be accessed. A staircase leading to the 2nd floor can be found here.

On the west side, a staircase to the 2nd floor can be found as well as a staircase to the VIP area. The VIP area staircase is off limited and guarded by a Bouncer.

In the central area, the dance floor, the DJ booth and the bar can be found. There is a small room that can be accessed that serves as a lighting control room, which has a computer terminal that can be hacked with 9 Intelligence.

If entered through the service entrance by elevator, it will lead to a hallway with stored instruments and a control room with a computer that can be hacked using 9 Intelligence. The room leads to the central area.

2nd Floor
On the second floor there are more seats and tables, toilets and a security room. Inside the women's toilet, a hackable S.C.S.M can be found that has no requirement. In the security room, a Security Guard and an Access Point, that required 9 Intelligence, can be found. Further down the security room, there is a ladder that leads to the scaffolding atop the DJ booth. This scaffolding can be crossed to reach the VIP area.

The VIP area is located on the northeast side of the second floor, but it is guarded by a Bouncer. Inside the VIP area, a terminal can be found and the nightclub's owner, Jack Mausser along with a Bouncer.

Basement
In the basement, one can find several caches with items. Most notably, one of the caches contains a large sum of eurodollars and two Tomahawks.

Associated Shards

Notes
*When visited before or after the Gig: An Inconvenient Killer, there are no Animals in the club and jumping and interaction with most doors is disabled.
*It is possible to scare off the bartender during Gig: An Inconvenient Killer. The club will remain accessible, but the icon will not appear on the map.

References

A Cool Metal Fire is a Side Job in .

Walkthrough
:This job starts during Chippin' In, and functions as an objective for it.

Johnny—using V's body—downs a large number of drinks before learning from Claire Russell where Cassius Ryder is. Cassius first asks Johnny which tattoo he wants, before giving him information on a man named Jeremiah Grayson, who works for Adam Smasher. He also provides the name of a night club dancer and his ex-girlfriend, Ruby Collins, who's known to be an associate of Grayson's. Johnny goes to the club where Ruby works, flirts with her, parties hard, fights with the bouncers, gets thrown out and finally leaves with Ruby in a stolen car. Things heat up between the two while Ruby's driving, distracting her and causing a car crash. They manage to get out of the wrecked car, and a wounded Ruby scribbles the name of Ebunike on a pack of Morley's before leaving. After taking a last draft of a cigarette, Johnny returns to a motel and goes to sleep.

Journal Entry
:Now, I don't ask you for much, but I gotta zero Smasher myself. That motherfucker thinks he's invincible. Worse, so does Rogue. All these years, Arasaka Tower's been haunting her. Enough's enough. I'm taking control this one time, I'm finding him, I'm wiping Adam Smasher off the face of the earth.

Objectives
*Get information and drink.
*Talk to Cassius.
*Watch Ruby dance.
*Buy champagne at the bar.
*Drink with Ruby.
**Drink with the others in the club.
**Choose a pill.
**Talk to Ruby.
**Go to the bathroom.
**Talk to the bouncers.
**Wait for Ruby to leave the club.
**Talk to Ruby.
**Take Ruby back to your place.
**Talk to Ruby.
**Have fun.
*Talk to Rogue.
*Talk to Johnny.

Notes
*The title comes from Johnny Silverhand's solo album A Cool Metal Fire.
*If not started, Gig: A Lack of Empathy will automatically be added to the Journal after completing this job.

Trivia
*During the job, V has to choose between a red or a blue pill, which is an homage to 1999's The Matrix film.

## A Like Supreme (quest)
image
- type：Side Job
- quest_giver：Johnny Silverhand
- district：Santo Domingo
- sub_district：Arroyo
- location：Red Dirt
- reward_xp：773
- reward_sc：1158
- previous_quest：Second Conflict
- next_quest：Rebel! Rebel!

A Like Supreme is a Side Job in .

Walkthrough
Some time after deciding which Samurai band member will play during the reunion and rescuing Nancy Hartley from the Totentanz, Nancy calls V, telling them that they are ready for the Samurai reunion at the Red Dirt bar.

When V arrives at the bar in the evening, Nancy asks that V open the guitar case. To Johnny and V's surprise, it is Johnny's old guitar, which was kept in a private collection. Nancy mentions that Kerry should be there momentarily, and that he will bring Drausin from Cutthroat with him to stand in for the missing bandmember.

:When V talks to Denny, she will mention that she helped Henry get with a new band, which helped him quit using drugs. When things started to go well for Henry, he proceeded to remove her from his live again, until a month later Denny stumbled upon Henry again, living on the streets because his new pals threw him out because he was acting up again, but she just left him there and made sure that he would not figure out where she was staying. When asked about how she feels about playing with Samurai again, she says that it feels weird, especially because Johnny isn't here, and that she misses him.

:V was able to talk with Henry, he may explain that when he hit rock bottom, Denny left him, and that she refused to talk to him. He also mentions to V that Kerry helped him get ready for the gig.

After talking with Nancy, V goes to the bathroom to discreetly take the Pseudoendotrizine, and allows Johnny to take over.

When Johnny returns in the main room, Kerry and Drausin have arrived. After a brief conversation, once the group is ready, it will cut to the group on stage. The group then starts playing "A Like Supreme."

After playing, Johnny and Kerry sitting at the bar, talking to each other. Johnny gifts Kerry the guitar, and gives V back control of their body. In return, Kerry gifts V the , his iconic Overture, and leaves the bar.

Journal Entry
This quest does not have a journal entry.

Objectives
*Wait a day for Nancy's call.
*Talk to Nancy.
*Go to the Red Dirt in the evening.
*
**Wait until evening.
*Talk to Nancy.
*Go to the bathroom and take the pills.
*Take the pills to give Johnny control.
*Go back to the main room in Red Dirt.
*Talk to Kerry.
*Perform with Kerry.
*Talk to Johnny.

Notes

引文：#1 viewer's favorite on the show "Guns and Horses" for two years in a row.（Nazaré）

The Nazaré (also known as the Nazaré CD) is a motorcycle manufactured by ARCH in .

Overview
The ARCH Nazaré is a unique mix between a cruiser and a racing bike - like an outcast, it refuses strict labels. Equipped with a single-sided, aluminium swingarm and cutting-edge steering capabilities, the ARCH Nazaré is perfect for an aggressive riding style. The true meat of the bike is the ARCH engine, complete with a ventilation system designed by ARCH's own engineers.

Database Entry

- transcript：The roar of one of these beauties gives all those corpos stuck in their sluggish, armor-heavy limos something to mull over in traffic. What if, instead of those endless quarterly report meetings or - barf - corporate responsibility retreats, they just hopped on one of these bad boys, got that motor runnin' and drove off into the sunset? Sigh... Because the ARCH Nazaré isn't just a bike. It's a way of life.

Acquisition
It can be acquired from the AUTOFIXER netpage for €$71,000.

Nazaré V Message CP2077.png

Development
The motorcycle was first seen in the "[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SM-7tygacE8 Behind the Scenes: Arch Motorcycle with Keanu Reeves and Gard Hollinger]" trailer. It was developed in partnership between ARCH Motorcycle and CD Projekt RED. The Nazaré is a custom production motorcycle based upon ARCH's Method143 from 2017.

Notes
*Prior to Patch 1.5 it cost €$138,000.
*Prior to the introduction of AUTOFIXER, Wakako Okada sold the bike via a text message: "Hello, V. I have an ARCH Nazaré's that is looking for a new owner - practically new. It onced belonged to a corpo who wanted to impress his minions... except he did not have the first clue about handling it. He braked a little too hard and launched himself into the air - skull smacked the pavement so forcefully that not even TT Platinum could save him. Thank God for idiots. So, are you ready to buy?"

Trivia
*Nazaré is Portuguese for "Nazareth."

Bugs
*Occasionally, standard Nazarés will spawn with the Racer model - as seen for the addition of a longer tail - or with the Itsumade one.

The "Itsumade" is a modified version of the Nazaré, a motorcycle manufactured by ARCH in .

Overview
The Itsumade is a tuned ARCH Nazaré prominently used by the Tyger Claws.

A unique Itsumade belonged to a boss of the Claws until a woman named Josie Alcazar stole it after the gang broke her Brennan cycle. Josie hid the tuned Itsumade in a garage somewhere in Watson. Unfortunately, Josie had been badly injured by the gang after stealing the vehicle, and eventually bleed out in an alley, never having the chance to recover the stolen bike.

Acquisition
One Itsumade is rewarded at the end of The Highwayman. The bike is found in a garage in Northside, Watson; right next to the All Foods Plant. Putting the code "0214" in the keypad will give you access to the garage and the bike.

Notes
*Itsumades are prominently spawned in front of Deravaja Dojo.
*If acquired during Act 1, the Motorcycle will not be added to V's garage until Act 2.

Aaron McCarlson is a NCPD sergeant and former associate of Regina Jones appearing in .

Biography
Aaron McCarlson serves an NCPD sergeant. While Aaron rose to become an influential officer, he was also notoriously corrupt. He was in contact with a Valentinos member Claudio Moreno and persuaded him to murder his former superior, Dario Sanchez, after the latter left prison, making sure that the police would not interfere during the hit.

Sometime in 2077 McCarlson became indebted to Dee, apparently his former love interest. Upon being reminded of his debt McCarlson met up with Dee but, instead of paying her, had her shot. He then realised that his crime was recorded by a CCTV located in a warehouse run by Maelstrom. He contacted the fixer Regina Jones, for whom he had previously worked as a consultant on a show "Cops 'n' Chops" , asking her to arrange for a retrieval of the camera footage, claiming that he needed it to conclude an investigation into Maelstrom.

Regina sent the mercenary V, who retrieved the footage but also watched it and realised McCarlson's true motive. The fate of the policeman depends on V's choice when he met up with his client to conclude the contract.

:Aaron managed to avoid any consequences for his crime and can be found at Dino Dinovic's bar in Downtown, City Center.

:Aaron is blackmailed by Regina and becomes her asset inside the NCPD. Similarly, he can be found at Dino Dinovic's bar in Downtown, City Center.

:Regina is disappointed in V's choice, and neither her nor V get any money from the contract on the account of their client's death.

The Abandoned Lake Dwelling is a small cottage found on the shores of Laguna Bend Reservoir, on the southeastern Badlands of Night City.

History
The former owner of the cottage was a resident of Laguna Bend prior to the construction of the new dam. After all residents were ordered to evacuate, he among others decided to stay. In the end, the NCPD had to drag him out of his house right before the water started to flood the area. Once the new reservoir was filled, this resident built a cottage on its shores to be as close as possible to his former home. He also installed a small Van der Duke generator to provide electricity to the building, as well as making sure there was running potable water and more. Unfortunately for him, the close proximity to the lake's toxic water made him get sick and soon after had to move out.

Years later, Judy Álvarez began to dive in the lake by using protective diving equipment. Occasionally, she used the abandoned cottage to rest after a diving session.

In 2077, Judy invited V to make a joint braindance recording while diving through the submerged ruins of her former hometown. Afterwards, since it was late and they were tired, instead of driving back to Night City, they stayed the night in the cottage.

Associated Quests
*Pyramid Song

## Adam Smasher
- aka：NC boogeyman
Chrome-dome
- status：Dependent
- place_of_birth：New York City, USA
- dod：2077 (dependent)
- place_of_death：Arasaka Tower (dependent)
- dob：June 21
- home：The Bronx, NYC
Night City
- gender：Male
- eyes：Red
- cyberware：See Cyberware
- equipment：See Equipment
- affiliation：United States Armed Forces (formerly)
Arasaka
- occupation：Gangster (formerly)
Marine (formerly)
Mercenary
Bodyguard
Arasaka's head of security
- role：Solo
- voiced_by：Alec Newman
- appears_books：

引文：Meat doesn't need to understand. Just to die!（Adam Smasher）

Adam Smasher is a full borg mercenary employed by Arasaka who became a notorious solo and rival of Morgan Blackhand. By 2077, he had risen to the position of head of security within Arasaka and the personal bodyguard of Yorinobu Arasaka.

Smasher is a towering cyborg, with little humanity left to be seen, not that he ever had much. After being reduced to mush by a rocket blast, Arasaka offered him a choice: either pull the plug or become a fully converted cyborg. With few options and a lack of attachment to his human side, he agreed and became more machine than man. Adam has no empathy for others, including his fellow employees, but as Arasaka kept him alive, he repays them by killing the corporation's enemies as directed. He can only be described as pure, uncontrolled evil.

Biography
Early life - 2010s
Adam was born in June 21 to a Bronx American father and a Russian mother. Growing up in the streets of New York City, in the South Bronx, Adam considered himself the meanest and toughest kid on his block, eventually joining his neighborhood combat gang. Despite being a fairly typical worthless punk, during the Collapse, Adam became the gang's leader, often rumbling around what was left of the Yankee Stadium. When the United States Armed Forces wiped out the last one of his gangoons, Smasher enlisted right away. He spent six years in the Marine Corps, where he learned many different skills and became a 108 kg strong man. However, he was discharged for insubordination.

After returning to his hometown, Adam took up the life of a mercenary, specializing in nasty and destructive gigs. Over the following years, he considered New York his stomping ground, accepting all kinds of dangerous jobs, from extractions or harassment to assassination and demolition. It was a good life for him, as his lack of squeamishness and sadistic thoroughness brought in enough jobs to keep him in guns, gear, drugs, and brutal one-night stands. Everything changed in 2015 when the local branch of Arasaka employed him and other mercs to steal a prototype tech from a competitor. During the job, two rocket-propelled grenades maimed Adam, who was later transported to a medical center where he effectively died for over eight minutes before the doctors managed to reanimate his brain. What remained of Adam's body was brought in by his teammates inside a backpack. Around this time, Smasher realized he was getting all of his inputs through interface, with his sensorial organs being inside gel at some corporate installations. Arasaka, preemptively knowing what Adam's fate would be, had already prepared a deal for him; a full body conversion in return for a "15"-year employment contract. In Adam's own words: "They figured I'd just walked into some bad luck and they liked my resume, performance record, skill, good looks and all that." The young man knew only a bit about cyberware, and he never had the money to afford an FBC, so he never thought about it either. But while in the life support tank, Adam knew that if he refused the deal, the next day, his remains would be in someone's body bank. With no other choice, nor any thoughts of lost humanity bothering him anyway, he accepted the corp deal.

Once inside his new chromed body, Adam Smasher realized that was the best decision he had ever made. After returning to the streets of NYC, with Arasaka allowing him time for freelancing, Adam used his new power to spill the blood of anyone that dared to cross his path, including boosterpunks, powered-armor soldiers, corporate hitmen, heavy-duty armed vehicles, dangerous cyberpets, or even children. For Smasher, metal was better than meat. He was obtaining so many gigs that there was no idle time for him, soon gaining fame along the eastern seaboard. He was hired out for almost any mission presented to him, as long as it wasn't an obvious suicide or double-cross. He did have one stipulation: collateral damage and civilian casualties were a must. Most of his time, however, was contracted by Arasaka, who put Smasher on offensive field duty, harassing the competition, and on some occasions in retrieval missions as well. One time he got shot point blank to the chest with a 40mm grenade launcher, throwing Adam off a building's rooftop and falling down nine stories onto a garbage truck. Right after, he returned to the roof to rip the enemy soldier's head off.

Over the following years, Adam defended the New York branch of Arasaka, killing dozens of merc crews that tried to infiltrate the building, while at the same time cleansing the city of what he considered a "fleshy infection." Once, a team of mercenaries were successful in stealing Arasaka files from the local offices, so Smasher pursued the last reaming member who tried to flee after going into a nearby mallplex. If he had been in his meat body, Adam would have needed a minigun to clear the way to pursue his objective. With his metal body, however, weapons as powerful as a minigun were a treat for him, as he could incorporate them into his frame, allowing Smasher to carry heavy weaponry with ease while feeling almost no recoil whatsoever. On the other hand, the meat merc that was escaping could only carry "small weapons," as anything bigger would turn their skeleton to kibble, in Smasher's opinion. Adam was able to catch up to her, though she hid amidst the mallplex crowd. Smasher swept over the multitude with his Tsunami Helix arm-gatling shotgun. In his view, he would never face any repercussions as he didn't wear any corporate tags, colors or logos when on an outside job, and even then, he always wore a different facemask each time he was deployed. Once the surviving crowd had dispersed, Smasher approached the countless bodies to retrieve the files from the corpse of the merc girl.

Over the years, Smasher also developed a quiet rivalry with Morgan Blackhand, seeing the classic solo as a threat to his metal-is-better-than-meat worldview. Adam had repeatedly tried to challenge him to a face-off, but Morgan only ignored him at every possible confrontation. Naturally, this snubbing had simply stoked the cyborg's psychopathic rage higher.

2020 - 2023
By 2020, Smasher liked to call himself a true borg, with little real flesh remaining on his body. He thought that humanity was obsolete, and meat would eventually be replaced, including the mind. With this belief, Adam had the opportunity to write an article for the Solo of Fortune magazine, where he endorsed the full body conversion, stating that anyone who didn't convert would get wiped out.

He had multiple custom FBC designs at his disposal, which were prepped before any operation so people couldn't tell who he was. Although he wished to spend his time mowing down civilians, Smasher knew that it was a dangerous endeavor, as he could still get killed if anyone with military-level hardware approached. For this reason he was expecting to get his hands on the new Cybermatrix Reactive Body Plating, which was equipped with body sensors that would warn him of any laser-targeted weapons, allowing Adam to dodge any incoming bullets with his boosterware. Smasher also loved to show off his weaponry; one time a punk insisted that his Malorian Arms 3516 could put a hole on Smasher's frame, but the borg laughed it off, showing what a real gun was to him. Smasher dragged out a Magnum Opus Hellbringer and blew off the punk's head with it.

In 2022, Adam Smasher was fully employed by Arasaka to fight in the Fourth Corporate War. He was more than happy to do this because he knew Blackhand had been hired by Militech, Arasaka's rival in the war. During the conflict, Smasher specialized — and took joy — in leading strike forces to slaughter communities full of not only Militech enemies but their families as well. One notorious attack took place in Connecticut during September 17, 2022.

On August 20 of 2023, Smasher was present at the Arasaka Towers. During the Militech assault, CEO Kei Arasaka ordered for Smasher and two squads to deal with the force that had infiltrated the Soulkiller lab at the 120th floor. An eager Adam and his team ambushed the Militech force led by Johnny Silverhand, pinning them down in a section of the laboratories. Silverhand tried to distract him in order to help the team escape, shouting and firing at the borg with his Malorian Arms 3516, though this proved futile and got cut in half by Smasher in the process. This, however, gave Shaitan an opportunity to hold Smasher back while the rest of the team escaped.

Supplied with everything he could ever want, Smasher later reappeared at the top of the towers equipped in an Arasaka DaiOni power armor that turned him into a nearly unstoppable machine. In his hand was Shaitan's biopod head, still alive. Adam waved at Morgan Blackhand, showing off Shaitan's head. This took the solo by surprise, who stepped down from one of the AVs to confront the borg. Adam provoked Blackhand by mentioning that Silverhand was dead, and Shaitan would soon be as well unless Morgan recovered the biopod from Smasher's hands. An angry Blackhand ordered his people to evacuate without him, and once the AV had lifted off, he turned to the borg with a remark about testing Smasher's "meat vs. metal" philosophy for itself shortly before the two launched themselves at each other in a last desperate attempt to kill the other. The outcome of the duel was never known, and soon after the building began to shake from the detonation of a nuclear device, causing the Night City Holocaust.

2023 - 2075
Somehow, Adam survived the blast, and he was supposedly tasked by Saburo Arasaka to take care of Silverhand's body and his possessions, being one of the few people who knew where Johnny was buried. Shortly after, Adam fell off the radar, disappearing for many years.

During the next decades, there were multiple rumors of an unstoppable metal juggernaut which ran operations around the globe. How much of this was true remained a mystery however, nor it was ever confirmed if this individual (or individuals) was the real Smasher or someone claiming to be him. Adam would reappear in Night City from time to time, where he also teamed up with Rogue Amendiares on a few occasions.

At some point after 2045, Smasher seemingly found more of Silverhand's possessions in Samantha Stevens' garage and other parts of NC. Although he had sold much of the rockerboy's items, he decided to keep some of them — including Silverhand's Porsche and his signature gun, the Malorian Arms 3516.

At some point during the early-mid 2070s, Adam was assigned as Yorinobu Arasaka's bodyguard and was placed in charge of carrying out Arasaka's dirtiest work, gaining a reputation for expert management of loose ends. During this time, he returned to Night City, making the Ebunike Docks in Watson one of his bases of operations. Jeremiah Grayson, one of his most loyal men, became his right-hand, and for a job well done, Smasher gifted him Silverhand's 3516 pistol.

2076
In 2076, Smasher was brought in by Arasaka counterintelligence agents Kate and Douglas to deal with the rampaging mercenary David Martinez, who was in possession of an experimental Arasaka "cyberskeleton."

When David arrived at Arasaka Tower in Night City, Smasher emerged to save Douglas's life and engaged David. The two solos had a brief exchange of insults before David got distracted by Faraday — whom he had incapacitated moments ago — being taken away by Trauma Team. Smasher would take this opportunity to shoot David in the gut, resulting in him briefly going cyberpsycho and activating his Sandevistan. Smasher responded by doing the same and fired a missile that directly hit the back of David's exo-skeleton with enough force to eject the latter, Lucy, and Faraday (still strapped to Trauma Team's stretcher) out of Arasaka Tower, the latter of whom fell to his death.

David briefly managed to escape with Lucy, only for Smasher to follow, crushing Rebecca to death in the process. Now inside Memorial Park, Falco attempted to slow Smasher down but was simply swatted away. David, on the verge of total cyberpsychosis, activated his Sandevistan again, but was shocked to see Smasher being able to keep up with him, with the latter scoffing that it was a "rudimentary implant." Lucy tried to quickhack Smasher, but this had little effect other than annoying him briefly before her cyberdeck fried. Smasher became briefly distracted trying to kill an escaping Lucy and Falco, which David used as an opportunity to immobilize the cyborg. An amused Smasher responded by ripping off the anti-grav devices from the exo-skeleton, causing it to crumble under its own weight, and proceeded to beat a now crippled David. After ripping the exo-skeleton apart completely, Smasher stood over a limbless David, commenting that he "had some fun, after all;" and mentioned David could have become "an interesting construct." David didn't care whatsoever about his words, then Smasher executed him with a shot to the skull at point-blank range.

Later that same year, a high-ranking Arasaka executive tried to get his hands on David's Jacket biomonitor. If the mercenary crew that was hired by a different party to obtain it didn't give him the item, the corpo employed Adam Smasher to retrieve it from their corpses.

2077
By 2077, Adam was still Yorinobu's bodyguard. He usually accompanied him to the Konpeki Plaza penthouse, even scaring guests such as Evelyn Parker. A number of weeks after, while the mercs V and Jackie Welles conducted a heist for the Relic in the penthouse, Smasher accompanied Yorinobu as his father Saburo arrived to talk with him. Smasher and Saburo's bodyguard, Goro Takemura, left shortly before Yorinobu snapped and strangled his father. Smasher attempted to stop the witnesses, V and Jackie, but they manage to escape before he could catch them.

Upon Saburo's death, Yorinobu became CEO of Arasaka, promoting Smasher to Head of Security. During the memorial parade for Saburo, Sandayu Oda warned Smasher that the parade was to be sabotaged in an effort to harm Yorinobu's sister, Hanako. Smasher brushed off Oda's warnings, accusing Oda of disobeying Yorinobu as Oda persisted in questioning Smasher's actions. Oda was ultimately correct — with V's help, Takemura gained access to Hanako's float in order to kidnap her. Smasher afterwards led an Arasaka strike team, personally rescuing Hanako and ordered for her kidnappers to be killed.

:Once Adam found that intruders had broken into Arasaka Tower through the subbasement, he made his way to the Mikoshi access point to kill them. He found members of the Aldecaldos; Panam Palmer, Saul Bright, and V. After destroying the gate, Saul shot at Adam's chest which wounded him right before Adam stomped on his head, killing him. A fight between the three broke out as Adam asked where Rogue was and yelled he'd find her after dealing with the Aldecaldos. However, Adam was defeated in the battle. Whether he was executed or not was V's choice.

:Adam as well as the rest of the security were on high alert after an unidentified flying vehicle had assaulted Arasaka Tower. He suspected it must have been the work of the Queen of Fixers, Rogue Amendiares. Adam made his way to the Mikoshi access point discovering Rogue, Crispin Weyland, and V were behind the assault. He confronted Rogue, however before he could kill her she detonated a grenade on his chest wounding him in the process. He then began to fight V (who was controlled by Johnny Silverhand's engram) and Crispin. Adam was defeated during the battle. Whether he was executed or not was Johnny's choice.

:During Yorinobu's military coup on Arasaka, Hanako's faction slowly had taken over Arasaka Tower with Goro Takemura and V leading the troops to the CEO's office. Adam intercepted them right before they could enter the CEO's office in a last ditch effort to protect Yorinobu. V and Takemura began to fight Adam as he asked where Rogue was and yelled he'd find her after dealing with them. Adam, however, was defeated during the battle. Whether he was executed or not was V's choice.

:Adam Smasher intercepted V before they made it through to the Mikoshi access point alone. A fight between the two broke out as he asked where Rogue was and yelled he'd find her after dealing with V. Adam was either defeated during the battle or managed to kill V and indirectly killing his nemesis, Johnny.

Quotes

引文：Anyone who doesn't want to be Fully Converted gets wiped out! Change yourself, and change the world. Combat superiority is only the beginning! Destroy all flesh!!（a metalhead solo speaks his transplanted mind, Destroy All Flesh!! by Adam Smasher）

引文：Seeing as how I'm a fully-cybernetic Street Samurai, you really don't want to cross swords with me. Yes, I am living proof that metal is better than meat!（Adam Smasher）

引文：Waitasec... You're tellin' me that you guys and Militech are trading blows, but you're doing it quietly? What the heck's the point!? Feh!! Call me when you clone yourself some cojones, flesh-weasel!（Adam Smasher to an Arasaka recruiter during the early Fourth Corporate War）

引文：They call this war a meat-grinder. Well, you're the meat, and I'm the grinder, baby!（Adam Smasher during the Fourth Corporate War）

引文：I'll slaughter each and every one of you. You're all the same meat to me.（Adam during his fight with David Martinez）

引文：You weaklings implant a little chrome, and start thinking you can call the shots. Time to die, little meat.（Adam to a merc crew）

引文：Everyone thinks they're the next damn Morgan Blackhand.（Adam to a merc crew）

引文：You look like a cut of fuckable meat. Are you?（Adam to Evelyn Parker）

引文：You spared [...] So very... human! And disgusting. Mercy is disgusting.（Adam to V）

Notes
*Scanning Smasher in Cyberpunk 2077 shows he is 96% cybernetic.
*Prior to the Fourth Corporate War, Adam Smasher affected a southern "good ol boy" accent that made him sound exactly like Elvis Presley.
*Adam Smasher used various cyberbodies throughout his life, having a closetful of them by 2023. The first body he used all the way into the Fourth Corporate War was a heavily modified Samson. Also before the war, he had access to a Gemini that looked and sounded like a young, overmuscled, blond Elvis Presley. After the war, however, he stopped using more humanoid bodies, and by 2077 he was supposedly using a heavily modified Dragoon.
*Mike Pondsmith identified Adam Smasher as a "high functioning cyberpsycho".
*During a Cyberpunk 2020 live session in Poland, Mike Pondsmith made a scenario for a group of players which involved Michiko Arasaka's 18 birthday, ending with her having a "wild fling" with Adam Smasher. Pondsmith later elaborated that during this time, Smasher would use a Gemini body that resembled a young, blonde Elvis Presley and treated Michiko respectfully partly because of her status in Arasaka. When the two first met, Michiko was a sheltered 17 year old girl, and her bodyguard, Kenichi Zaburo, threatened Smasher to mind his manners. Since this event has not been added to the story, it's not considered canon.
*Despite having a reputation for being devoid of empathy for virtually everyone, his gifting of Johnny's Malorian to Grayson indicates that he does appear to have a level of appreciation for reliable subordinates.
*The Japanese script of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners drops Smasher's habit of referring to others as meat and treating his targets like animals to be slaughtered, which is then returned in the English localization. For example, his threat to David, "Rest assured. It's a massacre. You won't get lonely then, right?" is substituted with "All the same meat to me. I'll slaughter each and every one of you," in the English dub. Similarly, "I said it was a massacre, didn't I? You won't escape!" is replaced with, "None leave the slaughterhouse; not alive!"

Trivia
*Adam Smasher's name is a play on the word "atom smasher", a nickname for particle accelerators like the Large Hadron Collider.
*Adam Smasher's English voice actor is Alec Newman, who also voices Anders Hellman and Arthur Jenkins.
*The young Adam Smasher's face is a 3D scan of AI Team Lead Tomas Plch.
*Adam Smasher appears as a skin in Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 2 being part of The Night City Denizens Set.
*Adam Smasher appears in Wuthering Waves as part of the Wuthering Waves × Cyberpunk: Edgerunners crossover event.

- city：Night City

The Advocet Hotel is located in Vista del Rey, in the Heywood district of central Night City.

History
2010s - 2020s
In the early 21st century, the Advocet was marketed as a luxury destination, and with good reason. The notorious three-star hotel had above average amenities, including terminals in each room, as well as a gym, spa, casino, shopping arcade, nightclub/lounge, and AV landing pads on the roof. The owners at the time felt their customers, mostly businessmen, would spend copious amounts of money inside the establishment to steadily increase profits. If customers wanted extralegal activities such as drugs, illegal braindances or similar, the hotel concierge arranged these as "services" only offered to in-house guests. As such, the NCPD's attention was usually focused elsewhere. This would ultimately result in rich, questionable patrons renting the upper penthouse suites. Rockers were a common sight here.

The Advocet and nearby competitor, the Havenford Hotel, were generally booked full the entire year due to their proximity to the Night City Convention Center.

2070s
By 2077, the hotel itself was a derelict husk covered in Valentino gang markings and was heavily neglected, though one of the elevators was still functional. By accessing the Advocet's lobby, the elevator could be taken up to the 42nd floor, the hotel's terrace.

Known Staff
2020
*Ziv Ellis (maid)

Trivia
*After taking the elevator to the terrace in , it will begin to rain and one can find an NPC labelled "Unknown" holding a bird. This is an homage to the character Roy Batty portrayed by Rutger Hauer in the 1982 science fiction film Blade Runner by Ridley Scott. Close to the NPC is a neon sign that reads: "Like Tears," a reference to Roy Batty's notorious monologue in the movie.
**Another homage to Roy Batty can be found at the North Oak Columbarium.

An aerozep (or AeroZep) is a type of aircraft in .

Overview
Cyberpunk RED
An aerozep is a type of cargo-carrying blimp.

Cyberpunk 2077
Freighter model aerozeps, designed for carrying cargo over long distances, can be seen traveling in and out of Night City. Several crashed aerozeps can be found in the Badlands to the east of the city, while another of these freighters can be seen crashed in the EBM Petrochem Stadium. This former NUS Army freighter was intercepted by BARGHEST under orders of Kurt Hansen.

Inhabitants of Dogtown use the intact reactor from the ship to power the sub-district without the need for the local city grid. BARGHEST also modified a working aerozep with their thematic yellow color and a display, which can be seen observed exclusively in the airspace above the sub-district.

引文："There is only one path in Night City worth walking: the one that leads to the Afterlife."（Old saying (Afterlife Database Entry)）

The Afterlife is the name of a club located in Little China, in the Watson district of northern Night City. Formerly located in the downtown area, it has been known throughout the decades for its merc clientele.

History

Early history
The old club located in downtown Night City was abandoned due to gentrification at some point after the Time of the Red. The club's owner, Rogue Amendiares, found another location in southern Watson where she established the new Afterlife. Keeping with old traditions, she rebuilt it in a former morgue and continued serving drinks named after legendary edgerunners who went out in a blaze of glory. The bar was still considered the most famous and infamous edgerunner esbalishment in all of Night City. The venue served as a base of operations for Rogue and her merc allies, and was also a location where, among other things, certain business transactions could be conducted.

2070s
During the 2070s, the Afterlife was a very famous club in Night City visited by many high-street cred fixers and mercs, such as Faraday or David Martinez. Brawl fights were a common occurrence in the bar. To enter the Afterlife, mercs needed to either be well known or have a referral from someone.

In 2077, V, Jackie Welles and T-Bug visited the Afterlife after successfully completing an assignment for Dexter DeShawn, gaining access to the Afterlife for the first time.

Database Entry

- transcript：As the old saying goes "There is only one path in Night City worth walking: the one that leads to the Afterlife." Once you make it here, sooner or later, everything else opens up to you. The Afterlife is an iconic bar where the who's who of mercs and first-rate fixers gather to kick back or conduct biz. It's also a major nerve center for the city. This is place where the biggest deals get cut and the job rewards have the most zeros tacked on. Stop here to spot big names such as Rogue, Dexter DeShawn and that guy who "drank with Morgan Blackhand once"... Speaking of , it's said Blackhand's ghost still wanders the bar, switching off the safeties of customers' holstered guns. Of course, it's probably best to check that out for yourself. That is... provided you've earned enough street cred to get you through the front door.

Akira is a character that appears in and as a security guard of Arasaka.

Biography
2013
Akira was a prominent bodyguard in the Arasaka Tower in 2013. He was described by the employees as the 'Hulk from hell.' He was tasked with guarding Toshiro, the high level corporate of the Arasaka Corporation in Night City. In 2013, Toshiro and Akira greeted Alt Cunningham in the bar of Arasaka Tower with a glass of scotch upon being awoken after the kidnapping.

However during the meeting between Toshiro and Alt, a riot at the foot of the tower was created with rockerboy Johnny Silverhand leading the charge. Akira moved to protect Toshiro and Alt while the two were working to replicate her work of the Soulkiller. Akira was confronted by Johnny, Rogue, Santiago, and Thompson as they fought through his men. Akira fought off the group but was eventually killed by Johnny Silverhand.

2077
In 2077, V enters the blackwall of the net, they relived Johnny Silverhands memories and saw fight with Akira who was defending Alt Cunningham. Akira's fate was left ambiguous, but Alt later tells the V that Johnny's memories are imperfect and elevate Johnny in his version of events.

After their superiors ordered them to stand down, Murphy followed Hansen in deserting the New United States and helped found the BARGHEST militia, who when on to rename and control the Pacifica sub-district Dogtown. As one of the few surviving members of the original unit, Murphy became a high-ranking member of BARGHEST.

In 2077, Murphy helped oversee the extraction of the Neural Matrix from a Militech device at the EBM Petrochem Stadium. ## Aldecaldo Camp (2077)
- caption：Original campsite

The Nomad Camp (first known as Mobile Camp) is a temporary Aldecaldo campsite located on the eastern Badlands of Night City.

Overview
The first camp, with its fast travel point being "Mobile Camp," is located in the central-eastern area of the Rocky Ridge Plains, inside the Wind Farms. The second one, with its fast travel point being "Nomad Camp," is on a valley in the northern parts of the plains. It has an unlockable apartment for V.

History
Around 2077, Saul Bright led his Aldecaldo family to the Badlands of Night City in order to find new work for them, as they desperately needed it.

After liberating Saul from the Wraiths and stealing a Basilisk tank from Militech, the Wraiths launched an attack on the Aldecaldo campsite. V and Panam Palmer, aboard the Basilisk, managed to disrupt the attack, though not without loses on the Aldecaldo side. To protect themselves from the Wraiths and any corporation that might want to attack them, the Aldecaldos decided to move their mobile base of operations to a more safe location among the neighboring hills to the north.

Database Entry

- transcript：The life of a nomad is one of constant motion. But although their camps are temporary, they're always designed with function, order and comfort in mind. Setting up a new camps is a quick operation because everyone knows their responsibilities, working together like parts in a well-oiled machine. As the nomad Santiago once said: "Whenever we make camp, for a short while we become farmers again. And the earlier a farmer finishes his work, the sooner he cracks open a bear." To those who don't buy into the propaganda, nomads are known as hospitable folk. Still, it's better to signal your peaceful intentions from afar, as their camps are well protected.

Alena Xenakis, also known as Alex, is a character in .

Biography

Alena grew up in the slums of the Los Angeles Metroplex, and following her dream, she became an aspiring braindance actress. Unbeknownst to her, the braindance studio she joined was a front for the Federal Intelligence Agency. Her formidable acting skills impressed them enough that she was recruited by Solomon Reed. Ever since, she has worked with the FIA in many covert operations, becoming a talented shapeshifter.

At some point after the Unification War, Alex was placed in Dogtown as an undercover agent.

In 2077, Alex worked with mercenary V while in Dogtown.

:When V tried to betray Songbird, she noticed and warned Kurt Hansen about the impostors. Moments later Kurt executed Alex. After the events of Somewhat Damaged, the NUSA recovered her body and was sent to be interred at her home. Solomon Reed thought that given Alex's service record in Night City, he felt the right thing to do was to leave behind a memorial at the North Oak Columbarium. Her niche's epitaph reads: "Not the retirement you dreamed of... but the kind that fate dealt. I hope you can forgive me. And thanks for everything."

:A few days after the incident at NCX Spaceport, Alex met V at her bar and informed them that she had been put to the task of eliminating V. She was, however, perfectly willing to wait for their timer to run out, as she assumed they only had a few months of life left. She also informed V that the FIA was pulling their agents out of NC, with her being permanently reassigned to "somewhere sunny." Some time later, V received a postcard from Alex, revealing that she ended up in Monte Carlo as she was promised.

## All Along the Watchtower
All Along the Watchtower is a Main Job in . It concludes "The Star" ending and awards the associated achievement.

Walkthrough

Several weeks have passed after the raid on Arasaka Tower, and V wakes up in Panam Palmer's Warhorse at the Coronado Dam overlooking Night City. Panam and V talk about how far they've come since they met, which is interrupted by V coughing up blood- a sign of their worsening condition; as well as their plans to leave Night City with the rest of the Aldecaldos to head for Arizona, along with all the plundered loot they've stolen from the corporation and discuss plans to use their connections to try and save V's life.

After talking, Panam heads back to her car, telling V to take their time looking at the city one more time before they get in the car and head to meet up with the others. As they ride to the Solar Arrays in Jackson Plains, they are joined by Mitch Anderson, who playfully teases Panam about the upcoming sandstorm as they drive to the meeting point.

Once arrived at the Solar Arrays, V talks with the other Aldecaldos–Cassidy Righter and Carol Emeka–before rejoining Mitch and Panam, who discuss using a famous Aldecaldo Tunnel to evade both Arasaka, who'll be looking for their stolen tech at every checkpoint, and Border Patrol, who'll want to stop any trespassers who try to jump the Border Crossing.

:V asks Panam and Mitch about the possible security measures the SoCal Border Patrol will have on the way to the tunnel. Panam will tell V not to worry, explaining they'll know what to do, and mentions Cassidy and Carol will also help distract Arasaka from ever finding them.

Mitch and Panam tell V that after they escape through the tunnel, they'll collapse it to prevent anyone from following them, then make their way toward the meeting point with the rest of the Aldecaldos, then together move toward Tuscon. Panam reassures V, telling them they won't be alone anymore starting today.

Boarding the Basilisk, the group charge across the Badlands and against the upcoming sandstorm, with V and Panam following them not far behind as they use it as cover to escape the Border Patrol drones, with Cassidy and Carol breaking off to distract them as planned, wishing them good luck. Heading to the tunnel entrance, V hands the controls to Panam, who use the modded Turbothrusters to ram through and into the tunnel, before making their way out the other side.

Having left Night City, the following ending cinematic will play where V will get out of the Basilisk to sit back and take in the night air as it hovers across the open water. Sitting back, V looks at the bullet pendant they received from Misty Olszewski, before taking it off and letting go of the necklace.

Journal Entry
:So you decided to ditch the City of Dreams - start anew, start fresh. I went through a few fresh starts in my life, too. And you know what? Don't regret a damn thing. You won't either. Give my regards to the South. And when you hear Johnny's voice, go ahead and smile, but don't bother to answer. It'll just be a voice on the radio recorded long ago, a fading reproduction, a flickering memory. You'll be someone completely different. Take care, V.

Objectives
*Join Panam.
*Talk to Panam.
*Get in the car.
*
**Find out who's waiting for you at the camp.
**Talk to Judy/River/Kerry.
*Discuss the plan with Mitch and Panam.
*Get in the Basilisk.
*Talk to Panam.
*Follow the nomads.
*Cross the border.

The All Foods Factory (also known as the All Foods Protein Processing Plant or All Foods Plant) is a defunct factory located in Northside, in the Watson district of northern Night City.

History
This synthetic protein factory was once owned by the food and beverage giant All Foods, who used these facilities to produce protein slurries that were marketed as "meat" or close enough. At some point, this Night City branch was shut down unexpectedly, with the factory being abandoned. Soon enough it became overrun by members of the local Maelstrom gang, who turned the place into one of their main hideouts in Watson.

Unlike the Totentanz club, the factory was a completely restricted area with high security and 30-40 gang members at the site. Patricia, the main lieutenant of the gang's leader Brick, conducted business with their mole in Militech from here, and it was also the main hideout of Royce, a gang member dissatisfied with Brick's leadership.

In 2077, Royce planned to stage a coup and tried to meet with Brick. The leader initially refused, as he was confident in his position. Only when Royce messaged Brick to come to the production floor with all of his guys, Brick realized he might be in trouble and told his supporters to go into hiding. Once Brick arrived by himself the next day, he was captured and imprisoned in a makeshift cell by Royce, while he and his lieutenant Dum Dum took over the gang.

At some point that same year, mercenaries V and Jackie Welles came to the factory to pick up a Militech MT0D12 "Flathead", which was bought from the gang by the fixer Dexter DeShawn. They were initially welcomed by Dum Dum, Kurt and Lars, but came into conflict with Royce, when they brought up that Brick already received the payment for the bot.

## Altiera Cunningham
- aka：Alt
- status：Deceased (physically)
Active (engram)
- dob：August 27
- dod：April 16, 2013 (original)
- place_of_death：Arasaka Tower
- home：Night City (2013)
Pre-DataKrash Cyberspace
- gender：Female
- hair_color：Blonde
- eyes：Green
- partner：Johnny Silverhand (boyfriend)
- affiliation：ITS (formerly)
- role：SPI
Netrunner
- voiced_by：Alix Wilton Regan

Altiera "Alt" Cunningham, was the best netrunner in Night City during the 2000s-2010s. She was described as a beautiful and talented woman; having worked for the ITS Corporation, and being the developer of the infamous Soulkiller program. Cunningham was also the girlfriend of the famous rockerboy Johnny Silverhand.

Her whole life changed however, when she was kidnapped by the Arasaka Corporation, who used her to create a version of the program for them, and later made her the program's first victim. Now her consciousness exists only as a digital ghost in the Net.

Biography
Early life
Cunningham was one of those rare few geniuses who could not only run the Net, but also create new concepts and new code. She wasn't just your typical netrunner, but one of the best programmers in the world.

Like many others during her age, Cunningham spent money to upgrade her body, enhancing her beauty with the best European bodysculpting money could buy. She also bought the neural processors and interface plugs needed to navigate the Net, and a golden cyberarm with a hidden compartment, specially designed to hold a Federated Arms X-22 pistol.

Shortly after the Pacifica region of the Net was formed, Cunningham would run the region with Rache Bartmoss, later calling these times her best netrunning memories.

Cunningham was famed for her skills at seeing software development on a different level. Due to her abilities, she was poached by the mysterious ITS corporation. During her employment, she began development on a revolutionary human/AI transfer program. Alt kept investing heavily in neural processing cyberware to augment her netrunning skills.

During this time she met Johnny Silverhand and the two entered into a relationship.

2013
Fascinated by the development of artificial intelligence, Cunningham made a breakthrough in the transfer and containment of intelligence, both AI and the human mind. The unnamed program was able to transfer the user's mind into the Net and explore independent of their existing body. Her employer, ITS, capitalized on the breakthrough and developed it further into a weapon known as the Soulkiller. Instead of transferring personalities, it imprisoned them.

On April 15, 2013, while leaving a concert with her boyfriend, she was kidnapped by gangers and Silverhand was left for dead. The kidnappers were hired by Toshiro Harada, who wanted Cunningham to recreate the program for the Arasaka Corporation. While captive, she rebuilt the software from memory and watched closely with the fear of Arasaka testing it on her. To prevent this, she built a fail-safe to ensure that she could make her escape.

Having survived his injuries, a team led by Johnny Silverhand started a riot at Arasaka Tower, with his legion of fans. Fearing the worst, Harada used the software on Cunningham, but before he was successful she managed to fend off the attack, killing the Arasaka netrunner team and incapacitating Harada's bodyguard, Akira, from within the Arasaka mainframe. Silverhand detonated an explosive charge which gave Harada the chance to disconnect Cunningham from her body. Silverhand killed Harada and disconnected Cunningham from the Arasaka mainframe, killing her in the process. Silverhand left with her lifeless body, unknowingly leaving her digital form behind.

Not long after, Cunningham's digital personality contacted Silverhand telling him she was in Arasaka Tower. She also told him not to come after her.

2020s
In 2021, during the Fourth Corporate War, Alt Cunningham's digital ghost was contacted by Militech, who asked for her help in destroying the Soukiller 2.0. She agreed with the hopes of taking revenge on Arasaka and convinced Rache Bartmoss to help in the effort. She was later captured by Arasaka, who forced her to develop the Soulkiller 3.0.

In 2023, Militech deployed an attack on the Arasaka Towers, with Johnny Silverhand leading one of the teams with the hopes of rescuing Cunningham. After infiltrating the building, she was contacted by Spider Murphy, who informed her of Bartmoss' death before downloading her into the memory core. During the conversation, Cunningham gave Spider a piece of the Soulkiller to use if needed. Later, however, after the team got ambushed by Adam Smasher and two squads of Arasaka Troopers, Cunningham was scattered into the Net by Spider, with hopes of retrieving her someday.

2045
In the years following the Fourth Corporate War, Cunningham set up a digital haven for the other victims of Soulkiller. It was rumored to be hidden on a server somewhere in Night City or in the great white north of Canada, but after the bioplague wiped out the population, the "Ghost Town" was established in the ruins of Hong Kong.

2077
In 2077, Cunningham was still a very powerful entity on the Net. A memorial niche to Alt Cunningham can be found at the Columbarium in Night City. V encountered her after being forced to cross the Blackwall by Voodoo Boys; while doing so, they relived Silverhand's memories of Cunningham before her physical death in 2013. The hope of the Voodoo Boys was that Cunningham would reveal herself to a familiar entity from her previous life.

Cunningham recognized the engram of Silverhand's and brought him and V to a safe place behind Blackwall. She revealed that she is nothing but an image of Alt Cunningham and is not actually her. The rogue AI explained that the engram was transferred to the Net during the 2013 raid. However, due to Silverhand disconnecting the physical embodiment of Alt Cunningham while she was still in the Net, her consciousness was split from the engram leaving her mind stuck in the Net while her body and consciousness laid dying in Silverhand's hands.

The engram kept the image of Alt Cunningham to keep itself from going insane as any other AI would in the Net over a prolonged time, as Mikoshi didn't exist back then to protect engrams from interference.

After Silverhand revealed the nature of V's goals, Cunningham did not see the situation as her problem. The two offered to take her to Mikoshi, which was the tech she would need. The AI explained that if they destroyed Mikoshi, she could try to create an engram of V if they were subjected to a Soulkiller program and then would transfer it back to their body. Doing so would kill V but allow the engram to be transferred back to their body allowing their brain to overwrite Silverhand's engram.

:Upon getting control over Arasaka Tower, Cunningham killed all employees within the area of Mikoshi and warned an elite soldier was on his way to intercept V. Cunningham destroyed the Mikoshi subspace and forced all the occupants to merge with her (members of the Secure Your Soul program as well as victims of Soulkiller). Once at the Mikoshi access point, she instructed V to pull in and submerge themselves so they would not fry. The AI tried to use the Soulkiller on V to ensure they were put back in their body. However she mentioned she could not repair the damage done to V's body, and that they would have six months to live. As for Silverhand, the body would accommodate his psyche without issue. She asked for whoever would remain should go back with her beyond the Blackwall.

## Anders Hellman
- status：Alive
- home：Night City
- gender：Male
- affiliation：Arasaka
Kang Tao (briefly)
- role：Corporate
- voiced_by：Alec Newman

Anders Hellman is a prominent bioengineer and central character in , most known for having the leading role in the creation of the Relic program.

Biography
Early life
Anders Hellman was an expert in neural networks and had a number of successful patents under his name, He was considered to be one of the cornerstones of Arasaka scientific project development. His most prominent role within the megacorporation was steering the advancement of the Relic Project as its director. Using the Soulkiller's source code, Hellman created a new piece of technology that is capable of communicating with personality constructs. His invention, regardless of being a celebrated breakthrough, remained a generally controversial topic.

During his time working with as the Relic Project director he was in personal contact with Saburo Arasaka and his children, being on a first-name basis with Hanako Arasaka.

2077
In 2077, a Relic prototype was stolen by Yorinobu Arasaka and taken to Konpeki Plaza in Night City. At one point, Hellman contacted him to warn him that the biochip was not ready or functional, and that he should consult either his father Saburo or him before taking action.
In a later phone call, Hellman expressed concerns about personal liability. Yorinobu showed no sympathy, complaining about his father instead, and was only willing to check Hellman's notes he had sent.
Presumably as a consequence of this, Hellman alerted Saburo about the biochip's theft, which led to the latter and Hanako Arasaka to travel to Night City on the Kujira. Caught between a rock and a hard place, Hellman begun negotiating employment status with Kang Tao.

Defection
During or shortly after Yorinobu's rise to CEO of Arasaka, Hellman deserted the corporation without formally terminating his employment contract, defecting to Kang Tao. However, the extraction was not covert enough to elude the attention of Rogue Amendiares, who tracked the engineer down.
The AV transporting him was brought down over Jackson Plains by V and Panam Palmer. The Kang Tao escort's subsequent efforts of evacuating Hellman to the nearest CHOOH2 station were foiled and the VIP was tracked down and, despite his attempts to engage in dialogue, incapacitated and taken to Sunset Motel.

The Aldecaldos nomad clan, who had taken initial casualties after approaching the downed AV in a presumably hostile manner, worked with the mercenaries, concealing their tracks.

Hellman opened the subsequent interrogation by asking for his location and whether the mercenary had been sent by Yorinobu. At V's reassurance, he mistook them for the hiring agent of a rival corporation, offering his loyalty for sale.

Once the mercenary revealed that Silverhand's engram was killing them, Hellman had to admit that the project had not left the trial phase by the time he left Arasaka. Where the previous version of the Relic had been used to communicate with pre-saved engrams, the prototype had been designed at Saburo Arasaka's personal commission to install and activate the personality construct in a new, "neurally indifferent" body.
Intrigued by the scientific challenge in front of him, Hellman connected his personal link to V. He interrupted the subsequent examination to give the mercenary the news that their neural network had deteriorated to the point where it would no longer function without the chip. The only recommendation he had was a hospice in Sweden to minimize pain during the terminal stages.

V proved unwilling to accept this suggestion, and they and Hellman queried each other for details. He asked if the construct had influenced their decision-making and revealed that a violent takeover of Johnny Silverhand's engram was unlikely in the favour of a more gradual takeover. When it became clear that the mercenary refused the hospice, Hellman offered to help them if they accompanied him to Kang Tao, or giving them the blueprints if they thought anyone else could help them.

At that point, the interrogation was interrupted by the arrival of Goro Takemura, who had been previously called by V and wanted Hellman as a witness about Saburo Arasaka's murder due to his close contact with Yorinobu in the time prior. When the mercenary left the room, Hellman tried to build rapport by appealing to the ex-bodyguard's more civilized side, but found himself threatened with waterboarding instead.

:Hellman arrived with Takemura to pick up V as they headed to rescue Hanako Arasaka from the Arasaka Estate, expressing low confidence in the merc's ability to stick to the plan due to the engram's progressive effect on their psyche. Revealing the identity of the engram to Takemura, he warned him to keep an eye on them as the mission developed.
Takemura did not appreciate the warning and even went so far as to threaten Hellman for a perceived insult of V.
As an explanation why he had gone unpunished for his attempted desertion, he briefly noted that he was worth more alive than harmed or dead.

:
::Seeing V aboard the Arasaka Orbital Station, Hellman explained that despite the successful surgery, the damage it caused had been too severe and that V would only live for another six months. By authorization of Hanako Arasaka, he then presented them with a contract to join the Secure Your Soul program, storing a digitized copy of V's psyche in Mikoshi until a new body became available. Hellman told V that they were free to refuse this offer, but warned that the alternative would be a short and painful life.

::
:::Once V took the document into their hands, Hellman casually mentioned that since a digitized psyche was not considered an individual, but rather property of the Arasaka corporation, and that the contract itself was in fact the relinquishment of human rights. He assured V that this was well-known to the program's current participants, and nobody had yet complained.

::
:::After V refused to sign the contract, Hellman left their fate to the Arasaka staff. He expressed unspoken anger at V's decision and walked out of the room.

Andrew Jones is the sheriff of the Southern Californian town of Yucca in Los Padres County.

Biography
Andrew Jones served in a military special forces operations unit known as the "Silver Shoguns" during the Unification War. After the conflict ended, Jones became the sheriff of the small town of Yucca, Los Padres County, in the Badlands of the NUSA-loyalist state of Southern California. He bore a strong prejudice against outsiders to Yucca, especially nomads.

If V has the Nomad lifepath, Sheriff Jones caught V in Mike's autoshop. After probing V's intentions and confirming his suspicion they were a nomad, Jones denied V permission to use the nearby telecom tower and ordered them to leave Yucca immediately.

## Andrew Weyland
- aka：Boa Boa
- status：Deceased
- place_of_birth：Montego Bay, Jamaica
- gender：Male
- relative：Crispin Weyland (son)
- affiliation：Water Leopards
Petrochem

- role：Solo
- appears_books：

Andrew "Boa Boa" Weyland is a character featured in .

Biography
Andrew Weyland leads one of the most terrifying black ops units in the corporate world: the Water Leopards. The Water Leopards are a group of Jamaican mercenaries that freelanced successfully for several years before hooking up with Angus Youngblood. Since Youngblood joined Petrochem, they have become part of the company's military forces.

Weyland is heavily into Rastafarian Mysticism, and he uses it as a tool to terrorize his targets and enemies. A ruthless and cruel man who enjoys his work and never tires of killing, he is a lethal enemy. He is also completely loyal to Angus Youngblood, although nominally a corporation employee. Weyland is a skilled soldier, and he aspires to command all of Petrochem's forces. Youngblood has promised to oblige him when he seizes power, but the Water Leopards have an acrimonious relationship with the regular soldiers, and such a move could prove dangerous. Weyland and Marshall Rock Shepard dislike and distrust each other, but they work together as their jobs dictate.

He has survived personal confrontations with Morgan Blackhand, Jenni Flexx, and John Jones (no slouch at hand-to-hand combat), but his experience is too specific for a number one slot. The Water Leopards have suffered setbacks—they lost two of their original twelve members last year, allegedly due to corporate infighting and poor intelligence. If this is true, then we may see the Leopards go freelance again soon.

He had a son named Crispin who became a mercenary like his father. Boa Boa died before 2077, his niche can be found in the Columbarium. His epitaph reads: "He tried to shape reality at a lethal cost."

Description
Weyland is a tall, imposing Jamaican, with a full set of braided dreadlocks. He sports the piercing, yellow, cybernetic eyes that are the trademark of the Water Leopards. He has a light-tattoo of a snakeskin pattern over his entire body, from which his troops coined his nickname of Boa Boa.

引文：Anna Hamill is a blue-blooded cop, through and through. The kind you'd expect to see in some NCPD promo. Beautiful, smart, honest to a fault. In other words, a really bad fit for Night City.（Regina Jones）

Anna Hamill is a character in .

Biography
Early life
Anna Hamill worked as a patrol officer in Night City. Amidst the rife corruption of the NCPD, Anna remained honest and was against any form of injustice. Her intentions were always pure, and she was one of the few good cops in town looking to make a difference. This, however, did not sit well with her less ethical colleagues. She would often become involved in matters the NCPD were already well aware of but simply turned a blind eye to. Despite the hostility from her colleagues, she persisted. While decent and honest, Anna is shown to be quick tempered and impulsive.

2077
In 2077, Anna began working undercover in a rented apartment above Watson's Kabuki Market. During her investigative work on a smuggling ring, Anna had managed to stumble upon systemic corruption at the highest levels. In her pursuit of the truth, she endangered at least two witnesses, promising them protection that Anna was either unwilling or unable to truly provide. This even included information on the NCPD cooperating with the Tyger Claws to cover up traces leading all the way to Jotaro Shobo's trafficking of victims for his XBD workshop, and the subsequent sale of the "orphaned" cyberware through people like Finn "Fingers" Gerstatt. This enraged Anna so much so that she began killing involved NCPD officers. Her former colleagues that had directly benefited from these illicit actions hired a fixer to prevent further discovery by removing Anna from the equation. However, the fixer they had contracted was Regina Jones, a former investigative journalist, who had a soft spot for truth seekers. Regina hired a mercenary named V for the job and requested that they seek other options to remove her.

Whilst Anna continued her investigation in the rented apartment, she was confronted by V, pulling her gun and demanding answers as to why they were there.

:V can try to negotiate with Anna in an attempt to have her back off for her own safety but fail, or simply follow through with the contract and execute Anna to protect the corrupt NCPD officers involved.

:If V speaks calmly and logically to Anna, she will reluctantly discontinue her investigation, declaring that she despises Night City and intends to leave.

:
::If V chose the Nomad lifepath, being an ex-nomad, they can inspire Anna to join a nomad clan instead, as their ideologies closely match her own. She can later be found at the Aldecaldos Mobile Camp and later Nomad Camp. There she is found playing with several children and tells V that she misses Night City, but feels good overall regarding her decision.

:
::If V is either a Corpo or Streetkid, several days after encountering Anna, V will find a dead NCPD officer dumped in a pile of garbage and possessing a data shard, located in an alley near Hamill's hotel. The conversation on the shard reveals that Anna, instead of leaving Night City, was out for the blood of every corrupt NCPD officer she could find. Several days after this, a news broadcast will reveal that one Anna Hamill was killed after entering an NCPD precinct and executing a number of officers before being eliminated herself. The official motive was filed as cyberpsychosis, while unofficial reports stated desperation.

Database Entry

- transcript：Want to live until a ripe, old age in Night City? Then learn to turn a blind eye. You see some little punks drag your neighbor into a dark alleyway? Look away. Notice a badge taking eddies from a Tyger Claw member? Look down and check if your shoelaces are tied. Stolen implants from the scavengers being sold at the market stalls? Buy them – they're cheaper than the legal ones anyway. Most folks understand these basic rules, but not Anna Hamill – she seems to be allergic to any kind of injustice. When she sees a misdeed, her entire body screams, "react!" It sounds ridiculous, but some people are just good at their core, like Anna – which makes it even more of a shame that she works at Night City's most corrupt institution.

Associated Quests

Anna Nox is a Mox leader and manager of one of their warehouses on Longshore North in .

Biography
Anna worked at Lizzie's Bar and managed a nearby Mox warehouse. Following the death of a fellow Mox, she commenced with her own private investigation into the crime that had taken place. Starting with an XBD, Anna's associate Lil Bex, contracted the crack-BD-tuner Hal Cantos. Hal was required to quickly isolate code from the XBD containing the death of a girl under the Moxes care, consequently allowing the investigators to trace the source of the XBD's creation.

According to one of two surviving eyewitness statements, Anna screamed in a way nobody had ever heard before while viewing the isolated AV, prior to attacking everyone in sight with her Higurashi 20-13 Mantis Blades. Lil Bex was the first to die, while Hal managed to hide in a shipping container for the duration of the event.

All of the Moxes are linked to the same localnet, so it is possible to disable some of Anna's cyberware by linking into the deceased. A Mox survivor of the attack, while advising linking cyberware, also notes that the only foreseen solution for Anna is to kill her.
