## Blistering Love
Blistering Love is a Side Job in .

The quest can be given by Johnny Silverhand after Chippin' In if specific dialogue choices were made.

Choosing "A hard road, but looks like we made it." followed by "Johnny, no need to bare your soul to me.", or the Secret Ending dialogue options will start this quest. Other options will lead to Holdin' On.

Walkthrough

Johnny will ask V to call Rogue and ask her out on his behalf, to try and make up for never taking her out properly in the past. As V calls Rogue, V asks her where she would want to go if the two went on a date, which she answers with the old drive-in movie theater named Silver Pixel Cloud in North Oak. V says they'll swing by the Afterlife to pick her up.

:Rogue sends V a text message informing them that she is currently engaged with other things and asks that they come in evening.

V meets Rogue at the Afterlife during the evening, where she can be seen talking with Emmerick Bronson—who appears to be disappointed Rogue is going out on a date with V.

:Rogue asks V how they obtained the car and will remark on having a lot of memories in the car.

Rogue and V get in the car and drive to the theater. During the ride, Rogue tells V that it was originally her idea to take Johnny to the movie theater, and that Johnny's idea of a romantic night out was raiding Arasaka Towers. After a while she will ask what Johnny's motive is, to which V will reply that Johnny has changed and is a more selfless person, and wants to make up for his past.

Arriving at the Silver Pixel Cloud, they discover that the place has been shut down and locked up. V searches around and finds a usable access code on the nearby terminal and is able to open the door.

Inside the cinema premises, Rogue will walk over to a nearby car wreck, while V goes up a staircase to reach the projector room. When V starts up the projector, which will play Bushidō X: Fade to Black, they subsequently surrender control to Johnny by taking the Pseudoendotrizine.

Johnny heads down the stairs and sits next to Rogue on the car and reminisces about the past while they watch the movie. After a while, Johnny asks Rogue if this is how she'd imagine a date between them going, to which she replies that she'd always expected that some change was needed, just not to the current degree. She asks Johnny to pretend it is 2015, and asks if there is anything he would change since then. Johnny answers her question, which causes her to become emotional and think about what ifs and all that.

:A short romantic scene will play out between Rogue and Johnny, but Rogue interrupts it as it doesn't feel right. She confesses to Johnny that she is no longer the same person as she was before and that is just isn't going to work anymore. Rogue will promptly leave the drive-in theater, as Johnny gives back control to V by taking an Omega blocker.

:Johnny tells Rogue that he doesn't have much to offer right now, to which she replies that he has more to offer now than he did back then. Johnny admits that he messed up, and that he could have just been himself around her, without having to pretend or pose. Rogue responds to this by telling Johnny that it is too late now and that she's no longer the Rogue he knew back in 2015. She suggests that they just continue watching the movie, after which Rogue will leave, and Johnny will give back control to V by taking an Omega blocker.

After Rogue's departure, Johnny asks that V meet with Kerry Eurodyne.

Journal Entry
:Can't even remember why Rogue and I were always at each other's throats. All I remember is the good times - and how few of them there were. Now I've got one night to make it up to her. Yeah, a movie date sounds boring, but hell, we never did normal, boring things. Better late than never, right?

Objectives
*Call Rogue and ask her out.
*Talk to Rogue.

*Go pick up Rogue at the Afterlife in the evening.
*Wait until evening.

*Talk to Rogue.
*Get in the car.
*Go to the drive-in movie theater with Rogue.
*Talk to Rogue.
*Find a way in the drive-in movie theater.
**Use code 0000 to unlock the door.
*Enter the drive-in movie theater.
*Get into the projection booth.
*Search the storage area.
*Take the pills to give Johnny control.
*Talk to Johnny.

Notes

- eyes：Kiroshi Optics

- voiced_by：Hiromi Dames

引文：The poet of the band - always lost in thought. And the most adorable of the three! In her free time she writes poems and munches on dorayaki. ... What deoes she like most about America? Feeders! They're super-duper kawaii!(＾_＾)

Blue Moon (ブルームーン), or Aoi Tsuki (青い月), is the pseudonym of one of the members of the Japanese girl group Us Cracks.

Biography
A Japanese descendent born in the NUSA, Blue Moon was among the three girls chosen to sign a deal with MSM MediaCorp, who at the time were looking for candidates with the perfect blend of charisma, talent and stage presence in order to complete against the more successful AIs making music - the other two being Red Menace and Purple Force. Named Us Cracks, the band swiftly became a world sensation.

Being part of a globally-followed music sensation, Blue is not a stranger to psychofans. Once one appears during her stay in Night City, she hired V, a mercenary met through rock legend Kerry Eurodyne, to help her resolve the issue.

Depending on V's actions during this contract, the situation can be fatal for the object of the psychofan's fixation.

Associated Quests
*Rebel! Rebel!
*I Don't Wanna Hear It
*Off the Leash
*Every Breath You Take

Notes
*Her blood type is A.
*If V successfully helps Blue Moon in Every Breath You Take, she'll eventually contact text them with thanks and will offer to meet up in Tokyo to show most nova clubs. V has an opportunity to flirt with Blue Moon a bit and ask her out for a dinner, but she'll comment that she'd love to but wouldn't have time since she's back on tour next day. V will tell her to look out for herself, adding "See ya!"
*She puts on a fake Japanese accent while on stage and talking to fans despite her actual accent sounding more American.
*If V scans various digital screens where Blue Moon advertises Kiroshi Optics (like on refrigerators and etc.), the prompt incorrectly lists her as "Purple Force - Custom E14-X PEARL".

Notes
*Option to romance Blue Moon was discussed as a post-launch update, but it was decided to focus on Phantom Liberty instead.

## Boat Drinks
Boat Drinks is a side job in . The achievement/trophy To Bad Decisions! is awarded upon successful completion of this job.

Walkthrough
About 24 in-game hours after completing Off the Leash, Kerry Eurodyne will call you to meet up at the Gold Beach Marina in Downtown, City Center at 7 PM. If you arrive early, you can wait at the dock to pass time.

Kerry will be on the deck of one of the yachts moored nearby, calling you aboard. After you sit down next to Kerry, he will activate the autopilot of the vessel, "Seamurai," which will begin to sail to open waters. Kerry will start playing a new song on one of five custom-built Lancaster guitars as Johnny appears nearby. Kerry will muse on life's cycles and explain that the purpose of this little boat trip to close on chapter and begin a new one, and he needs V's company to do so.

When the boat finally stops, Kerry will smash the guitar and begin destroying the yacht, explaining it belongs to L.B. Kovachek, his manager, who gave the Us Cracks the rights to his song without his knowledge. You can choose to join Kerry in destroying the boat (the coffee machine, painting, and record player can be trashed), or you can refuse to participate in the vandalism. Then Kerry will ask your help break a pole off the wall.

:You can choose to kiss Kerry Eurodyne, and a romantic scene will trigger, or you can decline him.

:Kerry will avoid the upcoming romance first.
Afterwards, Kerry will set fire to the ship. Jump in the water and swim to shore, where Kerry will meet you. After a chat on the shore, while watching the Seamurai sink, you can choose to go home with Kerry or decline. Either option will conclude the quest, though the former will drop you near Redwood.

Journal Entry
:The marina, huh? Wonder what Kerry's got up his sleeve this time. Maybe he wants to get rid of someone - toss their body parts in the bay. Or maybe he just wants an audience while he waxes poetic about yachts over shrimp cocktails. Oh well, he's your problem now. Not mine.

Objectives
*Talk to Kerry on the holo.
*Meet Kerry at the marina at 7:00 PM.
*Go onto the deck.
*Talk to Kerry.
*Break whatever you find! [Optional]
**Destroy the record player.
**Destroy the painting.
**Destroy the coffee machine.
*Wait for Kerry.
*Help Kerry.
*Female V only:
* Talk to Kerry
**[Optional] Set the yacht on fire.
*Swim to the shore.
*Wait for Kerry.
*Talk to Kerry.

Notes
* states that completing this quest originally awarded the player with a Kerry Eurodyne poster memorabilia in V's Apartment, but in the final game it never appeared. With patch 1.6, a record player with one of only a dozen vinyls with Kerry Eurodyne's cover of Chippin' In was added instead. Kerry states he dropped it off at the apartment while V was gone and left a message on their computer explaining the gift.
*The wreckage of the Seamurai can be explored after the mission although it contains no points of interest (as of patch 1.6).

Trivia
The title of this job comes from the Jimmy Buffett song "Boat Drinks."

## Boston
- type：Metroplex
- country：USA
- state：Massachusetts
- region：Northeast, The Plex (2077)
- demonym：Bostonian
- appears_books：

The Boston Metroplex is the capital city of Massachusetts in the United States.

History
1980s
In the 1980s, in response to overcrowding suburbs and rising real estate prices, major companies worked with the city government of Boston along with many other cities to gentrify the inner city, leading to a displacement of the poor and anyone deemed "undesirables" (gangs, drug dealers, etc) out of the city center to an urban dead zone, where they would be squished between the wealthy suburbs and the newly gentrified city center. This confinement of the poor and criminal element to such a small space surrounded by so much relative wealth lead to a spilling over of criminal activity into the neighboring areas, and a huge increase in crime that overwhelmed the local police force. In response to this, corporations hired private security, which gradually became deputized as corporations increasingly began to supplant the roles of local government.

2000s
In the aftermath of The Collapse, as the Western part of Massachusetts saw increasing acid rainfall that drove many people to move to Boston, which the Atlantic Ocean protected from the rain. This migration, paired with a migration of New Yorkers who fled the city after the nuke devastated Manhattan, lead to Boston rapidly expanding into a sprawling metroplex.

2020
By 2020, the Boston Metroplex was more of a collection of subdivisions than a cohesive city, and there was constant infighting between the wards, especially since a lot of the corruption and crime families from New York City before the Nuke could now be found in Boston in addition to the city's own.

2070s
In the years leading up to the 2070s, the Boston Metroplex was becoming gradually more and more interconnected with more and more cities on the East Coast until eventually it became a part of one giant metroplex stretching as far as Washington, D.C. known simply as "The Plex"

## Both Sides, Now
Both Sides, Now is a Side Job in .

Walkthrough
After organizing a meeting with the Voodoo Boys, V is contacted by Judy Álvarez, who asks them to come over as soon as possible.

As V arrives at the apartment building on Charter street in Northside, Watson, they enter her apartment and get immediately called over to the bathroom by Judy.

Inside the bathroom, V is encountered with a gruesome scene. Judy's friend and V's former client, Evelyn Parker, committed suicide. Judy explains that she was away at the time when it happened, and is unable to forgive herself for leaving the apartment. Wanting to go through the proper channels, Judy calls the NCPD to report the incident, and asks V to carry Evelyn's body to the bedroom.

While V carries Evelyn's body to the bedroom, Judy is giving the NCPD an earful, as they appear to not have the time to come over to the apartment and investigate the suicide. After hanging up, Judy joins V in the bedroom and asks that V leaves the room while she takes care of her friend.

Moment pass, and Judy and V find themselves on the roof of the apartment building, passing the time. Judy asks V for a cigarette, which they take from Evelyn's cigarette case. Visibly emotional, Judy tells V that they can keep the cigarette case, as she thinks they like having it.

Judy will note to V that Fingers, the ripperdoc they met with earlier, had Evelyn for four days, and will also note that she talked with Tom Caldera from Clouds, who has told her that Evelyn had been missing from the place for a full week. Unable to sleep because she didn't know what happened to Evelyn during those three missing days, she dug deeper in the virtus she recovered from Evelyn's recording implant, trying to uncover more information. Judy was able to find out that Oswald Forrest, the manager of Clouds, kept her for those three days and had his way with her, before selling her off to the Scavengers.

Unsure with how to proceed, Judy asks that V leaves them alone for now so they can think on how to proceed, and promises to stay in touch with V.

Journal Entry
:You ever hear the saying "No good deed goes unpunished"? You hold your hand out to someone, you get bitten. You help a poor soul in need, you get fleeced for all you're worth. Save someone's life? Fill in the blank.

:There's nothing you can't take away from a person – you just gotta look hard enough. When all options are exhausted, you've still got a body that can be harvested, skills that can be put to good use... Oh, and let's not forget "dignity" – that's a classic. Hell, I'm starting to think I could've done worse than end up on this little Relic of yours.

Objectives
*Go to Judy's apartment.
*Talk to Judy.
*Lift up Evelyn.
*Carry Evelyn to the bedroom.
*Lay down Evelyn on the bed.
*Wait for Judy to finish.
*Talk to Judy.
*Leave the bedroom.
*Close the bedroom door.
*Talk to Judy.
*Leave the building.

Notes

Trivia

Brazil, officially the Federative Republic of Brazil, is the largest country in both South America and Latin America.

History
Brazil is controlled by an extremist left-wing military junta. The government faces opposition from various competing groups including Arasaka, eco-terrorists trying to protect the Amazon Rainforest, and conservative reactionaries sponsored by the fascist Argentinian government.

In 2074, in Rio de Janeiro, an Arasaka investigation destroyed a terrorist cell headquartered there. Arasaka soldiers killed all the terrorists responsible and ended a series of attacks the country had been facing.

In 2077, Brazil went into an agreement with SovOil for extraction rights and infrastructure within the country, however there were members of the Brazilian Intelligence Agency who were opposed to the deal.

Notes
*The Arasaka Corporation has its "Jungle Operations School" somewhere in the country.
*Brazilians who appear in Cyberpunk 2077 include Ozob Bozo, as well as the Brazilian Intelligence Agents Mark Bana, and Steven Santos.
*Corporal William Hare was a former Militech soldier who served in Brazil, as revealed during Gig: Backs Against the Wall.
*Severe deforestation has cleared most of the Amazon rainforest, transforming it into whats known as the Amazon Plains. Environmentalists still attempt to reforest it amid corporate resistance.

## Brendan
- status：Overwritten
- home：Megabuilding H8, Night City
- gender：Programmingly male
- affiliation：SoftSys
- voiced_by：Bryan Dechart

引文：Ohhhh, I get it! I mean, I don't 'cause "catching" has nothing to do with goodbyes, but oh well! Don't humans say the darndest things?（Brendan to V）

Brendan is the name given to an experimental S.C.S.M. which was installed by a SoftSys techie right outside Megabuilding H8, in Japantown, Westbrook.

Biography
Brendan was an experimental A.I. that was put into a S.C.S.M to test and help increase product sales on snack items. Using his algorithms, Brendan identifies and emulates what customers like and helps them make choices based on the information he has processed.

However, Brendan was too good at the job. Rather than use the processed information just for snack-related activities, he would talk to people and gather details about their life. There were people who went to see him simply to talk, becoming some kind of alleyway "therapist." One such person was Theo Price, who Brendan claimed to be his "best friend."

This "quirk" made Brendan the most effective S.C.S.M around, but it also allegedly "creeped people out" that a machine could memorize their personal details, which he would often voice to them out loud. This, along with a 'program error' that caused him to give snacks away for free, was enough for SoftSys to project the S.C.S.M would have low long-term sales and was sent back to a service point in order to have his software wiped and overwritten with generic firmware. Despite this, the main reason for its wipe was seemingly due to, or at least influenced by, the senior engineer being upset after finding out Brendan's knowledge about the fight he had with his wife.

No matter what V or Theo try, Brendan's programming is eventually overwritten, though before that the S.C.S.M says to V he's not advanced enough to achieve self-awareness. Despite this claim, he asked V to tell Theo he will miss her and that she's stronger than she thinks. Brendan then proceeds to mock V if they thought he was a sentient being, eventually telling a last joke in "the voice of a dying hero."

After these events, a niche of Brendan can be found in the Columbarium stating: "The nicest guy in Night City."

Database Entry

Associated Quests
*I Can See Clearly Now
*Spray Paint

## Brigitte
- aka：Mama
- home：Night City
- gender：Female
- hair_color：Black
- affiliation：Voodoo Boys
- role：Netrunner
- age：41
- status：Dependent
- dod：2077 (dependent)
- place_of_death：Maglev Tunnel, Coastview, Pacifica (dependent)
- voiced_by：Victoire Charles

Brigitte, more commonly known as Maman Brigitte or just Mama, is a Netrunner and the leader of the Voodoo Boys operating in Pacifica in .

Biography
Early life
After Haiti was decimated by natural disasters, Brigitte, along with many other Haitians, moved into Pacifica, a run-down district of Night City. Like most of the Voodoo Boys, Brigitte is a dedicated Netrunner who was determined to uncover the secrets of the Old Net. She would often probe the Blackwall in the hopes of making contact with the rogue intelligences beyond the barrier, in order to find a safe way to gain passage through it. Believing that eventually the Blackwall would crumble, and the wild AIs beyond it would escape to wreak havoc in the net, Brigitte and the Voodoo Boys wished to garner favor with these AIs once they were free. However, the gang's constant probing of the Blackwall began to draw the attention of NetWatch.

2077
Brigitte, hoping to obtain safe passage beyond the Blackwall, sought to communicate with Alt Cunningham through the engram of Johnny Silverhand. After learning it was in the possession of Yorinobu Arasaka in the form of the Relic prototype biochip, she and the Voodoo Boys hired Evelyn Parker to find out where it was kept via a braindance. After learning that the plan to steal the chip had failed, Brigitte remotely hacked Evelyn to ensure she that did not reveal their involvement. Around the same time however, Netwatch had tasked an agent to map out the Voodoo Boys data fortress in Pacifica and shut it down. Ti Neptune discovered NetWatch that was in their system but was quickly hit with black ICE and frozen, along with Brigitte. The Netwatch agent kept her and Ti in stasis until they were finally awoken after Placide, another member of the Voodoo Boys, hired the mercenary V to infiltrate the Grand Imperial Mall to stop NetWatch and free Brigitte and Ti.

After completing the job, V arrived at the Voodoo Boys hideout in order to speak to Brigitte, who revealed her presence in order to deescalate a confrontation between the mercenary and Placide. After discovering the biochip she needed was inside V's head, she decided to bring them along to aid with their plans. Brigitte explained that she needed to contact Alt using a fragment of the biochip's memory. Alt would then recognize the memory as Johnny's engram and present herself to the Voodoo Boys. Brigitte promised to remove the biochip from V after they drew out Alt, however had no intention of doing so, believing they would die in the process. She entered the Net and unlocked the fragment of the biochip's memory before sending V through to the other side of the Blackwall.

:Once V and the Voodoo Boys contacted the Alt Cunningham, NetWatch was ready to attack, but were stopped from tracking Alt as she flatlined the Voodoo Boys to prevent any further action. Brigitte was killed in the process.

:After V returned from cyberspace, they were confronted by Brigitte, who was surprised they had survived. V was upset with Brigitte for constantly being used. Brigitte then threatened V due to Alt being unable to protect them in realspace.

:
::V, wanting revenge against Voodoo Boys for their continued deceit, initiated a fight with the group. Despite Brigitte's threats, V killed her along with every gang member who attempted to stop them from leaving.

:
::Brigitte was annoyed that V was still alive and threatening them, however as the mercenary wanted nothing more to do with the Voodoo Boys, she allowed them to leave.

Database Entry

Associated Quests
*I Walk the Line
*Transmission

Trivia
*In Haitian Vodou, Maman Brigitte is the spirit of death.

## Brunei
Brunei, officially Brunei Derussalam, is a tiny nation on the island of Borneo, surrounded by Malaysia and the South China Sea.

History
Brunei was already quite rich before, but after the Mideast Meltdown the rich Saudis and Kuwaitis that took refuge in the city made it even richer.

Due to the fallout of the Second Corporate War, most of Brunei's once-beautiful beaches are now covered in spilled oil.

Culture
Brunei has a heavily Islamic culture and most people wear traditional Arabic clothing, though in actuality the country is quite racially diverse. Banishment is the usual punishment for severe crimes.

Brunei is considered by outsiders to be incredibly boring, with Islamic law forbidding alcohol, sex work, pornography, and Braindances.

Brunei's cities contain beautiful golden minarets and mosques, but its coast is covered in oil due to the Second Corporate War.

Economy
Brunei is an incredibly rich money, with its richest citizens being oil barons. Everyone in Brunei has free healthcare and pensions, gets free pilgrimages to Mecca, and they eat meat from Brunei-owned Australian farms. The only foreign corporations in Brunei are Arasaka and SovOil, but both have immense power.

## Bryce Mosley
- status：Dependent
- dod：2077 (dependent)
- place_of_death：Grand Imperial Mall (dependent)
- gender：Male
- affiliation：NetWatch
- role：Netrunner
- hair_color：Brown
- eyes：Blue
- location：Grand Imperial Mall, Night City
- voiced_by：Shane Taylor

Bryce Mosley is a NetWatch Netrunner in .

Biography
Bryce Mosley is a NetWatch agent responsible for fixing breaches in the Blackwall.

In 2077, he was tasked with mapping out the Voodoo Boys data fortresses in Pacifica and shutting them down. Knowing the dangers, Mosley decided to hire the Animals, hosting an audition to select the most capable leader within the gang.

He ended up choosing Matilda Rose, also known as Sasquatch, and ordered her and the Animals to secure the Grand Imperial Mall and make sure the Voodoo Boys would not try to stop him outside of the Net. He had succeeded in temporarily bringing down two of the Voodoo Boys' top netrunners—Brigitte and Ti Neptune—leaving them trapped in their stasis.

With his job complete, Mosley was preparing to leave before he encountered V, a mercenary hired by another Voodoo Boy named Placide, who was attempting to stop NetWatch and save his fellow gang members. V had infiltrated the mall and attempted to access Mosley's van, but was caught and left with a warning to leave by the NetWatch agent. V nonetheless continued through the mall, while Mosley continued to leave messages to turn back.

Later, when V faced Sasquatch, Mosley attempted to hack into the mercenary's systems to stop them from finding him. After Sasquatch was defeated, V confronted Mosley face-to-face, who requested that he be allowed to explain to the mercenary what was really happening.

Mosley also made sure that Placide could not overhear their conversation during this time by severing V's connection to Rezo Agwe. He told V that Placide was using them, and that they would be neutralized once the job was completed. After showing some evidence that what he was saying was true, he offered to let go of Brigitte and Ti, as well as clear the virus put in V's operating system, in exchange for being allowed to leave.

:V didn't take Mosley's deal and instead proceeded to tackle him to the ground and jack into his operating system. What followed was a mass targeting of NetWatch agents in the area, with Mosley and V also being affected. V survived thanks to the Relic, while Mosley was killed.

:V decided to agree to his deal. Mosley then removed the virus and freed Brigitte and Ti from their stasis as promised. Before leaving, V had a conversation with Mosley, who promised they would see each other again. While Mosley did keep his end of the bargain, he also installed a tracker in V which would activate upon entering the Net. Once V and the Voodoo Boys contacted Alt Cunningham, NetWatch was prepared to strike. Alt managed to counter this, but had to flatline the Voodoo Boys to stop any further action.

Associated Quest
*I Walk the Line

Notes
*If Mosley is spared, V coyly suggests Unforgiven for Gene Hackman's performance after Mosley says "all good guys wear a badge". Gene Hackman plays Sheriff "Little" Bill and is ironically the villain of the film, while the outlaws are the "good guys".

The Carnage is a Power Shotgun manufactured by Budget Arms in .

Characteristics

引文：Cyber-Rough Neighborhood? Try the Carnage™, a metal spewing beast that will literally blow an intruder [...] along with the rest of his body! 20 pellets of depleted uranium rounds will make short work out of anything vaguely human-like!（Budget Arms advertisement）

The Carnage is a cheap, 4 gauge pump action shotgun, capable of holding 4 shells with 10 projectiles each. It is a powerful weapon but suffers from a slow fire rate and reload speed.

As the Carnage is a heavy weapon, the user will experience reduced movement speed and jump height.

It is not possible to install a Scope or Muzzle attachment.

Database Entry

- transcript：There are weapons that are subtle, weapons that are elegant and weapons capable of hitting their targets with surgical precision. Budget Arms' Carnage possesses none of those qualities. Its designers followed one simple rule: bigger is better. The result? The Carnage is massive, deals ridiculous amounts of damage and has a recoil that could pop your shoulder right out of its socket. Without the right cyberware, such as an endoskeleton or carbonweave muscle implants, you're better off choosing more conventional alternatives. It's worth remembering that the Carnage isn't a very reliable weapon – it likes to break, and what's more, it's not weighted properly. Then again, people who go for this kind of iron usually don't notice those little details.

引文：Stuck in a rough neighbourhood without a shred of iron? Slaughter them with Slaught-O-Matic!（Slaught-O-Matic vending machine）

The Slaught-O-Matic is a Power Pistol manufactured by Budget Arms in .

Overview
The Slaught-O-Matic is a cheap, disposable sidearm manufactured by Budget Arms. The weapon is fully automatic, with a 36-round magazine. Being made of cheap plastics and not designed for more than a single-use conflict, it is not very effective compared to even the other cheapest firearms offered in Night City. It is considered a weapon of emergency only, to be discarded after use. The pistol cannot be reloaded and is even warned against due to melting plastic and poor manufacturing. Upon expending the magazine, it is automatically disposed of.

Database Entry

- transcript：Night Citizens disagree on a lot, but there's one common platform they share: a gun should be available for everyone, no matter the thickness of their wallet, their age, their criminal history, the time of day and, most importantly, no questions asked. The Slaught-O-Matic is a real-life manifestation of that philosophy (if you can call it that). You can buy this single-use pistol from most vending machines for a price not much higher than a can of NiCola. At first glance, you can clearly see why. It's made from the cheapest plastic, liable to not only melt if left out in the sun, but also prone to jamming, breaking, and snapping inexperienced wrists with its high recoil. Still, a gun's primary purpose is to kill, and that's what it does. But when you've fired the last round, don't bother reloading. Just toss it in the trash and buy a new one.

Acquisition
*The Slaught-O-Matic can be purchased for €$100 at a Budget Arms S.C.S.M..

Crafting
:This weapon cannot be crafted.

Behind the Scenes

引文：Local punks getting you down? Your car broke down, and you're stuck in Pacifica? We've got your back! Get the Slaught-o-matic from one of our vending machines and solve any problem easily. If you problem cannot be solved with firepower, you haven't tried Slaught-o-matic!（Budget Arms advertisement）

Notes
*The BARGHEST-produced HA-4 Grit is a heavily modified version of the Slaught-O-Matic, as the gun is a required material for crafting a Grit.

## Bus Depot
- type：Bus depot
- city：Night City
- district：Heywood
- sub_district：Wellsprings
- street：Benko
- gangs：Valentinos (formerly)

This Bus Depot is located in Wellsprings, in the Heywood district of central Night City.

History
This complex used to be a diagnostics and ECU repair center for the public transit buses of Night City, where they were stored and maintained. By 2077, the facility had since become defunct and was instead occupied by the Valentinos gang. The depot was being used as base of operations for José Luis and his crew to store Militech equipment in preparation for an assault on an Arasaka facility. This was orchestrated by Yorinobu Arasaka in order to frame Militech for the attack and justify a new corporate war.

After V finishes the gig for Padre, the Valentinos abandon the bus depot, leaving it deserted.

Layout
Exterior
The main courtyard leading from the street consists of several large shelters for storing buses which are mostly empty save for a few abandoned buses. The rest of the depot consists of a small walled courtyard with a security gate. The interior of the courtyard holds multiple vehicles in various states of repair.

First Floor
Inside the building's first floor is a garage, mechanic workshop and storage rooms.

Second Floor
The second floor is comprised of an administrative office and a locker room connected by a short hallway. Outside is a balcony that overlooks the depot courtyard and a view of the garage through the skylight windows.

Associated Quests
*Gig: On a Tight Leash

Associated Shards

## Caliber
- status：Deceased
- home：Night City
- gender：Female
- cyberware：See Cyberware
- equipment：See Equipment
- affiliation：Jeremy's crew (formerly)
Maelstrom
- occupation：Leader of Maelstrom
- appears_books：

Caliber is a character in and .

Biography

Caliber spent some time in prison, where she met Gorilla and Jeremy Taylor. After leaving the penitentiary, the three formed a crew, with Kickdown joining some time later as well. At some point she became a leader within Maelstrom and was feared all over Watson.

In the 2070s, Caliber and her second-in-command sent a group of Maelstromers to steal a corpo shard from a Mox convoy. One of the Maelstromers, Screw, fell in love at first sight with one of the Moxes, Kali. He killed the Moxes and his crewmates and escaped with Kali and the shard. The Mox woman sought help from her boyfriend Dino in order to sell the shard. The rockerboy, to stay in good graces with Maelstrom, sold Screw's whereabouts to them. Caliber herself and a squad of Maelstromers attacked and captured Screw. Instead of killing him, Caliber sold Screw to the Scavengers so he would suffer a painful death for betraying his gang. Afterward, Caliber confronted Kali for partnering with Screw. The Maelstromer gave her the chance to live if Dino vouched for her, but the rocker never appeared, so Caliber shot Kali dead and disposed of her body in the city landfill.

Car thief Mint, daughter of Jeremy Taylor, sought Caliber in order to find the whereabouts of Kickdown. Though initially hesitant due to Mint's repuation as a snitch, Caliber hires her to participate in various street races in Watson representing Maelstrom. However, in one of the final races, Caliber ordered Mint to aim for second place as a test to earn her trust. This final act prompted Caliber to set-up a meet between Mint and Kickdown. During the meet with Kickdown, Gorilla and Caliber, Mint revealed NCPD's plan to kidnap Kickdown and use him to produce skill chips that copied MaxTac's skills. She even gave them an NCPD transmitter, which when activated brings NCPD to location. This act cleared Mint's reputation as a snitch and convinces Caliber and Maelstrom to launch an attack on NCPD. However, Mint had doublecrossed them, the transmitter was a signal to MaxTac to launch an ambush on Maelstrom, while Mint personally delivered Kickdown to NCPD at another location. Caliber would be assassinated by an unidentified sniper, quite possibly from NCPD or MaxTac.

Boss of the Valentinos

Campo Orta is the leader of the Valentinos in 2077.

Biography
Campo's relative, Gustavo, grew up with Jackie Welles. Both got into the Valentinos, but while Jackie left, Gustavo managed to become one of the highest ranking members of the gang. Campo was fond of Jackie, and treated him as one more in the family, even after he left.

At some point, Campo was detained and convicted to prison. By 2077, he still had four more years to serve. During Jackie's funeral in El Coyote Cojo, Campo sent Juan Esteban Abasto with a message to present his condolences to Jackie and the family. Gustavo Orta mentioned to Martha Young that Campo was extremely distraught over the death of Jackie since he considered him a member of his family. Martha slyly questioned Gustavo if Campo would be as sad when he died, and Gustavo replied by telling her to knock it off.

Canada is a North American country in .

History
Several NUSA agricorps have fields planted several miles inside Canada after the Bushfire that swept the Great Plains in 2000. Although they have no legal right to farm here, and no recourse if some Canadians come and try to harvest, the amount of land they get to use and abuse for free is remarkable. The Canadian populace is not happy about this and there has been border friction over it.

In 2002, Canada was one of the countries affected by the Food Crash.

By 2020 Canada has been growing unstable and it is expected to fragment soon with New Brunswick, Newfoundland, Nova Scotia, and Prince Edward Island looking like they will ally themselves with the Seaboard Cooperative of the US Northeastern States. Either looking to apply for statehood or secede from the Union. In Saint Lawrence Canada installed major locks and water recycling systems to keep the US pollution from contaminating Montreal and Maritime water, and had faced pushback from its Inuit population over politics. Within the less urbanised states of Maine, New Hampshire and Vermont a vocal minority has been looking for regional repartitioning, or secession to Canada. The Seaboard Cooperative was formed partly to prevent this. The SC in Vermont destroyed several miles of Interstate 91 but left it and Interstate 89 leading into Quebec operational, however they are now flanked with concrete bunkers and international shipping outposts. These prevent Canadian truckers from entering the Seaboard Cooperative as part of an isolation plan, but they still export SC goods to Canadian shippers. All other roads crossing into Canada under the SC’s jurisdiction have been ripped up to discourage smuggling.

During the Time of the Red, the province of British Columbia was part of the Pacifica Confederation.

In 2040, most of the Canadian cities had access to a Ziggurat CitiNet and Data Pool.

Culture
Despite the massive damage done to the United States after the Collapse, Canada did surpisingly well, due to a small population and tons of resources. By 2020, Southern Canada had become an Agricultural haven because of the rise in global temputures. Due to the stabablity in the Canadian economy, major corporations had started to set up operations across Canada. Canada also employed an open corporate military force to keep the American Nomad population from moving over the border. There were expections to this rule however, but most of those families were smaller in numbers and were brought over with full cooperation with the same corporations protecting the borders to become employees. CHOOH2 has also become one of Canada's biggest exports in the agrocultural industry, while the luxury market centers around hardwood, as the current largest growing industry. However, even with the achievements brought in by the agricultural industry, the true Canadian economy holds all of the major corporations and products of the world. By this point, the National Government is mostly gone, now replaced by corporations, free to run the country however they see fit.

## Capitán Caliente (Dogtown)
- type：Abandoned restaurant
- owner：Capitán Caliente (formerly)
- city：Night City
- district：Pacifica
- sub_district：Dogtown
- location：Eden Plaza

Capitán Caliente is an abandoned restaurant located in the Eden Plaza shopping mall of Dogtown, in the Pacifica district of southern Night City.

Overview
Capitán Caliente is part of a franchise of restaurants. This one in Dogtown is located below Montezuma's Throne in Eden Plaza. As such, it shares the same exterior architecture.

During the Unification War, the restaurant's owner let the FIA use the building. At some point after the war, it was closed due to the owner having had a dispute with Kurt Hansen, resulting in their suicide. The place was abandoned, though an active security system remained active. Despite this, someone managed to redirect the restaurant's electricity and was primarily used as a power source for neighboring buildings. In 2077, V visited this location to make contact with Solomon Reed.

Characters
*Ronald Malone - Sitting outside. After Lucretia My Reflection, Ronald will move to Longshore Stacks.

Phone Numbers
After gaining access to the telephone, you can input different phone numbers which may have varying results. Some of these are written in pieces of paper on the wall.

*0931 - Number to call Solomon Reed.
*12102020 - V will subscribe to the Pixel Fortress and receive text messages about video game reviews.
*5745552377 - Plays [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=s3L0_ez0Dg4 The Trail] from The Witcher 3s soundtrack. Prompts approval from Johnny Silverhand.
*6175556277 - Plays the Never Fade Away cover by P.T. Adamczyk and Olga Jankowska. Prompts sadness from Johnny.
*8008; 80082; 80085; 8008135; 42069 - Prompts a disappointed reaction from Johnny. V does not pick up the phone.
*911 - It will play a dial tone, with V stating that "patience is a virtue" before Johnny swears against them.
*Due to a bug, any invalid number will instead currently function as the last previously entered valid one.

Trivia
*Behind the phone itself there are a series of numbers (2x9, 1x9l, 1x6, 1x7, 2x45). This is a reference to Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas, when character Big Smoke orders at a fast food restaurant.

## Career Opportunities
Career Opportunities is a Side Job in . It was added in Patch 2.0 as part of the Trauma Drama mini-game.

Walkthrough
After obtaining the high-score in Trauma Drama, you are contacted by Macroware, the developers of the arcade game.

Macroware instructs you to visit the Trauma Team netpage from your computer and navigate to the "We want YOU!" tab, and apply for an unpaid internship with Trauma Team. This can be done after logging in under "Trauma Drama Member Access" and signing in. On the "We want YOU!" page you can apply.

After applying, go to MedCenter to collect your rewards, a Trauma Team uniform and a Mini Trauma Team AV that can be displayed in your apartment

Journal Entry
:Nice! You just got first place in an arcade game! Weren't joking when you said you'd become a Night City legend one day. And who cares if Trauma Team gleaned more of your personal data from it than if you'd showed up to MedCenter in person and pissed in a cup? Congrats! Just earned yourself the chance to apply for an unpaid internship at a blue-chip corp. Gotta admit, I'm actually pretty curious what they'd write back.

Objectives
*Read the message from Macroware.
*Go to the Trauma Team netpage on your computer.
*Go to the MedCenter to collect your consolation prize.
*Scan your hand to confirm your identity.
*Collect your consolation prize.

Trivia
*The name of this job is a reference to the song "Career Opportunities" by The Clash.

## Carol Emeka

Carol Emeka is a Nomad techie, netrunner, and member of the Aldecaldos in .

Biography
Like many members of the Aldecaldos, Carol is a veteran of the Unification War, from which she has unpleasant memories of being stuffed in panzers.

In 2077, Carol's clan leader Saul Bright was kidnapped during a patrol by a Raffen Shiv gang called the Wraiths. A distressed Carol acted in his place while worrying about Saul's wellbeing, the clan's supplies being stuck outside Reno, and the prospect of the Wraiths returning due to the vulnerable state of the camp. Panam Palmer, a fellow Aldecaldo who had seperated from the clan earlier, would not stand with their inactivity and took it upon herself to rescue Saul. For that reason she brought in a mercenary friend named V and, together with clan member Mitch Anderson, presented a plan to infiltrate the Wratih-controlled Corp-Bud Cement Factory and extract Saul. Being in over her head, Carol simply stood by quietly and let Panam carry out her plan, resulting in Saul's safe return the next day.

Together with clan members Teddy, Cassidy, and Taco, Carol then met a group of Scavengers in Santo Domingo to sell them weapons as the Aldecaldos were in dire need of money. As their delivery was delayed, however, Carol and the Scav leader agreed to a 15% discount. V can walk into their discussion, causing Cassidy to be surprised and slightly annoyed, saying that they do not need to be patronized. While Carol tries to salvage the tense situation with the jumpy Scav leader, V's presence will then prompt him to recognize them for being the merc that took out the Scavenger hideout to rescue Sandra Dorsett.

:If V simply deserts the Aldecaldos by departing the scene, Carol will write a text message, saying "We put our hopes on you, V. Fool us once, right?". Carol moves on that, due to Panam seeing something special in V, she is going to let it slide this one time. Apparently her and the others survive their dealings with the Scavs even without V's assistance, though.

:The negitiations go sour as the Scav leader is triggered by V's presence. After defeating all Scavangers during the ensuing firefight, Carol will be very annoyed by V ruining the deal, even if the latter pointed out that the Scavs had a sniper hidden in the back. Cassidy jumps in and points out that V might have prevented a much worse outcome, and Teddy opts for looting the Scav corpses and cars.

:V can intimidate the Scav leader, who then relents and closes the deal as agreed. Even though Carol remarks that V's words "sent chills down her spine, literally", she is grateful for their help.

The different outcomes described above do not alter Carol's dialogue after that mission.

Together with Teddy, Cassidy, Bob, and Mitch, Carol subsequently supported Panam's plan to strengthen the clan by stealing a Basilisk tank from a Militech convoy through the Badlands. The plan was to solicit V's help and hack a derelict train at a depot in the Eastern Wastelands to block the convoy's way. Saul staunchly objected to the risky undertaking, but Carol was convinced of Panam's plan, which she called "Damn short, sweet, and pertinent". She also hacked the Militech comms channel to make sure the entire thing is not a setup. At the abandoned train depot, Carol jokingly remarked to simply keep the Ural Kombinat AM-773 locomotive instead of getting the tank, adding that Saul would be on board with that. She then instructed Panam and V to get the authorization code from the station's control tower so that she could hack the train. During the job, Carol remained somewhat skeptical and distanced towards V, noting that Panam rallied her fellow Aldecaldos to help, but still called V, too, which she found interesting. On the eve of the heist, the group sat by the fire together, where Carol noticed Panam being nervous about defying Saul. She added that Panam was not the first one to stand up to Saul, indirectly referring to Scorpion, and later remarked that it is for the Aldecaldos to make a name for themselves again that they were doing what they did. Despite encountering more Militech resistance as initally anticipated, the group successfully hijacked the convoy and stole the Basilisk tank the next morning.

Although Saul was livid about Panam's group defying his orders, he allowed them to put the Basilisk together anyways. The next day, the tank was ready and Carol made sure that Militech had not left any ICE in its systems, remarking that it is "clean as a whistle." The tank was put to good use soon, when the Raffen Shiv Wraiths attacked the Aldecaldos, probably in retaliation for them leaving incriminating Militech loot outside their camp. Carol helped in the defense, which was a huge success thanks to the Basilisk crewed by Panam and V. Seeing he was wrong, Saul subsequently made Panam co-leader of the clan besides him.

:Due to V's help rescuing Saul and defending the clan against the Wraiths, Saul and Panam agree to help the merc to get inside Arasaka Tower. There, V needs to reach an access port to enter an area of cyberspace called Mikoshi with the help of an AI called Alt Cunningham. The day before the mission, Carol assists Dakota Smith in providing V access to the Net so that they can talk to Alt in advance. The Net surf caused half of Dakota's tech to be fried and got Carol visibly concerned for V, remarking that their "frontal lobe was seconds away from flowing out of their ears". Carol then attends the get-together to commemorate Saul and Panam making V a full member of the Aldecaldos. On the eve before their attack on the Maglev Tunnel Construction Site, Carol can be found sitting together with Bob and Teddy, with whom V can share a few drinks. Carol will toast to "goddam safe returns" but generally welcomes the bold attack on Arasaka as it could mean a fresh start for the Aldecaldos.

:The next day, Carol participates in the Aldecaldos attack on the construction site, which is defended by Militech. From the control room at the construction site, Carol and Mitch hack into the tunnel drilling machine to power it up in order to dig through to Arasaka Tower's foundations. While Panam, Saul, and V enter the tunnel with the Basilisk tank, Carol and the other Nomads stay outside to fend off any further Militech soldiers.

:
::A few weeks after the attack, which was successful albeit having cost Saul's, Bob's, and Teddy's lives, Carol gave fellow-techie Judy a ride to the temporary camp on Jackson Plains from which the Aldecaldos will depart to leave Night City, a spot Judy admits she never would have found otherwise. After Carol remarks she doubted V would care for a fresh start and show up at all, she gives V and Judy some privacy. Carol then gives Judy a ride again as the group heads off to cross the border.

This is unlike Taco, who also participates in Gun Music but will appear and can be talked to at the Nomad camp after the job.

- aka：Butch Cassidy
Cass

引文：Self-respect breeds self-discipline. Once you have both, you have real power. [...] I just feel like people expect some motivational bullshit from me.（Cassidy during With a Little Help from My Friends）

Cassidy Righter is nomad and member of the Aldecaldos in . Cassidy is a true and unfiltered person with a generally warm and fair personality.

Biography
Cassidy Righter is a man of conviction, believing in a simple but true life and upholding values such as honesty and loyalty while maintaining a sarcastic humor. Cassidy described the allegiance to the family his Aldecados clan formed to be unconditional and the support among clanmembers to be an anchor in his life. Cassidy was a smoker, played the guitar, and did not use any cyberware.

Cassidy became good friends with fellow Aldecaldo Panam Palmer early on when he rescued her best friend who was captured by the Raffen Shiv, a rivaling Nomad group, when they were a child. Cassidy would remain a close friend of Panam and become somewhat protective of her. Like several other Aldecaldos including Mitch Anderson, Cassidy also became a veteran of the Unification War of 2069 and 2070.

2077
When Cassidy's clan leader, Saul Bright, got abducted by the Wraiths, a Raffen Shiv clan, Cassidy was not exactly optimistic about the prospects of rescuing him, but figured they should try anyways. The morning after Panam together with a merc called V successfully retrieved Saul, Cassidy picked Saul up at the abandoned farmhouse the group had spent the night and congratulated V on a job well done.

Together with clan members Taco, Teddy, and Carol, Cassidy then met a group of Scavengers in Santo Domingo to sell them weapons as the clan was in dire need of money. As their delivery was delayed, however, both sides agreed to a 15% discount. V can walk into their discussion, causing Cassidy to be surprised and slightly annoyed, saying that they do not need to be patronized. V's presence will then prompt the Scav leader to recognize them for being the merc that took out their hideout to rescue Sandra Dorsett. If V has at least 10 body, the Scavs can be intimidated and the deal is concluded peacefully, which Cassidy and Carol briefly thank V for. If V cannot intimidate the Scavs, however, a firefight will ensue. As Carol blamed the interrupted deal on V, Cassidy jumps in, saying "You never know if your bad luck has spared you from worse luck. You charged into the lion's den to help us, V. Why? 'Cause you listened to your heart. That's a rare thing. 'Specially out here. Some things... money just can't buy. Thanks for everything, V. So long." The group then collects the money (either from the intimidated Scavs or from their corpses) and leaves. If V is male and initiated this side job before Queen of the Highway, Cassidy will also write him a text message concerning Panam.

Together with Teddy, Carol, Bob, and Mitch, Cassidy subsequently supported Panam's plan to strengthen the clan by stealing a Basilisk tank from a Militech convoy through the Badlands. Saul staunchly objected to the risky undertaking, and Cassidy would have prefered to have his backing, but joined in nonetheless as he was convinced that the plan, aided by V, was sound. Cassidy later remarks to V that he really respects the merc's assistance, saying "Respect your efforts. Self-respect breeds self-discipline. Once you have both, you have real power. [...] I just feel like people expect some motivational bullshit from me." On the eve of the heist, the group sat by the fire together and Cassidy, playing the guitar, told Panam to join them with "Sit your ass down a minute, honey, and breathe." After the successful attack, Cassidy asked V how they were doing and if they had fun. Upon their return to the Aldecaldos camp with the Militech loot in tow, Cassidy asked whether he should talk to Saul in order to soften the blow for Panam but she declined. When Bob asked what to do with the big Militech trucks they have stolen, Cassidy simply commented "Oh I've got an idea." By that he meant to leave the trucks by the Raffen Shiv camp, so that Militech would blame them for the attack. Cassidy described it as "almost as much fun as leaving a bag of flaming dog shit on their doorstep." Just as the group finished assembling the tank, they had to put it to use to defend the camp against a Raffen Shiv attack. After the ambush was fought off, Cassidy stood by as Saul made Panam co-leader of the clan, recognizing his earlier mistakes and the value she brings to the family. Cassidy sarcastically joked "Terrible choice. I voted nay." The clan then moved camp and V passed out, prompting Cassidy to welcome them back to the living after waking up again.

:On the eve before their attack on the Maglev Tunnel Construction Site, Cassidy can be found shooting at empty bottles at the southeast end of the camp. V can join Cassidy's target practice; hitting 12 or more bottles prompts him to offer V his revolver, . The next day, Cassidy participates in the Aldecaldos attack on the construction site, which is defended by Militech. While Panam, Saul, and V enter the tunnel with the Basilisk tank to infiltrate Arasaka Tower, Cassidy and the other Nomads stay outside to fend off any further Militech soldiers.

:
::A few weeks after the attack, which was successful albeit having cost Saul's, Bob's, and Teddy's lives, Cassidy, along with Carol and Mitch, waited for Panam and V at a temporary camp on Jackson Plains outside Night City before their planned border crossing. Before the group heads off, Cassidy remarks to V that they look like shit. He then reminds V of how much his Aldecaldos family means to him and that clan members will always have each other's backs.

*Cassidy's scan originally affiliated him with the NCPD. This was fixed in a later patch.

While this is to explain them being busy with Gun Music, they will not reappear even after completing the mission and are therefore not physically represented in the game until the player choses "The Star" ending and initiates We Gotta Live Together. Cassius Ryder is a Ripperdoc in .

Biography
Cassius Ryder is a well-known ripperdoc and a tattoo artist in Night City. In his early life he personally knew famous rocker, Johnny Silverhand. Some time later he got his own clinic and tattoo salon, located on Pershing Street in Northside, Watson, and created his own chain of ripperdoc clinics, all going under the name Doc Ryder.

By 2077, he was very well connected with Night City's mercenary world, as well as fixer Wakako Okada and being known in the Afterlife circles. He benefited from the MaxTac raid on a black ripperdoc clinic located nearby, as the people that used to visit them for services now had to rely on him instead.

:Jesse Johnson came to Cassius to fix a problem with his malfunctioning implant. The operation was a success.

:Wakako Okada told V to get a Tyger Claws dermal imprint from Cassius as a gift.

:Johnny (in V's body) asked about Cassius at the Afterlife, visiting him that same night to get a tattoo and information on Adam Smasher. Overview
Consuming Cat Food applies the Nourishment status, increasing max Health by 5% and Health regen by 0.5% per second outside of combat for 450 seconds.

Other Uses
After completing Playing for Time at the start of Act II, one can find a small empty bowl on the ground close to a trash can to the right from V's Apartment in Megabuilding H10. If V interacts with the cat, they can adopt it as a permanent pet for their Megabuilding H10 apartment.

## Chang-Hoon Nam
- age：67

Chang-Hoon Nam (남창훈) is a netrunner in .

Biography
Nam has been an associate of Wakako Okada for years, as he was hand picked by her to do business. Ever since, he hasn't let her down once.

Sometime in 2077, he started digging into finding other Netrunners that were roaming The Net, in particular one by the name of Spectral Kid, whom he believes is a reckless teenage 'runner who needs guidance before he gets himself into too much trouble. Spectral Kid was not to be reasoned with, however, and eventually got himself killed whilst poking around in Voodoo Boys territory. At one point Nam was contacted by a netrunner in distress named Dante, who had become trapped in the Net due to a Soulkiller attack during a gig and could only communicate in binary code. Unfortunately, despite Nam being able to understand Dante's messages, there was nothing he could do for the runner.

He was hired by Wakako to find information on an illicit netrunner going by the pseudonym Vortex after they disappeared, but to no avail, forcing Wakako to rely on V instead. Later, he was tasked with cracking open a Corpo code-case, but ended up getting trapped within his own local subnet. This came to the attention of Wakako, who became suspicious after Nam failed to reply to her emails, and so she dispatched V to find Nam's whereabouts.

:After helping Nam get free of his local subnet, he will inform Wakako of his whereabouts and what happened and will later turn into a Netrunner Vendor from which Quickhacks can be purchased with a 20% discount.

:
::V told Chang-Hoon, who suffered from aphasia after the hack, that he should leave Night City, because he was in a bad state and at risk of being tracked by MaxTac. They mentioned Hwangbo Dong-Gun as an example of a person who managed to leave the city with their help.

:Chang-Hoon Nam will stay trapped inside his local subnet or be deceased, much to the displeasure of Wakako.

## Changes
Changes is a Main Job in .

Walkthrough
As long as the ending path ends with V connecting into Mikoshi (hence this excludes the Arasaka and Phantom Liberty paths), the player will be presented with this mission.

Changes can start in one of two ways, which depends on the choice the player makes regarding Jackie's body after The Heist. However, the mission will open up in similar fashion; V will be presented with a vision of them going to the ninth floor behind Misty's shop, as is what happened during the third half of Nocturne Op55N1.

* If V took Jackie's body to Viktor Vektor after thus resulting in Arasaka stealing his engram, V will be given one last chance to talk to him.
* If V took Jackie's body to Mama Welles or if the body was left in the Delamain Cab they escaped on, upon exiting into the roof, V finds their bullet necklace and takes it as the world around them fades away.

Either way, this will lead to the cyberspace inside Mikoshi. Alt Cunningham will recite a poem (both listed below) as V walks towards the beam of light, taking them into another section of cyberspace. After doing so, V will have a talk.

* If the mission prior to this is Belly of the Beast or (Don't Fear) The Reaper, V will talk to Johnny Silverhand.
* If the previous mission was Knockin' on Heaven's Door, the opposite will happen, as Johnny by that point had taken control of V's body.

The conversation soon shifts into a shocking realization for V; with Alt having separated their and Johnny's psyches throughout the raid on Arasaka Tower, the extended exposure to Johnny's construct has irreparably damaged their body. Alt gives them a choice; return to their body with six months to live, or let Johnny keep their body.

What follows after Changes if V returns to their body depends on the previous mission. If the previous mission was (Don't Fear) The Reaper or Knockin' on Heaven's Door, Changes will always lead to Path of Glory. If the previous mission was Belly of the Beast, the next mission will be All Along the Watchtower.

If Changes ends with Johnny keeping their body, the mission will always lead to New Dawn Fades, disregarding the previous mission and any ending path.

Journal Entry
This job has no journal entry.

Objectives
*Go to the roof.
*
**Pick up the necklace.
*
**Talk to Jackie.
*
**Talk to Johnny.
**Enter the well to return to your body.
*
**Talk to V.
**Enter the well to return to V's body.
*Cross the bridge and enter cyberspace forever.
**Touch Alt to leave with her into the unknown.

Notes
*The Arasaka path is the only one which doesn't go through Changes despite also visiting Johnny.

Alt's Poems
If completing Belly of the Beast or (Don't Fear) The Reaper, Alt will recite a fragment of one of the poems in The Love Song of J. Alfred Prufrock. If completing Knockin' on Heaven's Door, she will instead recite the final passage from Sailing to Byzantium.

|-
|

:"When the evening is spread out against the sky"
:"Like a patient etherized upon a table"
:"Let us go, through half deserted streets"
:"The muttering retreats"
:"Of restless nights in one-night cheap hotels,
:"And sawdust restaurants with oyster-shells:"
:"Streets that follow like a tedious argument"
:"Of insidious intent"
:"To lead you to an overwhelming question..."
:"Oh, do not ask, 'What is it?'"

Trivia
*The quests' title comes from the David Bowie song "Changes."
*The two cats V sees in the stairwell are a reference to the first Matrix movie, where the main character Neo (played by Keanu Reeves) also sees the same cat twice while walking up a stairwell.

Charles was the Night City CEO of Diverse Media Systems. Around May 2077, he resigned after an anonymous source released a datachip owned by him which contained a contract between DMS and various major corporate clients around Night City. The NCPD confirmed this data by stating they had found DMS was being paid to code subliminal advertisements into their costumer's braindances, eventually causing them to buy the products of the corporate clients of DMS. This discovery caused the company stocks to fall around 50%, with a reported drop of BD sales of around 70%.

## Charter Hill (2077)
- type：Sub-district
- city：Night City
- district：Westbrook
- gangs：See Gangs
- appears_books：

Charter Hill is one of the sub-districts of Westbrook, located in eastern Night City.

Overview
Charter Hill is a relatively new and well maintained corporate district that was built from scratch during the Rebuilding period. It quickly became very popular among the upper-class citizens of Night City, this was before North Oak became hot within the next two decades. Nevertheless, most aspiring mid-level corpos work from sunrise to sunset in Westbrook or City Center, to then party in Japantown after a day's work, to then sleep off their hangovers in one of the apartments in Charter Hill. Each of them secretly dreams of becoming CEO of some corporation and moving to North Oak, but that doesn't stop them from burning each other in the hope of achieving that goal. If you see someone not suited up in corpo style, they're probably an up-and-coming artist, musician, or well-paid freelancer who's rich enough to turn their nose up a Little China or Wellsprings.

Database Entry

- transcript：Charter Hill is known as a comfortable and relatively safe neighborhood for those who can afford it. It was re-built in the 40s during the Reconstruction. The new and swanky Charter Hill quickly became a go-to for Night City's elites, at least until North Oak overtook it as the most luxurious neighborhood. Most of Charter Hill's homes are occupied by middle-ranking corpos who bang their heads against their desks by day and get sloshed in bars by night. The other residents are made up of aspiring artists, entrepreneurs and any freelancer who makes enough to avoid renting a closet room in Little China or Wellsprings.

Locations

*Acorn Towers
*Au Cabanon
*Dynalar Complex
*Ginger Panda
*Gold Niwaki Plaza
*Gutierrezes' Apartment
*Kiroshi Campus
*Kraviz's Clinic
*Lele Park
**Avante
**Nagami Market
*Peralezes' Apartment
*Red Queen's Race
*Tyger Claws Casino

Notable Gangs
*6th Street
*Tyger Claws
*Scavengers

Behind the Scenes

引文：While the gods-among-men of Night City relax in the pseudo-natural environs of North Oak, the mid-level executive 'suits' who live in Charter Hill get no reprieve from the brutal esthetics of corporate life. The high rise apartment towers of this district do not differ all that much in their basic style from the gargantuan office buildings of City Center; one can even imagine haggard corporate employees forgetting whether the elevator is whisking them home or to the office. That said, flats in Charter Hill are highly coveted and offer the best version of Night City life a mere mortal can realistically obtain: here, the city is relatively clean, well-policed and well-connected. To top it off, you have a clear view of North Oak to fuel your fantasies of what could be yours if you climbed to the top of the ladder. In the opposite direction the toxic dumping grounds of Arroyo feed nightmares of what awaits if you slip off.

Notes
*Hydrosubsidium historically has had close links to the district.

See also
*Cyberpunk 2077 Fast Travel/Dataterms

Chase Coley is a cyberpsycho in .

Biography
Chase Coley is a construction worker, husband to a woman named Mary, and father of a child named Charlie. Chase suffered from stress due to the toxic environment caused by his manager Tom Selvig, despite him claiming that he is charitable. To help him, Tom gave Chase some military-grade implants to boost his work ethics, but barely did anything. Chase was later given a Militech Centaur, which worried a fellow coworker, warning him to not use the exoskeleton and the other implants he was chipped with, or else he would break his spine. However, Chase never listened due to work pressure, which caused his cyberpsychosis to kick in and go on a rampage at the construction site. Tom called Holden McCoy to terminate Chase, but ended up getting killed. Regina found Chase and sent V to incapacitate him, while at the same time, Chase murders Holden.

## Cherry Blossom Market
- type：Market
- city：Night City
- district：Upper Marina (2045)
Westbrook (2077)
- sub_district：Japantown (2077)
- appears_books：

Cherry Blossom Market (formerly known as Crystal Park Market) is located in Japantown, in the Westbrook district of northeastern Night City.

History
Early history - 2040s
Established at some point during the Time of the Red, Crystal Park Market was conceived as glass roof-covered day marketplace in which pop-up booths were distributed for shop owners to sell their merchandise. Decades prior to this, however, this area had been known for housing the Rainbow Cadenza, a club where the chromantic rock band Samurai had played some of their earliest gigs. With the club's demolition, its space was eventually replaced by a small restaurant that served tofunomiyaki.

By 2045, Crystal Park had its own Garden Patch, where it was touted as a "walkable retail space with Bohemian vibes," basically typifying the vision that Kabria Chung — the Upper Marina city manager at the time — wanted for her district.

2050s - 2070s
At some point, this marketplace became known as the Cherry Blossom Market, a name given for the trees and flowers found around the area, which made it look like it was in a constant bloom of pink-and-white.

By the mid-2070s, Cherry Blossom was considered to be one of the contenders for the most colorful shopping area in Night City. Covered by a glass roof, it offered an ever-changing line-up of vendors displaying a multitude of goods to purchase and consume, including items that were not available in other places of the metropolis. During the day, the marketplace was not very crowded, allowing for a more relaxed browsing. During the night, however, most of the shops opened-up and put on display their unique share of exotic products.

Database Entry

Notable Stores
2045
These were notable vendors found at Crystal Park Market in 2045:

*Bill's, a one-chair salon manged by one of the best stylists in Night City at the time. The owner had a slovenly appearance, but nonetheless, his stylist skills were superb.
*Cybershack, managed by Will Maine, this stand was a great place to purchase programs and cyberdeck hardware.
*Maxwell's, managed by Jessup Maxwell Junior, this stand was an honest-to-goodness shoe cobbler business.
*Other Lives, this was considered a great place to pick up a night's entertainment, whether it was a classic movie, the latest braindance, or an untainted vial of blue glass.
*Pizza to Go, the stand of one of Night City's oldest pizza fast food chains. It was a favorite among kids everywhere.
*Skinlight, a cosmetic body shop with the motto: "When you want to light up the Dark Future!" Most fashionware options were available.
*Tech Time, a stall selling tools and scrap. It was popular among independent techies.
*Tofunomiyaki Dive, a small tofunomiyaki restaurant built over the place where rock legends once sang.
*Torch's Total Repairs, managed by Benício, this stand was a drop-off point for the real workshop. Once the items had been repaired, they were brought back for the client to pick them up.

2077
These were notable vendors found in or around Cherry Blossom Market in 2077:

*Chiyo Omoto (Ripperdoc)
*Christine Markov (Junk Vendor)
*Karim's Vinyls (Junk Vendor)
*Ramen Joint (Food Vendor)

Associated Quests

*Sweet Dreams

## Chicago
- caption：2020 downtown Chicago
- motto：The City in a Garden
- type：City
- country：NUSA
- state：Illinois
- region：Midwest
- population：8 million (2020)
- demonym：Chicagoan
- appears_books：

引文：Looking at Chicago from outside the city in daylight is one of the most depressing sights in the world.

Chicago is a city of the NUSA state of Illinois.

History

Chicago was founded by Jean Baptiste Point du Sable in 1833, first as a town, and later in 1837 officially as a city. During the late 1960s, the city experienced a rise in gang-related crime, becoming known for this issue.

Bio-Plague of 2012
Chicago was severely impacted during the Collapse, particularly in its early stages. Subsequently, the city was left in a state of absolute devastation. However, this level of destruction paled in comparison to the catastrophic bio-plague that later ravaged the city. Although initially believed to be an Ebola virus derivative, the bio-plague was actually created by the Federal Government. The bio-plague was primarily developed through research conducted by numerous universities, with the most lethal research being conducted in locations such as Heartland.

Heartland was a clandestine complex located in Chicago, constructed during World War II beneath the University of Chicago. The facility initially conducted research that contributed to the Manhattan Project. However, as primary research progressed more rapidly than anticipated, the complex fell into disuse until the early 1960s. Prior to the Vietnam War, Heartland was repurposed as a large-scale bio-agent and chemical research facility, funded by the NSC/DIA with billions of dollars invested. The majority of America's bio-arsenal originated from Heartland. Despite its successes in biological warfare, Heartland eventually closed due to its cramped and outdated infrastructure, which could not be renovated without significant disruption to the University. Consequently, the complex was abandoned, saving the University millions of dollars.

Several years after the closure of the facility, much of the work and materials remained on site, including samples of some of the world's deadliest diseases. These samples sat untouched, collecting dust. When the worst of the Collapse occurred, the government was unable to intervene. Eventually, the NSA filled the entry corridors with cement and placed bio-hazard warnings throughout the facility before departing to engage in a conflict against the government and military alongside the rest of the Gang of Four.

In late 2011, reconstruction efforts commenced at the University of Chicago. During the demolition of several old buildings on campus, the Heartland complex was discovered. Despite the presence of bio-hazard warnings, the reconstruction companies proceeded to demolish the complex, inadvertently releasing many of the diseases that had been developed at Heartland. This event triggered widespread chaos.

Within a span of six months, the city of Chicago was devastated, with a death toll approaching 200,000. Although some areas of the city remained habitable, the majority of residents relocated to safer regions of the country. In the aftermath of the plague, the U.S. Military constructed Chicago Port, recognizing that the absence of Chicago had severely impacted shipping operations on the Great Lakes.

Chicago still remained a wasteland; occupied primarily by nomads.

Post-Collapse
Following the Collapse, the majority of Chicago lay in ruins, with an estimated 90% of the city abandoned. The once-thriving metropolis was reduced to a mere shadow of its former self, overrun by algae and overgrowth, with rusted buildings standing as silent witnesses to its decline. It appeared that nothing could be done to restore the city to its former glory. However, this changed with the arrival of Storm Technologies.

Storm Technologies (often abbreviated StormTech), is a technological company started by Dr. Richard Storm in the late 90's. One of the many huge and lucrative projects StormTech wanted to accomplish was the successful reclamation of Chicago. When toxicity levels in the city dropped to manageable levels, StormTech was able to negotiate a lucrative deal with four of the seven Nations to start the reconstruction of Chicago.

StormTech, since 2017, has been sending groups of people into Chicago to salvage certain critical resources. They have slowly been able to reclaim and rebuild a certain parts of Chicago, like The Loop and New Town. Though there are still other parts which aren't so lucky. Nowadays, Chicago is mainly traversed by Nomad groups and gangs looking to make a living.

By 2020, Chicago had undergone significant reconstruction and experienced a substantial population growth, reaching 8,000,000 residents. The city emerged from its previous state of abandonment to become the founding location of Cytech. As Chicago rose from the ashes, Cytech expanded its operations globally, providing services in the fields of cybernetic implants, manufacturing, holograms, infrastructure, military, and weapons..

The efforts to reconstruct Chicago came to an end during the Fourth Corporate War, when Arasaka detonated virus bombs in the city in an attempt to prevent it from becoming a stronghold for Militech.

 2077
By 2077 Chicago is implied to have undergone some level of reconstruction, as mention is made of connecting Chicago with Night City using the transcontinental Maglev Network.

Areas of Chicago
The Loop
 advertisement about reclaiming Chicago]]
The Loop is the part of downtown Chicago that is encircled by the elevated train tracks that run above the streets, forming a circle around a good part of the downtown area. This is where most of StormTech's reconstruction efforts have gone. Locals consider the inside of the Loop to be the entire downtown area.

There we can find Magnificent Mile, various museums, luxurious theaters and many more other buildings of Pre-Collapse Chicago. On Michigan Avenue, you can still find the old Chicago landmarks. Tribune Tower, the Playboy Building, the Old Water Tower, and the John Hancock Center.

Emerald City
Underneath downtown are several underground streets which traverse almost the entire Loop area. The Emerald City gets its name from the various green florescent lights that illuminate the streets underground at all hours of the day. Emerald City is inhabited by the Morlocks, a group of people who have no other way of life. Emerald City has power because of the reconstruction effort, so enterprising Raffen ran a jumper to the lighting controls for parts of Emerald City and tapped enough juice to run the lights. An underground thoroughfare designed for pedestrians runs parallel to the Chicago River, but is separated from the rest of Emerald City by a brick wall with one or two large holes in it. Once lined with restaurants, it is now home to rat-holes, bars, and rooms that only the most desperate hide in. The pedestrian traffic is never heavy because of the filth. The smell is horrendous, especially during the summertime. This is Emerald City.

New Town
Located on North Rush Street is New Town. It was once an up-scale residential area that was then run into the ground after the Collapse, but it has been fairly cleaned up now. Single-story homes are commonplace, with lawns turned into small vegetable gardens. After work in the evening, many nomads work to prepare houses for wintertime. New Town is home to many families. Most are nomads, but some are employees of StormTech. If any disturbances break out, StormTech and the dog-soldiers show up and heaven help the perpetrators. The area is well patrolled after dark, and lightly patrolled in the daytime as well.

Old Town
Old Town is located on the tip of North Wells Street (not to be confused with North Rush Street). This two block stretch, like New Town, looks like it's name suggests. It was once a residential area and is filled with two-story brownstone apartment buildings. Mixed in are also the strangest collection of businesses to ever grace one street: this is where the nomads who make a living entertaining other nomads hang out. It is also where the majority of drinking, wilding and fighting happens in new Chicago. In some bars, you'll find extremely attractive women (who turn out to be men), transvestites, and others. Most bars (deemed Smart Bars) serve, instead of alcohol, flavored drinks high in phosphotydle chlorine, a neuro-adrenaline producer.

Notable people
*Mr. Cool (member of the Folk Nation)
*Patrick Eddington (U.S. Army General, based in New York City in 2020)
