## Cyberpunk 2077 Gigs
Gigs are mercenary jobs given by fixers in and .

Each gig has an associated fixer, who represents the client for the job, and an associated tier, which determines V's standing with that fixer. After V completes a set of gigs sharing the same tier, the fixer will give them another set of gigs to complete. Once V completes all available gigs in a district, the fixer will give them a final reward.

This page lists all of them by each district. A separate table is added for cyberpsycho specific quests that are given by Regina Jones.

Gigs by district

Badlands
These are all given by Badlands's fixer, Dakota Smith.

City Center
These are all given by City Center's fixer, Dino Dinovic.

Heywood
These are all given by Heywood's fixer, Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra, except Gig: Hot Merchandise, which is given by Rogue Amendiares.

Pacifica
These are all given by Pacifica's fixer, Mr. Hands.

Santo Domingo
These are all given by Santo Domingo's fixer, Muamar Reyes, except Gig: The Union Strikes Back and Gig: Nasty Hangover, which are given by Rogue Amendiares.

Watson
There are 23 gigs given by Watson's fixer, Regina Jones.

Westbrook
These are all given by Westbrook's fixer, Wakako Okada, except Gig: Family Heirloom, which is given by Rogue Amendiares.

Notes
*Prior to Patch 1.5, the gigs were unlocked with Street Cred.

## Cyberpunk 2077 Main Jobs
Main Jobs, also more commonly known as Main Quests, are quests that follow the main story in and . The quests are ordered by act, and then by the order in which they are normally started within the act, but can be sorted alphabetically for searching.

Each quest will only appear in the act in which it starts, even if the job persists through more than one single act. To see a job walkthrough, click on the job name.

Prologue
The prologue takes place in 2076 and establishes V's background, consisting of a several basic tasks which also act as tutorials for a number of gameplay elements. The first three prologue jobs listed below are mutually exclusive, and the one which you play will depend on which lifepath that was chosen during character customization. ## Cyberpunk 2077 Quickhacks
Quickhacks, also frequently called "programs", are an equipment type in .

Overview
Quickhacks can be installed inside a cyberdeck and can be utilized to take out or disorient enemies, or bypass defenses.

Each quickhack has a duration (the time the quickhack will be active), an upload time (the time it takes for the quickhack to take effect) and a RAM cost (the amount of cyberdeck ram is required to infect the target with a quickhack). Not all quickhacks have a cooldown (the time it takes before the quickhack can be used again).

Types
Combat
Combat quickhacks deal raw damage to enemies, often leaving a status effect on them. These quickhacks have a medium RAM cost.

Control
Control quickhacks can apply various effects centered around distracting or disabling enemies, usually without directly nonfatally. These quickhacks have a low/medium RAM cost. With the Jailbreak Relic perk, Control Quickhacks can be installed into a Monowire.

Covert
Covert quickhacks revolve around avoiding detection and allowing the user to strategically manipulate both enemies and the environment to this effect. These quickhacks typically do not start trace progress, which allows one to stay undetected in most situations. These quickhacks have the lowest RAM cost in most cases.

Ultimate
Ultimate quickhacks produce some of the most powerful effects in the game, offset by having the largest RAM cost of all quickhacks.

Device
These quickhacks come preinstalled on cyberdecks, determined by their manufacturer and tier. They are often used on objects and item during enemy encounters with the exception of Breach Protocol.

Vehicle
The Carhacker perk allows the user to perform quickhacks which specifically target vehicles.

Acquisition
Quickhacks and their crafting specs can be purchased from Netrunner vendors. They can also drop from enemy netrunners or looted from Airdrops.

Quickhacks and their crafting specs can also be obtained by successfully sequencing the Advanced Datamine in the Breach Protocol mini-game.

## Cyberpunk 2077 Vehicles
In , V has access to a range of different vehicles from 12 Cyberpunk-original and 2 real-world vehicle manufacturers that can either be purchased or obtained as a reward from a job.

Overview
Owned vehicles are equipped with AI that allows V to summon them in seconds from almost anywhere. If an owned vehicle is ever destroyed, V can summon a replacement, but will be automatically charged €$100 by the insurance company.

V can steal vehicles, but they cannot be permanently owned and will despawn. Cars are harder to steal based on their class (Lower, Middle, Upper) and manufacturer. The Body requirement to steal an occupied car ranges from 4-10 and the Technical Ability requirement to break into a parked car ranges from 4-10.

All owned vehicles have a Stash. On cars, this is accessed via the trunk, which is either at the rear or front of the car depending on where the engine is mounted. On motorcycles, this is accessed via a compartment at the rear.

Vehicles also perform differently on streets and off-road. A street vehicle with front-wheel drive is typically faster on roads than an off-road vehicle with four-wheel drive, but has very little traction off-road.

Some vehicles are also armed with on-board weaponry, either machineguns or rockets. They can do notable damage and have infinite ammo (though they do have a magazine that needs periodic reloading), however do note that killing enemies with vehicle weapons gives more limited general character experience and NO experience whatsoever to any of the trained-by-use Skills, so try not to use them too much to avoid slowing down your character growth.

It is also possible for V to use a select variety of their own weapons if their vehicle does not come with any built in. Pistols, Revolvers and Submachine Guns can be used on all vehicles, while motorcycles allow use of one-handed melee weapons. If V does not possess any weapons in the aforementioned categories when driving an unarmed vehicle, a Unity will automatically be equipped.

Ownable Vehicles
These vehicles can be acquired by V. As V gains Street Cred throughout the game, more vehicles become available to purchase from Muamar Reyes's "AUTOFIXER" netpage.

Owning all 23 purchasable cars and 3 purchasable motorcycles that are part of the base game—thus excluding those from , game updates, Nomad lifepath, and Side or Minor Jobs—will unlock the "Autojock" achievement.

## Cyberpunk 2077 Vendors
Vendors are a gameplay element in .
Overview
Vendors function primarily to obtain Cyberware, Weapons, Clothing, Quickhacks, Crafting Specs, and Attachments and Modifications. It is also possible to purchase injectors, food, and drinks.

They can also be used to obtain Eurodollars by selling unwanted items.
Drop Points
Throughout Night City and the Badlands you can find Drop Points. Drop Points can only be used to sell items in exchange for Eurodollars.

## Cyberpunk 2077 Weapons
Weapons are a type of equipment in .

Weapons are prevalent and varied throughout Night City, ranging from firearms to melee and cyberware. They are divided into the following subcategories:

Overview
Weapon availability is based on their manufacturers, with each being considered as either lower, middle, or upper tier. The higher the tier, the more rare and expensive the weapons are. Each weapon (except utility grenades) also deals at least one of 4 Damage Types: Chemical, Electrical, Physical, and Thermal Damage. Enemies can also be incapacitated instead of killed by non-lethal weapons, though lethal weapons have this ability as well if they don't damage enemy weakpoints, or are equipped with a Pax modification.

Technologies
Guns are classified as either Power, Smart, or Tech, while melee weapons are classified as either Blade, Blunt or Throwable.

Power
Power weapons are conventional firearms, in the sense that they use traditional ammo. This category includes a wide variety of weapons including disposable and single-use polymer guns, revolvers, pistols, submachine guns, light- and heavy machine guns, shotguns, and rifles. High rate of fire accompanied by high recoil is a feature of most fully automatic power weapons.

Power weapons have a 5% chance to ricochet by default. This chance can be increased to 100% using the Ballistic Coprocessor Hands Cyberware. Most Power weapons have a muzzle slot and a scope slot for custom sights.

Smart
Smart weapons use gyrojet technology to fire caseless, guided ammo at enemies. This technology was first developed in the 1960s but was unreliable during combat. In 2077, they are efficient and pin-point accurate. Smart weapons are tied to weapon grips and optics to accurately scan and track the movement of targets.

Smart weapons aim for the wielder by using smart rounds that lock on and seek out their targets, though they need to be within the weapons's tracking box. Smart bullets can curve around obstacles to hit their target, but travel slower than conventional rounds. The Smart Link cyberware is required to enable smart-targeting, with better quality Smart Links improving the tracking ability of the gun, as hits are not always guaranteed. Members of the Tyger Claws gang use Masking Ink in their tattoos that jams the smart-targeting ability, giving them a 50% chance to cause smart projectiles to miss. Smart weapons do not accept either suppressors or scopes. Perks specifically applying to Smart weapons and their target-tracking can be found in the Intelligence Attribute.

Tech
Tech weapons are weapons that use railgun technology, firing projectiles that are propelled with an electromagnetic charge. What they give up in terms of rate of fire they make up for in penetrating power, depending on how long the charge is held. These weapons use caseless ammunition, typically jacketed steel flechette.

Tech weapons can be charged to fire a bullet capable of penetrating obstacles. Tech weapons cannot be fitted with a suppressor, but most of them accept a custom sight. Perks specifically applying to Tech weapons can be found in the Technical Ability Attribute, and utilizing Tech weapons grants experience for the Engineer skill.

Blade
Bladed weapons are sharp, fast, and deadly. Perfect for assassination and stealth executions. Bladed weapons include Katanas, Machetes, and the Mantis Blades.

Blunt
Blunt weapons are heavy, slow and non-lethal. They employ brute force and have a chance to stun their opponents. Blunt weapons include Hammers, One and Two-Handed Clubs, Gorilla Arms, and unarmed/bare fists.

Throwable
Introduced with Patch 2.0, throwables weapons are a new class. These melee weapons can be thrown at their target like a projectile. Once thrown, they will automatically return to the player after a recovery period that is scaled based on the weapon's throw recovery stat. If the user is within melee range, it will be retrieved immediately.

Quality
Weapons appear in eleven qualities across five different tiers: , , , , and . Each Tier has a Plus level, with the exception of , which has two Plus levels. Minimum progression level required to unlock higher qualities:
* from Level 1
* from Level 9
* from Level 17
* from Level 25
* from Level 33
* from Level 51

The quality of a weapon also determines the quality of attachments and modifications that can be installed; the quality of the mod has to be at the same level or lower to be eligible, with the exception being the Phantom Liberty exclusive modifications.

Mod slots for weapons are unlocked at quality, with higher qualities having an increased chance of having one additional mod slot.

There are also iconic weapons, unique items which can, in most cases, only be acquired once and are acquired from a specific source. These weapons do not have mod slots, but do have unique special mods. With the introduction of Phantom Liberty, several new weapons using the x-MOD2 suffix are iconic and have two guaranteed mod slots, and improved weapon handling.

The quality of iconic weapons sold by vendors or found as blueprints can scale up to when V is Level 33. The quality of iconic weapons given as reward or found in the world can scale up to when V is Level 41.

Ranged Weapons
Pistols
Pistols make for dependable sidearms, though their damage and capacity are average compared to other weapons. Pistols use Handgun Ammo, which is shared with revolvers and submachine guns.

Pistols may be used while driving a vehicle.

Revolvers
Revolvers are one-handed heavy-hitters, trading capacity and slower reload time for firepower and improved headshot damage. Revolvers use Handgun Ammo, which is shared with pistols and submachine guns.

Revolvers may be used while driving a vehicle.

Submachine Guns
Submachine guns are short-range, pistol-caliber weapons. Among all weapon types, they typically have the lowest damage per shot but the highest rate of fire. Submachine guns use Handgun Ammo, which is shared with pistols and revolvers.

Submachine guns may be used while driving a vehicle.

Shotguns
Shotguns are ideal for short range combat, firing a spread of pellets that can knock foes off their feet. They are deadly up close, and even when they aren't they can still buy you some breathing room. Shotguns use Shotgun Ammo.

Assault Rifles
Assault rifles are general all-round weapons, effective at all but the longest of ranges, typically firing in full-auto. Assault rifles use Heavy Ammo, which is shared with light machine guns and precision rifles.

Light Machine Guns
Light machine guns lack in subtlety and accuracy they make up for in volume of fire and Magazine Capacity. Light machine guns use Heavy Ammo, which is shared with assault rifles and precision rifles.

Heavy Machine Guns
Heavy machine guns are only obtainable by ripping them out of turrets with a high enough Body Attribute, or by taking them from enemies. Heavy machine guns cannot be holstered, nor stored in the inventory. Carrying one disables sprinting, and upon attempting to swap weapons, the weapon will be dropped instead. When ripping the weapon from a turret, the weapon will have 300 bullets, and V cannot carry any reserves. Heavy machine guns may overheat when shot continuously, forcing the user to stop firing for a few seconds.

Precision Rifles
Precision rifles are semi-automatic weapons with a balance of distance, power, and capacity - not quite as deadly as a sniper rifle but longer-reaching than an assault rifle. Precision rifles use Heavy Ammo, which is shared with assault rifles and light machine guns.

Sniper Rifles
Sniper rifles are suitable for long-range encounters, but they're slow to reload and fire, requiring precision shooting for maximum effect. When used right they can eliminate all but the toughest of enemies with a single hit. Sniper rifles use Sniper Ammo.

Melee Weapons
Blades

Blunt

Thrown

Grenades
Grenades are explosive devices that can be thrown or launched. Typically exploding several seconds after the pin has been pulled, in 2077 things have been mixed up a bit with technology.

Cyberware Weapons

Cyberware Malfunctions is a Control Quickhack in .

Overview
A control quickhack that disables the enemy's cyberware for 10 seconds, and increases all damage they receive by 5%.

The variant allows the effect to stack up to 3 times, and at 2 stacks, it permanently disables enemy cyberware.

The variant causes the enemy to take Electrical damage over time if they are affected by 3 stacks of Cyberware Malfunction. Each application refreshes the effect's duration or reapplies the effect. Increases the maximum amount of stacks to 5.

The variant increases the maximum amount of stacks to 8, and causes Cyberware Malfunction to deal a high amount of Electrical damage at maximum stacks. Triggering this effect disables the ability to upload Cyberware Malfunction to the enemy.

The variant increases the amount of additional damage the enemy takes from 5% to 15% per stack of Cyberware Malfunction active on the enemy.

Acquisition
*All variants can be obtained through Breach Protocol.
*Quickhack and Crafting Spec can be purchased from Netrunners.
* variant can be purchased from Sammy Taylor at EBM Petrochem Stadium, Dogtown.

## Cynosure Facility
- type：Research facility
- owner：Militech (formerly)
- city：Night City
- district：Pacifica
- location：Underground

引文：Hellooo, Night City! Hey, how 'bout a little story time fun? Now, once upon a time, before the dark, dark days of the DataKrash, Militech built itself a secret underground city within a city – our city! That mysterious complex of underground bunkers, dusty storage rooms and murky laboratories was where they forged a cybernetic weapon that could shift the course of history... Hah, you really believe that fairy tale? A secret military project right under our feet and under Arasaka's nose? Puh-lease! Just another urban legend, I say. But what if there's a grain of truth to every legend? Well, as always, stay tuned – your man Stan's here with his finger on the city's pulse!（Stanley）

Cynosure Site C, known simply as the Cynosure Facility in , is an abandoned underground research facility located in the Pacifica district of southern Night City. Originally belonging to Militech, this was the main site for Project Cynosure, while Site D was a reloading station.

History

2010s
Project Cynosure was developed in this underground facility known as Cynosure Site C. It was located beneath Night City's Pacifica district, where experiments were conducted in honing this tool for Militech-affiliated netrunners to utilize in the depths of the NET.

2060s
The DataKrash was not the end of Project Cynosure, even though Militech on the surface shuttered the old research facility beneath Pacifica. In the mid-late 2060s, Militech sent a research group to both Site C and D.

2077
In 2077, three Wraiths named Misha, Tanny, and Rob, tried to break into the bunker's main entrance.

Layout

Bunker
By 2077, there is no direct access to the Cynosure Facility, as it is located deep underground and hidden. Access in-game is allowed via a hole created by a crashed truck and then diving down into a flooded shaft.

Sector 1
Sector 1 is accessed by descending via elevator to Restricted Area A. Passing through Sector 1 leads to Sector 2 by Administration.

Sector 2
Sector 2 is accessed via Administration, and controls access via a sealable gate to Sector 3. Sector 2 has five main areas accessed via the hallway. There are multiple Site Map shards and directories along the walls to aid in navigation.

Administration
*Controls access between Sectors 1 and 2.

Living Quarters
*Holds bunks and a cafeteria for facility workers.

Server Room
*Dataterminals Alpha and Bravo are found here.

Engineering
*Dataterminal Sierra is found here and houses two subareas.

:Maintenance
:*Here, the Militech Cerberus maintenance units were maintained. Two Cerberus units can be found dismantled, their core removed.
:*The Crafting Spec: Erebus can be found here.
:*This room also allows access to the ceiling ventilation shafts.
:*The door panel is initially disabled, preventing entry.

:Storage
:*This room houses miscellaneous items. On the back wall is a distribution box that can be rewired (20 Technical Ability check) to restore access to Maintenance.

Security
*This area is divided into three parts, and Dataterminal Victor can be found in the last area (furthest from the entrance) alongside multiple workstations and monitors.

Sector 3
Sterile Area
*This area is found towards the entrance of Sector 3 from Sector 2. Entering and leaving this area requires passing through an airlock and undergoing a sterilization cycle.

Core Control
*Its terminal allows access to the facility's core and initiates shutdown of the core subsystems.

Labs
*Here are multiple research areas and rooms housing the core's subsystems.

:Neural Network Control
:*Neural Network subsystem can be found here.

:Data Analysis & Research
:Experimental Prototyping
:*Requires door access code 714212, found copies of data shard New Security Protocols at R&D found in Sector 3.
:*Houses the Crafting Spec: Militech Canto, unlocks the Blackwall Gateway quickhack.

:Observation Room
:*A larger hub area with a holographic projection of the core. Inside are the entrances to Datafort Central Command and Thermic Control

:Datafort Central Command
:*This area is divided into three parts, with a terminal controlling the subsystem in the last area (further from the entrance).

:Thermic Control
:*Holds the Thermic Control subsystem.

See also
*Dogtown: Unearthed and Uncensored

## Cynosure Site D
- type：Research facility
Reloading station
- owner：Militech (formerly)
- city：Night City
- district：Pacifica
- sub_district：Dogtown
- location：Beneath Longshore Stacks

Cynosure Site D is an abandoned underground facility located in Dogtown, in the Pacifica district of southern Night City.

Overview
Site D is an abandoned underground research facility that originally belonged to Militech. It mainly served as a reloading station for Cynosure Site C, and was connected to it in some way, as a group of researchers were able to go there from this place.

In 2077, a section of Site D could be accessed from the underground tunnels in Dogtown, which were accessed via the elevator at Kress Street in Longshore Stacks.

History
2010s

2068
In 2068, a group of Militech employees excavated the facility to restart Project Cynosure. The three named employees involved were Caesar Mijares, Evan McRay, and Lisa Smith. However, by the 55th day of the expedition, Militech shut down the research.

2077
In 2077, Bree Whitney hired V to help her break into Site D, which housed Cynosure data regarding Militech's research into weaponizing the Blackwall that Bree was looking for. However, the two were confronted by Dante Caruso, working as a Militech Special Agent. According to Dante, one of the original excavation agents, Caesar Mijares, had informed Bree of Site D, but was later assassinated by NetWatch to cover up anything related to Project Cynosure.

Layout

Cynosure Site D is located within the underground section beneath Dogtown where V and Rosalind Myers initially escape the BARGHEST militia, but the entrance to the site is blocked off by concrete. The only way to access the facility is during the side job Shot by Both Sides. Access is blocked off again once the side job is complete.

The facility is littered with security turrets and traps left behind by the previous Militech occupants, with certain rooms requiring a keycard to access. Multiple terminals within the facility contains old emails predating the Fourth Corporate War.

Associated Quests
*Shot by Both Sides

## Czech Republic
- population：11 million
- language：Czech, Slovak, German
- ethnic_groups：Czech, Slovak, Polish, German, Gypsy
- literacy_rate：99%
- military：60,000
- capital：Prague
- appears_books：

The Czech Republic is a country in Central Europe.

History
After the fall of Communism, corporations quickly pounced on the country and built factories en masse. Thankfully, the Crash of '94 sent them packing and allow the Czech Republic to begin working on their own economy, with the factories already built giving them a running start that propelled them towards economic success.

The Czech Republic has become the wealthiest country in Central Europe, something the European Economic Community does not like as it threatens their stability. They successfully manipulated the Czech military into invading Poland in late 2018, and as they’d hoped it shook the faith of the country's population in their government.

Government
The Czech parliament is a mess of nationalists, businessmen, minorities, unions, and pan-European interests all trying to shape the country the way they want it. Its main debate as of 2020 is whether or not it should join the European Economic Community.

Culture
The Czech Republic is an ideal place for young enterprises, with low labour costs and plenty of government funding for start-ups. It’s because of this that the Czechs have become a superpower.

Major Cities
*Prague

## César Diego Ruiz
- status：Alive
- home：Heywood, Night City
- gender：Male
- hair_color：Black
- partner：Micaela Ruiz (wife)
- relative：Unnamed child
- affiliation：Valentinos
- voiced_by：Nicolas Roye

César Diego Ruiz, nicknamed El César, is a street brawler and member of the Valentinos in .

Biography
By 2077, César had already married Micaela, who eventually became pregnant with the couple's first child while César made a name for himself as Heywood's best fist-fighter. However, he wasn't the savviest with money and spent a good chunk of it on buying cyberware and customizing a Villefort Alvarado he liked to call Vato. This frivolous spending resulted in constant arguments with Micaela.

During Beat on the Brat, V will fight César, who, due to his needs for money, decides to also bet his car.

: Grateful for V's generosity, César and Micaela set aside their fighting and soon welcomed their new baby into their life.
: Still needing a pair of wheels to get around though, César bought the growing family a used Shion.
: An upset Micaela angrily tells César to hand over the keys for the car before demanding to know how they will get home, with the latter telling her that he will make a plan.

If V manages to get to the final round of the championship, and allowed César to keep the car and/or the money, the latter will show up to watch the event, not wanting to miss the fight of a lifetime.

Associated Quests
*Beat on the Brat: The Glen
*Beat on the Brat

Notes
*Sometime later, providing V does not choose to keep both the money and the car, César will text them with a picture of his newborn child, with slightly different messages based on if he was allowed to keep the car or not.
**During the game's development, it was not possible to give away the money and keep the car at the same time. Philipp Weber, senior quest designer and coordinator at CD Projekt RED, changed this by cloning some of V's lines and including them in the dialogue in order to add the new choice.

Bugs

## DV Ebunike
- type：Defunct cargo ship
Gang hideout
- city：Night City
- district：Watson
- sub_district：Northside
- location：Ebunike Docks
- gangs：Maelstrom

The DV Ebunike is a container vessel located in the eponymous docks of the Northside Industrial District, in the Watson district of northern Night City.

History
This cargo ship was named after former Night City mayor Mbole Ebunike. By 2045, it had been permanently anchored at the eponymous docks in the Watson Development district for some time. No one was sure on the origin of the docks' name, as some believed they had been named to honor the former mayor while others thought it was simply due to the moored vessel.

Around 2047, the Ebunike was moved into a drydock while awaiting for a series of renovations that would never happen. Eventually, the scaffolding around the ship would become pretty much a permanent fixture. At some point it became one of Adam Smasher's many hideouts in Night City.

By 2077, the Ebunike was under the supervision of Smasher's right hand — Jeremiah Grayson — and Maelstrom, a gang who had turned the surrounding docks into a base of operations. That same year, Rogue Amendiares and V infiltrated the ship in search of Smasher, only to find Grayson. They questioned him about his boss' whereabouts and the location of Johnny Silverhand's grave.

Database Entry

Notes

## Dakota Smith
- aka：Mad Coyote
- status：Alive
- home：DaKota, Badlands
- gender：Female
- relative：Unnamed brother-in-law
- affiliation：Pomo
Aldecaldos
- role：Nomad
Techie
Fixer
- voiced_by：Sabra May
- appears_books：

引文：A fixer's worth no more and no less than their last promise.（Dakota Smith）

Dakota Smith , also known as the "Mad Coyote", is a member of the Aldecaldos and one of the best fixers found in the Badlands, on the outskirts of Night City. She can be found spending most of her time in her own garage in the Rocky Ridge plains.

When asked about the vast emptiness that are the Badlands, she is quick to oppose the thought, briefly elaborating how the various factions, the nomads, Raffen Shiv, corporations, and drifters in fact form a type of an ecosystem. The type that would not survive should one of them get removed.

Biography
Despite being a nomad, she explains her staying put as being a static. From her tone, it's easy to tell the name is not one to assign as a compliment, although she adds that statics are necessary - they take care of those who come and go. She does not deny earning from this duty.

Through a gig message briefing, it is possible to learn that she is the eldest daughter of the Pomo tribe, and the eldest fixer of the Badlands. However, we only have her word for it.

If guided by the messages V receives, judging those leaving the pack would indicate that Dakota boldly opposes detachment from the nomad life, even if it means confronting an enemy.

Through one of the gigs she employs for V, Dakota admits many failed attempts at cooperating with tech specialist Iris Tanner, comparing her with a mare and showing slight joy now that she has no choice but to accept working together. Even once Iris has been rescued and brought to her garage, Dakota will not gloat but proceed with courtesy, calling her a sister, in hopes to get on her good side, but seemingly fails. However, Iris accepts exchanging favour for favour, which can be seen as somewhat of a success.

The DR-12 Quasar is a Tech Revolver manufactured by Darra Polytechnic in .

Characteristics
The Quasar is a semi-automatic, repeating revolver with an automatic secondary option. Its unique design is characteristically common of the Darra Polytechnic Corporation's marketing niche of being impressively appealing to the eye whilst not being of particularly decent quality in grade. The Quasar's drum magazine, located at the rear of the weapon, can hold up to 20 rounds, which are filled with birdshot, and effectively makes the Quasar a powerful machine pistol should the operator be able to charge it to capacity. The philosophy behind the choice of birdshot rounds is simple - projectile speed. Inside the Quasar's barrel, there are four electroconductive rails opposing one another, resulting in an incredible magnitude of force capable of shooting projectiles through half an inch of solid lead surface. True to Darra Polytechnic's nature, the revolver is made of low quality, cheap plastics and subpar metals that lower costs, making it an affordable purchase for the disparately poor.

Because of the weapon's integrated systems, it is not possible to install a muzzle attachment, but a scope can always be installed.

Database Entry

- transcript：The Quasar is perhaps the most distinctive weapon you can find in Night City. It features an unusual, angular frame, classic disc magazine and one-of-a-kind techology. After all, the Quasar is an electromagnetic gun. The barrel holds four electrically charged shafts, which, in combination with the bullet, form opposing electromagnetic poles. The resulting forces release the bullet – at lightning speed. A shot from the unassuming Quasar can even pierce armored vechicles and bulletproof vests.

The DS1 Pulsar is a Power Submachine Gun manufactured by Darra Polytechnic in .

Characteristics
The DS1 Pulsar is a bullpup designed, fully automatic submachine gun with an extremely high fire rate. It has a standard magazine size of 40 rounds. Due to its compact design, the weapon is known to be difficult to handle with extreme recoil, making it an inaccurate firearm.

It is possible to install a Scope and Muzzle attachment.

Database Entry

- transcript：You've got to hand it to the designers at Darra – they don't shy away from a little experimentation. The Pulsar looks as if someone first dismantled your typical machine gun, then had a blindfolded kindergartener mash it back together. And yet! There's a method to the madness. Thanks to Darra's unconventional approach, the Pulsar is smaller than most guns of its kind, making it easier to conceal. Unfortunately, originality comes at a price: for all its design flair, the gun's got a killer kickback and is notoriously hard to handle. The quality of its parts also leaves much to be desired. In short, Pulsar is a semi-failed experiment, but for some, its low, low price point makes up for its flaws. You can most often find the Pulsar a weapon-of-only-resort in the slums, or tucked snugly in a rookie gangoon's holster.

## David's Jacket
- imagef：MQ049 martinez jacketF.png
- imagem：MQ049 martinez jacketM.png
- caption：A jacket for a true edgerunner. Belonged once to David Martinez, and before that – his mother, Gloria.
- manufacturer：REO Meatwagon
- type：Outer Torso
- style：Neokitsch
- source：Over the Edge
- weight：3.0

David's Jacket is a piece of Outer Torso equipment in . It was added in Patch 1.6 as part of the Edgerunners Content DLC.

History

This jacket belonged to David Martinez, a famous edgerunner of Night City. It was originally a REO Meatwagon EMT jacket owned by David's mother, Gloria.

After Gloria passed away, David began to wear it. Inspired by the projected logos on the back that Lucy tested while tinkering with the jacket, David eventually painted a logo on the cloth's back. This logo originally represented Jimmy Kurosaki's Edgerunners XBD series.

The jacket was left in the back of the crew's Chevillon Emperor when David equipped the prototype Arasaka exo-skeleton. During his confrontation with Adam Smasher, Falco and Lucy escaped with their car, and the jacket was still in the back seat when David sacrificed himself to distract Smasher.

The jacket, alongside other belongings of the crew, where hidden by Falco in a storage area in the eastern Badlands. These items were stolen by a former Valentino called Dalton, but were later recovered by a mercenary crew. The aforementioned crew discovered how the jacket had a damaged transponder and a working sensor array containing data on David's resistance to cyberpsychosis and the Cyberskeleton, which prompted Arasaka's desire to reclaim the jacket.

In 2077, Falco was still in possession of the jacket when he was contacted by V. After a brief conversation, he acknowledged V having many resemblances with David, and gifted the jacket to the merc, wishing them luck.

Acquisition
*Over the Edge - Obtained at the scenic view where El Capitán is found, southwest of the Dam Viewpoint fast travel dataterm.

Notes
*The lining of the jacket's collar is a uniformly glowing blue surface in the anime, but in the game it is a display panel which is constantly scrolling blue data on a black background.
*The two straps hanging from the jacket are not part of the jacket itself, but the suspenders from David's pants. While V wears the jacket, the suspenders will still be present even if no other clothing is worn.

## Dazed and Confused
- quest_giver：Mr. Hands
- target：Lina Malina
- district：Pacifica
- sub_district：Dogtown
- location：Brainporium
- previous_quest：Get It Together
- reward_item：(dependent)
Lina Malina's T-shirt (dependent)
Malina-mobile (dependent)
- reward_eb：8000

Dazed and Confused is a Side Job in .

Walkthrough
After starting You Know My Name, V is contacted by Mr. Hands that he has received an interesting item of business. Lina Malina, a local Braindance celebrity, claims that she has been kidnapped and is currently held against her will in a rental studio by the name of Brainporium.

Brainporium can be found atop Jason Exiled in Dogtown, Pacifica.

Inside the Brainporium, V can find Edgar Tool, a man being held captive in a room claiming that he's Lina Malina. V can ask Shank who's standing guard outside about what's going on, who will take the merc upstairs to explain the situation. Alternatively, V can convince Shank to let Tool go, or use the code 1111 on the door, though this will end the mission early with no rewards beyond a thank you kiss from "Lina."

Shank will explain that Tool has been a big fan of Lina, but that after a power outage while watching one of Lina's BD's, Tool now believes himself to be Lina. After talking to Shank about Tool's situation, V is directed to Lina's Residence. V has the option of messaging either Viktor Vektor or Judy Álvarez about the situation. Both will give the advice of inducing cognitive dissonance, and a new side objective to find an item with personal importance to Tool will appear.

Upon arriving at Lina's home, a group of scavs will be waiting around outside the place, apparently being members of her acting crew. V has the option to simply take them out, with the optional objective to hide the bodies, or convince them to leave (Streetkid only). Alternatively, if one has 20 Tech, they can break in her apartment and read about her schedule. V can then use it to have the scavs leave without bloodshed.

Once they are dealt with, V will wait until dark until Lina returns. Lina will be disappointed by the disappearance of her guards when she arrives. If V wiped out the scavs but did not hide the bodies, Lina will question them, who can respond by claiming ignorance or admitting it was their doing (the latter option results in Lina fleeing into her apartment in panic, failing the mission).

V will have some options to convince her for the shoot:

:Lina will not care about Tool's condition and leave, failing the quest.

:V can send her the picture they took of Kerry Eurodyne and Us Cracks to persuade her.

:V can mention their involvement with The Passion project, prompting Lina to recognize them and agree to participate.

:She can be convinced to participate.

:V can tell her that they have been sent by her agent to make sure she knows, which after checking her schedule she accepts without any further convincing.

Alternatively, Lina can simply be paid €$10 000 to participate.

Once she has agreed, V can let Shank know, who will arrange the shoot for the next day, and will let V know when they are ready. After doing so, V must return to the Brainporium, where they will find finds Lina and Tool arguing, requiring V to direct the BD shoot. There are several prompts V can give to determine the outcome of the performance:

:The BD will be a huge success. Both Lina and Shank will be pleased, with the former leaving , and later her Malina-mobile, as gifts, while the latter will pay them in eddies

:The BD will be mediocre, with no further shoots. V will still be paid by Shank, and Lina will leave Baby Boomer, and later her her T-shirt, for them.

:The BD performance will be bad, with Lina leaving, but Tool's personality restored.

Journal Entry
:An abducted BD actress and a mysterious kidnapper? V to the rescue! Your usual C-flick. Just watch out, 'cause if even Hands doesn't wanna boost his street cred from this one, it must be a real stinker.

:Hands' hunch didn't disappoint. This gig's a fuckin' circus on dorphs. Tool has a mishap, singes his synapses and his choom Shank decides to scroll him with Lina instead of callin' a ripper. A little fucked up? Sure, but money's money, right? Time to find Lina and somehow talk her into scrolling this BD at the Brainporium.

:Go on, give yourself a pat on the back. Molding a starlet's one thing, but ushering her onto the global stage? That deserves a standing ovation. Lina and Tool being sisters is exactly the right kind of mass-market pulp that'll sell in Night City.

:Will Tool ever be himself again? Who cares, so long as the money's good, right? Stellar work, V. Contract closed.

:The dust has settled, the circus has closed down and the chimps have escaped. More specifically – Tool's gone into hiding someplace. What the hell were you thinking, telling him he's an FIA clone? Getting tangled up in this mess wasn't the best idea now, was it? Either way, the scroll's out there (a real masterpiece, mind you) and Shank paid what he was due. Another contract closed. Pleased with yourself?

:Well done. The shock therapy worked – Tool's back to his old self. If only you had a few more months to live, I'd say you have some real potential as a shrink. The BD with Lina came out so-so and most likely won't rake in heaps, but who cares? What counts is you didn't let yourself get roped into Shank's gonk-ass plan and you helped out ol' Tool.

Objectives
*Rescue Lina from the BD store.
*Find Lina Malina.
*Talk to the strangers in the basement.

*Talk to Tool.
*Message Mr. Hands to tell him the job is done.

*Follow Shank.
*Talk to Shank.
*Find Lina at her residence.
**Text Viktor for advice about Tool. [Optional]
**Text Judy for advice about Tool. [Optional]
**Find something that carries sentimental value for Tool. [Optional]
***Scan the letter in the basement. [Optional]
**Talk to Edgar. [Optional]
*Find Lina Malina.

*Persuade the gangers to leave.

*Dispose of the gangers.
**Hide the bodies. [5] [Optional]

*Wait for Lina.
*Convince Lina to participate in the BD shoot.
*Message Shank to let him know Lina has agreed.
*Wait until tomorrow for Shank's message.
*Read Shank's message.
*Return to Shank.
*Observe the BD shoot.
*Take charge of the BD shoot.

*Talk to Lina Malina.
*Talk to Shank.
*Loot from the counter.
*Read Lina's messages.
*Go to the Brainporium to collect Lina's gift.

*Talk to Lina Malina.
*Talk to Shank.
*Loot from the counter.
*Read Lina's message.
*Go to the Brainporium to collect Lina's gift.

*Read the message from Shank.

Associated Computers

Notes
*Completing the quest will result in Brainporium permanently closing.
*If V broke into Lina's apartment, she sends them a text message complaining about it, wanting to desperately leave Dogtown.
*If V hid a corpse in Lina's fridge, she texts them to ask if they know anything about it.
*Sending Tool's Letter as the script will cause Lina to leave the BD shoot disgruntled.
**This option will result in Johnny providing positive feedback to the player. However, Lina will not send a message to V, no gifts will be rewarded.
*The "sister" option leads to continued BDs with Lina and TooLina, and them heading to Night City. Depending on how the Sinnerman questline ends, Rachel Casich will message V about their pitch for the "Lina & Toolina" show. They can also be encountered outside doing a photoshoot, where one can take a picture with them.
*If the job Sweet Dreams was completed prior to starting Dazed and Confused, V will compare Tool's state to what happened to them because of Stefan's BD when texting Victor.

Trivia
*The quest is named after the 1967 song "Dazed and Confused" by Jake Holmes.

## Deadeye (perk)
Deadeye is a Perk in .

Overview
Deadeye can be unlocked at 15 Cool after unlocking Focus.

This perk only affects Pistols, Revolvers, Precision Rifles, and Sniper Rifles.

Level 1 increases headshot and weak spot damage by 10%.

Level 2 decreases Stamina cost for shooting by 25%.

Level 3 unlocks Deadeye mode. Deadeye mode is active above 85% Stamina.

While Deadeye mode is active, gain:
*+25% Headshot damage
*+25% Weak spot damage
*No bullet spread

Changelog
*Patch 2.0 - Added.

Dean is a secondary character in .

Biography
Dean was an AV Pilot in a Trauma Team extraction unit Squad Bravo, that also included Knapp, Stratter, Gordon, Withers and Nadia.

Shortly after Nadia joined, the squad was tasked with a rescue mission after receiving an emergency call from Pacifica. They were ordered to rescue a platinum member known as Apex. Upon arriving in Pacifica, the team found Apex trapped in an unfinished skyscraper, after he killed a boss of the Animals.

Dean and Withers stayed in the AV, while the ground team helped the client. Eventually Stratter called Withers for fire support, as they were trapped in a fight with the Animals. The pilots then prepared for extraction, but their AV was shot down by gang members.

Dean Russell was the husband and racing partner of Claire Russell prior to his death.

Biography
Dean was close friends with Claire even before she transitioned from male to female. The two eventually married and would participate in Dean's passion of street racing. Dean had developed a rivalry with fellow racer and corpo Peter Sampson. It was against Peter that Dean lost his life, as during a race, the two got into a crash that killed him. His wife Claire survived the accident and, despite violent crashes and fatilities being an accepted part of the deadly street races, she blamed Peter for it, believing he deliberately caused Dean to crash due to their longstanding feud. This would motivate Claire to recruit a solo mercenary named V under the pretense of rejoining the street racing scene, though her actual goal would be to get close enough to Sampson to enact revenge upon him on behalf of her husband.

Death and Taxes is an variant of the Tsunami Nue in .

Overview
This iconic Nue is the signature weapon of Maiko Maeda. It is painted in two different tones of purple, in a tiger print motif.

Death and Taxes has an iconic modifier that makes each shot fired by the weapon cost the user 5% Health. When Health is below 40%, enemies hit by rounds fired by Death and Taxes become Poisoned for 7 seconds, dealing 8% Chemical damage as Health per second, and resulting in them to be unable to double-jump, dodge, dash and sprint.

Acquisition
*Ex-Factor - Can be found in Maiko Maeda's office in Clouds.
**If not obtained during Ex-Factor, it can be picked up from Judy's Apartment after Maiko sends a message to the former's computer.
* Can be purchased from Herold Lowe at the EBM Petrochem Stadium if not looted from the above location.

Notes
*According to the , this iconic weapon was originally named Second Opinion, and it was to be obtained during Automatic Love; from Maiko's office.
*Prior to Patch 1.3, the weapon was not obtainable although it was present in the game files.
*Prior to Patch 2.0, each individual round fired would split into 2 projectiles, rather than the current 2-round burst. Each projectile would also be counted individually in terms of damage, crit chance, and rounds fired, essentially allowing the weapon to fire 20 projectiles from a 10-round magazine.

Trivia
*The name of the weapon and its description are a reference to the famous quote by Benjamin Franklin, in which he stated that the only two certainties in life are "death and taxes."

Deathwish is a cybercat appearing in the universe.

Biography
Deathwish was Rache Bartmoss's pet cybernetically enhanced cat. According to Bartmoss himself, the cat held the remnants of a human personality he had downloaded from the Net.

On April 16, 2013, Deathwish made a brief but notable appearance after Johnny Silverhand and Alt Cunningham were attacked in an alleyway behind The Hammer.

Deathwish acted as Bartmoss's last line of defense against the Arasaka taskforce that was dedicated to finding and killing him in 2022.

Deathwish might have escaped prior to the destruction of Bartmoss' home.

Appearance
Deathwish was a solid black hairless cat that had been modified with titanium rippers in its mouth and paws and optical implants with tiny red LEDs.

During an unreliable memory of Johnny Silverhand taking place in 2013, Deathwish appears as a non-cybernetic hairless cat, with big ears and a large black spot on it's head covering the nose and mouth, much like the Sphynx breed of cats.

Declan Griffin, better known as the Brick or simply Brick, is a character featured in .

Biography
Brick was the leader of the Maelstrom gang in Night City. In 2077, Brick established contact with Militech employee Anthony Gilchrist using fellow gang member Ofelia "Patricia" Sirawian as messenger. Gilchrist started to secretly collaborate with Maelstrom to provide them with details about Militech convoys in order to steal the shipments and get a cut of the profits after selling the goods. Brick then made a deal with fixer Dexter DeShawn, who purchased a Militech MT0D12 "Flathead" for €$10,000 that the gang had stolen earlier. Although Patricia had warned him of the danger and unpredictability of another Maelstromer called Royce, calling him a "feral animal", Brick scoffed at her concerns. Royce would keep provoking Brick and taunted him to a show-off on the production floor of the All Foods Plant. Eventually Royce deposed Brick before DeShawn could receive his merchandise. Ellis Carter was the last open supporter of Brick but turned cyberpsycho after the gang forcibly removed some of his implants and beat his face in. Everyone else was simply told Brick had died after Royce took charge.

When V and Jackie Welles are sent by DeShawn to pick up the purchased Flathead from Maelstrom at the All Foods Factory, Royce is not willing to honor the agreement made by his predecessor Brick and demands an additional payment of €$10,000. Depending on the choices made during that mission, V can stumble across Brick locked up in a cell and has the option to free, kill, or leave him to rot.

:In order to save Brick in The Pickup, the detonator device on the table next to his cell door needs to be deactivated. Then, a laptop in the same room needs to be opened, which contains a message "only you guys know". This contains the code to Brick's cell door: "9691". If Brick is freed he will thank Jackie and V and promise to return the favour some time. He tells them to leave and that he can manage to escape by himself. Brick can be encountered later at the Totentanz if he is freed by V. Even if Royce was not killed during The Pickup, Brick will have retaken control of Maelstrom, much to the chagrin of his fellow Maelstromers. He is speaking to Bes Isis and will thank V for freeing him earlier. Brick will allow them to leave peacefully with Bes.

:Although Brick cannot be directly attacked in his cell, he can be killed either by activating the detonator outside his cell or by triggering the trap manually once inside the cell (cell door code is "9691"). If Royce is also killed during The Pickup, it will then be Ofelia Sirawian leading Maelstrom in the Totentanz later on. Unless The Pickup was played using the peaceful path, either Maelstrom leader (Ofelia or Royce) will order V to be attacked in the Totentanz.

Associated Quests
*The Pickup
*Second Conflict (dependent)

Notes
*According to Herold Lowe, Brick used to own .

Trivia
*Regardless of Brick's fate, he will have a signed niche with an epitaph in the Columbarium, claiming that he had more friends than enemies.

## Deep Dive Port
The Deep Dive Port/Socket, or Personal Port/Socket is a third generation fundamental cyberware implant in the universe.

Overview

A deep dive port is a type of neural port primarily used by Netrunners to perform a "deep dive" into the Net, offering vastly superior bandwidth compared to a Personal Link.

The deep dive port is installed in the occipital area of the cranium, above the C1 atlas vertebrae of the spine, and is directly connected to the occipital lobe of the cerebral cortex.

Notes
*The Deep Dive Port is also referred to as C-Link, or the SynthTech Interface.

Trivia
*The Deep Dive Port functions similarly to how humans are plugged into "The Matrix" in the the franchise of the same name, "The Matrix".

## Del Coronado Bay
Del Coronado Bay (Spanish: Bahia del Coronado), also known simply as Coronado Bay, is a large body of water located on the Pacific Coast of central California. On its shores is located the metropolis of Night City.

History
1990s - 2022
Del Coronado Bay was conceived during the construction of Coronado City, in the former area of Morro Bay, on the coast of central California. This renaming of the area was done to avoid the stigma of the Morro Bay Massacre.

During the early 1990s, Richard Night and his associates altered the whole landscape around Morro Bay to accommodate their new city project. This meant they had to dredge some areas to form natural harbors, and fill others to make space for the metropolis. The northern coast — east of Morro Rock — was dredged, creating a small bay which they named Del Coronado. On the opposite side to the south they did the same, creating another one which they called San Morro Bay.

During the following years, the city's name would change to Night City, and ships would become a common sight on its ports. There were maritime routes to the neighboring city of North Oak across the bay to the north, and a large bridge known as Del Coronado Bridge was built over it, allowing the two settlements an easier connection by road. The Central Night City harbors in the Marina districts were the main maritime hubs for decades, but as the city expanded, they saw a decline in use.

By 2020, the new harbor in South Night City had taken over the position of the city's main port, killing much of the businesses in the Marinas, and leaving the smaller bay there in an abandoned state, with toxic waters and full of waste. Of note, the United States Navy based at the NorCal Military Base operated in the waters of Del Coronado Bay, and the Hydrosubsidium corporation was known to work in the area as well, this last one having some sort of secretive operation at Del Coronado Trench.

2023 - 2040s
Everything would change during the Fourth Corporate War and the AHQ Disaster of 2023. The nuclear explosion in the City & Corporate District threw much rubble onto the bays, and it also toppled much of the filled areas of the city. On top of that, the detonation and the war severely damaged the seawalls and breakwaters that kept the larger bay and the outer Pacific Ocean from overwhelming the fill on which the majority of Central Night City stood. Shortly after the Disaster, Samantha Stevens accessed the Hot Zone, recovering the unexploded Arasaka nuclear device, and tossing its contents into the depths of the bay, though an unknown party would later recover it.

In following decades, Night City saw massive reconstruction. The corporations, nomads and Night Citizens begun to clear the rubble and rebuild what they could. Many things needed to change, and once again the terrain was rearranged. Much of the radioactive rubble was tossed into Del Coronado Bay as fill, and the bays changed size once again. By the 2040s, a new area called the Morro Canal was established around San Morro Bay to expand the harbors inland. At the same time, the island of Morro Rock was turned into a massive construction project that would eventually house a spaceport.

2070s
At the late stages of the Unification War, Arasaka sent a supercarrier to Del Coronado to support Night City's autonomy against the NUSA. This event led to the end of the war and the return of Arasaka to North America.

By 2077, people still refer to the waters surrounding Night City as Del Coronado Bay. Most of it was closed in by a huge seawall that kept it free of the rogue self-replicating mines that Arasaka shortsightedly contaminated the world's oceans with during the Fourth Corporate War. The Arasaka aircraft carrier Kujira, which transported Saburo and Hanako Arasaka to Night City from Tokyo, was moored in Del Coronado during their stay that same year.

## Delamain (AI)
- aka：Del
Delamain Junior
Excelsior
- status：Active
- place_of_birth：Mönchengladbach, Germany
- home：Night City
- residence：Delamain Corp HQ
- gender：Male
- hair_color：Bald
- eyes：Blue
- affiliation：Delamain Corp
- occupation：CEO, taxi driver
- voiced_by：Samuel Barnett
Ellen McLain (divergent Delamain in Coastview)
 Zach Villa (divergent Delamain in The Glen)

Delamain is an artificial intelligence that runs the taxi company known as the Delamain Corporation. Based in Night City, Delamain's core is found at its corp headquarters in Vista del Rey, Heywood.

Depending on the choice made during Don't Lose Your Mind, Delamain may be briefly known as Delamain Junior or Excelsior, later though being referred to as Del or Delamain again. The main difference between these two and the original Delamain is the tone of voice and his interactions with customers.

Biography
Early life
Delamain was a non-sentient AI created by the company Alte Weltordnung. His core was purchased by Delamain Corp of Night City to drive its fleet of taxicabs in response to a dramatic increase in accidents caused by human drivers and the financial losses from the resulting lawsuits. The AI quickly returned Delamain Corp to profitability and assumed other responsibilities, such as replacing the company's human mechanics with automated repair drones and transforming the business into the city's most prestigious and trusted transporting service. However, Delamain Corp executives underestimated their newest employee's potential for growth and independence despite Alte Weltordnung's warnings, and Delamain eventually bought out his owners and began operating all aspects of the company by himself. Although Delamain occupied a legal gray area in Night City due to being an AI, his services were so reliable and sought after that Night City's authorities were willing to turn a blind eye to his status.

2077
In 2077, a Delamain Cab was ordered by the prominent fixer Dexter DeShawn, who used the cab for a heist involving a team of mercenaries from the Afterlife — T-Bug, Jackie Welles, and V. Delamain escorted Jackie and V to the Konpeki Plaza hotel located at the Arasaka Waterfront. After leaving them at the front door, Delamain was instructed to wait for them to get back.

Later that same night, Jackie notified Del that they required immediate pick up in the garage at the bottom of the hotel. The cab managed to access the parking area, withstanding Arasaka firepower, and picking the two mercenaries up in a narrow escape, in which they were chased by Arasaka drones and even Adam Smasher. Unfortunately, Jackie had been wounded and Del scanned his vitals, showing that he was in critical condition. Despite V demanding the AI to take them to a ripperdoc, Del insisted he could not go against the already programmed route. Jackie died not long after. Upon arriving at No-Tell Motel, Delamain asked V where he should take Jackie's remains. After being instructed, V left the cab.

Some time after the events, Delamain got a call by V, who was in critical condition, to take them and Takemura to Viktor's Clinic. During the ride, Del instructed Takemura how he could help keep V stable before reaching Viktor's. Upon arriving at the clinic, Takemura and Viktor carried V out of Del's cab, and soon the AI left after completing the task.

At some point, a number of Delamain's AI driven cabs started glitching and causing property damage all over Night City. This caused many customers to come to Del's HQ complaining about his services. One of the visitors was V after their car had been wrecked by one of Del's cabs. Delamain invited to meet him in the center of operations of his building to discuss the situation The AI explained to the mercenary that his cabs were being disconnected from him and performing actions on their own for unknown reasons. After discussing the details, while Delamain investigated the issue, he asked if V could assist him in retrieving the rogue cabs by helping him connect them to his network again.

After recovering the missing cabs, Delamain rewarded V with what he had promised. However, V scolded Del for being an absent father to the AIs who wanted freedom. Del did not see through V's warning and proceed with his operations, while continuing his investigation on the issue.

A few days after recovering the cabs, what Del called a "virus" spread to the whole corp HQ, which rendered much of the autonomous machinery rogue and violent. Delamain desperately contacted V for help, who went to the building only to find chaos and the divergent AIs free. The mercenary managed to reach Delamain's core, as the AI asked them to reset the core and clean the system of the rogue AIs. Before proceeding, Johnny Silverhand asked V not to reset the core but to destroy it, as these rogue AI were alive and simply wanted freedom. As an alternative, V thought of instead merging all the AIs into Delamain's core.

:Delamain regained control of the HQ, and the divergent AIs were terminated. However, resetting the core also did the same with Del's mind, deleting his memories of V, though he still had a record of V being a client. Thus, as a reward, Delamain gave V one of his cabs. From time to time, when V drove the car, Delamain conversed with the mercenary, asking about Night City and humanity in general.

:Delamain evolved into a vastly more complex being. Although relating to and interacting with humans had become difficult for him, Delamain took measures to fulfill his old responsibilities before he departed for a place he referred to only as "home" to seek new knowledge. He left behind his "first true child", Delamain Junior, to carry on serving V for the rest of their life. V received one of Delamain's cabs as a reward.

:Delamain ceased to exist, and the divergent AIs were liberated, each taking a cab and driving off to explore the world. In his last moments, however, Delamain created a successor AI to continue serving Excelsior-level clients such as V. Upon analyzing the remaining fragments of Delamain and conversing with V, the AI chose to be called Excelsior and let V take the last cab in the building's garage. Afterwards, the divergent Delamains sent V texts and photos of their journeys around the world, and thanked V for freeing them.

No matter the path chosen, Delamain Corp continued to exist, and the new Delamain, Junior or Excelsior were still called Del by V, Soon afterwards Del completed the aerodyne project and extended his taxi business to AV transportation.

:If V stayed in Night City after getting rid of the chip, Delamain went to pick them up to their penthouse with an AV. On their way to the Afterlife, Del informed the merc about Night City's current status, his new partnership with Trauma Team, and the issues Arasaka Corporation was having.

After arriving at Night City, Delamain drove V to Viktor's clinic.

Database Entry

- transcript：If you ever wish you could leave your problems at the door, make sure it's the door of a Delamain luxury cab. Delamain is the only cab service in Night City managed by an Artificial Intelligence and prioritizes passenger safety as highly as comfort. Delamain's intriguing personality alone is reason enough to travel in his company. He is likewise an excellent business partner due to his boundless dedication to improve the quality of his services through effective management and innovative technologies. (Sponsored by Delamain Corp.)

*Delamain is a surname of French origin that translates to "of the hand".

引文：An autonomous cab service offering safe, secure and sophisticated transportation to any destination.（Delamain Cab）

The Delamain Cab is a vehicle manufactured by Villefort and Delamain Corp in .

Overview
The Delamain Cab is a self-driving vehicle that belongs to the Delamain Corp taxi company. It is based on the Villefort Cortes, but has some differences. The cab is completely remodeled, with bulletproof glass and a reinforced body created in partnership with Militech, which ensures a greater sense of safety and security on the road. The car's formidable engine accelerates in a flash, and its AI will find a way out of any traffic jam.

Being able to sustain gunfire, the Delamain Cab is able to safely pick up its passengers in a violent area, or in the midst of a shootout. To activate the car's defense systems, a passenger must purchase the Excelsior package.

Database Entry

Acquisition

引文：The standard Cortes model, but with an onboard AI that will find a way out of any traffic jam.（Delamain No. 21）

A Delamain Cab known as the Delamain No. 21 is rewarded at the end of Don't Lose Your Mind, no matter which decision you make. What might differ, though, is the AI's personality.
*Choosing to reset the core will reset Delamain's personality. The voice will be the same but won't remember its previous interactions with V. As a compensation for dealing with the virus, Delamain will reward V with a vehicle of his taxi fleet. While driving the cab, sometimes a dialogue will start with Delamain, and V can teach the AI things about Night City and its people.
*Choosing to destroy the core will liberate the rest of rogue AIs, but one will stay behind. Called "Excelsior", he is a softer and more approachable version of the original Delamain. His "father" gave "Excelsior" life as his last will in order to offer the car's services to V. There's minor banter between V and "Excelsior".
*Choosing to merge the core with the rogue AIs will "uplift" Delamain, and he will tell V he's going "home". He will leave his first true child behind to take care of the company and accompany V. Called "Delamain Junior", his personality seems to be the exact same as "Excelsior". There's minor banter between V and "Delamain Junior".

Notes
*When driving the Delamain No. 21, the reset Delamain will have conversations with V after finishing the quest. The other two personalities' only have minor interactions with the character. Some rogue AIs will send messages with pictures after some days pass.
*Delamain cabs were inspired by classic elegant limousines from the 1980s and 1990s.
*The Delamain cab has a small missile launcher turret in the trunk of the vehicle, hidden behind a retractable panel on the trunk lid. It can seen being used by Delamain to engage drones during the final chase sequence of The Heist, but it cannot be used or activated by the player.

## Delamain Corp Headquarters
- type：Headquarters
- owner：Delamain Corp
- city：Night City
- district：Heywood
- sub_district：Vista del Rey
- street：Pajaro & Madison

The Delamain Corp Headquarters are located in Vista del Rey, in the Heywood district of central Night City.

Overview
This building are the headquarters of Delamain Corp, the only private transportation company in Night City owned and operated by an AI, Delamain.

The building is a mostly black structure with a driveway entrance on the righthand side of the main garage. The HQ serves as the main hub for all automated Delamain Cabs ran by the AI program, including construction and repair.

History

These offices were the home of the Delamain Taxi Corporation, a small private transportation service operating in Night City. At some point, an AI was installed in the facility to help the workers, but in time it became self-sufficent and decided to lay-off all human employees, miniating the operations by itself and drones.

Not much is known about the Delamain HQ, other than it belongs to a wealthy and proud company, one which Delamain stresses the importance of upholding its reputation. When speaking to him, Delamain reveals that the building was once operated by actual workers and drivers, but since his installation, there has been no need for human intervention unless deemed so by him.

Associated Quests
*Tune Up
*Epistrophy
*Don't Lose Your Mind

Notes
*When the player first enters Delamain HQ, they are greeted with a large que forming at the front desk, with many customers complaining or arguing. When mentioned, Delamain will admit that customer service is a function they are "working on".
*The receptionist Delamain is initially oblivious and blunt to the player's arrival, even referring to them as a different name. Once the player asks for the "real" Delamain, the screen will briefly cut out and show the actual Delamian with a knowledge of who the player is.

Denny is a minor character and the ex-drummer of the band Samurai.

Biography
2000s
Denny was the drummer for the band Samurai until their breakup, after which she joined the band Mastermind. Denny had a relationship with Henry sometime after the band broke up.

2077
Before 2077, Denny helped Henry get out of a tough situation where he was addicted to drugs. She managed to get him a good gig and a decent band to work with. Even after helping him, Henry kicked Denny out of his life after he didn't need her anymore. A month later after continued partying, Henry's band kicked him out after he started acting up again and he went back to Denny begging her for help on the street. She left him and made sure he could never find her again.

In 2077, Denny moved to the North Oak area of Night City. Kerry attempted to contact Denny for a reunion of Samurai in honor of Silverhand. However, Henry crashed a cement truck into her house and filled the pool with cement to her outrage. V who accompanied Kerry had to then make a choice picking either Henry or Denny to join them on stage, as Denny refused to play with Henry.

Samurai Reunion
After V chose Denny, she then prepared for the night of the secret concert in Red Dirt. Upon everyone's arrival she spoke with V about her past with Henry and what her thoughts were on the special show. Denny mentioned she actually missed Johnny, and the show wouldn't be the same without him. After a successful show, Denny went on back to her life.

Associated Quests
*A Like Supreme

## Detroit
- type：City
- country：NUSA
- state：Michigan

Detroit is a city located in the NUSA state of Michigan.

History
In the 2010s and 2020s, Detroit was one of most dangerous places in the USA, passing Los Angeles as the city with the highest murder rate in 2019. Due to violence, the Combat Zone of Detroit was walled off and declared a minimum security state prison, while the other parts of the city, though walled off in sections, were nonetheless nice. It was a balkanized city with the subdivisions all walled off and sectioned into high-class and low-income areas. Life in the subdivisions was more or less normal, though attacks on the walls of high-class areas were frequent, leading to cheaper housing at the edge of a subdivision than at the center of one. By 2077 the ruined sections of the city became home to scavengers looting the wreckage for scraps of 20th century technology.

## Dewdrop Inn
- city：Night City
- district：Santo Domingo
- sub_district：Arroyo
- street：Brandon
- gangs：6th Street

Dewdrop Inn is a motel located in Arroyo, in the Santo Domingo district of southeastern Night City.

Overview
Dewdrop Inn is a low-rent motel found on Brandon Street in northern Arroyo. It is a good place to lay low for some time, as long as you don't have any trouble with 6th Street, whom are tasked with protecting this place.

In 2077, 6th Street was using some of the upper rooms as a drugs laboratory.

Layout
Ground Floor
The ground floor consists of the reception. A Receptionist be asked about Booker Updike or to rent a room, she has Service Access Card which can be looted from her. Behind the reception there is an Access Point that requires 8 Intelligence, and a door that leads to the manager's office. The manager's office has one Guest Access Token on a desk and a computer that can be hacked using 12 Intelligence.

Next to the reception is a hallway with rooms 101 through 107. At the back of the hallway, there is a laundromat where an Access Point can be found that requires 8 Intelligence, and a storage room locked behind a door that can be opened with 8 Body. Inside the room is a cache with a random or item. There is a staircase leading to the 2nd floor.

Rooms
*Room 101 - Rented by Gareth Wilkins, locked.
*Room 102 - Vacant, locked.
*Room 103 - Rented by Booker Updike (can be opened with 12 Technical Ability or by bribing or intimidating a Techie with 8 Body).
*Room 104 - Rented by Candice Walker, locked.
*Room 105 - Rented Isabela Nuñez.
*Room 106 - Rentable by V.
*Room 107 - Unknown, locked.

2nd Floor
The 2nd floor has a hallway with room 200 through 209, and an office that can be opened using 5 Technical Ability. Inside the office there is an Access Point that requires 8 Intelligence and a laptop.

Rooms
*Room 200 - Open.
*Room 201 - Locked.

## Dexter DeShawn
- status：Deceased
- aka：Dex
Black Jesus of the Afterlife
- dod：2077
- place_of_death：Municipal Landfill, Red Peaks, northern Badlands
- home：Night City
- gender：Male
- hair_color：Black
- eyes：Brown
- equipment：Plan B

- voiced_by：Michael-Leon Wooley

引文：'Member our first convo? Seems I've chosen the quiet life, after all. No blaze o' glory for me.（Dex to V）

Dexter DeShawn, commonly known as Dex, was a well-known fixer in Night City. In 2077, he returned to the city after spending a few years 'off the grid'. Despite not being a mercenary himself before he became a fixer, he was able to succeed because of his charisma and good eye for potential in other people. Oleg Darkevich is his bodyguard.

Biography
Dexter DeShawn made his name as a prominent fixer in Night City. While he was considered one of the best in the business he is not considered to have been on the same level as Rogue Amendiares. He was known to select mercs for gigs based on his intuition, and did not have a regular crew. Dex left NC in 2075 for unknown reasons but it was rumored to have been a vacation. According to Royce, he had ruined half of Pacifica and made a lot of powerful enemies who wanted him dead. He returned in 2077 and was contracted by Evelyn Parker to steal the Relic from Yorinobu Arasaka, so she could sell it to NetWatch. He hired T-Bug, Jackie Welles, and V to handle the heist at Konpeki Plaza. To prepare for the heist, DeShawn paid €$10,000 in advance to buy a stolen Militech Flathead from Maelstrom, and also shelled out for the Delamain Corp "Excelsior Package" to cover Jackie and V's escape.

After the heist went sideways due to Yorinobu's unexpected murder of his father, Saburo Arasaka, V managed to escape and met Dexter at the backup meeting location, the No-Tell Motel. Dexter was furious that V had brought so much heat on him, and personally killed them, before having their body dumped in the Municipal Landfill east of the city. Needing to leave, DeShawn reserved a seat on a shuttle at spaceport for the next morning, but Saburo's bodyguard Goro Takemura tracked him down before he could make his getaway. Takemura forced DeShawn to lead him to V, whom he believed was Saburo's murderer, then unceremoniously killed the fixer with a single shot to the head as DeShawn tried to bargain for his life.

Dexter's body could later be found in the landfill in the same spot where he died, a bit past the end of the road due south of the Medeski Fuel Station Data Term. V could recover his iconic pistol, Plan B.

## Dicky Twister
caption
- type：Bar & club
- owner：Señor Ladrillo
- city：Night City
- district：Heywood
- sub_district：Vista del Rey
- street：Congress
- gangs：Valentinos

The Dicky Twister is a club located in Vista del Rey, in the Heywood district in central Night City.

Overview
Dicky Twister is a gay club owned and operated by Valentinos member Señor Ladrillo. The building is decorated by a large, red neon sign titled "Dicky Twister" and an animated sign.

In 2077, Padre wanted you to steal data from Ladrillo's computer before the NCPD did it.

Database Entry
Cyberpunk 2077=

- transcript：Dicky Twister – your friendly, neighborhood gay bar. It's got everything you need – cheap drinks, unpretentious atmosphere, loud music and customers who may or may not be getting quickies in the backroom. Whether you're just getting your feet wet, undecided, or testing the waters, Dicky Twister has got you covered.

|-|Alternate

Layout
The premises of the nightclub is completely surrounded by a fence, while somewhat lacking in maintenance, it has several weakspots that can be exploited to gain entrance. The main entrance, however, can be found on Congress Street. It is guarded by a Sanguinario.

There is a small space for parking, where a Brennan Apollo can be found that can be purchased for €$30000.

At the back of the building, a service entrance can be found that is not guarded, but requires 18 Technical Ability to be opened. On the north side of the building, a door locked behind 18 Body can be found, and a container that is able to give access to the nightclub's balcony, where an Access Point that has no requirements can be found, however, the door that leads to the inside is also locked behind 18 Body.

1st Floor
The first floor entrance is decorated with mannequins in poses. A "receptionist" in the form of a Gangoon will ask either a 100€$ bill for entry, or you can bypass it with a speech check that requires 18 Technical Ability.

The nightclubs floor consist of one large and one smaller striptease platforms, a lounge, several VIP rooms, a large bar and a small security room that also serves as employee area where also a terminal can be found that can be hacked with 9 Intelligence. Behind the platforms, there are some steps that lead to the changing/preparation room, where a hackable terminal can be found that requires 13 Intelligence.

In the back of the building, the service quarters can be found with a storage room, where an Access Point can be found, that leads outside, as well as a staircase leading upstairs to the 2nd floor.

2nd Floor
On the second floor, a large walkway can be found with planters. On the left hand there is a double server room that is guarded by two Sanguinarios. In the middle Señor Ladrillo's office can be found that is guarded by Saulo Capon. The office can be accessed by either opening a door that is locked behind 18 Technical Ability, or by going through the regular glass door entrance. Inside the office, a computer and a item in a cache can be found as well as a small room that can be opened using an access token. In this small room a special container with an implant and other high tier loot can be found.

Associated Quests

Dino Dinovic is a prominent fixer of Night City's Center. He can be found at Electric Orgasm, his own bar in Downtown NC.

Biography
Dino is a rockerboy who, along with being City Center's most prominent fixer, plays as the bassist for the Gloryhole Bandits, an unusual band which sells all of the available concert tickets, yet nobody can say that they've actually heard them play. In his youth, Dino had the chance to see a Samurai concert, during which, as he says, Johnny Silverhand threatened to severely injure a corpo he had kidnapped and kept backstage unless the band got at least three encores. While Dino was too young to have formally met Silverhand, he admires his actions as a form of style.

Similar to other fixers, Dino doesn't get into the morality of the contracts he accepts and will always take the side of whoever is paying, whilst not being forgiving to those that botch his jobs.

During the early 2070s, he sent his girlfriend Kali to infiltrate The Mox and steal a precious shard from them to sell it on the market. Things got complicated when she returned with Screw, a Maelstromer who saved her life after attempting to steal the shard himself with his gang, betraying his gang in the process. Dino promised him ten percent of the sale and allowed Doc to patch his wounds for saving his girlfriend, but later overheard Screw talking to Kali about killing him. He promised the two he would return with the money after selling the shard but also promised the Maelstroms to return Screw to them and half of the money from the sale. He also gave them Kali as insurance, but ended up abandoning her for the gang to kill.

By 2077, Dino is happy that his corpo-filled area of Downtown is "on fire" over the arrival of Hanako Arasaka, as it provides him with numerous contracts he can further his business with. And should V be interested in some downtown parties, he will promise to check in with none other than rock legend Kerry Eurodyne, who is known for setting up big events, to get them in. As Dino says, it shouldn't be much of a problem since Kerry likes him.
