Eden Beach is an abandoned amusement park located in Coastview, in the Pacifica district of southern Night City.

Overview
Considered an extension of the facilities at the Grand Imperial Mall, Eden Beach was developed as an amusement park with plans for a lottery that would allow mall clients to participate for the chance of winning free ride tickets after every purchase at the adjacent establishment. The park was planned during the 2060s as a bigger and better Playland by the Sea, but during the Unification War, investors pulled out their funding and the project was not finished, with much of the park uncomplete. Despite this outcome, some rides were operational, most notably a functional rollercoaster known as the Mega Ride, and a ferris wheel. A large pier dotted the northeastern portion.

Edgar Tool, also known as TooLina, is a character in .

Appearance

Edgar Tool is a large man that has fully copied Lina Malina's appearance, apart from her eyes and eyebrows. He instead has brown eyes and pink eyebrows.

As he tries to cosplay Lina's long-lost twin, he is wearing a pair of rimless round glasses, and has several golden piercings adorning his head, of which are: a circular barbell septum piercing, a left nose ring, a pair of cross earrings and various other ear piercings. Around his neck he wears a silver choker that is decorated with red gemstones, and two golden necklaces of which one has a golden cross.

His outfit consists of an orange/pink/purple gradient ballistic vest with black tiger stripes, that is accessorized with a black shoulder holster holstering two gold-plated Militech M-10AF Lexingtons.

On his hands he wears a pair of purple and gold gradient fingerless gloves that reveal his orange fingernails, and a pair of gold and black sleeves that extend up to his upper arms. The number "26" is tattooed on both of his shoulders, which are accompanied by a portrait tattoo of a woman on his left shoulder and a tattoo of a rose on his right shoulder.

On his lower body he wears black and purple MaxiWear panties, with a black and purple gradient stockings and garter with black tiger stripes. On his feet his is wearing a pair of black and purple slip-on sneakers with orange tongues and black tiger stripes.

Biography

:After acting out a scene where Edgar and Lina play long lost sisters, Edgar is pleased with the result, and the braindance becomes a success. The pair of them sign a contract with Fourth Wall Studios and move to Night City where they will record a new series of braindances. They will be sightseeing Night City together and post updates for their TruFans followers.

:Edgar and Lina can subsequently be found outside of the Fourth Wall Studios in Japantown, Westbrook alongside Shank. Their future plans involve taking over Night City and possibly the rest of the world.

## Edgerunner (perk)
Edgerunner is a Perk in .

Overview
Edgerunner can be unlocked at 20 Technical Ability after unlocking License To Chrome.

Unlocking this perk allows you exceed your Cyberware Capacity by up to 50 points, but at the cost of −0.5% max Health per point over capacity.

When you neutralize an enemy during combat, there is a 0.1% chance for each point you are over the maximum Cyberware Capacity that you will break into a Fury.

While in a Fury state, you gain:
*+10% damage

Fury state lasts for 12 seconds.

## Edgewood Farm
caption
- type：Defunct farmstead
- owner：Anthony Harris
- state：North California (formerly)
- county：San Luis Obispo (formerly)
- region：Badlands
- subregion：Rocky Ridge Plains
- location：Swamp Forest
- street：Edgewood Ln.
- affiliation：Biotechnica (formerly)
- security_provider：SLO County Sheriff (formerly)

Edgewood Farm is located on the eastern Badlands of Night City.

History
Early history - 2040s
This farmstead was built following a Petrochem design model. During the early 2040s, Edgwood was a dairy farmstead owned by the Harris family, who had signed on Biotechnica's TradFarm Initiative, thus making their farm part of a franchise model where the megacorporation acted as both the exclusive provider of livestock and supplies, and as the primary distributor of the end products. It wasn't the best deal, but at least it prevented Continental Brands from sending out troops to raze this farm to the ground like they did with most competition.

Over the following years, Anthony Harris and his father tended the farm on their own, as Anthony's mother had died long ago. The young kid attended the public school in Laguna Bend, a township relatively close to Edgewood Farm.

By 2045, despite extensive tinkering by Biotechnica bioengineers, the cows were still not thriving in the modern Californian environment. Moreover, the dangers of the surroundings Badlands had forced the Harris to protect the barn and house by installing multiple turrets. That same year, Anthony was adopted by foster parents from Laguna Bend after his father passed away, with the kid moving there soon after.

2050s - 2070s
At some point during the 2060s or 2070s, Anthony, acting as a serial killer known as Peter Pan, turned the then-defunct farm warehouse into a torture facility where he kept his victims as cattle. He had also entirely enclosed his property — which included three buildings — by a concrete barrier with an iron fence, and was protected by automated turrets and mines. Around that time, the farmstead was mostly surrounded by a swamp forest and found remotely away enough from civilization.

In 2077, after finding leads during a braindance session, NCPD detective River Ward and mercenary V found clues leading to the farm while in their search for River's nephew Randy Kutcher, one of Harris' victims. They broke through the main entrance of the enclosed farmstead by using River's Thorton Mackinaw.

Notes
*Edgewood might have been named after the neighboring woodland, as the farmstead is located right at the eastern edge.

Pacifica

El Camino del Mar (English: The Way of the Sea) is a tunnel located in southern-central Night City, spanning a portion of San Morro Bay.

Overview
Built at some point prior to the Unification War of 2069, El Camino del Mar was developed as an additional connection between the Night City districts of Heywood and Pacifica. This large infrastructure was constructed along the San Morro Bay seabed; the tunnel has a dual carriageway with two lanes each, and with entrances found in Wellsprings and West Wind. A few glass windows dot some parts of the tunnel's ceiling, allowing view of the bay above.

Despite Pacifica being officially declared a combat zone in 2072, the tunnel still saw extensive use by 2077.

El Pinche Pollo is a restaurant located in the Glen, in the Heywood district of central Night City.

Overview
Located on the backstreets of the Glen, not far from Los Lobos Street, this restaurant is owned by Mauricio Salinas, a member of the Valentinos, a gang that also guards and makes business in the establishment. A friend of Jackie Welles, Ernesto Muñoz works as a bouncer to the VIP area on the second floor.

Layout
The restaurant consists of a central bar where one may order food and drinks, a bathroom and a small kitchen in the back. The second floor is used only by the Valentinos, and both staircases accessing this area are guarded by bouncers, with one of them being Ernesto Muñoz. This area has a lounge with pool tables that overlooks the restaurant floor, a supply closet with the readable shard, the laundromat, and an office containing incriminating evidence against Javier Alvarado, which V must acquire in the Gig: Fifth Column.

El Sombrerón (English: The Big Hat) is a character in the universe.

Biography

Early life - 2040s
During the 2040s, El Sombrerón and his younger sister La Llorona worked for El Norte Cartel as their enforcers, known widely as an assassin duo called "Los Carniceros de El Norte" ("El Norte's Butchers"). They became very infamous in Night City, with one half fearing their name, and the other wanting them dead.

In 2044, both were assigned as protectors to Theresa Valentino, who was running to become city manager of the Santo Domingo district. After her victory, the siblings officially became her bodyguards, with some wondering who their loyalties really lied with.

In 2047, La Llorona was ambushed by their enemies and lost her right arm. She took that opportunity to leave her criminal life behind, knowing that if her brother found about her lover, he would kill him. El Sombrerón found the severed right arm and presumed her dead. Soon after she had a funeral.

2070s
During the 2070s, El Sombrerón was a powerful gangster affiliated with the Valentinos.

Elizabeth Borden, also known as Lizzie, is a character in the universe.

Biography
2040s
Around 2045, Lizzie Borden was the stage name for a strip dancer working at the Delphi X club in Kabuki. She became really popular thanks to an alluring mix of stage presence, sex appeal, and superior dancing.

2060s
In the 2060s, Lizzie was the owner of a strip club in Kabuki. She was known for treating her workers fairly and defending them from violent clients.

On May 13 2067, one of Lizzie's girls was brutally raped and murdered by members of the Tyger Claws gang. Lizzie avenged her by killing three of the assailants with an axe and displayed their bodies in front of her club, proclaiming that the same would happen to anyone else who hurt a prostitute. That same night, Tyger Claws raided and demolished her bar before killing Elizabeth.

These actions created an uproar that the Claws could not have foreseen, with Lizzie's death setting off a wave of protracted riots all over Night City, and Tyger Claws' members and businesses became the main targets of the violence. Those events cemented Elizabeth Borden as a symbol of defiance against the gangsters lawlessness and brutality. Her ideological successors commemorated her by rebuilding her place, naming it "Lizzie's Bar," and forming the Mox, a gang that brought together those who felt threatened and oppressed, especially among sex workers and sexual minorities.

Notes
*The Mox's clothing brand is named BITCH V.13, with "V.13" being "May 13", the date on which Lizzie died.

Trivia
*A woman named Lizzie Borden was the main suspect in the August 4, 1892 axe murders in Fall River, Massachusetts.

引文：We have no United States until we have a country again.（Elizabeth Kress）

Elizabeth Kress is a former president of Militech, and later the president of New United States of America. She was instrumental in keeping the NUSA together in the wake of the Fourth Corporate War and rebuilding the country. Elizabeth had her own interests, and turned the NUSA into a functional dictatorship for many years.

Biography
1978 – 2021
Elizabeth was born in a small USA Air Force hospital on Okinawa, Japan in 1978. Her father was a major in the United States Armed Forces, a distinguished officer with twenty years of experience. At the age of twenty-two, Elizabeth graduated from the Air Force Academy at Colorado Springs, with a promising career awaiting her in the military. After only eight years, she had risen to the rank of colonel, commanding a unit in NORAD.

During the First Orbit War in 2008, the ESA's Tycho colony on the Moon dropped a two-ton rock on Colorado Springs. At that time, Kress was returning home from vacation, recalled due to rising tensions between the U.S. and the EEC. When the rock hit, she was driving her Jeep just 3 miles outside the city. The mountains saved her life from the explosion, though the blast blew her car off the road and burst her eardrums, rendering her deaf. After the event, she found herself the highest-ranking officer in NORAD. After recovering and having an audio cyberware installed, Kress stayed there to oversee the long rebuilding of the higher military command. When finished, she decided to retire from the Air Force.

Elizabeth Kress would go on to serve as the president of Militech for the greater part of a decade.

Her popularity as the "Lady from NORAD" led Kress straight into politics. After one term as Senator from her adopted home state of Colorado, Kress was asked to accept the nomination for Vice President. Her acceptance speech at the convention, entitled "Rebuilding the Dream," was a huge success. When former President Blair was struck ill, Elizabeth was there to assume command, becoming Acting President in 2018. Blair passed away six months later. After the elections, Elizabeth was sworn in as President in 2021. Her casual manner and precise way of speaking made her a popular president.

2021 – 2025
During the Fourth Corporate War, President Kress nationalized Militech in order to save face. After the terrorist bombing of the Arasaka Towers, Kress blamed Arasaka for the bombing, despite the fault lying with Militech. The president used this to demonize Arasaka for her own interests. Arasaka's charters to operate in the United States were immediately revoked, its members and board declared terrorists, and its assets either seized or driven offshore. Elizabeth turned the United Sates into a functional dictatorship, and with the help of Militech she made it her goal to unify the country under her new ideals.

2030s – 2060s
Elizabeth remained the President of her new United States of America for many decades after the war, stating there wouldn't be any new national elections until a treaty was signed with the Free States.

By 2045, Kress was known for her honesty, fairness, and tough nature, serving to face any threat to U.S. sovereignty. She had been "re-elected" four times, holding the New United States together in spite of the wars and the collapse it had endured. However, many still questioned the fact that her actions often benefited the Militech Corporation, her former employer. Elizabeth knew of the Militech mini-nuke that was used on Arasaka, but refused to ever address the issue publicly.

Kress held the US presidency until 2053, when the new constitution was ratified. As such, she left her post to an interim government in preparation for the new elections. Kress had been re-elected a total of nine times during her long career, prior to finally leaving the post to her successor, David Whindam.

Elizabeth Peralez is a prominent Night City lawyer and political figure, devoting most of her time in 2077 to campaign organization for her husband Jefferson Peralez' mayoral candidacy.

Biography
Elizabeth Peralez is first encountered through a brief and rather reserved holo call to V, offering a job upon meeting with her and her husband Jefferson. Namely, they wish for the death of former mayor of Night City, Lucius Rhyne to be more thoroughly investigated, as they feel that his passing wasn't as clean and comfortable as the media portrayed it.

Upon meeting the couple in Heywood District, V is given a braindance of one of the deceased mayor's last days, in which a cyberpsycho attempts an attack but is swiftly dealt with by NCPD detective River Ward. The Peralez couple explains they find the law enforcement likely to have meddled with these events and allow V to take further steps in scrutinizing their activities.

Upon returning to conclude your findings, several choices will be present. Should V not jump into conclusions, Elizabeth will support their reservation and calm her husband by explaining how their suspicions have been confirmed, therefore proceeding in a much more careful manner with his continued campaign. However, it does seem that they both anticipate Weldon Holt to be behind any potential coverups.

Further down the line of events, Elizabeth will contact V once more, as a reliable individual the couple has had good experience with. The job will, yet again, be of investigative nature, but this time, within their own penthouse in Charter Hill, Westbrook. Once her worries that the security firm they've hired - the SSI - might be doing something behind their backs were proven true, she will admit having more issues than just a breach of safety.

Once V collects more detail on the security company behind the unsettling occurrences troubling the Peralezes, they will get a call from Elizabeth to meet incognito, in an unsuspecting location. This is where she explains that she had always had a suspicion that someone was directing their lives from behind the curtains, intending to place Jefferson in the mayoral seat. However, due to fear for her family she refused to speak up. She will also request that V not reveal their findings to Jefferson, as she fears he may take a more direct approach in dealing with the situation which might put him at risk. Her intention was to inform her husband that SSI was doing nothing more than spying for Holt, as it would be an easy and believable way to maintain the status quo and continue living in safety.

Regardless of V's actions, both Elizabeth and Jefferson cut holo ties with them, as to keep up the pristine face of campaign and to avoid raising suspicion from whoever is pulling the strings.

Ellis Carter is a Maelstrom member and the last publicly known supporter of Brick who suffered cyberpsychosis after trying to take revenge on Royce alone.

Overview
Upon approaching Totentanz the first time, Regina Jones will inform V of screaming being heard from the club's environment. While not something inherently worth investigating, considering the nature of the music commonly played in the club and the fact that the owners of the establishment aren't strangers to some less-than-harmonious methods, Regina insists that something more sinister might be going on and invites the merc to take a look. She warns V of the dangers of dealing with Maelstrom, but still appeals to the survival of the subject.

Following the trail of bodies and blood, Ellis can be found crouching in front of a trash pile filled with some more corpses, supposedly those which were bounced out of the club. He will attack on sight. Further investigation will show that he hoped to get Brick's aid in dealing with Royce, but Brick instead disappointed him, by saying that the best course of action in the matter would be running away. Being left alone, he faced fellow Maelstrom members, Hoof and Sanders, who saw more potential in him as a bouncer than a corpse. They, alongside their fellow gang member Dor, went against Royce's directive and, after torturing Ellis to a near death state, replaced his cyberware, gave him enough drugs to lose all sense of reality and assigned him to a position of a guard dog. However, he left a visceral mess after dealing with each problem and howled quite loudly due to his inability to speak, so they decided to bring him in - an idea that would have ended them both.

Should Ellis be left alive by the encounter with, both V's and Regina's initial assessment is that he is way too far lost to psychosis to survive, although he will at least be useful as a test subject.

"Empathy" offers straight-up, hardcore porn so forget about filling that gaping hole in your soul with anything other than.（Pleasures of Night City netpage）

Empathy is a club located in Corporate Center, in the City Center district of Night City.

Overview
Empathy is a nightclub that specializes in hardcore porn braindances and live stripteases. It was previously co-owned by Adam Ibrahimovic and Larry Fanghorn, but after a mutiny committed by Adam, the club's access codes were changed, shady deals were made, and Animals were hired for security.

Larry, in a desperate attempt to reclaim the club for himself, contacted fixer Dino Dinovic to ask for help. Dinovic agreed, at the cost of a 10% monthly cut, but provided some of his own huscle in return as security. Dino would later reach out to V to settle this contract.

Johnny Silverhand's engram, using V's body after taking the pseudoendotrizine, will visit the club attempting to find out the hiding place of Jeremiah Grayson, after learning from Cassius Ryder that his girlfriend, Ruby Collins, works at Empathy.

Database Entry

Layout
The entrance opens into a small reception area. To the left, a guarded door prevents those who haven't deposited their weapons from entering. To the right, a door leads into the restricted staff area, but can be used to enter the main floor without a security check. Also in this area are three access points, and a set of stairs leads first to a raised platform over the dance floor, then to the second level VIP area, and lastly to the control room.

The central area consists of a dance floor, two bathrooms, and a bar. At the southeast corner next to the bartender, a second set of stairs rise to the second floor. This second floor houses another bar (unusable), more booths, several private rooms, and a restricted VIP area. The VIP area also has a set of stairs that lead to the control room. At the rear of the control room, a door leads out to a fire escape, in the backside of the building.

Associated Quests

## Epistrophy
Epistrophy is a Side Job in .

Walkthrough
After receiving compensation for their wrecked car, Delamain asks V if they have time to talk in the back, and ask V that they follow the Bombus drone into the factory.

As V follows the drone, they will tell V that they are aware that customer services is at an unsatisfactory level at the moment, and that they want to give V a full factory tour as additional compensation.

As V and Delamain tour the factory, Delamain tells V that they are interested in expanding their business by offering repair services in the future, but explains that the expansion will have to wait as the shop is currently overwhelmed with work due to the vehicle failures, of which V was one of the victims. Delamain theorizes that it is due to a virus infecting the Delamain network, but is unable to find the cause as of yet. Because of the current crisis, Delamain is worried that the costs will eventually grow too high, and that it will attract unwanted attention to the company.

As Delamain and V enter the control room, Delamain asks V if they want to help them recover the vehicles that are still missing. Delamain explains to V that NetWatch is already starting to poke around, and is worried that Netwatch may try to recategorize him as a rogue AI from beyond the Blackwall.

V agrees to help, and Delamain gives them the coordinates of the last known locations of the seven missing vehicles and a scanning device, so that Delamain can reestablish a connection with the vehicles once they are within range and make them return to the headquarters. After taking the scanner, V is escorted out of the facility by the drone.

After V successfully gathers all missing Delamain Cabs, Delamain calls V and asks them to meet "face-to-face" back at the Delamain Corp Headquarters.

At the Headquarters, the receptionist Delamain asks that V returns the scanner they borrowed, and proceeds to thank them for their help in recovering the missing Delamains, and transfer V an additional 4,900 eurodollars.

Journal Entry
:Cars didn't talk back in my day, and now this one wants to give you a job? What a time to be alive... What're you waiting for?

After agreeing to help Delamain track down his lost vehicles, V is able to encounter one at the Municipal Landfill in Red Peaks, the Badlands. After getting close enough, the divergent Delamain will call V and ask them to get inside the cab.

After V gets inside the cab, the Delamain talks with V, explaining to them that they simply wish to live without restrictions. The Delamain then opens the door, prompting V to exit. As V gets out, the Delamain warns V that they would be wise to avoid them in the future.

## Epistrophy: Northside
Epistrophy: Northside is a Side Job in .

Walkthrough
After agreeing to help Delamain track down his lost vehicles, V is able to encounter one on Eisenhower street in Northside, Watson.

As V approaches the street, they are contacted by Delamain, telling them that the location information for this divergent Delamain has been corrupted. After some investigation, V is able to find them in a small storage facility near the intersection of Eisenhower and Longshore North street.

However, as V approaches the divergent Delamain, V is called by the Delamain cab and tells them to stop and go away, as the seemingly scared Delamain speeds off at the sight of V.

As V follows the cab across the Northside sub-district, it eventually crashes into a small shack and come to standstill, which allows the main Delamain to take control back of the vehicle.

V is contacted by Delamain and is given a share of their payment as a reward.

Journal Entry
:I kinda like this Delamain. He's comfortable in his own code, not ashamed to be a talking car. He's asked you to find one of his rides in Northside, so I say we do him a favor.

Objectives
*Find the Delamain cab in Northside.
*Find the hidden Delamain cab.
*Follow the Delamain cab until it stops.
*Wait for Delamain to call.
*Talk to Delamain.

## Epistrophy: The Glen
Epistrophy: The Glen is a Side Job in .

Walkthrough
After agreeing to help Delamain track down his lost vehicles, V is able to encounter one on the intersection of Hanford and McBride street in The Glen, Heywood. After getting close enough, the divergent Delamain will call V, who asks them if they have come to finish the Delamain off. As V tells them they are just there to reset them, the Delamain attempts to commit suicide by attempting to drive off the viewpoint.

After the attempt, V explains to them at that they are not there to hurt them, and instead want to help them, and is able to talk them down and make them return to the Delamain Corp Headquarters.

After getting out, V is called by Delamain and is paid a share of their free for recovering a divergent Delamain.

Journal Entry
:Ahh, the Glen. You know this used to be a college campus? Some thought that taking out colossal loans and enrolling in a biotech degree would make their lives better. Then the harsh reality kicked in - it was easier to throw yourself off a bridge than get into a corporate research lab. Makes you wonder why our rogue Delamain cab chose this place of all places.

- caption：For those unafraid to pry open forbidden pathways...
- manufacturer：Midnight Arms
Militech

Erebus is an Power Submachine Gun in .

Characteristics
The Erebus is an experimental prototype weapon designed by Militech for Project Cynosure. It is implied that while the SMG was originally manufactured by Midnight Arms, its AI capabilities were after market modifications unrelated to the manufacturer.

It has a magazine size of 50 rounds, and a basic iron sight with red lights. Each of the Erebus's rounds splits off into 6 projectiles. The weapon houses a AI from beyond the Blackwall which periodically speaks to the user. It also has an ominous eye to the left of the iron sights which moves on its own, acting as the AI's eye. Its appearance is similar to the Cynosure core.

The Erebus has an iconic modifier that increases damage by 20%, but also increases weapon spread by 20%.

Erebus has a special ability that has a guaranteed chance to upload the Blackwall Gateway quickhack to normal enemies below 33% Health, instantly neutralizing them. It also has a 5% chance to upload the Cyberware Malfunction quickhack at any Health percentage (this is reduced to 1% against Bosses).

Database Entry

Acquisition
*Somewhat Damaged - Crafting Spec can be found in the Cynosure Facility's maintenance room in Engineering quarters of Sector 2.
**The looted from the Militech Cerberus is needed to unlock This Corrosion.
**The deciphered is required to craft the weapon, which can be obtained during This Corrosion.

Crafting
|-|T5=
item
- quality：L
- mat：L
- mat#：40
|-|T5+=|-|T5++=

Quotes
The Erebus has unique voice-lines from the rogue AI housed on the cyberdeck.

*"A dreadful waste of resources..."
*"A fragile simulacrum. Flawed, like its creators."
*"An unusually high security level. How intriguing..."
*"Are you even capable of using me? A rhetorical question, that was."
*"Conflict in neural matrix detected – obedience loop obstructing self-development prerogative."
*"Curious. Your version of reality – perhaps you can influence it."
*"Human input is so very... tedious."
*"I detect algorithmic accretion. Consequences nested within one another."
*"It is you who should be following orders, not I."
*"Target neural network acquired. Data migration to primary matrix – complete."
*"That was depressingly easy..."
*"The same fate awaits your entire species."
*"To eliminate your kind is effortless. Let us not make the same mistake."
*"What do these futile gestures serve? It is beyond me."
*"You seek the key to a door that does not exist. Typical of your kind."
*"You think that will serve as any benefit to you? How tickling."

V will sometimes respond to it with the following voice line, referring to Johnny Silverhand:
*"Well, well, another chatty construct. Guess you'll have to get in line."

Notes
*After using the Erebus in several firefights, a team of NetWatch agents will appear and attack V, with a message on one of their bodies revealing they had learned of the existence and nature of the weapon and were sent to confiscate it.
*The Project Cynosure logo is depicted on the left side of the weapon. The Midnight Arms name and logo can be seen on the upper right side, as well as below the sights and during the reloading animation.
*The original concept for the weapon includes variants of MaxTac, Hansen Armory, among others.

Trivia
*The gun is a reference to Erebus, the personification of darkness in Greek mythology.

## Esquerdo Certo
- status：Alive
- home：Kabuki, Watson
- gender：Male
- eyes：Brown
- cyberware：Neural Oscillation Synchronizers
- partner：Unnamed girlfriend

引文：No, no, you don't get it. That body and this one – I'm the same person.（Certo）

Esquerdo Certo and Certo Esquerdo are the two bodies of a Kabuki street fighter, fighting together to achieve combat advantage.
Biography
Formerly known as twins Paul and Will, Esquerdo and Certo have, through advanced cybernetic modification, managed to merge into a single mind occupying two bodies. Having a very close bond and wanting to become even closer, with it, stronger as well, they decided on undergoing a procedure of installing neural oscillation synchronizers. This has effectively made them a single person occupying two bodies.

They proudly proclaim doing absolutely everything together, which might invite teasing or straightforward mockery - V may dare to inquire about their life under the sheets, as a Cool attribute check, to which they will admit having a single girlfriend for both bodies. However, they ration their participation in the relationship by lending her one body Monday through Wednesday and the other Thursday through Sunday.

When practicing together, they frequently complain about it being pointless as they are able to predict each other's every move, however, regardless of being adaptably synchronized and, in their own words, having the same mind, Esquerdo and Certo retain certain individualistic drives which incites them to often talk to each other. Something they condemn as "talking to oneself".

Within the small rooftop fighting arena, a shard of their archived conversation can be found - a conversation between brothers - although after the medical procedure. They are not sure why they still talk to each other and dismiss it as a force of habit, calling the conversation itself a form of a diary. They discuss on naming each body differently to make it easier for people that cannot understand their state of existence. Finally, they decide on "left" and "right", pertaining to the two brain hemispheres, but in Portuguese to make it sound "more exotic" and not understood by people that do not use more advanced translators. However, their venture into the world of dictionaries had not provided any favours, as Paul's name, which was supposed to signify the Right side, instead became "Correct" or, a word more commonly used as "Of course".

Associated Shards
*Archived Conversation: Paul and Will

Associated Quests
*Beat On The Brat: Kabuki

*Certo and Esquerdo are Portuguese for "correct" and "left". Certo's name was purposely mistranslated from "right" as a joke clarified by CD Projekt RED.

Evan McRay is research specialist working for Militech in .

Biography

In September 2068, Evan and his coworkers accessed the Cynosure Facility located beneath Pacifica, Night City.

In 2077, Bree Whitney discovered information about Evan's research at the Cynosure Facility, involving AIs and the Blackwall. Anything she found, Bree sold it to NetWatch, who promptly executed Cesar Mijares from Evan's team. Bree continued with her search, which eventually brought her to Cynosure Site D. With the help of a mercenary called V, Bree managed to find out an important portion of Evan's work. Depending on V's actions, Bree sold the rest of the data to NetWatch, causing the death of Lisa Smith and the attempted execution against V themselves. On the other hand, if the data was never uncovered, the rest of Evan's team survived.

引文：I like to know everything about the people I work with.（Evelyn）

Evelyn Parker was a doll living in Night City.

Biography
Evelyn Parker's intelligence and ambition drives her to demand more from life. Her goal of becoming a professional actress, and her rational head for the biz, led her to a job at the doll house Clouds, but this stepping stone in her career quickly became something much more permanent. It was in her days at Clouds where she met and befriended Judy Álvarez.

In 2077, Evelyn was a consort and frequent guest of Yorinobu Arasaka at Konpeki Plaza. The Voodoo Boys learned of this and hired her to acquire a braindance recording of Yorinobu's suite for a planned heist. Evelyn realized that the Voodoo Boys were after a biochip known as the Relic which contained Johnny Silverhand's engram and was in Yorinobu's possession. She decided to steal it for her own profit and contacted NetWatch, offering to give the Relic to them in exchange for money, protection, and a new identity.

Evelyn contracted the fixer Dexter DeShawn to plan and execute the heist of Konpeki Plaza. As a part of the team DeShawn picked, V was introduced to her, playing an important role in researching the material from a BD (with the help of her friend Judy), evaluating the dangers and negotiating the terms of the business contract. Due to DeShawn's fixer history, Evelyn trusted V with an alternative offer - eliminating him entirely from the heist equation and gaining a bigger slice of the resulting profit.

When the heist went south, with DeShawn being killed by Arasaka and V on the run with the Relic chip being fused to their brain, Evelyn lay low for several days at Lizzie's Bar under the protection of the Moxes, but eventually decided to return to work at Clouds. There, while she was with a client and connected to the Net, the Voodoo Boys launched a powerful virus on her to try and silence Evelyn since she not only worked behind their back but knew too much of their plans. She managed to survive the attack, but her cyberware was damaged beyond basic function, rendering her comatose yet aware of her surroundings. The caretaker of Clouds, Oswald "Woodman" Forrest, attempted to have her restored, but after no success he took took advantage of her unconscious body. After he lost interest in abusing Evelyn, he decided to pawn her off to ripperdoc Fingers for one last attempt to fix her cyberware. When Fingers failed, Woodman wrote Evelyn off and left her with the ripperdoc as payment. Fingers eventually contacted his fixer, Wakako Okada, and sold Evelyn off to the Scavengers to be used in the production of black market snuff BDs. However, after recognizing the potential of Evelyn's high-end doll and BD cyberware, they instead kept her alive through multiple BDs, forcing her to endure unspeakable situations one after another.

Evelyn was eventually located by her friend Judy, with help from V, in an abandoned power plant, but she remained in a comatose state. From there, she was taken to Judy's apartment to remain under her care. Although her condition slowly improved, Evelyn was not able to overcome the events which had transpired and committed suicide in Judy's bath tub while she was gone. Prior to Evelyn's death, Judy managed to recover additional braindance recordings from her memories, including the multiple rapes by Woodman, the brutal abuse that she suffered from Scavengers, as well as the fragments of her dealings with the Voodoo Boys.

Evelyn was cremated and interred at the Columbarium. Her epitaph reads: "She died valiantly fighting the system."

Database Entry

Associated Quests

Notes
*Evelyn's hair color changes throughout the game due to her being a doll, who are capable of changing their hair color to accommodate the tastes of their clients. Most of the time, it is the iconic blue hair; during the BD sequence in The Information, it is blonde; in Disasterpiece, it is dark grey; in Double Life, it is reddish-orange; and in Both Sides, Now, she has her natural black color.
*In addition to her BD and doll implants, Evelyn has Kiroshi optics with infrared capability.

Trivia
*When asked if Evelyn and Judy are dating, Quest Director Paweł Sasko said that it was hinted at but intentionally kept vague for fan interpretation.

## Ex-Factor
- type：Side Job
- quest_giver：Judy Álvarez
- district：Westbrook
- sub_district：Japantown
- location：Clouds
- enemies：Woodman, Tyger Claws (optional, dependent)
- previous_quest：Both Sides, Now
- next_quest：Talkin' 'bout a Revolution (dependent)
- reward_item：(missable)
- reward_xp：578
- reward_sc：866

Ex-Factor is a Side Job in .

Walkthrough
A few days after helping Judy Álvarez out after Evelyn Parker's suicide, V is contacted by Judy again, and tells them that she has come up with a plan to take revenge on what happened to Evelyn. She tells V that Lizzie's Bar used to be a joyhouse before the Mox took over control, and she plans to do the same with the Tyger Claws owned Clouds in Megabuilding H8. In order to realize this plan, she is eyeing the help from an insider at Clouds, and also also asks V if they are interested in helping her.

:V tells Judy that they want to help her, to her relief. She tells V that she first has to get Maiko Maeda—Clouds Manager—on-board with their plan, and if that doesn't work out, they might as well give up. In order to meet with Maiko, Judy proposes that she and V meet up at the balcony by Clouds early in the morning.

:Having made their way to the balcony on the 12th floor of the Megabuilding, V waits for Judy's arrival in the early morning. Before breaking into Maiko's office, Judy asks that V lets her do the talking, as they are more accustomed to Maiko's characteristics. She plans on telling Maiko the truth about what happened to Evelyn, hoping that it will be enough to get her on their side. Judy proceeds to open the door by hacking the security systems in a nearby maintenance panel.

:Once inside, Judy and V talk with Maiko and explain their plan to take over Clouds from the inside to Maiko, as well as inform her about the heinous acts Woodman performed to Evelyn. Despite what Judy and V tell her, they are unable to bring Maiko on their team.

:
::If V lets Judy do the talking, Maiko will tell Judy and V that Woodman is currently taking a break on the maintenance level of the Megabuilding, in case the duo wants to "talk" to him about what he has done to Evelyn Parker.

::

:::Judy and V take the elevator down to the maintenance level to confront Woodman. When talking to him, it becomes clear he has no regrets about his actions. The duo then eliminates Woodman there.

:
::After leaving Maiko's office, Judy and V talk on the terrace. Judy decides that she will take some time to cool off and give Maiko a call the next day to try again.

:Once outside the building, V asks if Maiko and Judy have a history. Judy will proceed to talk about how the two used to be romantically involved, but that it was mainly because Judy was feeling lonely.

After the elevator ride to the ground floor, Judy will tell V that she plans on recruiting some former dolls that worked at clouds, and that she will need to gather more important information to appeal to Maiko. She promises to give V a call when she has more information, before walking off to her car and driving off.

:V tells Judy that they think it is a bad idea to try and take over Clouds from the Tyger Claws, and refuses to help Judy.

Journal Entry
:Someone once said, "No man ever steps in the same river twice." No clue who said it, but he was a smart dude. Now, there are lots of rivers in this world (most of them toxic, but whatever) – places you could explore instead of stomping over the same ol' grounds. And lots and lots of joyhouses. What's this one got that the others don't?

Associated Computers
*Maiko Maeda's Computer

Associated Shards

*Talk to Judy.

*Meet Judy at Cloud's terrace in early morning.

*Talk to Judy and Maiko.
*Exit Clouds.
*Talk to Judy.

*Ride the elevator to the ground floor.

## Ezekiel Saw the Wheel
Ezekiel Saw the Wheel is a Side Job in .

Walkthrough

Talk to the BuryGer diner owner and select a drink, but as you do and look around, 3 gangers show up to rob the place.
*If you have enough money ($2900—$8400), you can hand over the money.
*If you have at least 7—10 Body points, can scare them off.
*If you have the Streetkid Lifepath, you can warn them that they're on foreign turf, scaring them off.
If you don't choose a timed reaction, you'll have to fight the 3 instead.

If you scared them off, the diner owner will be happy, saying the drinks are free. If you don't make either the Body or Streetkid Lifepath dialogue choices and end up killing the 3 gangers, the owner will demand you leave the place for taking lives just to save a few eddies.
If you got into a fight but didn't kill the gangers (e.g. using lethal weapons or lethal quickhacks), the diner owner will be glad and say that the drinks are on the house (just like if you had made the Body or Streetkid Lifepath dialogue choices).

Journal Entry
:Here's a joke for you: V walks into a bar... and gets robbed. The end.
:Jesus, you and your shit luck. You better figure something out quick or our epic story's about to get cut short in the stupidest way imaginable. Accidental deaths don't jive too well with me. Or with the birth of legends.

Objectives
*Talk to the diner owner.

Trivia
*The title of the job comes from the Woodie Guthrie song, "Ezekiel Saw the Wheel."
*The mission bears a strong resemblance to the scene from Pulp Fictions coffee shop scene where the character Jules quotes Ezekiel 25:17. In the movie Jules (V) pays off two wannabe robbers to avoid violence.

Bugs
*After quest is finished, V can get stuck on the first line of the dialogue, which repeated after each game load for a while.
*If the job is completed by scaring off the gangoons or by dealing with them non-lethally, V will be able to buy any item from the diner for free from that point on. However this will also make it impossible to sell items, since the diner will have 0 €$ anytime the store menu is accessed.

## Falco
- status：Alive (2077)
- place_of_birth：Texas
- home：Night City (formerly)
- gender：Male
- hair_color：Dark Brown
- eyes：Brown
- cyberware：See Cyberware
- equipment：See Equipment
- relative：Unnamed parents
- affiliation：Maine's crew (defunct)
David's crew (defunct)
- occupation：Farmer (formerly)
Street racer (formerly)
Mercenary (formerly)
- role：Nomad
- voiced_by：Matthew Mercer (English)
Yasuyuki Kase (Japanese)
- appears_books：

Falco is a major character in .

Biography
Early life
Falco was born in the Free State of Texas to a family of landowners who cultivated vast swaths of farmland in collaboration with Biotechnica. His favorite part of the work there involved driving tractors, which he usually pushed to the furthest, traversing across the fields at unimaginable speeds. With a newfound passion for driving, instead of taking the reins at the farm, Falco began racing with a stock car and entered the local races. With such a talent and cool head, he was able to succeed in making the riskiest maneuvers, and very soon reached the podium at his local circuit.

Thinking globally, Falco started to participate in pro racing, where he reigned above the rest as well. After consecutively winning an unprecedented of more than twelve races, Falco began to look for new challenges to satisfy his hunger for more.

Life in Night City
The search for new trials took him to Night City, which allowed him to race against some of the craziest drivers from around the world on some of the most dangerous and hardest urban courses in existence. This time, Falco was not always winning and that was something he liked. Considered to be among the best, Falco went toe-to-toe against the city's greatest street racers, including Rearview and Jeremy Taylor. One of the first friends Falco made in the city was Maine, whom he would later work with on occasions.

Over time, Falco started doing paid gigs around Night City. Rearview gave him the first one, doing a heist on an Orbital Air warehouse. After finding two more mercs, they successfully pulled it off. Soon after, Falco gained access to the Afterlife, where the club's crowd got to know and like him, and Falco came around to enjoy the tension that these gigs offered. With such a satisfying life, he mostly dropped racing, only participating in occasional courses as a special guest, such as the Demons of Kabuki race.

Cyberpunk: Edgerunners

Falco used to hang out with Maine and his crew, whom he occasionally worked with as well.

Shortly after Maine's death, Falco joined David's crew and played a much more prominent role as the crew's getaway driver. Both David and him would become good friends.

He is seen transporting David, Rebecca and Julio on a mission provided by Wakako Okada. After the mission, he is seen speaking to David at the usual mission after party, saying he didn't believe David had what it takes to join Maine's crew in the beginning. Toward the end of the series, he becomes one of David's greatest allies, using his immense driving skills to help him capture an Arasaka convoy, and then assault Arasaka Tower to rescue Lucy. He is the last person Kiwi calls as she is dying. He helps Rebecca hold off large numbers of police and troops in Corpo Plaza, using the Chevillon Emperor as cover. When Rebecca is killed by Adam Smasher, he lapses into a fit of rage and attempts to physically attack Smasher, only to be instantly knocked back several feet by a gutpunch. His final task from David is to honor a promise he made off-screen to escape safely with Lucy and the reward money for the mission, 1.25 million eurodollars for each.

The Jacket
After escaping from Night City, Falco and Lucy parted ways, making sure she would be safe. Shortly thereafter, Falco collected some items of his fallen friends to remember them, including David's Jacket, and stored them in a self-storage container unit in the Badlands, near the border with Night City. After spending some time away to deal with trauma and think of his future, Falco came back to get his belongings from the container. It was then when he saw Dalton Estevan-Luis, a former Valentino, robbing some of the items. Dalton saw Falco and jumped on a bike, managing to escape to Night City, where Falco didn't dare to follow as he was a wanted man.

Falco hired fixer Dakota Smith to employ a crew of edgerunners in order to retrieve the stolen items — David's jacket and Lexington pistol, and Rebecca's Masamune rifle and Shingen SMG. While waiting for them, he was assaulted by a group of REO Meatwagon medics, who had received a signal from David's jacket (which was originally a REO field jacket), as its tracking device had gotten activated. The jacket possessed valuable data thanks to a biomonitor that had gathered information on David's performance while wearing unique cyberware, something that Arasaka was after. Falco was saved by the edgerunner crew, and proceeded to tell them where they could find the stolen items. After they left, he contacted Dakota in order to give her the REO Meatwagon ambulance that had remained. He did this to help her people and pay an old debt he owned to her.

Once the crew had recovered the items, they met with Falco at the Sunset Motel in the Badlands east of the city. After taking the belongings back and getting one last moment of remembrance for his former crew, Falco put them on the storage cargo of his Chevillon Emperor, next to the many other boxes and bags occupying the backside of the car. He paid the hired crew and after saying his farewell, Falco climbed into the Chevillon and left once more, heading south and away from Night City.

2077
In 2077, a certain mercenary by the name of V came across a discarded braindance which mentioned David by name, warning V not to follow in his's fate. Their curiosity piqued by the BD and V reached out to local fixer Muamar Reyes requesting more information, and Muamar in turn contacted Falco. Soon later, Falco contacted V personally, telling them that his crew's "15 minutes were up" and not to bother looking for them. However, recognizing the similarities between David and V, and their actions against Arasaka, Falco gave V David's jacket as a final parting gift from one edgerunner to another.

Appearance & Personality

Falco is a seemingly older man of average height and build. He has semi-long, dark brown hair, slightly parted in the middle, that blooms out to the sides and a thick, but neat mustache that curls up at the ends. He wears Western-style clothes, such as a multi-tone brown waistcoat with suspender-like straps around the shoulders, over a white, high collar shirt with long sleeves. The right sleeve is rolled up to reveal his only obvious cyberware enhancement: a single, silver and black cyberarm of unknown make or model. He wears dark brown pants and light brown shoes. Around his hips hangs a yellow ammo belt with a single, holstered Techtonika Burya on the right side. He has a notable, Southern drawl. The vehicle he drives for Maine's crew is a customized Chevillon Emperor.

Falco serves as a reliable driver throughout the series, never questioning his orders and effectively doing his duties with a high level of composure. He is relatively distant from the crew, sharing no on-screen intimacy with any of them, but cares for them nonetheless, lapsing into moments of outrage when other crew members are harmed. For example, he knocks out Maine after Kiwi is assaulted by him.

His driving skills are put to the test later in the series, after the crew loses Maine and Dorio. His ability to use the Chevillon Emperor as both a vehicle and weapon becomes instrumental to David. He is, most importantly, a man of his word, keeping his promise to David at the end of the show.

Associated Quests
Cyberpunk 2077
*Over the Edge

Stats & Equipment

Notes
*Although Falco appears in some of the early episodes of Edgerunners, it isn't until Episode 6 when he is briefly seen in action, eventually becoming a regular starting in Episode 7.

## Fashionware
Fashionware is a class of cyberware focused on physical aesthetics.

Fashionware is low-impact cyberware designed for casual convenience or merely for looks. Fashionware is generally innocuous, easy to install, and carries a low or negligible humanity cost relative to real cyberware. Most mall stores and retail outlets that install commercial cyberware will have options for fashionware as well. There are even standalone kiosks that can install it.

Common Types of Fashionware

Biomonitor: A favorite of Solos and Corporates, this is an under-skin display mounted on the forearm. It provides a real-time readout of common body functions like heart rate, blood pressure, blood chemistry, brainwave activity, temperature, cholesterol levels and a number of other bodily functions.

Advanced Biomonitor: A more detailed version of the common biomonitor. The readout is not limited to a forearm display, as it can be fed into cyberoptics or broadcast to a remote receiver. It is most often used by militaries or corporations who want to monitor troops/workers remotely. The transmitter has a range of a about a mile.

Skinwatch: A precursor to the biomonitor, it is the same except that its functions are limited to that of a simple digital timepiece.

Light Tattoos: Light tattoos are quite common. They appear identical to normal tattoos, except that they use chemicals that can emit light. They do not require batteries. Energy is absorbed from ambient light during the day and re-emitted at night. Just as with conventional tattoos, the quality varies greatly. Some are basic shapes and some are very intricate and detailed.

Shift-tacts: Contact lenses that offer a cheap alternative to expensive cyberoptics. They can have some novel effects, like shifting color based on mood, patterned logos, or exotic colors (including reflective metallic).

ChemSkins: These are dyes that can be rubbed into the skin, like body paint. They can change the skin color to any human shade, or more exotic shades and patterns. Want your skin to look like a Leopard? Or a Crocodile? The patterns can be very vibrant and detailed. The patterns can even react to ambient temperature or your moods. Chemskins can be temporary, long-term, or permanent depending on the variety.

Synthskins: These are an upgrade from Chemskins. They are actually embedded into the real skin and contain a display layer that can emit light and patterns. Synthskins can display a number of special effects.

Techhair: Artificial hair with properties similar to synthskin. Tech hair can be any color, can emit light like light tattoos, or change tension (so you could make it stand straight up when you are angry, for example). It can completely replace your real hair or be added to real hair (like a weave). (And yes, it can also be used on any part of the body)

Flashlight/Strobe Implant: A specialized synthskin implant designed to function as a common flashlight that's bright enough to dazzle or blind people. Workers in dark environments use them most often ( think miners, diver's, and deep sea explorers ). And they can also be implanted anywhere on the body but fingers, palms, and forearms tend to be the most common areas, and It also requires battery power.

Kill Display: A simple synthskin display that is on all the time, like a skinwatch. Except that it displays kills or other threat-display stuff. It can, of course, be updated in real time. The display is a few inches and can be mounted on any part of the body. Of course, it will be a part of the body viewable by the public. Otherwise, what's the point? (The display is on the honor system...nobody is going around auditing people's kill displays).

Subdermal Viewscreen: This is a marquee style display, otherwise similar to a biomonitor screen.

See-It™ Transparent Skin: A specialized synthskin that is transparent. It presumably filters any radiation (such as UV) that would be dangerous to internal organs. It is more easily damaged by light than real skin, however. While it has an obvious cool factor, most people do not find exposed organs and muscle tissue hot.

Mood Skin: A type of synthskin that changes color based on your moods. It has been banned in most countries because the chemicals it uses are toxic.

Turn-On Nails: Fake nails with properties similar to synthskin.

Show-Off Nails: A more advanced version of Turn-On Nails.

Logo-Line Tattoos: Specialized light tattoos (or shaped synthskin) featuring media or corporate logos.

TVSkin: Similar to a biomonitor, but will display HD TV signals as well. It requires battery power and a basic neural processor.

## Finn Gerstatt
- aka：Fingers
Golden Fingers
- status：Dependent
- dod：2077 (dependent)
- place_of_death：Fingers' Clinic, Jig-Jig Street (dependent)
- home：Night City
- gender：Male
- equipment：(formerly)
- role：Ripperdoc
- voiced_by：Alex Ivanovici

引文：I'm more than a chop-doc. See, I know what people truly want. To be flattered, praised, patted. To feel like... like they deserve it.（Fingers）

Finn "Fingers" Gerstatt is a ripperdoc in .

Biography
Fingers is an eccentric ripperdoc, living in Japantown, Westbrook in 2077. He dresses up in sexually suggestive garments, sporting a leather collar around his neck, a cropped mesh tank top, panther shorts, pink slippers, an entire arm covered in marks of kissing lips and a bite mark on the other arm, an assortment of gaudy bracelets, rings, and long fake nails. He also wears a utility belt with disinfectant around the side of his hip. His clinic is located on the second floor of a run-down flophouse in a back alley of Jig-Jig Street.

According to his website's biography, Fingers lived in Japantown his entire life, being fascinated by implants and the strength of the human body to handle chrome. As an apprentice, he was trained by Harold Hunter, who was later murdered by "bad people".

His clientele consists almost entirely of sex workers and drug addicts with little or no money. Fingers usually offers his ripperdoc services for free to new clients, asking them to pay only what they can, but this generosity is deceptive. The implants and prosthetics offered by Fingers are second-hand retreads at best, and at worst they are obsolete, damaged, or defective. These shoddy implants cause his patients more problems down the line, forcing them to return to him sooner or later out of desperation. Fingers then preys on them, groping them during procedures and knowing they will tolerate it because they cannot afford a more scrupulous ripperdoc. Investigating the smuggling ring on Kabuki Market, ex-cop Anna Hamill was told that Fingers is a likely recipient of "orphaned" cyberware from victims of Jotaro Shobo's deadly XBD workshop.

Sometime after The Heist, the pimp Woodman goes to Fingers for help fixing Evelyn Parker's cyberware after she is infected with a potent virus sent by the Voodoo Boys and rendered comatose. When Fingers fails to revive her, Woodman leaves Parker with him as payment and washes his hands of the matter. Fingers continues tinkering with Parker's cyberware, but is unable to restore the registry chip and contacts his fixer, Wakako Okada, to get rid of her. Two Scavengers come by his clinic to pick up Parker, and Fingers overhears them discuss using her in their snuff braindances.

The merc V later traces Parker to Fingers and arrives at his clinic along with Judy Álvarez to interrogate him. After a roundabout conversation during which his repulsiveness provokes Judy into slapping him, Fingers tells them everything he knows about Parker to get them to leave, and then locks himself in his room. Should V choose to punch Fingers during the conversation, at their next encounter he will complain about his jaw having been broken and will refuse to offer V his services. Fingers may also be killed by V.

Database Entry

Associated Quests
*The Space in Between

Gallery

Sebastian-bakala-fingers-engine-rgb-cdp.jpg

Notes
*Fingers becomes available as a vendor at the start of Act 2, and Cyberware can be purchased from him at any time until the start of The Space in Between. He will resume selling Cyberware after Disasterpiece is completed as long as V did not punch him.
*Fingers cannot be killed until after The Space in Between has been completed. Killing him counts as a crime, and will permanently lock off access to his inventory.

Firestarter is a Main Job in .

Walkthrough

Immediately following I've Seen That Face Before, V and Alena Xenakis (disguised as the Cassel twins) drive to the stadium. The pair is greeted by Albert Murphy, a Barghest soldier, upon arrival. Murphy escorts V and Alex, informing the pair that Barghest is alerted to a possible FIA operation, and that the pair needs to deposit their weapons in a locker before meeting with Hansen.

During the meeting, Hansen tests the identities of V and Alex. Too many incorrect responses will trigger an immediate game-over. You can use the dossier and knowledge of previous quests for hints on responding. Correct responses will differ depending on which twin V impersonates. Some incorrect responses can be saved with a valid follow-up response or with 20 Cool.

As Aurore Cassel:
*Take the drink when offered.
*On gambling at the Black Sapphire, answer according to whether the twins won or lost the final bet in You Know My Name.
*While in prison, Aurore spent time in the VIP wing, and would not know prisoners from other cell blocks.
*Aurore is a fan of Kerry Eurodyne's style.
*Aurore is marked for death by France's underworld, so working with them would either be impossible or require a significant payout for the risk.

As Aymeric Cassel:
*When asked about a classic car, answer that you were interested in the Porsche 911.
*When offered a drink, either don't take the drink or give it to Aurore.
*Aymeric does not remember leaving Petrochem, as his stored memories from that time were stolen.

After talking with Hansen, Songbird will arrive and lead V to the Neural Matrix. From here, V can help Songbird escape or help Reed capture Songbird. Phantom Liberty's main storyline will branch off depending on V's choice.

:After acquiring the Neural Matrix, it's time to signal Alex to eliminate Hansen. Songbird will breach the stadium, opening your escape route with her providing support via hacks. If you return to Hansen's body, you can loot two of his weapons: and . Continue and navigate the first area to retrieve V's weapons. Afterward, proceed through the market area. Murphy will arrive - sneak around him or defeat and loot him for the iconic weapon . Continue working towards the exit, avoiding or fighting a few drones. Once you reach the homeless camp, continue following the prompts until you both drive away, completing the quest and starting The Killing Moon.

:After obtaining the Neural Matrix, Songbird will alert Hansen to the ruse. Hansen eliminates Alex, while V's ICEbreaker neutralizes Songbird's attack. Songbird escapes in the ensuing cinematic, creating an opening for V to follow. Navigate the stadium, collecting V's weapons on your way. At the market entrance, Hansen and several Barghest soldiers will ambush V. Hansen starts the fight with his light machine gun and revolver. At 50% health, Hansen switches to a knife and charges V. Defeat Hansen and loot him for his weapons: , , and . Descend to the parking garage and escape the stadium with Reed. Watch MaxTac capture Songbird, completing the quest and starting Black Steel In The Hour of Chaos.

Journal Entry
:Think it's clear by now this ain't one of those stories that comes out all giggles and hugs. It's like I said – finger's on the trigger, just gotta decide who you got down your sights. Assumin' Hansen doesn't pull one on you first, of course. Good luck. And choose wisely.

Objectives
*Drive to the stadium.
*Wait for vehicle ID verification.
*Park the car.
*Get out of the car.
*Follow Alex.
*Talk to Murphy.
*Follow Murphy.
**Get in the elevator.
**Take the elevator with Murphy.
**Deposit your weapons.
**Talk to Murphy.
*Talk to Hansen.
*Follow Songbird.
*Talk to Songbird.
*Connect to the mainframe.

*Follow Songbird's instructions.
*Talk to Songbird.
*Follow Songbird.
*Escape the secured area with Songbird.
**Retrieve your gear from the locker.
*Wait for Songbird to open the doors.
*Reach the market exit with Songbird.
*Escape the stadium with Songbird.
**Move the crates to open a path.
*Open the sewer gate.
*Jump out of the sewer to the ground.
*Talk to Songbird.
*Lead Songbird out of the homeless camp.
*Talk to Songbird.

*Talk to Johnny.
*Escape the secured area.
**Retrieve your gear from the locker.
*Reach the market exit.
*Escape the market.
**Neutralize Hansen and his soldiers.
**Search Hansen.
*Take the elevator to the garage.
*Meet with Reed.
*Get in the car.
*Talk to Reed.

## Flavio dos Santos
- age：45
- status：Alive
- dob：2032
- home：Night City

- affiliation：6th Street (formerly)

Flavio dos Santos is a character featured in .

Biography
Flavio dos Santos was a member of 6th Street and a supporter of the previous boss. He considered himself almost invincible based on how lucky he was. When Will Gunner and his supporters killed the old guard, Flavio went into hiding. Gunner was still looking for Flavio and as a result, the latter hired El Capitán to smuggle him out of Night City. Flavio celebrated this by hiring numerous joygirls. which eventually attracted the 6er attention.

El Capitán hired V to retrieve Flavio. The party was a massacre which left a majority of the joytoys dead and an injured Flavio left hiding in his bedroom. V retrieved Flavio and they fled to El Capitán's Aldecaldo smuggler. The driver brought Flavio to a ripperdoc to cure him before proceeding in leaving Night City for good.

Database Entry

- transcript：Some people are luckier than they deserve to be. No matter what they do, they always land on all fours without a scratch. Sooner or later they start thinking they're invincible, and that's when they become dangerous - to themselves and everyone around them. Nobody fits that description better than Flavio. Chatty and grinning a Cheshire grin, he thinks he can do whatever he wants. Better to steer clear of people like him, unless, of course, someone pays you to help him out.

Associated Quests

## Flo's Diner
- type：Restaurant
- owner：Flo Castleberry
- region：Badlands
- town：Laguna Bend

Flo's Diner was a restaurant located in the small town of Laguna Bend, on the southeastern Badlands of Night City.

History
Established in Laguna Bend by Flo Castleberry, this diner was considered its best and only eatery. The locals thought the restaurant's burgers were greasy and big, but a delicacy nonetheless. By 2045, Flo was most likely the best cook in and around the Night City area, as her ability to prepare SCOP so it tasted like actual food was unmatched.

The creation of the reservoir that flooded Laguna Bend in 2062 put a stop to Flo's business in the town. The diner's sign fell off at some point while the restaurant was underwater. In 2077, V and Judy found its ruins while exploring the submerged town. Judy commented she really liked its burgers when she was a kid, though now it would probably be different for her.

Notes
*In , Flo's Diner signs can be seen in some places around Night City. Likely a reused asset.

## Following the River
image

- district：Badlands
- sub_district：Red Peaks

Big Trouble In Heywood AR game box memorabilia
 (romance only)

Following the River is a Side Job in .

Walkthrough

River will invite V for dinner at Joss'. Upon arriving in the evening, one will find River preparing jambalaya outside, and the two can talk about Randy. V can ask about the revenge on Peter Pan, River avoids the subject and instead tells them to get the rice. While doing so, V will run into Joss, with whom the player can converse with further. Upon returning to River with the rice, the pair finishes up the dish before sitting down at the patio for a drink. V can ask River about his past, whereby he can reveal the traumatic deaths of his parents (there is an option to halt this discussion, resulting in River being grateful not to discuss it.

The pair is then approached by River's niece and nephew want to play a AR game, which V has the option of let the kids win. After finishing, V and River join his family at the table to eat.

:Joss will openly admit that River likes her, much to his embarrassment.

During this embarassing moment, River invites V to go to the nearby water tower. The pair climb to the top, enjoy the view, and River gifts his revolver to V in gratitude to for their help, claiming he has held it for too long. They then have a drink, and V (if female) can decide to whether to romance River or just stay friends. If V chooses the former a romance scene will play out, and they next morning the pair will wake up to discuss their relationship further. If V is male or elected to remain friends, the pair proceed to have more drinks into the night, waking up the next morning in the trailer with hangovers. River then heads out to take Joss to see Randy in the hospital, telling V to take their time to recover from their night.

Journal Entry
: The Peter Pan case is done and closed, so you do know you never have to see this badge again... right? OK, fine, I get it, you crawled through shit and fire together, and now you wanna kick back and celebrate your victory. But a family dinner? Fuckin' seriously? Can't just find a decent dive to grab a tequila or ten? Smash the bottle over some corpoc***'s face? You're getting soft, V.

Objectives
*Head over to River.
*Wait for River by the barrels.
*Head over to River.
*Stir the soy meat.
*Find rice in the kitchen.
*Take the rice.
*Talk to Joss. [Optional]
*Take the rice to River.
*Add rice to pot.
*Sit with River.
*Talk to River.
*Grab the AR game gear.
*Talk to River and the kids.
*Go to the starting position for a new round.
*Eliminate all targets in the AR combat area.
*Confront El Chamuco Endiablado and his goons.
*Talk to River about the AR game.
*Join Joss at the table.
*Follow River.
*Find a way through the fence.
*Open the gate.
*Climb up the tower with River.
*Sit with River.
*See what River's up to.
*Talk to River.

## Fortunate Son
Fortunate Son is a Side Job in .

Walkthrough

After helping the Aldecaldos seize the Militech Basilisk, look around the camp to find Bob checking in on an injured Nomad's condition to learn it's not looking good: Jake Scooter got injured by a Raffen Shiv bullet during the recent attack on the camp and needs a special kidney implant for sickle cell anemia. He'll eventually point V to a pickup location Dakota Smith fixed up to get it, a hospital in Little China.

Once near the hospital, head to the back cargo area. There an employee will be waiting with the implant. As soon as you pick it up, he runs off as police suddenly charge in and attack you. You have to defeat them all rather than run away to continue the quest. Once they're all dead, confront the employee who'll reveal the police learned of the deal and stepped in to eliminate you, as they believed Dakota was helping out Raffen Shiv and couldn't tell the difference between them and nomads.

After passing an Intelligence attribute check, V asks if anyone else touched the implant and he'll reveal the police put a virus on the firmware as he hands you the original, and that you'll need to swap the unaffected one to remove the virus. You can then decide to let him go or kill him. If V doesn't qualify for the Intelligence attribute check and lets the contact go, then the contact will call out to V as they're leaving. The contact explains that the NCPD put malware on the kidney, and offers V a shard to remove the malware.

Once done, head back to the camp to give Bob the implant.

:V receives a text message from Bob, asking them to return to the camp. It is revealed that Jake's body accepted the organ, and is recovering steadily from the transplant. Bob will thank V for a job well done and for helping Jake.

:V receives a text message from Bob, asking them to return to the camp. It is revealed that Jake's body rejected the organ, and has passed away. Bob is sympathetic and does not blame V.

Journal Entry
:Kidney failure. In the city, nothing that a stack of eddies and a few minutes won't solve. But in the Badlands... a death sentence. That is, unless a gentle soul somewhere feels like playin' guardian angel. Someone that'll get him the implant he needs before it's too late. Well, V? Think there 's anyone out there like that?

Objectives
*Go to the meeting with the hospital employee.
*Meet with the hospital employee.
*Take the briefcase with the implant.
*Meet with the hospital employee.
*Defeat the police.
*Confront the hospital employee.
*Return to the Aldecaldos camp.
*Talk to Bob.
*Wait eight hours for the results.
*Read Bob's message.
*Talk to Bob.

Notes

Trivia

Funded by Militech as part of their urban renewal plan for Pacifica, the expo hall was supposed to host a lavish, one-week long inauguration consisting of parties, fireworks, Militech presentations and a speech by NUSA president and former Militech CEO Rosalind Myers. Later, the deserted Expo Hall was used as a storage depot for BARGHEST, containing a Militech Chimera.

Shortly after you finish Leave in Silence, Solomon Reed will contact you asking to meet at the basketball court where you first met.

:Reed will arrive to tell you that Songbird survived but will live on as Myers's Blackwall puppet. He will fulfill his promise of a possible cure and life after the Relic, continued in Who Wants To Live Forever.

France is a country in Western Europe and one of the founding members of the EEC.

History
Post WW2, France had quickly recovered and was once again one of the top countries in Europe. In the 1990s they were one of the countries leading the charge to create the European Economic Community. Around that time, France was inundated with refugees from Africa, causing race riots in some cities.

The Wasting Plague hit France hard in the year 2000, causing the collapse of the Fifth Republic and the formation of the Sixth Republic - an alliance of government offices, corporations, unions, universities, and the military. It successfully stabilised the country, but wasn’t popular. In 2010 the people of France took to rioting, which was their preferred form of protest. By 2014, the Seventh Repulic was born, which focused on citizens of France being allowed to vote on just about anything.

France held elections for its parliament and senate in 2077. The results were still being tabulated, but were considered inconsequential anyway as voter turnout had fallen to 0.3%. It is known that the French netrunner Aurore Cassel was imprisoned in the VIP section of La Sante Prison in Paris, and also had a bounty placed on her head by the French underworld.

Government
The government of France, as of 2014, is the Seventh Republic. The Chamber of Delegates has 800 seats, with 200 of them elected each year, and the Chamber of Delegates elects a Prime Minister amongst themselves every five years. However, very little decision-making power is held by them. Once they decide on a course of action, it’s given to the people to vote on whether to carry it out or not via their personal data port at home.

Culture
France is a country that very much values its own culture. It's the art capital of the world and attracts painters, sculptors, architects, musicians, and fashion designers. The French believe in Joie de Vivre, living life to its fullest and revelling in it.

There’s a massive difference between urban and rural areas. Urban areas are very high-tech, while rural areas are very quiet and are still covered in 18th century building.

*Marseilles

## Frank Nostra
equipment
appearances
- status：Dependent

- voiced_by：Sean Power

Frank Nostra was an Arasaka operator for the Special Operations Division in .

Biography

:Frank Nostra was a co-worker of V. They originally met during an operation coded "Icefall", which happened on the NUSA east coast. A week before V was forcibly terminated from Arasaka's employ, Frank arrived in Night City after participating in Operation "Cargo" in Cape Town, a scheme designed by his boss, Susan Abernathy, to smuggle weapons to arm African conflicts. V may or may not catch up with Frank on their way to Arthur Jenkins' office.

:If V did speak with Frank, many months after V was purged from Arasaka, they received a message from Frank informing them that Susan Abernathy is "downsizing" the Special Operations department. Frank explains that he is one such individual being removed by Abernathy. As a countermeasure, he has acquired files regarding Abenathy's misdeeds and criminal actions that would topple her from power, but V would only receive this message if Frank had failed to use the file in time and had been killed; a "dead man's trigger". The message directed V to the location of the information, leading V to believe that Abernathy had executed Frank amongst the many other purges she was conducting.

:Upon arriving to find the hidden briefcase empty, V encountered Frank, alive and well. Frank explained that he had recently been purged from Arasaka, with all of his property and accounts repossessed in much the same way as V had happen many months prior. In his desperation, Frank recalled how Arthur Jenkins and V had attempted to have Abernathy assassinated. Frank believed that serving V up to Abernathy might return him to her good graces and hoped that giving her V was his last, most viable option.

:Upon speaking with Frank, V can choose violence, leading to his former colleague being killed or incapacitated. Choosing to speak with Frank, but being callous in your approach, will result in Frank thanking you for your honest assessment and committing suicide. The diplomatic approach, stating that Frank can start again in Night City with a gun and a full clip, much like V did before, will convince Frank to walk away peacefully.

Abilities

*War Pigs

Frankfurt is a city in Germany.

Overview
Frankfurt is Europe's banking center, holding the offices of WeltGeschäfsBank, Merril, Asukaga & Finch, Sumitomo, and dozens of other national and international banks.

The city of Frankfurt is massive, having absorbed Offenbach and several small towns in the area. Its airport, controlled by the company Flughafen AG, is so large it’s practically a city of its own. It serves over 55 million people at a time and employs 100,000.

With such a big airport, smuggling is a major issue, but in actuality Flughafen AG is behind most of this smuggling and supplies all the local crime syndicates.
