## Full Disclosure
Full Disclosure is a Side Job in .

Walkthrough

Sometime after Gig: Last Login has become active (whether it has been completed or not), Sandra Dorsett will contact V about obtaining her missing databank, which is located in the same building as the aforementioned gig. if the player has already obtained the databank, Sandra will simply ask that you return it to her. V has the option to decrypt the databank as well, revealing information on Sandra's activities.

Sandra can be found at her apartment in Watson and will nervously open the door to let the player in. Inside Sandra's apartment, V can find Entry 36, Entry 37, and Entry 38, which tell the story of how Sandra uncovered Operation Carpe Noctem, and indicates that she's on the run from Night Corp.

Depending on whether the shard is read, there are different levels of reward or consequence for V.

:Sandra is thankful for the discretion and reliability, and finalizes the transaction with the agreed sum of 830€$.

:
::Sandra becomes upset and instead pays less than the agreed amount.

:
::
:::Sandra rewards V with the agreed sum as if the shard was not decrypted.

::
:::V acknowledges that anyone who can hack Night Corp deserves respect. Sandra says that she'll use the databank to fight against Night Corp, and she rewards V's honesty with additional eurodollars.

:::
::::Sandra reveals the nature of her pursuit as well as the root of her fears, and expresses her gratitude to have a fellow runner to talk with. Relieved, she rewards V with an even larger sum of 3800€$.

::
:::Sandra becomes hostile and will need to be neutralised, along with her security turret.

Journal Entry
:Sandra Dorsett... that chick you pulled out of a scavs' nest? Man, give someone an inch and they take a mile... This databank must be pretty special to her if she ain't even willing to go through a fixer. Well, damn... now I'm kinda curious. Gonna help out - or play by the rules of the game?

Objectives
*Find Sandra's databank.
*Call Sandra Dorsett.
*Meet with Sandra.

Notes
*This quest can be done simultaneously with Gig: Last Login, as they take place at the same location.

Trivia
*The title of this job comes from the Fugazi song "Full Disclosure."

Overview
In 2077, Mordellini's yacht, the GEIshhhhA, was moored at the Gold Beach Marina of City Center. It was famous due to the unbelievable parties that went on the boat. They were so wild, that Bartolomeo got reported to the marina administration by Josh Kavorkin, owner of a neighboring yacht called the OTTERLY FABULOUS III. The report stated Mordellini had violated the marina's article 8 - "noise curfew" - and article 11 - "conducting economic activity on marina grounds."

Database Entry

- transcript：A luxury yacht moored at the Gold Beach Street marina. Titillating rumors abound over the parties held on Mordellini's vessel. It's said only Night City's elite of the elite ever attends, but not a one of them has uttered a peep and no uninvited guests have ever managed to step aboard. Just what happens at the yacht's orgies of legend remains solidly in the realm of fantasy and conjecture.

*The yachts name GEIshhhha alludes to the word "geisha," a Japanese traditional artform practiced by women to entertain customers at banquets and performances.

Gerald Winkler, known as Garry the Prophet, is a conspiracy theorist in Night City. He can be found in Urmland Street, right next to Misty's Esoterica, in Little China, Watson.

Biography
Garry can be seen throughout the campaign spreading various theories. Many of them relate to lizard men from Alpha Centauri and Arasaka. V can interact with him to comment on the theories and even donate cash to him.

Whilst spouting a theory that nomads are actually werewolves, Garry inadvertently offends two members of the Aldecaldos, forcing V to step in and rescue him. With his life saved, Garry tells V that one of his implants allows him to listen to communication channels, which he believes to be aliens. He guides them to what he believes to be a meeting site for the lizard men, though this turns out to be a meeting between Maelstrom members and two unidentified corpos.

When V returns with a chip recovered from the meeting, they learn from one of Garry's supporters that he's been "abducted" by black suited people with blue eyes, who took him into an AV and flew away to their "mothership." Garry's friends tried asking for help to the NCPD, but the officers simply claimed Garry was "sick" and let him be taken away. It's unknown who these individuals were, but they were described by Gerald's friend, Sue Glover, to be dressed as corporates and have "blue eyes." V either thinks they were aliens, or can agree with Johnny that they were simply corrupt corpos.

A niche in the Columbarium is dedicated to him: "He knew too much, so THEY dealt with him."

Associated Quests

*Garry sleeps till the afternoon. Leave the area and return later to interact with him.

## Germany
- aka：United Germany
- capital：Berlin
- population：65.5 million
- language：German (official)
English
Russian
Turkish
Polish
French
Italian
- affiliation：European Economic Community
- ethnic_groups：Caucasian
Slav
Turkoman
- literacy_rate：99%
- military：221,000 (as of 2020)

Germany is the industrial and political center of all of Europe and a major member of the European Economic Community.

History

With the reunification of Germany in 1990, the road to European dominance was clear and inevitable. For the last years of the century, the economic, political, and social dislocations caused by the marriage of two different systems had been overcome, and finally a unified Germany became an acknowledged regional superpower. For the time Germany's strength in Europe was assured.

From 1999 to 2000, the Wasting Plague proved a turning point. Germany was especially hard hit initially but the BioWare labs at Neustrelitz were the first to come up with a partial inoculation. Additionally, the break off of Eastern Bloc countries from the Soviet Union allowed Germany to fill the vacuum of these new economies, making most of them dependent on their trade.

During this time, a politician named Volker Mohr came into power. He preached a safe-seeming version of German nationalism, but upon wining the election they began spewing rhetoric all-too familiar to the German people. He was
very quickly deposed, not just by his enemies but by his own political party, as his dogma was too much even for them. It’s said that the European Economic Community's "Fortress Europe" policy is a remaining remnant of
this era of politics, as well as Germany's corporate-subservient bent.

By 2077, Germany held the record for most citizens employed by corporations, having 42% of the populace employed.

Government
Germany is a democratic federal parliamentary republic where federal legislative power is vested in the Bundestag (the parliament of Germany) and the Bundesrat. The multilateral system has existed since 1949 and has been dominated by the Christian Democratic Union (CDU) and the Social Democratic Party of Germany (SPD). The judiciary of Germany is independent of the executive and the legislature, while it is common for leading members of the executive to be members of the legislature as well. The political system is laid out in the 1949 constitution "The Grundgesetz (Basic Law)" which remained in effect with minor amendments after German reunification in 1990.

The constitution emphasizes the protection of individual liberty in an extensive catalog of human and civil rights and divides powers both between the federal and state levels and between the legislative, executive and judicial branches.

Culture

German society is heavily evolved around corporate productivity. Due to low birth rates, corporations encourage their employees to send their children to special private schools where they’ll be trained to be good employees from childhood.

In what free time they have, Germans enjoy drag racing on the Autobahn, attending soccer matches, dancing at illegal, high-intensity raves, clubbing, and listening to technoise music.

Ghost Town is a Main Job in .

Walkthrough
Head to the Afterlife and look for Rogue Amendiares, Night City's top fixer and Johnny Silverhand's ex-lover. Asking her about Anders Hellman results in Rogue demanding money in exchange for her help. After paying her and waiting a day, Rogue provides V with an information Shard. V slots it in, learning that the Kang Tao transport is carrying an anonymous person, presumed to be Hellman. In order to take down the AV and interrogate Hellman, V must first recruit a driver named Panam Palmer, a nomad merc who can help. Rogue states that V must help Panam get her car back in exchange.

After contacting Panam and meeting up with her at the Rancho Coronado Container Freight Station, V explains the situation, offering info on Panam's cargo in return. She demands to know the location of her car, which V reveals is in Rocky Ridge. Panam agrees on the condition that they get her car first. She also explains that her partner, Nash, stole her vehicle and their cargo and plans to sell it in Rocky Ridge.

Panam calls the client, Boz, and agrees to meet over the phone. Panam explains she used to drive for Boz, a 6th Street gang member she refers to as a "good guy." They must go to the Aldecaldo Camp to pick up her friends to help.

Upon arriving at the camp, V meets Scorpion and Mitch, two of Panam's friends. The two tell Panam that Saul, the camp's leader, has order them to watch the generators until they are brought online, barring them from helping. However, Mitch offers the duo to take any gear they might need instead.

Panam and V arrive at the ghost town of Rocky Ridge. Panam checks the substation while V scans the power source and fusebox. Panam plans to use the substation to confuse the Raffen with the traffic lights. They wait for the Raffen to approach and commence with the plan. After the Raffen have been disposed of and they have recovered Panam's car, Panam states that they need to track down Nash. Here, V can choose to help Panam or not.

:Panam explains that she granted Nash her trust, and he betrayed her. Her and V go to the Raffen Shiv's hideout to hunt him down.

While driving, they discuss the plan to meet the 6th street gang at the Sunset Motel. They arrive at the motel, and Panam hands off a package of merch to Boz. They head inside the hotel and order a drink from the bartender, Noah. Panam reveals that the package contained Betahaloperidol, "drugs for the cyberpsychos in our midst." Panam expresses a hope to start fresh in Night City, with Rogue, and with new friends. They rent a room for the night to sleep.

Journal Entry
:Wanna track down Hellman? Start at the Afterlife. Sure, the place has changed over the years, but one thing never will: you got a question you just can't shake, head to The Afterlife. Always someone there to whisper the answer in your ear... for the right price. And if that someone's Rogue – shit, I wouldn't miss this meet for the world.
:Just when you think you've solved your problem, your solution goes and starts making fucking demands. Looks like Panam'll only scratch your back if you scratch hers. Could've expected that, coming from a nomad. Know what, though? I've got a good feeling about this sand-swept desert dame. Let's see where our newfound friendship takes us. Preferably to that weasely fuck, Hellman.

Associated Shards

## Gig: A Lack of Empathy
A Lack of Empathy is a Gig in .

Walkthrough
This gig requires V to enter a club called Empathy, which is under the control of Animals. There is also an optional objective to avoid detection. Entering through the main will require one to relinquish their weapons. Alternatively, one can enter through a door to the right of the entrance room, navigating through a set of private backrooms with several hackable computers before entering the club proper without relinquishing weapons.

Once inside the club proper, find the area called labeled "Private", which leads upstairs to the computer room where V needs to go to upload the malware. They will need to get past one of the Animal guards on duty. Sneak up to the computer room beyond, and one will see another Animals guard with his back turned.

After uploading the malware, V exist the club via the way they came in, or you can slip out the back door of the computer room where they can drop into the lot below. This will fulfill the "Leave the club" objective, after which V can circle around the building before heading back into the entrance and retrieving their gear again. If V avoided detection, one must get to the drop point in order to complete the quest.

Journal Entry
:Meet Adam Ibrahimovic and Larry Fanghorn. Adam's the bad guy and Larry's our client.
:Once upon a time the two friends opened a club called Empathy and things got off the ground pretty quickly. The eddies poured in, their popularity surged, they were surrounded by hordes of young ladies and one question at the back of their minds - who's got their hand in who's pocket? Adam or Larry?
:The blame fell on our innocent, naive Larry.
:What does Adam do? He changes the club's access codes, made a few shady deals and hired Animals as bouncers. If you were Larry, wouldn't you be pissed?
:Here's what you're gonna do. You'll break into Empathy, upload the attached virus to their net and bring the club's operations to a standstill. Empathy won't budge an inch until Adam welcomes his ol' pal Larry back with open arms.
:Sounds like a breeze, right? Just keep things quiet, no witnesses and everyone'll be happy.

Objectives
*Enter the "Empathy" club.
*Deposit your weapons [Optional]
*Avoid getting into combat. [Optional]
*Find the subnet's main computer.
*Upload the virus to the club's server.
*Leave the club.
**Retrieve your weapons.
*Collect your reward from the Drop Point.

## Gig: An Inconvenient Killer
Gig: An Inconvenient Killer is a Gig in .

Walkthrough
V will be contacted by Dino Dinovic to eliminate Jack Mausser, a merc who can be found at his club, 7th Hell. Dino will offer an increased reward if V does not enter combat. A €$500 fee is required to enter the club; Streetkid V, however, is able to bluff their way through by claiming that they're to "recruit new illegal BD talents" within the club.

If Mausser's office is reached without being detected, V has the option to converse with him and can convince him to flee Night City, which impresses Dino later. Otherwise, Mausser will eventually turn hostile following the conversation, and will need to be neutralised.

One also has the option to incapacitate Mausser after convincing him to leave NC.

Journal Entry
:I'll cut to the chase. Jack Mausser - NC-s gonkest merc. Did a recent job for me and went too far. Way too fucking far. He was supposed to klep some shards from a Zetatech transport - quiet-like. Except it wasn't fucking quiet. That psycho offed every single guard, beheaded the driver and blew up the truck. Corp's foaming at the mouth, searching high and low for the prick, and I'll be damned if I go down 'cause of him. I need you to toss his head at their feet. Maybe then they'll let this go.
:Mausser owns a seedy club downtown called 7th Hell. Gut tells me he's holed up there till the smoke's cleared. I need you to get inside the club and take his psycho ass down - preferably on the down-low. Understood? Good. Let me know when it's done.

Walkthrough

V will be hired by Regina Jones to locate some stolen meds from a dilapidated housing block on Columbus Street in Watson.

After entering the indicated residence, V must head to the furthest back room from the entrance and go up the collapsed part of the ceiling to get to the second level, and then to the only door on the left. upon opening it, V be confronted by Corporal William Hare.

V can convince Hare to relinquish the meds willingly, either with a Body attribute check or by convincing him that the meds are useless to him, all other options will turn him hostile. While there is no red timer bar, taking too long to make dialogue choices will also cause him to attack.

If V does manage to get him to stand down, he'll let them take the medicine while he goes to sit down but, as soon as one exits the room, he'll commit suicide.

V must take the medicine to the nearby drop point to complete the quest.

Journal Entry
:A few years back I scrolled a little feature called "How Affordable is Health?" It turns out not very. My numbers showed only 3 percent of Night Citizens could afford healthcare. A lot has changed since. For the worse. Some people are declaring open war on rippers, breaking into clinics, klepping meds and chems. No surprise there. And no surprise these rippers want to protect what's theirs.
:They want you to recover a pack of stolen meds. Thanks to the GPS tracer hidden inside, we know exactly where to look.

Objectives
*Go to the indicated residence.
*Find the stolen medicine.
*Retrieve the stolen medicine.
*Deposit the medicine in the Drop Point.

## Gig: Big Pete's Got Big Problems
Big Pete's Got Big Problems is a Gig in .

Walkthrough
This is an assassination gig and the target is Big Pete, a techie who works with the Wraiths. He can be found working in the basement of the New American Autoworks garage in the southern Badlands, which is guarded by two turrets (both facing the main road), six cameras (four external, two interior), and a total of nine Wraiths gang members (five exterior, four interior). Combat will finish the gig quickly, but stealth is also possible as long as the interior cameras and enemies are dealt with quietly.

However the enemies and defenses are handled, look for the door into the basement on the left side of the garage's interior. Upon entering the basement, Big Pete immediately notices V and pleads for mercy, explaining that the only reason he has a price on his head is because he sold a faulty signal jammer. In exchange for lying about killing him so he can escape with his life, Big Pete offers to double V's payout for the hit. If V perused one of the computers in the garage and read about Big Pete's brother, Tiny Mike, begging him for money, they can surmise that Big Pete is broke, When they point this out, Big Mike claims that this is no longer the case.

Once Big Pete is dealt with, V can use a utility tunnel that is only accessible from the basement as an alternate way to leave the area. The tunnel exits behind a communications tower behind the garage, out of view of any enemies or surveillance devices.

:Big Pete wires V the eurodollars and promises to leave Night City forever. Dakota Smith is surprised that V let the target go, but closes the contract since the problem has been solved.

:Big Pete promises to leave Night City forever. Dakota Smith is surprised that V let the target go, but closes the contract since the problem has been solved.

:Just so happens Pete's enemies are my friends and I owe said friends a favor. You make Big Pete eat dust - I get one less favor to owe.
:It's not hard to find him. Just try any of the Wraith's garages.

## Gig: Bloodsport

Walkthrough

Roh is being held in the basement of a Tyger Claws dojo. The building surrounded by a small walled courtyard, with one guard posted at the entrance and several more inside. The the courtyard is a public area, so the exterior guard doesn't react to V's presence in the courtyard. On the left side of the building is a side door that requires a Body check to open. On the roof above that door is a window that requires a Technical check to open. Elsewhere on the roof is a window that doesn't require any check to open.

Upon reaching the basement, there will be two cameras along with a couple more gangers, one of which who will be beating Roh, while the other is in a different room watching TV. Neutralise the guard beating Roh and lead him out of the building. The Tyger Claw at the entrance to the courtyard will be gone when you leave the area.

Roh moves quite slowly, so V will have to wait for him. When you reach the Regina's transport, he stops to sit on a bench and asks V who paid to get him out. V can tell him it was Macidew or say that it's a secret. If one tells him who it was, Roh seems surprised and expresses mixed feelings because Macidew is the reason he got picked up to begin with. V advises that it's a good idea if Roh and Macidew don't see each other again, and Roh agrees.

If V rescues Roh without tripping the alarms, Regina is impressed and includes a bonus payment for V to pick up at a drop point.

Journal Entry
:Matter's urgent. My client, Macidew Coolidge (you might recognize him from his show, "Boxathon," on N54 from a few years back) is looking for someone to get his coach back from the Tyger Claws.

And what did he do with it? He goes to the bookie incognito and bets on his own win. Next thing you know, he KO's his opponent in the second round and blasts off into the sunset in an AV.
:It was happily ever after for Macidew, until they kidnapped his coach, Roh Chi-Won. They're threatening to kill him if Macidew doesn't come back to Night City. Macidew doesn't want his coach's death to weigh on his conscience, so he got in touch with me and I got in touch with you. Sending you the coords for where they're keeping Roh Chi-Won. Try getting to him without tripping the alarm. Hostages and shootouts don't mix well. Good luck.

## Gig: Breaking News
Breaking News is a Gig in .

Walkthrough
Upon approaching the area, Muamar Reyes will call V to start this job, directing them to meet with Ted Fox, a reporter for N54 news, who is waiting in a car outside the Kendachi factory. Ted explains that he wants to publish an expose about Kendachi cooperating with 6th Street to design its latest product line, but he needs V to help him acquire proof of this connection by covertly installing a tracker on a Kendachi transport. V must sneak into the factory, plant the tracker on the van, and get out without raising any alarms. Take the tracker from Ted to proceed.

The factory grounds are small, and there are only two cameras, both outside the main building, but several security guards patrol the parking lot. Two guards are also inside the building: one in the garage with the van and another in the adjacent office. Place the tracker by interacting with the van's driver-side panel door.

Once V is clear, Muamar will wire payment. If no one was alerted, he will be pleased and provide a bonus through a nearby dropbox. Otherwise, Teddy will still get the proof he needs, but Muamar gives V a "C minus" for their performance.

Journal Entry

:That's where you come in to save the day. Ted'll tell you exactly what you have to do, but be ready to get onto Kendachi factory grounds, poke around. All clear? Head on over to Ted. As they say in the media biz - it's showtime!

*Remain undetected. [Optional]
*Install the tracker.

*Collect your reward.

## Gig: Bring Me the Head of Gustavo Orta
Bring Me the Head of Gustavo Orta is a Gig in .

Walkthrough

V is contracted to assassinate Gustavo Orta, a high-ranking Valentino, after his girlfriend Martha Frakes, the daughter of 6th Street member Nolan Frakes, was shot and put into a coma. Nolan blamed Gustavo and reached out to Padre to exact justice for his daughter. At Gustavo's apartment building, take the elevator to the 32nd floor. The hallway area outside Gustavo's apartment has some points of interest. First is a neutral surveillance camera that is linked to two more cameras inside Gustavo's apartment, which should be helpful for stealthy netrunners to scope out the interior. Second is a utility closet that can be unlocked with 9 Technical Ability to reveal a small trove of loot. Third is the entrance to Gustavo's apartment, which can only be opened with 17 Body or by quickhacking the keypad to the door's left; be warned that prying open the door will instantly alert all of the apartment's occupants. Lastly is a large shutter that opens onto a narrow catwalk outside the building, from which V can reach the lower and upper balconies of the apartment.

To carry out the hit, reach Gustavo Orta in his office on the apartment's second floor. Gustavo can either be killed or incapacitated and carried to a car waiting outside to complete the gig.

Alternatively, the gig can be completed nonviolently, either by jumping onto the upper balcony and sneaking into Gustavo's office, or by ringing the doorbell and answering correctly with the Streetkid (Lifepath) (the guard opening the door for V will point out that Gustavo is upstairs). If V has not harmed anyone in the apartment or been noticed, Gustavo will engage V in conversation and explain the circumstances of Martha's injury. Martha disliked her father and ran away from him to be with Gustavo. Later, Gustavo's car was ambushed by 6th Street when he was with Martha. During the ensuing shootout, Gustavo survived unscathed, but Martha was caught in the crossfire. Nolan did not truly care about his daughter, but hated Gustavo for taking her from him and used her injury as justification to have Gustavo killed. V can choose to spare Gustavo by telling him to leave Night City. He is reluctant to abandon Martha, but agrees to go when V points out that Martha will never be safe as long as she is together with him. He gives V safe passage out of his apartment (If V attempts to read any computers or hack any access points in the apartment while being watched by Gustavo and or his henchmen, they will turn hostile. However, if V hacks an access point unnoticed, they will not turn hostile). Exit the building and head to the dropbox to receive payment. Padre then calls to inform V that Gustavo committed suicide, but he assumes that V somehow made Gustavo do it and is impressed by the feat. V can then return to Gustavo's apartment to loot his body for a note and other items.

Journal Entry
:The world is built on certain rules. Rules that don't appear out of nothing - which grew from the blood and mistakes of our predecessors. These rules are meant to protect us, but they young disregard them. They believe they are special, that they are not held to the same rules, that rate is theirs to tempt.
:Martha Frakes believed the same and now sleeps in a coma after taking a bullet to the head. The streets tell me this is her punishment for abandoning family. The girl turned from her own father, Nolan Frakes, to side with the enemy - Gustavo Orta.
:But what the street says doesn't matter - not to Nolan. He believes Gustavo is solely responsible for what happened to his daughter. Let's fulfill the wish of a father desperate for revenge. He's paying, after all.
:Go to Gustavo's apartment. Deal with him. Don't worry about authorization. My netrunner made sure you don't run into any problems.
:And FYI - if you hadn't caught on yet - Gustavo is Valentinos, Nolan is 6th Street. Stay sharp.

Objectives
*Go to Gustavo's apartment.
*Go to the 32nd floor.
*Go to Gustavo's apartment.
*Find Gustavo.
*Neutralize Gustavo.

*Leave the apartment complex with Gustavo's body.
*Put Gustavo in the trunk.

*Leave the apartment complex.

*Convince Gustavo to leave Night City. (Optional)
*Leave the apartment complex.

Associated Shards

Trivia

## Gig: Concrete Cage Trap
- type：SOS: Merc Needed
- quest_giver：Regina Jones
- objective：Rescue Tiny Mike from the Militech raid
- district：Watson
- sub_district：Kabuki
- location：Residence building at the corner of Cortes and Kennedy
- tier：8
- enemies：Militech
- reward_xp：1000
- reward_sc：770
- reward_eb：9600

Concrete Cage Trap is a Gig in . It was added in Patch 1.6 as part of the Added Side Missions DLC.

Walkthrough
V is tasked with finding and escorting the client, Tiny Mike, out of a Kabuki housing block alive, as he is being hunted by Militech for stealing data from a lab in the Badlands for Regina.

Tiny Mike can be reached can be entering the block via a fire escape. Two locals loitering on the perimeter will point out that the fire escape can be reached by climbing a nearby vending machine and jumping from some pipes. Once on the fire escape, climb to the second level instead of entering the open window, and follow the catwalk. Watch out for a Militech drone on the ground to the left which has a partial view of the catwalk, and two Militech soldiers guarding an open apartment along the way. At the end of the catwalk, jump down and continue heading forward to a ladder close by. Climb up and head straight to enter the third floor of the building where Tiny Mike is hiding.

Tiny Mike is in an apartment on the second floor, in the bathroom. When prompted, grab his air hypo from the desk and give it to him, which gives him the strength to move, but not to help in any fighting. He allows V to take his personal weapon, , which is sitting on the sink, to make up for it. Next, follow him downstairs, where he gives V the option to let him open up an alternate exit through an adjacent restaurant. Going through Tiny Mike's escape route is faster and avoids any remaining guards, but three Militech soldiers may still be patrolling outside the restaurant. It is possible to eliminate each of them quietly, but their patrol routines do allow a brief window where none of them are looking directly at the restaurant's entrance.

However V and Tiny Mike escape the block, enter the vehicle that Regina sent to leave the area and complete the gig

Journal Entry
Tiny Mike's got himself in a scrape. You help him today, he helps you tomorrow – you know how it works.

I sent Tiny to klep some files from a Militech facility yesterday and clearly it didn't go as planned (mostly). Tiny swiped the data but Militech tracked the hack and has him cornered. You don't like sad endings do you? Let's try to avoid one here.

Tiny's hunkered down in our safehouse – apartment 63 at a residential block in north Kabuki. Militech's got him pinned inside and surrounded. Armored vehicles, heavy-ironed corpsec troops, the whole thing, probably the fucking spanish armada too. Break through their lines and save my man.

And don't worry – this isn't a charity case.

I'm attaching something that will help you recognize him.

Objectives
*Get inside the lockdown area.
*Use emergency stairs. [Optional]
*Go to Tiny Mike's hideout.
*Find Tiny Mike. (He's in the bathroom)
*Talk to Tiny Mike.
*Take the inhaler from Tiny Mike's backpack.
*Give the inhaler to Tiny Mike. (V can give him one of their own)
*Talk to Tiny Mike.
*Take gun. [Optional]
*Follow Tiny Mike.
*Talk to Tiny Mike.
*Escort Tiny Mike to the fixer's transport.
*Lead Tiny Mike to the restaurant. [Optional]
*Get in the car with Tiny Mike.

Associated Shards
*International Termination Warrant

Notes
*Completing this gig before Gig: Big Pete's Got Big Problems unlocks additional dialogue with Big Pete in the latter.
*Completing this gig is not required to unlock the achievement It's Elementary, but it is required to unlock the side job Last Call.
*After completing this gig, Tiny Mike can be found in the Afterlife.

## Gig: Desperate Measures
Desperate Measures is a Gig in . It was made available in Patch 1.6 as part of the Added Side Missions DLC.

Walkthrough
Zetatech employee Pedro Aimar plans to steal an automated transport from his company and sell the AV thruster parts it is carrying. He reveals to V that he has ALS, and only has a few months left to save himself by undergoing a full-body conversion. While Zetatech refused to pay for the operation, Pedro found a Soviet ripperdoc named Dr. Federov in Abakan, Siberia who claims he can perform the operation relatively cheaply, and the hundreds of thousands of eurodollars that Pedro raises from this heist will cover the costs and then some. Pedro says he has secretly tampered with Zetatech's delivery route algorithm and arranged for a transport to drive through the same area at the same time every day, and all he needs V to do is get inside the transport and insert a shard so he can remotely take over the onboard computer. Pick up Pedro's shard before leaving his motel room.

Travel to the Kenmore Diner and take a seat inside to wait until 5pm, when the Zetatech transport is scheduled to pass by. As the truck crosses the intersection outside the diner, Pedro brings it to a halt by activating traffic barriers. Get into the front passenger seat of the truck quickly (taking too long will cause several Zetatech guards to arrive on the scene), and insert the shard. Pedro takes control of the vehicle and begins driving it to the drop-off point, a Tirempire garage near Megabuilding H4. On the way, Zetatech security catches up with the stolen vehicle, engaging V in a shootout. Once the pursuers are eliminated, V must drive the truck the rest of the way to the destination manually. Park the truck and exit to complete the gig.

Journal Entry
:Better get some tissues ready - this one's gonna be a real tearjerker. Pedro Aimar, a guy who thinks he's some kinda nova netrunner cuz he coded a few algorithms for Zetatech. Well, now he wants to klep their ass. It's not what you think - see, he has some kinda health problems and Zetatech doesn't wanna chip in for his operation. Crazy, right? A corp that doesn't give a shit about its employee. I'm practically speechless. Well, now look at that... tears are splashing onto my screen. This is a life and death situation, V! Pedro needs our help! He (and we) reeeaally need the eddies!
:Pedro wants to klep a Zetatech truck full of A-grade tech (already got a buyer). Meet up with Pedro and figure out how you want to play this. If you help him, our readiness to help a poor soul in need will be handsomely rewarded.

Objectives
*Meet with Pedro in his motel room.
*Talk to Pedro.
*Take the shard.
*Be at the Kenmore Diner at 5 PM.
*Grab a seat in the diner and wait for Pedro's call.
*Take the passenger seat.
*Neutralize the Zetatech guards. [Optional]
*Talk to Pedro.
*Slot in Pedro's shard.
*Wait until the onboard computer is hacked.
*Leave the car at Tirempire.
*Lose the Zetatech pursuers.
*Wait for instructions.
*Leave the car at Tirempire.
*Exit the car.
*Talk to Pedro.

Notes
*Completing this gig is not required to unlock the achievement The Jungle, but it is required to unlock the side job Ride Captain Ride.
*Becomes available during the Main Job Ghost Town, along with Rogue's Gigs.

## Gig: Eye for an Eye
Eye for an Eye is a Gig in .

Walkthrough
Tucker's building can be entered by one of the three routes: the front door where a guard is waiting; the back door (requires Technical Ability); or an upper window, accessible by augmented jumping to a fire escape. Inside, one will find eight guards scattered around the house. Avoid or neutralize them to reach Tucker's office on the top floor.

There, V can choose to immediately take down Tucker or hear her out. She will ask why they are there, expecting V to have been sent by one of her competitors, and becomes dismissive when she discovers that the merc were sent after her because of the girl she hit with her car, saying that the case is closed because she already paid compensation and was insured for such accidents. Relaxed, she offers V a deal: take the money in her safe (which she declares must contain more than the payment offered to go after her) if she is allowed to live. She says that nobody has to know. V can choose to take the deal and leave, refuse and take her down. She can also be neutralised after accepting.

## Gig: Family Matters
Family Matters is a Gig in .

Walkthrough
V is instructed by El Capitán to visit the residence of Juliet Horrigan, one of his favorite netrunners. Juliet regularly provides him with stolen data from Zetatech, but she has not been heard from since her last heist two weeks ago. V's priority is retrieving Juliet's latest score, but the fixer is also a little concerned about why she went silent so abruptly.

The Horrigan residence has three entrances. Opening the front door requires a Technical Ability check, and opening the back door requires a Body check, but if one lacks sufficient levels in both they can climb onto the front roof and enter through an open window into the upstairs bathroom. Once inside, investigate the first and second floors to find a locked safe, where Juliet's data shard is kept, and traces of something terrible that happened. Upon inspecting the safe, one will be prompted to search for the access key, and by this time there is only one place it could be: the basement. If one has checked the computer near the safe, V can access a surveillance camera in the basement that reveals Juliet has been killed by her sister, Rose Horrigan, who has fallen victim to cyberpsychosis.

Juliet's tragic fate can be surmised from the evidence throughout the house. Her sister Rose had implanted a large amount of cyberware for her job, but she was fired and moved in with Juliet and her husband, Cy. Over time, Rose fell ill and began exhibiting symptoms of cyberpsychosis. Juliet tried to cure her sister by giving her high-end painkillers and antipsychotics, but Rose required larger and larger doses to stay lucid. Juliet even consulted with Viktor Vektor, but Rose was too far gone to help, and he could only suggest contacting MaxTac to take her in before she became a danger to everyone around her. After Rose broke Cy's arm, he left for the Sunset Motel for his own safety, but Juliet refused to go with him and continued to care for her sister. A month later, Rose became convinced that Juliet was poisoning her and stabbed her sister in the back.

Rose still wanders the basement of the house, where Juliet's body and the safe access key can be found. V's only option is to neutralize Rose. After retrieving the access key near Juliet's body, V returns to the safe, and opens it to recover the shard.

After V tells El Capitán what happened, he is saddened by Juliet's death, and shocked to learn that she had a sister.

Journal Entry
:I like everyone to know I'm patient, understanding. I realize there's a time for work and a time for family. Without a good work-life balance we'd all blast our brains out. I get it, I do. But... disappearing for 2 weeks cuz of "family issues?" That how Juliet thinks of me? How much she respects me? I love her cuz she's ripped so much nova data outta Zetatech for me, but man she's starting to hurt my feelings, you know?
:Go to her place, see what her deal is. But remember - #1 priority is that data she still owes me. Juliet's nova and all, but if she's got a problem with that, well... like I said, data is prio #1.

Objectives
*Go to Juliet's home.
*Look for the chip.
*Find out what happened to Juliet. [Optional]
*Find a way to open the safe.
*Open the safe.
*Deposit the datashard in the Drop Point.

Associated Shards
*Archived Conversation: Rose and Bernard Ackermann
*Dr. Havoc & Radon
*I'm sorry
*illness diary
*Test Results

Trivia
*Lidocaine and betahaloperidol are the two drugs found being used on Rose. Lidocaine is actually a local anesthetic and is not used for painkilling. Betahaloperidol on the other hand, is a fictional drug likely based on haloperidol, a real life antipsychotic, and is widely used in the Cyberpunk world, in attempts to cure individuals experiencing cyberpsychosis.

## Gig: Flying Drugs
Flying Drugs is a Gig in .

Walkthrough
V will be contracted to investigate the cause of the disappearance of a smuggler's drones, and is directed to Union Railroad Station, an old railway station that is occupied by the Wraiths. The station is heavily guarded, with Wraiths both inside and outside the station's main building, automated turrets guarding the gateways, and cameras watching most of the grounds. Arriving at the station will prompt V to figure out how the drones are being intercepted, which can be done in two different ways.

The first method requires an Intelligence rank of 7. Enter the building, look for a computer on the ground floor, and pass the Intelligence skill check to hack it. Once hacked, go to the messages tab to discover the rooftop transmission antenna has been reprogrammed to broadcast a virus that disables the propulsion systems of drones that come within range, allowing the Wraiths to steal their cargo. V is directed to the roof to disable the antenna.

The second method is to ignore the computer and proceed straight to the roof to examine the antenna. Johnny Silverhand will appear and point out that the antenna is obviously being used to down the drones.

Disabling the antenna can be achieved by either destroying it with a weapon, which will alert any remaining guards and security systems on the premises, or by having a Technical Ability rank of 10, which lets V cut the antenna's power and stay undetected. Lastly, leave the area to complete the gig.

It is possible to destroy the antenna without ever entering the compound:
*Use a Ping on one of the guards and wait for the antenna to be highlighted, or
*Take control of the surveillance camera at the very top of the tower, which will give a direct view of the antenna.

Hack the antenna with an Initiate Overload command to destroy it. Dakota will have a unique line if the antenna is destroyed in this manner.

Journal Entry
:A good friend of mine, Mosquito, is running an op in the Badlands. He packs a chem shipment in a drone and sends it off to the city, then when he gets his eddies wired, he slices off a piece for me. The problem now is those drones aren't making roost at their destinations. Someone's plucking them out of the sky along the way.
:We sent the last drone with a GPS tag. The thieves took the bait and we're getting pinged from the transmitter. You follow that ping then make sure Mosquito's birds can fly free once again.

Objectives
*Go to the signal source.
*Find out how the drones were intercepted.
*Destroy the antenna.
*Leave the outpost.

Associated Shards

## Gig: Guinea Pigs
Guinea Pigs is a Gig in .

Walkthrough

V must navigate the Biotechnica Hotel, which is divided into three accessible floors (lobby, floor 19, and the roof) that are swarming with Biotechnica security guards and robots, to eliminate Joanne Koch. She is wanted by the Red Ocher, a nomad clan that lost 70 members to the effects of a virus test run for Koch's pet project, codenamed Nightingale. Koch can be killed on the spot, or incapacitated and airlifted out of the building for Red Ochre to deal with personally.

First, V must reach Koch's apartment. The lobby of the hotel is patrolled by several guards and monitored by surveillance cameras and a turret. All of this can be bypassed by entering through an unlocked side door around the side the building with the police cordon, which leads into a small staff office with a single worker inside. A computer in the room can be used to view or disable the lobby cameras. Bypass or eliminate the worker, then head out the office door and turn right to find the elevator. Alternatively, the other side of the building has a door that can be opened with sufficient Technical Ability.

The 19th floor is covered by more guards, dormant robots, and cameras. One guard patrols the atrium outside the elevator, and others are inside a security office at the end of the corridor opposite the elevator. At the intersection, head left to a cluster of apartment entrances and an access door to the roof that is covered by a single camera. Sufficient Technical Ability can unlock the door to Koch's apartment, otherwise take the door to the roof to find an alternate way in.

The roof is monitored by two surveillance cameras and four guards. Two of the guards are constantly moving around a skylight with an open window that leads into the apartment. Bypass or deal with them, then jump down through the open window to find Joanne Koch absorbed in a braindance.

V can either kill Koch and leave the way they came, or knock her out for the Red Ochre survivors. Koch can also be woken up and spoken to, which causes her to plead for the chance to upload her Nightingale project data for her colleagues to use. She reasons that the deaths of the Red Ochre members would be in vain if the test data obtained from Nightingale never sees the light of day. If V allows her to upload the data, she will move to a computer, but proceed to call for security. If V refuses her, she will run away and also call for security.

If V intends to deliver Koch to Red Ochre alive and incapacitates her, Dino Dinovic will notify them that an AV, specifically a Zetatech Canopy, is on the way to the roof. If V has not already eliminated the four guards on the roof, they will be prompted to do so at this time to allow the AV to safely land. Take Koch to the roof by exiting her apartment and using the adjacent roof access staircase, wait for the AV, then deposit her body inside it. Lastly, return to the 19th floor, take the elevator back down, and leave the hotel to complete the gig.

Journal Entry
:Chick's name is Joanne Koch, regional director for tech and development or some shit at Biotechnica. Means she tests all the shiny new gizmos. Last little gizmo she tested? Yeah, that one flatlined over 70 souls - folks from a clan called Red Orchid or Red Ocher or something like that. Koch tried to dry the tears of victims' families with a few ennies (ever try that? doesn't work) and decided to close the book on it. Sure enough, book didn't close all the way - all them families pooled together to hire someone who'd give this Director Koch the cordial greeting she deserves. you know the kind - SUPER CORDIAL, to show her they REALLY CARE.
:I'll flick you the coords and the access code to the corpo hotel Koch is holed up in. Shoot me a word after the smoke's cleared.

Objectives
*Reach the 19th floor.
*Get inside Koch's apartment.
*Neutralize Joanne Koch.
*Neutralize the attackers on the roof before the AV arrives.
*Wait for the AV outside the landing zone.
*Carry Koch to the AV.
*Stay clear of the landing zone.
*Escape the hotel.

When V nears Megabuilding H6, Muamar Reyes will call with a job to sabotage a 6th Street hideout responsible for jumping a Militech transport in the area. He tasks V to infect their systems with a virus, and to kill Lucius Thoran, the Techie behind the 6th Street plans.

## Gig: Heaviest of Hearts
- quest_giver：Mr. Hands
- objective：Complete assignment from Michael Maldonado
- district：Pacifica
- sub_district：Dogtown
- location：Golden Pacific
- tier：4
- previous_quest：Firestarter
Run This Town
- reward_item：(missable)
- reward_xp：1832
- reward_sc：167
- reward_eb：4000-8000

Heaviest of Hearts is a Gig in .

To be able to start this gig, the main job "Firestarter" must first be completed. if the side job "Run This Town" is active, it must be completed as well.

Walkthrough
V meets with Michael Maldonado underneath The Needle. Michael explains that he was forced to testify against his son, Eric Maldonado, by D.A. Georgina Zembinsky and her partner, Hank Davis, after they tortured Michael for a false confession. He will tell V to go to the Heavy Hearts Club, where Georgina spends much of her time. On their way there, Mr. Hands will text V to not cause trouble within the Heavy Hearts Club, due to the fact that he operates out of there.

If V talks to the bartender, she will say that the D.A. is likely in the VIP booth, and to meet with a person named Jack in the bathroom for more information.

:V interrupts Jack while in the middle of some sort of deal in the toilets of Heavy Hearts.

:
::After paying Jack a sum of 550 eurodollars, or convincing him that V can get him better connections in Night City in exchange, he will tell V that Georgina may be in VIP room 04.

:V questions one of the waitresses of the Heavy Hearts club, and learns that Georgina may be in VIP room 04.

:V breaks into the dressing room of the Heavy Hearts club, and can find a computer terminal there with a list of guests at the club. Through this, they learn that Georgina may be in VIP room 06.

:V can interact with a man inside VIP room 04 telling them that Georgina is actually in VIP room 06.

Once inside VIP room 06, V will confront Georgina and Hank. They will explain that they need Eric in prison in order to help catch Hector Sacristán, a high-ranking Valentinos gang member accused of being a serial murderer she's been after for two years. They will also explain that Eric is a gang member himself, being accused of various crimes. Furthermore, they will deny that they tortured Michael, and that his testimony was not fabricated, despite what Michael claims, though he did receive payment for the testimony. They will then show a recording of his testimony, where Michael testifies that Eric told him over a holocall that Hector shot a man named Marcos Ferreria, and ordered his body to be dumped in the bay. They then offer to anonymize Michael's testimony, to ensure that Eric does not know that his father testified against him.

:Georgina will anonymize the testimony as she says she will, and V is free to leave the club and return to Michael.
:Upon doing so, V will tell Michael that she removed his name and data from the testimony. Michael will be unhappy that Georgina did not delete the testimony, and refuse to pay V. No matter which dialogue option is chosen, V will demand that Michael pays up in return for V's silence. Michael does so, giving them €$2000 before dismissing them. Mr. Hands will appear unhappy that his client is unhappy, but will note it if V did not raise the alarm and pay them €$6000.

:V will not believe Georgina and Hank's claims and demand that they delete the testimony. Georgina will then tell Hank to threaten V but if they have a high enough Body attribute they can threaten Hank first, If V does so Hank will give in to V's demands and leave the room; Otherwise, Hank will attack V and they'll be forced to defeat him. Regardless of what happens, Georgina will delete the testimony, and V is free to leave the club and return to Michael. Upon doing so, V will tell Michael that Georgina has deleted Michael's testimony, and he responds happily to this. After V requests their payment, Michael will pay them €$2000, and V leaves. Mr. Hands will appear happy because his client is happy, and if V did not trigger the alarm, he will pay V €$6000; Otherwise, he will only pay them €$4000.

Journal entry
:I have been informed that this is a delicate matter, however mundane it may be. Michael Maldonado has been blessed with two things: a wayward son and endless trouble. He will inform you of the exact nature of the assistance he requires. All I know is Michael is willing to compensate you – and me – surprisingly well for our efforts.
:Visit him to learn more about the nature of the job. Maldonado runs a business that he never seems to leave. You know how it is, V – those with the least stand to lose the most.

Associated shards

*Talk to Michael.
*Avoid raising the alarm in the club. (Optional)
*Go to the Heavy Hearts club.
*Ask around to find Georgina Zembinsky.

*
**Find a way to enter VIP Room 4.

**Find a way to enter VIP Room 6.
*Talk to Georgina Zembinsky.
*
**Defeat Hank.
*Leave the club.

## Gig: Hot Merchandise
Hot Merchandise is a Gig in .

Walkthrough

Rogue contacts V with a gig that she presents as a necessary evil. Either disrupt an otherwise respectable small business, or risk Militech cracking down on the city to stem the tide of jailbroken and untraceable weapons bearing their manufacturer's mark. The contract is for the former outcome.

V may either enter the Data Inc. store normally, through a set of industrial shutters in the alleyway south of the storefront, or circle around to the west of the store to attempt either a Technical Ability check on the rear door's lock or a Body check to force open the garage door.

:V can pose as a customer and even shop at the store without raising suspicion. The item selection is typical of a junk vendor, although sold at a significant markup by the surly and abnormally muscular salesperson. No weapons are available to buy even if V hints to the vendor that they are aware of the store's "high end" inventory. A gangoon will be arguing with the back-room staff about exactly this when V enters, but he leaves shortly after expressing his disappointment.

:The customer puts aside his complaints and defends the store. If the employees are alerted after the gangoon leaves, he will also be alerted, although he's going to be too far away to provide much immediate help.

:Attempting to get into an employee-only area will make the Animals posing as legitimate businessmen attack V on sight. If V opens the rear garage door, Rebeca will use her Netrunner skills to immediately start tracing V's location - presuming that the Animal in the back of the store doesn't see V as soon as the door opens.

Rebeca and a final guard can be found downstairs in a netrunning den. The last guard can be overheard on a holocall complaining to a friend that he's missing leg day because he has to "make sure [Rebeca] doesn't starve," provided he hasn't been alerted. Rebeca herself is out of her netrunning chair working on computers. A data shard in her inventory will reveal that she's in this business under duress rather than her own initiative, as Rogue had assumed. She will turn hostile if she spots V regardless; it seems that she has too much to lose.

:Rogue expresses no remorse if Rebeca is killed. In her mind, this was about maintaining equilibrium and nothing more.

:Rogue's tone is slightly more congratulatory. Incidentally, the quickest way to the fixer's transport is through the one-way door at the south end of the netrunning den.

Rogue does not remark on Rebeca's motivations in either outcome.

Journal Entry
:I'm guessing you don't follow the stock market, but recently Militech has been lagging behind everyone else. Just stroll around Corpo Plaza and you'll see their HQ abuzz like a hornet's nest. You can tell they're just itching for an excuse to send the armed cavalry into the city.
:You've got reasonable people telling you not to get under corps' skins, and then you have Rebeca Price, who decides to open a fucking store selling hacked (and previously stolen) Militech equipment. It's not that I don't value small businesses - on the contrary! It's just that not having the fucking army on our streets is something I value more.
:Rebeca Price needs to disappear. The "how" is your call. I won't go into the fine details. And I'm sure you know what to do if any Animals get in your way. They of all creatures should understand the importance of balance in our delicate little ecosystem.

Objectives
*Enter the electronics store.
*Reach the back of the store.
*Find a way into the basement.
*Find Rebeca Price.
*Neutralize Rebeca Price.
*Carry Rebeca out of the store.
*Carry the body to the car.

Associated computers
*Rebeca Price's computer
*Data Inc. computer

Associated shards

## Gig: MIA
MIA is a Gig in .

Walkthrough
Mercenary Benedict McAdams was promised safe passage out of Night City by Dakota Smith after assassinating a corrupt Night City councilman for her, but his driver, Jason Wildriver, went off course and McAdams has gone missing. McAdams had the forethought to implant a GPS chip before taking on Dakota's job, and Dakota wants V to investigate his coordinates so she can provide him with a new driver.

McAdams is imprisoned in the basement of an Abandoned House in the Biotechnica Flats. It turns out that Jason Wildriver decided to sell the merc to Militech instead of taking him out of the city. The councilman whom McAdams killed had deep ties to Militech, and the corp wanted to cover up the corruption by scapegoating McAdams for the murder and a litany of other shady dealings. Wildriver jumped at the chance to line his pockets. As V arrives at Wildriver's hideout, they can overhear Wildriver on the phone with a Militech representative, threatening to kill McAdams unless the corp increases their payout.

The only enemy in the area is Wildriver, who can be found roaming the yard outside the house. He can be killed or incapacitated, or avoided by sneaking into the house. Be warned that multiple mines have been placed behind the house, and the front is guarded by a turret. There is also a surveillance camera in the basement where McAdams is located, but it can be deactivated using the computer inside the house.

Speak with McAdams. He explains what happened to him and agrees to follow V. If V did not bring a car, there is an Archer Quartz "Sidewinder" in the garage that they can take to drive McAdams to the rendezvous point. Starting the car will alert Wildriver if he has not already been eliminated, but he can be easily escaped.

At the rendezvous point, exit the car and wait for McAdams' new driver. McAdams recognizes him as Starkey, an old friend, and they drive away together. Dakota then sends V their payment.

Journal Entry
:A fixer's worth no more and no less than their last promise. And I promised Benedict McAdams I'd get him out of town once he checked off a job for me.

:Benedect's one devil of a pro. Just six hours in of taking the job and Councilman McClean's heart beat for the last time - that fat fish I'd had dangling on my line too long. The risk of a slip-up was high, so before he set to it, Benedict installed a GPS in his biomon so I could have an eye in the sky on him, as it were.

:This slickster didn't work alone, mind you - had a driver, Jason Wildriver. The problem is, instead of hauling quick across the border, Jason went off route. Something here stinks worse than McClean's fishy corpse.

:Find them and bring me Benedict. I'll find him a new driver.

Objectives
*Find Ben.
*Talk to Ben.
*Take Ben to the meeting point.
*Exit the car.
*Wait for Dakota's guy.
*Talk to Dakota's guy.

Associated Shards

V will be hired to infiltrate a Revere Courier Services Facility in order to steal a van. The premises are inhabited by numerous Tyger Claws, along with a total of eight cameras dotting the area.

The facility can be entered through one of the two gates or, for a discreet entry, through one of the openings in the fence (there's an opening near each gate). Once inside the fenced area, V can enter the main building itself either through the doors on the first floor or climb up to the roof where there's a door into the stairwell or an open window to a small hallway with a camera overhead.

To get access to the van, V will need to enter the office and access the computer to authorize them as a driver. Head downstairs and drive the van out of the facility and to the designated location.

Journal Entry
:This is all I know – some guy named Karl Ginsky started with a merlot in City Center and ended with jello shots at a dive in Santo Domingo. Classic case. Everyone's gotta get fucked up time to time, know what I'm saying? As long as you do it smart. Problem is, Karl's brain had more than a 0.23 BAC – it also had a shard. If it weren't for the deus ex machina that is Trauma Team, he'd probably be missing more than just his shard.

:Head over to where those 6ers are holed up and recover Ginsky's property. If the Kang Tao top brass finds out, even Trauma Team won't be able to save him.

V will learn from Dakota Smith that the Wraiths are holding hostage Iris Tanner - a brilliant techie who managed to discreetly send an S.O.S. by using an old radio.

The Wraiths are holding Tanner in a makeshift outpost in the Municipal Landfill. The front entrance is guarded by turrets and sentries, while the side routes are secured with landmines. However, most of the gang will be gathered near the building at the back of the outpost, where they are trying to force Tanner to work for them.

After dealing with the defenses, V will find Iris, who asks them to find her van, located in the nearby garage. This will prompt an optional objective to extract Iris using her vehicle.

Whether V accepts her request or not, delivering Tanner to the DaKota autoshop will complete the quest.

:Iris Tanner is the best tech specialist I've met in decades of living outside the city. Car broke down? Trouble with water filters? Ailing generator? Call Iris and give her five minutes with it.

:One thing she's not great with though: People. Reading them, at least.

:Foolish girl started doing biz with the Wraiths. Making them angry is bad, sure, but making them happy is almost worse. Rather than just pay for a job well done, they kidnapped her instead. You ask why they'd kidnap someone who's capable of putting out an SOS from a rickety old radio? I – Dakota "Mad Coyote" Smith, eldest daughter of the Pomo tribe, eldest fixer in the Badlands – will offer my expert opinion: They're stupid.

## Gig: Old Friends
Old Friends is a Gig in .

Walkthrough
Padre has a personal grudge against the solo Karubo Bairei, who recently returned to Night City and took ownership of a bar. Bairei caused a major mess in Night City sometime ago and fled to the East Coast to wait for the heat to die down, and Padre is just one of many people who want revenge now that he is back in town. The fixer asks V to take out Karubo, but requests it be done quietly, since Karubo's bar is frequented by the Valentinos and the gang is friendly with him.

Per Padre's optional objective, Karubo must be killed or incapacitated and carried out of the bar without the Valentinos inside knowing. Karubo can be found roaming the bar's kitchen, but 1-2 Valentinos are watching the kitchen most of the time, another is watching the front door of the bar, and four others are scattered about the main room.

With a high level of Technical Ability, V can unlock the back door of the bar, which leads to a small storage room adjacent to the kitchen and bypasses most of these enemies. Once in the storage room, V only has to deal with three witnesses to quietly grab Karubo: a drunk Valentino who is moving around the main room, a Valentino next to the kitchen window who sometimes turns away briefly, and Karubo himself, who moves between four different spots in the kitchen.

There is also a hatch in the bar's roof that leads to a second storage room where one Valentino is taking inventory.

Once Karubo is dealt with, Padre will call. If V incapacitated Karubo without alerting anyone and placed him in the car Padre sent, the fixer is especially pleased and describes how he will savor the solo's punishment.

Journal Entry
:There's a time for forgiveness and a time for revenge. There's a time for turning the other cheek and a time for crushing your enemies like the roaches they are. In the words of the prophet Jeremiah: "Cursed is he who keeps his sword from bloodshed!"
:The man you're to eliminate is Karubo Bairei. He's an old-timer, but don't let appearances fool you - he used to be a solo. He killed my friends - people who were like brothers and sisters to me. When all hell broke loose in Night City, he fled to the east coast. Now he's back, probably thinking everyone forgot about him. But not me.
:Karubo runs a filthy dive that serves as a Valentinos hangout. Go there and show him that nobody can avoid the hand of justice.
:And try not to make a scene, OK? Be professional - no unnecessary attention.

Objectives
*Enter Karubo's bar.
*Neutralize Karubo Bairei.
*Neutralize Karubo without raising the alarm.
*Carry Karubo's body outside.
*Carry Karubo's body to the fixer's transport.
*Collect your reward from the Drop Point.

Associated Shards
*Archived Conversation: Gustavo and Karubo
*Archived Conversation: Jose Luis and Pilar
*Archived Conversation: Nolan and Xavi
*Outstanding payments

Trivia
*One of the shards that can be picked up from an unnamed Valentino gang member references a conversation with someone named Pilar. However, it is unlikely to be the same Pilar from the Edgerunners anime since that Pilar died in 2076, a year prior to the events of Cyberpunk 2077.

Bugs
*It is possible for the body of Karubo to appear after the quest is finished, able to kill him and gain the reward twice. Two lines from Padre will play at once then.

## Gig: Olive Branch
Olive Branch is a Gig in .

Walkthrough

Meet with Sergei Karasinsky and he will tell V to drive a car to the Tyger Claws as a peace offering. He implies that the peace offering is more than just a car, but he does not elaborate and leaves after unlocking the garage containing the car.

Upon entering the garage for the car, one can inspect the trunk immediately or ignore it. One will hear pleas from the trunk while driving. If V opens the trunk at any point before getting to the restaurant, they will find Alex Pushkin, a Biotechnica employee who refused an offer from the Tyger Claws, and whom Sergei kidnapped to give to them to buy himself a pardon.

If V opens the trunk and talks to Alex, they will have the option to either free him or close the trunk and deliver him to the Tyger Claws. With the Nomad Lifepath and have previously completed Gig: Guinea Pigs, an additional dialogue option will appear that reveals Alex worked with Joanne Koch on testing a new product in the Badlands that killed dozens of members of the Red Ocher nomad clan; Alex expresses no remorse for his role in the tragedy and likens the victims to roaches.

If V delivers Alex and the car to the Tyger Claws' restaurant as contracted, the gig is successfully completed. Wakako Okada will additionally praise V for their discretion. Otherwise, Alex will pay double what Sergei would have given V. Wakako will be surprised that the merc showed mercy to a corpo and left Sergei holding the bag, but remarks that Sergei was simply outbid and closes the contract.

If anything is done to antagonize the Tyger Claws while delivering Alex to the restaurant, they will turn hostile and an objective to kill them is given. After this is completed, the quest can only be finished by freeing Alex.

Alternatively, one can kill Alex yourself or attempt to drive him out of Night City, but both actions result in failing the gig and disappointing Wakako.

Journal Entry
:Sergei Karasinsky called. He's a solo who, like my husband, acts before he thinks. It's a personal characteristic that always leads to the same thing sooner or later - trouble. Fortunately for us, Sergei is not only a man who acts without thinking but a panicked one at that. This means the pay is good and almost literally flying out of his account into ours.
:Sergei is waiting for you at Silk Road. You will meet him there and pick up the peace offering he would like delivered to the Tyger Claws. He can't do this himself because he's recently been added to their blacklist.
:The boy believes this small token will help the Tygers find forgiveness in their hearts for his terrible mistake.

Objectives
*Meet Sergei at the designated location.
*Talk to Sergei Karasinsky.
*Get into the garage.
*Get in the car.
**Drive Sergei's car to the Tyger Claws' restaurant.
**Defeat the Tyger Claws in the diner.
*Talk to the man in the trunk. [Optional]

Associated Shards

Notes
*If Alex Pushkin is delivered to the Tyger Claws, his body can be found at a storm drain in Charter Hill near the casino from Gig: Tyger and Vulture.
*If Alex Pushkin is set free, Sergei's body can be found in an alley in Vista del Rey near Delamain Corp Headquarters, behind Dicky Twister.
*In order to get the additional dialogue option, one must speak to the clerk at the hotel during Gig: Guinea Pigs.

There are numerous Valentinos stationed throughout the area, including a sniper on the main building roof. Inside, two Militech vehicles can be scanned, plus several shelves of Militech uniforms and crates of Militech ammunition, which triggers some choice comments by Johnny. Walkthrough
Regina Jones sends V to the Kashuu Hanten eatery in Little China, a front for a Tyger Claws operated illegal casino, to retrieve an implant a man named Jacob Lamb gambled away.

After arriving in front of the eatery, V can take the alley to the right and enter through the back door guarded by a Racketeer. Once inside, there is a Kunoichi around the corner to the left and the implant is locked in the storage room. The door can be forced open passing a Body attribute check. Otherwise, scanning it will add the optional objective to find the bar staff key. Either way, after opening the door, V can take the implant, leave through the back door and deposit it in the Drop Point to complete the gig.

## Gig: Prototype in the Scraper
Prototype in the Scraper is a Gig in .

Walkthrough

Mr. Hands contacts V with a new gig. At the Scraper in Longshore Stacks, Scavengers have taken possession of a prototype Zetatech implant. V is tasked with retrieving the prototype from the Scraper by any means necessary.

Getting closer to the prototype's signal atop the Scraper, V encounters Hasan Demir, a former Techie for Zetatech, whom had the prototype implant installed in his own ocular system. After freeing Hasan and leading him safely out of the base, V has several options.

Essentially, V's choice boils down to turning Hasan over to Zetatech or letting him escape with the prototype while keeping the schematics.

Hasan will explain his side, and V will get a choice of two dialogue options:

:V and Mr. Hands decide Hasan's fate together.

:
::V turns Hasan over to Zetatech.

:
::Mr. Hands sides with V and lets Hasan go after the prototype is safely removed. After a few days, Hasan will contact V after having set up shop in Longshore Stacks. Choosing this option leads to Go Your Own Way.

:V keeps the schematics for Mr. Hands. A few days later, Mr. Hands texts V to tell them a vendor appeared on the market selling the exact same Zetatech implant, adding "it might still interest you to learn he was last seen in a Golden Pacific squat". Hasan will appear at the Kress Street Hideout, no longer wishing to talk to V after the ripperdoc scammed him from his implant.

Journal Entry
:A few days ago the scavengers raided a convoy returning from the stadium. Soon after, I received a call from the regional director of Zetatech informing me said convoy was theirs. Now, they'd tried to keep their transaction on the down low - unfortunately, it seems the scavs go lower. Zetatech lost a valuable prototype implant along with its technical documentation. They'd like to retrieve their lost items. Fortunately, the prototype is emitting a trackable signal.

:It's pointed us to a scav haunt in the Longshore Stacks, at the construction site of a long-unfinished skyscraper. I've sent you the coordinates; I trust you'll do the rest.

*Follow Hasan.
*Talk to Hasan.

Psychofan is a Gig in .

Walkthrough
V is tasked by Sebastian Ibarra to steal a guitar belonging to former Samurai member Kerry Eurodyne, which came in the possession of Gaston Slayton, a Samurai superfan.

When V enters the apartment building on Los Lobos Street and takes the elevator up to the 17th floor, there are two ways to break into Gaston Slayton's apartment. The first is to simply break in through the front door, which requires a high level of Technical Ability. Otherwise, V must access the apartment via the balcony, which involves getting to the roof. To do so, go to the fire exit at the right of the apartment door and go up the stairs until one reaches the apartment roof. From there, go straight ahead to the edge of the building, where one will see the apartment's balcony below. Disable or note the security camera before dropping to the balcony below, where V can enter an unlocked door to the apartment.

While inside the apartment, V can freely explore his surroundings without the risk of being caught, noticing various Samurai concert posters and vintage guitars, although Johnny Silverhand will call them "hot trash". Proceeding upstairs will take V to Slayton's bedroom along with a suitcase containing the item "Johnny's pants", and a shrine room containing Kerry's guitar. the door to the shrine is protected by a keypad, the code for which can be found on a still with the guitar in it with the date "2065". Simply enter the code (or force the door open with a Body attribute check), take the guitar. There is a computer in the bedroom locked via a keycode; although it doesn't unlock from the same code, entering the code into the door panel also appears to unlock the computer to check the messages showing Gaston wanted to get surgery to look like Johnny's band mate Kerry. V can also jack into the computer to get additional information. Exit the apartment building and head to Drop Point to deposit the guitar, completing the gig.

Journal Entry
:There was this band in the 20's, Samurai, maybe you've heard of them - talentless bunch of angsty, skezzed out kids who thought they were actually making music. For some reason, people nowadays still listen to them. One more reason why this world's going to shit and the end times are near.
:I'll cut to the chase - my client wants to get his hands on Kerry Eurodyne's guitar, one of the members of Samurai. Weird gig, I know, but the eddies are legit, and that's all that matters.
:I tracked down the guitar - it's owned by one Gaston Slayton. Guy's obsessed with Samurai and is a collector of the band's memorabilia. Getting into the building shouldn't be a problem - you'll have access to the elevator. Only thing is, Slayton's unit will probably be tightly secured - Eurodyne's guitar is his prized possession. Drop me a line when it's done.

Objectives
*Get inside the building.
*Go to apartment 1702 on the 17th floor.
*Find Kerry Eurodyne's guitar.
*Get inside the shrine room.
*Enter the code 2065. [Optional]
*Take Kerry Eurodyne's guitar.
*Leave the building.
*Deposit the guitar in the Drop Point.

Associated Shards
*Archived Conversation: Robert McIntyre and Gaston Slayton
*DRONE #26654V: LOG
*Fanfiction: An Omelet of Passion

Notes
*Judging by a shard found close to Villa Eurodyne, the guitar was stolen from Kerry Eurodyne's property per drone and later recovered.
*By reading Kerry Eurodyne's computer messages, it can be assumed that Kerry himself wanted the guitar back.

As V approaches the Sunshine Motel in the Badlands, they receive a call from Dakota.

## Gig: Serial Suicide

Walkthrough

Journal Entry
:Something's rotten in the City of Dreams. A series of suicides, a rash of self-destruction. The contagion mostly targets politicians, corpos, journalists and police officers.
:The latest victim was Zoli Barnes, a journalist who "fell" onto the tracks at Memorial Park station. Her death was officially ruled a suicide, but Barnes' parents say that she went to meet one of her informants at the station and that she never would've taken her own life (I know, I know, that's what all parents say). Seems like the jury's still out - nobody really knows what happened because every last shred of CCTV footage was wiped clean. Her parents tracked down the witnesses, but they didn't want to talk and what's more - Militech took a keen interest in the whole thing.
:It's our turn to make heads or tails of this. Head to the station, breach the servers and download any CCTV-related files. I'll have my code monkeys try to recover the deleted footage.
:P.S. Oh and by the way, at the time Zoli was working on a piece about Brad Noorwood - a Militech fanboy in the Night City Council.
:Anyway, looks like that piece is never getting published.
:P.P.S. Transferring you Militech authorization that'll get you into the station.

Objectives
*Sneak into the station.
*Reach the main server room in the station.
*Steal the CCTV footage.
*Leave the station.

*The premise of the gig is a reference to the Netflix show House of Cards. In episode 14, main character Frank Underwood, an ambitious and unscrupulous US congressman, arranges a secret meeting with journalist Zoe Barnes at a subway station and pushes her onto the tracks to her death.
