## Gustavo Orta
- status：Dependent
- place_of_birth：Heywood, Night City
- home：Night City
- residence：Apartment in Vista del Rey
- gender：Male
- equipment：D5 Sidewinder
CHAR Incendiary Grenade
- partner：Martha Frakes (girlfriend)
- relative：Campo Orta
José (cousin)
- affiliation：Valentinos
- occupation：High-ranking gangster
- voiced_by：Christian Lanz
- appears_books：(mentioned)

引文：You here to do me, too? Do it. Just shoot straight this time, don't hit no more innocent bystanders.（Gustavo to V when confronting him in his apartment）

Gustavo Orta is a high-ranking member of the Valentinos, and a relative of the gang's leader, Campo Orta.

Biography
Early life
Orta and Jackie Welles began life together in the Valentinos, both becoming fast friends. As the years went by, while Jackie left the gang, Gustavo's ruthlessness and familial ties helped him climb high in the Valentinos' ranks.

2070s
In 2076, Gustavo sent Maria Torres, one of his lieutenants, after Dalton Estevan-Luis, a Valentino who had wronged the gang and was attempting to escape.

By 2077, Gustavo, who was known for his lack of mercy towards gang rivals and having garnered a name for himself for stamping them out of Heywood, had begun to become more mellow; his stony nature taking a backseat to a less callous personality, leading him to behave out of character. This was due to Gustavo having started dating Martha Frakes, the daughter of a senior member of the 6th Street gang. Their relationship was dangerous due to the bitter rivalry between the Valentinos and 6th Street, but both, who had fallen in love, managed to maintain their secret from both factions.

Gustavo attended the funeral of Jackie Welles to pay his respects along with a Valentino entourage, including his girlfriend, who went under the disguise of a fellow Valentino named "Martha Young.” V could toast alongside Orta and his posse in Jackie's name.

Sometime after, unfortunately, during a 6th Street ambush aimed at assassinating Gustavo, Martha was shot in the head during the attack and was hospitalized in a comatose state. The girl's father, Nolan Frakes, blamed Gustavo for his daughter's condition, as he believed he was responsible for her injury, not knowing his daughter would be at the ambush site. For that reason, Nolan hired Padre to contract an assassin to remove Gustavo.

V can accept this contract to eliminate Orta and can take several paths of resolution to do so. V can either enter Orta's apartment by force, stealth, or diplomacy. V has the option of eliminating Orta and fulfilling the contract or can also render him unconscious and put him in the trunk of the car of one of Padre's employees. If V peacefully reaches Gustavo without conflict, they can find Gustavo in his office, where V can speak with him. Orta claims the assault was planned by Nolan to eliminate him, but was unaware that Martha would be there. Gustavo considers himself and Nolan are both equally at fault. V can then convince him to leave Night City, but he will refuse, initially, stating that Martha is still his love and that he won't abandon her, despite her dire condition. V answers that Gustavo is a marked man, others will follow, and, if Martha ever recovers, he won't be there for her. This convinces Gustavo to agree to leave the city, upon which Gustavo will stand down his security detail and surveillance systems, allowing V to leave his apartment peacefully.

However, upon leaving the apartment, V will receive a call soon after from Padre informing them that Gustavo has killed himself, complimenting V whilst pondering how they convinced him to do so. The quest then completes with the same rewards as if V had killed Orta. V can then take the elevator back up to the apartment to find Orta's body dead at his desk, although it is unknown if this was intentional. Alternatively, if V puts him in the trunk of Padre's employee's car, his fate is unknown.

Database Entry

- transcript：Open an encyclopedia and flip to the "Valentinos." You should find a picture of Gustavo Orta – or more likely his mugshot. But who reads encyclopedias these days anyway? Just one look at Gustavo Orta and you know he's a Valentino inside and out. His style could be characterized as ruthless – a trait that's certainly helped him climb to the peak of the gang's ranks. Recently, however, Gustavo has been acting... strangely. If the rumors are true, he spends more time silently contemplating the water in the bay than doing what he's been known and feared for – brutally stamping out his rivals in Heywood.

Guts is an variant of the Budget Arms Carnage in . It was added in Patch 1.6 as part of the Edgerunners Content DLC.

Characteristics
This green and pink Carnage belonged to Rebecca, a member of David Martinez's crew. It was originally obtained by her off of an Animals member during a shootout at a café in Night City.

Guts has an iconic modifier which increases the chance to wound and dismember an enemy.

After neutralizing an enemy using the Guts, damage increases by 15%, Crit Chance by 10%, and increases attack speed and reload time reduced by 6.6%, but also increases weapon spread by 18%. This buff lasts 15 seconds and can stack up to 5 times, for a total of 75% increased damage, 50% Crit Chance, 33% attack speed increase and reload time reduction, and 90% increased spread.

Guts is classified as a heavy weapon, reducing the user's movement speed and jump height by 15% while using the weapon. Due to its heavy recoil, firing the weapon will knock back the user, and if crouched, cancel it.

## Haiti
- type：Country
- capital：Port-au-Prince (formerly)
- population：11,439,646
- language：French
Haitian Creole

Haiti, or Republic of Haiti, was a country located on the island of Hispaniola in the Greater Antilles archipelago of the Caribbean Sea.

History
2040s - 2060s
At some point during the Time of the Red, Haiti and the Dominican Republic were affected by a disaster that decimated the Dominican part of the Hispaniola island. Refugees from this event left the island, with a number of them moving to Night City during the 2040s.

In 2062, a large tropical storm devastated what remained of Haiti, forcing its last residents to abandon the country in order to survive. Philippe Oreste, a captain of a ship, sailed through the waves, winds, and torrential rains of the storm to save 150 lives and guide them to safety atop pneumatic rafts. Over the following months, with their home lost, Philippe led the refugees in search of shelter and a new life, wandering around North America and eventually reaching Night City, where they were employed in the construction of a resort city in the Pacifica district alongside other Haitians and other communities living there. The ancient loa deities such as Agwe, Erzulie or Legba were eventually forgotten, for they could not look after the Night City Haitian community as the nascent Voodoo Boys had come to do.

2070s
Despite constant push by the Night City government and the NCPD, the Haitian community and Voodoo Boys gang fought back from returning the Pacifica district to them. Pacifica to them was their new Haiti, where the community planned to rebuild their homes.

Hal Cantos is a former World News Service employee currently working as an independent crack braindance editor in .

Biography
Prior to finding himself in the role of Night City's "known quantity", working as a freelance braindance tuner, Hal had been employed by the WNS. His contract was terminated once he had been caught committing fraud. By 2077, he has been doing street gigs mainly, one of which was a contract for the Mox.

From a brief message which can be found in the Mox warehouse on Longshore North, Watson, it is possible to find that his direct contractor was Lil Bex, investigating the death of a Mox protectee which had been recorded on a certain XBD. Hal's job was to isolate the code in order to extract the original AV layer, as it would be good evidence for tracking down the scroller of the event. However, whether something went wrong during the process or if the content of the braindance had a more severe impact than anticipated, the Mox leader, Anna Nox, who was the first to view it, experienced cyberpsychosis and went on a rampage, killing anyone in her way.

Hal had managed to hide in a nearby shipping container and contact his fixer, Regina Jones as a final SOS attempt. Despite lacking air in the container, he will patiently wait for V, the merc Regina hired, to free him. Once having a chance to talk, Hal will deny any notion of being the one to blame for Anna's cyberpsychosis, saying not much more than that he expected this day to go south from the moment he woke up. He will not express worry for the remaining survivor of the attack but claim that he will contact Regina to deal with her once he's out.

A repurposed version of the standard sledgehammer utilized generally as a tool of necessity in construction, demolition and mining efforts. This two-handed hammer is often carried by heavily muscled enemies, such as the Animals. Because of its weight, it has a slow attack speed but deals high damage. It is also effective for blocking attacks. Enemies hit by the Hammer have a high chance of being knocked down.

The weapon is classified as a heavy weapon, reducing the user's movement speed and jump height while using the weapon.

## Hanako Arasaka
- age：78
- status：Dependent
- dob：March 2, 1999
- place_of_birth：Tokyo, Japan
- dod：2077 (dependent)

- eyes：Brown
- cyberware：See Cyberware

- relative：Unnamed great-grandfather
Sasai Arasaka (grandfather)
Yui Arasaka (grandmother)
Saburo Arasaka (father)
Michiko Arasaka (mother)
Kei Arasaka (half-brother)
Yorinobu Arasaka (brother)
Michiko Arasaka (niece)
- affiliation：Hatashi Shipping Company
Arasaka (Kiji)
- role：Netrunner
- voiced_by：Alpha Takahashi (English)

Hanako Arasaka (荒坂 華子) is the third child and only daughter to Saburo. Hanako is a skilled, self-taught Netrunner and the head of the Kiji (雉) Faction of the Arasaka Corporation. She is loved by many people and often described as sweet and beautiful in the eyes of many Arasaka employees. Hanako is an intelligent woman who didn't agree with her father's ambitions and had her own agenda she planned to follow. Despite knowing what her father's wishes entailed with her, she still loved and didn't want to displease him.

Her relationship with her brother Yorinobu is one of great importance to her. Through her strong and calm demeanor she is able to command and lead with great pride for her work. Hanako became the figurehead and CEO of the Corporation. Although her digital projects were what drove her, Hanako was the only one who understood Alt's work with the Soulkiller.

Biography

1999-2020
Hanako Arasaka was born to Michiko Arasaka and Saburo Arasaka on March 2, 1999. Her mother died shortly thereafter due to complications caused by the birth. Due to this, she quickly became Saburo's favorite child.

Saburo was charmed by his little daughter's stunning beauty, and he decided to raise her in the sheltered confines of the Arasaka Family Compound to protect her from the scarring traumas of life in the exterior world. Hanako received her schooling at the compound through trusted tutors. Although she is a grown woman now, Hanako still only leaves the compound about once a month, and then only under heavy escort. Cut off from the outside world, she learned how to travel and explore the Net instead. Saburo made sure that Hanako was never made aware of the darker side of the corporation, but, through her Net explorations, Hanako was just beginning to suspect the horrible truth.

While Hanako would not leave the compound, the few times she would leave to see Tokyo she was escorted by Shintaro Takayama, the chief of security of the compound, or Katsuo Iwashima, the second in command. Shintaro was like a second father to her and she trusted him more than most. Hanako was also delighted with his stories of ancient Japan he would tell her while she was growing up. Katsuo would escort her when Shintaro was not available and her relationship with him was a pleasant one.

Hanako was a sweet and intelligent woman. She had been chafing under her father's well meaning restraint for several years, but she had never voiced her complaints. She knew that her father wanted to arrange her marriage in order to solidify a corporate alliance, but she secretly dreaded the day it would happen. Hanako never wished to hurt her father, but she had sworn to live an independent life after he died. Hanako's relationship with her older half-brother Kei was strained. While Kei adored Hanako and would do anything for her, she found him cold and threatening and never fully trusting him.

Her closest family member was Yorinobu, her older rebellious brother of the same mother. Hanako and Yorinobu would regularly meet in the Net while he rode with the Steel Dragons.

2022-2023
Hanako was not directly involved in the Fourth Corporate War; she was kept under strict protection. During these years, Hanako spent most of her time in Osaka. After the war ended, she attended the funeral of her eldest brother Kei, who had become a casualty of the fighting.
 Hanako and her father were surprised when Yorinobu used the funeral as an opportunity to ask for forgiveness. Thanks to her support, Yorinobu was accepted back into the family's fold.

2045-2070
A highly skilled Netrunner, Hanako was of one few who grasped the true meaning of Alt Cunningham's work. Having always been reclusive, she preferred to work on her digital projects, particularly on a revised version of Soulkiller with the aim of transferring engrams into clone bodies.
 However, after the death of Kei, the remainder of the Old Guard unified around her, forming the Kiji (雉) Faction. A group of conservative technocrats, they wanted to continue Saburo and Kei's plans, yet hoping for a peaceful reconciliation with the NUSA. While Hanako was the faction's figurehead, the degree of her involvement remains unclear.

At some point before 2070, Hanako opened a preserve on the island of Shikoku for the faction's name-giving animal, the last Japanese green pheasants (キジ).

2077
Together with her bodyguard Sandayu Oda, Hanako accompanied her father Saburo on his trip on the aircraft carrier Kujira from Japan to Night City, where he wanted to confront Yorinobu for stealing his personal commission — the Relic — from the lab. Concerned for him, she offered to accompany Saburo or speak to her brother herself, but the CEO declined both requests. On her question what he planned to do, he could not give her a good answer; however, he let himself be discouraged from annihilating Night City to avoid the talk.

After Saburo's apparent death, Hanako agreed with her brother Yorinobu to give an eulogy at the dashi float parade in Japantown during Aratama-matsuri festival.
 Shortly after her speech, Hanako was confronted by Saburo's former bodyguard Goro Takemura, who wanted to tell her about Yorinobu's involvement. When she wouldn't listen, he abducted her to an abandoned apartment building in Vista del Rey, where he attempted to reason with her. Hanako refused this along with the offered tea. Only the merc V, Takemura's ally and eyewitness to Saburo's death, was able to tell Hanako the truth: that her father had been killed by her brother. However, at that point of the conversation, Arasaka soldiers led by Adam Smasher burst into the building, securing Hanako and destroying the floor in the process.

Upon returning to the Arasaka compound, Hanako sent a proxy to speak with V, who had gone into hiding in the Sunset Motel in the aftermath of the parade. Having mistaken the rescue for an attempt at her life, she agreed to work together. Claiming that her hands were tied, she tasked the merc with acquiring a copy of Soulkiller, then contact her on her private line. Depending on Takemura's fate, V either asks her about the bodyguard's whereabouts and is answered with a claim that he was in a secure location, or V scorned her for being responsible for Takemura's death by not listening earlier, something she rebukes them about, reminding them that he had done everything for this conversation to happen and as such demanded respect.

Once the merc had acquired the necessary software, she summoned them to the luxury restaurant Embers. When they arrived, Hanako explained the situation: from the start, the story of Saburo's poisoning had been disbelieved, yet no one (herself included) had been willing to stand against Yorinobu. She revealed she loved her brother too much to oppose him until she realized that he had tried to kill her. At this point, Hanako offered to save V's life in return for their testimony in front of Arasaka's board of directors. The conversation ended somewhat abruptly when she was called back to the Arasaka Estate in North Oak, Westbrook.

:Yorinobu confirmed that Hanako was among the victims from when Alt took control of Arasaka Tower, vowing to find those responsible for her death.

:Be it with Takemura's help or not, Hanako pushed forward the meeting with the board of directors. Yorinobu followed his plan to kill the board during said meeting but spare his family members. Unfortunately, Hanako became one of the casualties. Yorinobu returned to the Tokyo headquarters to grieve his sister.

:Directly after the conversation with V, Hanako had been escorted to Arasaka Estate by her brother's soldiers, ostensibly for her own safety. She sent Anders Hellman and (if he survived Search and Destroy) Goro Takemura to rendezvous with V and extract her. Her initial orders are limited to neutralizing the four Arasaka elite soldiers guarding the main complex. The operation took place without her support aside from a tactical briefing.
:After extraction, the group took off in an AV for Arasaka Tower, where Hanako led the mercenary to her father's office. On the way, she shared her improvised plan to confront the Board of Directors before taking the mercenary to the Mikoshi access point below Night City by means of a secret elevator. There, she revealed Saburo Arasaka's engram; a brief conversation ensued until he informed her that he was ready.
:Together with Takemura (if alive), Oda (if alive), V, and three soldiers, she informed the board of Yorinobu's disposal as CEO of Arasaka and accused him of murdering their father. Her and V's testimony was initially dismissed, but gained instant credibility when backed by Saburo's engram. Immediately after she asserted control over the company's leadership, the facility went into lockdown as Taka soldiers arrived to dispose of the board of directors. Only thanks to V's presence did she and Michiko Arasaka survive the attempted assassination, after which she sent the mercenary to detain her brother, explicitly stating that if he was killed, their deal would be void.
:V arrived in the CEO's rooms to find a broken man who offered no resistance, taking away the gun with which he had not killed himself. During the wait, he shared his motivation: to finish what Johnny Silverhand had started, destroying Arasaka from the inside. Led by Anders Hellman from where Hanako was cradling her brother, the mercenary was one of the last people to see Yorinobu alive before his consciousness was overwritten by Saburo's engram. Despite global protests and unrest, the CEO proceeded to live in his son's body, reverting any change of policy that he had implemented.

Database Entry (2077)

Associated Quests

*Search and Destroy

Stats & Equipment

Behind the Scenes

引文：This beautiful, elegant, delicate woman is Saburo Arasaka's youngest child and only daughter-thus elevating her into the ranks of the world's most powerful. Born when Saburo was already eighty years of age, she became the apple of his eye. Fearing she would get beaten and bruised in the many Arasaka Corporation backroom brawls, he chose to keep her in a glided cage rather than prime her for the family trade. However, this prison of over-protection could not keep her spirit contained. She became skilled in netrunning and eventually assumed powerful roles as keeper of the company secrets and trusted representative of her father's interests. Yet, in the wake of Saburo's death, all she had known threatened to unravel around her. Hanako lives in an entirely different realm than V. Ethereal and otherworldly, she has never had grime from the street besmirch her clothes or the imperfections of age or illness pock her body-the latest and greatest marvels of cosmetic engineering have always been at her back and call. Her entire essence is one of dissonance: age without aging, power without agency, family without real intimacy or trust.
citation

Notes
*In the Arasaka ending, V refers to Yorinobu Arasaka as Hanako's baby brother. This is either an oversight or a mistake on V's part, as Hanako is the youngest of Saburo Arasaka's children. Hanako also regularly addresses Yorinobu as her older brother in Japanese (niisan).

Trivia
*Hanako's identity in a trailer was confirmed by CD Projekt RED's Senior Quest Designer, Philipp Weber.
*Her name in Kanji appears to be 荒坂 華子, according to a post by a Japanese CDPR forum moderator. However, as game subtitles are displaying all Japanese names in katakana, she is spelled as ハナコ.
*During a developer stream, it was confirmed that Yorinobu never intended Hanako's death.
*Hanako suffered from Raynaud's Disease. Her golden cyberware fingers reflect this in their design.

## Happy Together
Happy Together is a Side Job in .

Walkthrough

From the beginning of Act 2, on the floor below V's Apartment in Megabuilding H10, one can find two police officers knocking on the door of the apartment of Barry Lewis, an ex-cop who's so distraught over his friend's death that he left the force, has holed up in his apartment due to severe depression. Nadia Petrova and Juan Mendez will eventually see V and ask if they can see what's going on with Barry as he's refusing to answer them. V can try to knock on his door now, but Barry will refuse to answer, which will trigger a prompt to come back in a few hours.

After coming back sometime later, Barry will answer and eventually let V in, talking about a really bad case he had to work that got swept under the rug and losing his close friend, Andrew, made it worse for him.

At this point one can either talk to his colleagues outside, or go visit the columbarium in North Oak to learn more. If V chooses to not visit the grave and talk to the cops, Barry will end up committing suicide sometime later and with a distraught Mendez outside his apartment.

If V heads out to the grave of Andrew, they will find out that he wasn't a person, but actually a pet turtle. One can then inform the police officers of this information, in which case Mendez will open up to Barry about his own tough cases, prompting the latter to let the cops in.

Journal Entry
:Seems like the PD's taken an interest in a neighbor of yours. Even sounded like they knew each other. Will you assume the mantle of a concerned, responsible citizen and ask what's going on? I mean, if you got a potential psycho for a neighbor, wouldn't you want to know?

Objectives
*Talk to the cops.
*Talk to Barry.
*Try talking to Barry in a few hours.
*Try talking to Barry.
*Talk to the cops.
**Find Andrew's niche before talking to the cops. [Optional]
**Talk to Johnny. [Optional]
*Check on Barry.

## Harold Han
- home：Night City
- gender：Male
- hair_color：Gray
- relative：Unnamed daughter
- affiliation：NCPD
- role：Cop
- voiced_by：Matthew Yang King

Harold Han is a character in .

Biography
Early life
Harold Han and his family were one of the victims of the Fourth Corporate War. After the bomb turned Night City to shambles, Harold and his family moved into a shelter in order to survive and would walk for miles just to get clean water and food. Eventually the city began to rebuild, bringing back order and stability to Night City and Harold and his family were able to move into a proper house with all the benefits of modern day civilization. Harold, wanting to keep building Night City and make sure it never reverted back to chaos, joined the NCPD and eventually became a detective. Harold at some point was partnered with fellow detective River Ward.

2077
In 2077, Night City's Mayor Lucius Rhyne was killed at a secret sex club, the Red Queen's Race, with a spiked BD. Harold was sent in by Deputy Mayor Weldon Holt to cover it up and then move the mayor's body discreetly back to his home, and say he died of heart complications instead, which Harold readily complied to, though he was unaware of the spiked braindance and assumed that Rhyne passed due to his heart giving out during a session. Despite this, his partner, River, couldn't let go of the idea that the mayor died under suspicious circumstances, with Harold repeatedly telling River to just let it go, as his supervisor had ordered him to do so.

:While Harold and River were grabbing a bite to eat at Chubby Buffalo's BBQ, V approached them. Once Harold realized the mercenary was there to talk about the mayor's untimely death, Harold once more told his partner he should stop trying to re-open a closed case but this fell on deaf ears as River noted he was merely listening to some gossip, nothing more. Exasperated, Harold left the two to talk as he needed to go pick up his daughter.

:Some time after that, Harold got a call from River, requesting they meet up to talk. The two met up once more at the diner, with V still in attendance with River. Once River made it clear he knew Harold's part in the coverup regarding the late mayor's death, Harold confirmed it, but re-asserted he did it to look out for his NCPD family and unlike River he had no objections to doing so as nobody was clean in Night City. While Harold didn't reveal it was Holt that told him to cover it up, River was able to deduce it anyways and said he'd file a report with Internal Affairs with Harold's confession. Unfazed by this, Harold remarked it wouldn't get River anywhere other than put him in the higher ups' sights and, with that, he then drove off. As Harold guessed, River was suspended soon after and removed as Harold's partner.

Associated Quests
*I Fought the Law

Humans of Night City

Notes
*If River's quests are completed, he'll mention that he once considered Harold a friend until he learned the truth about the latter's role in the coverup.

- gender：Male

- place_of_death：Kabuki, Watson, Night City (dependent)
- voiced_by：Yoshi Ando

Haruyoshi Nishikata is a character in .

Biography
Haruyoshi Nishikata was an individual that found himself fleeing his home country of Japan after letting his moral values overthrow the oath he took as a doctor of medicine. He takes pride in achieving the title of world's best surgeon vocally and attributes it to having good instincts.

Haruyoshi's misfortune started once he found one of the Tyger Claw bosses on his operating table. Despite having a clear duty as a surgeon, he chose to take matters into his own hands for a greater good and allowed the surgery to fail. With his reputation of making no mistakes, the cause for the results of the unsuccessful procedure were obvious to the Tyger Claws, forcing Haruyoshi to take up hiding on a boat and swimming to America, straight to Night City, where his contact Dennis was to rescue him.

Dennis contracted a local merc named V to deal with the pickup, which proved that the Tyger Claws had not given up searching for Haruyoshi even as he spent time concealed in a broken-down freezer in one of Kabuki beach shacks until losing consciousness.

Survival
Upon meeting Dennis, Haruyoshi showed visible relief and was glad to explain his tragedy to V.

Associated Quests

Trivia

Hasan Demir is a former Zetatech Techie in .

Appearance

Biography
On one hand, Hasan is a clever and convincing man capable of bold moves. On the other, he fails to measure how is audacity may drive him to dangerous and even perilous situations.

He has dedicated his life to Zetatech and feels he is not given enough retribution for his sacrifices.

When V meets Hasan, he reveals he is a runaway Zetatech engineer who ended up using a prototype eye implant on himself in order to escape and be able to sell it afterwards. Johnny underlines the irony of the situation in comparison to V's situation with the Relic. The prototype is of immense value since it may eventually outsell even the famous Kiroshi Optics implants. After being released by V, Hasan pleads for their mercy.

:Hasan has his optical implant properly removed. He sets up a shop and lives peacefully afterwards.

:Hasan can be seen being escorted out of Dogtown by Zetatech soldiers and is never to be met again.

:Hasan finds a buyer for his implant. He is played by the ripperdoc who takes outs the implant with no consideration to Hasan's health and abandons him on the pavement with an uncurable empty eye-socket. Hasan eventually joins a squatters camp at the street level of a Kress Street building and bitterly rejects any more interaction with V.

- district：Pacifica
- sub_district：Dogtown

Heavy Hearts is a club located in Dogtown, in the Pacifica district of southern Night City.

Overview
Stylized as a pyramid, Heavy Hearts is an Egyptian-themed nightclub reserved for the elite of Dogtown. Local residents visit the club to party and negotiate, making Heavy Hearts a notorious business center and neutral ground in the district. The main entrance has two Anubis statues.

Although the club was finished prior to the Unification War, investors pulled out their money from any ongoing projects, leaving Heavy Hearts to the locals.

Staff
*Helen Wandoo, bartender.
*Sarah, manager.

Trivia
*The name "Heavy Hearts" is a reference to the Ancient Egyptian belief that the souls of the dead had their hearts weighed before the feather of Ma'at in the afterlife; those whose hearts were heavier than the feather were seen to be impure, and as such had their hearts devoured by the goddess Ammit.
**As such the name of the club is also an indirect reference to the "impure" nature of Dogtown's denizens.

Henry is the former bassist of the band Samurai. He appears as a minor character in .

Biography

2000s
Henry was the bassist for the band Samurai until their breakup, after which he fried his brain while working on a human interface prototype with Blazetech.

2010s
After the incident, Henry's nervous system was rewired, he slowly regained his memory, and by 2013 he was slowly regaining basic motor skills. He eventually became an addict. At some point after the band break up, he had a relationship with Denny, the drummer.

2077
Before 2077, Henry was a drug addict. He went to Denny for help and she managed to get him a good gig and a decent band to work with. After a month of getting along with the new band they kicked him out and he was back at where he started. He begged Denny for help, but she left him. Henry almost flatlined on the street where she stepped around. Afterwards all of Denny's old friends stopped communication with him.

In 2077, Henry was contacted by Kerry Eurodyne for a Samurai reunion in honor of Silverhand. After being told to meet up with Denny at her place, he crashed a cement truck into her house and filled the pool with cement much to her annoyance. V Had the choice picking either Henry or Denny to join them on stage.

:Henry prepared for the night of the secret concert in the Arroyo bar Red Dirt. Upon arrival, he spoke with V about his past with Denny and what his thoughts were on the special show. Henry mentions how Kerry helped him get in shape for the show. After the gig, Henry states that he is going to drink himself "to oblivion" as Kerry's paying all the bills.

Associated Quests
*Love Like Fire
*Second Conflict
*A Like Supreme (dependent)

## Henry Stints
- status：Alive
- place_of_birth：Heywood, Night City
- home：Night City
- gender：Male
- eyes：Blue
- affiliation：NCPD
- role：Detective (former)
Inspector

引文：I've always maintained it's the same for all you termites in Heywood. Born here, live here, die here. [...] Truth hurts, huh? Just watch your tone - I'm not a patient man.（Stints to V）

Henry Stints is an NCPD inspector in Night City.

Biography
Henry Stints was born and raised in the Heywood District of Night City. He eventually joined the NCPD as an officer. Soon enough Stints arrived at the conclusion that the conflict prone citizens who were born and lived in Heywood, would also eventually die there.

Henry managed to rise through the NCPD ranks, eventually becoming an inspector. During those years, he encountered and detained Jackie Welles more than once, to the point they've known each other for a while.

In the last months of 2076, during the Streetkid lifepath, Inspector Stints and his crew arrested V and Jackie Welles when they were trying to steal a luxurious car from a parking garage in Embers, The Glen. Henry recognized Jackie from the old days, and to their surprise, V too. Stints had been investigating V for a while, knowing they had been living in Atlanta for the past two years, "lookin' for a slice of happiness" in his own words, though they had returned to NC after it didn't work out. It was then when the owner of the car appeared; a high-ranking Arasaka corporate named Kaoru Fujioka. Stints was not pleased at seeing him. The inspector tried keep on with the procedures and bring the arrested to the precinct, but for Fujioka it was a waste of effort as he didn't have time to testify nor "play" at an investigation. He suggested Stints break their legs and toss them in the sea before leaving the area. The inspector ordered his people to do what the corpo had said.

Despite the order, Stints' people only bruised the pair and left them in a back-alley. V and Jackie pondered on the reason why Stints let them be, thinking he still had some little sense of honor left. They also assumed that, by being born and bred in Heywood, Stints cared to a extent about them despite being criminals, so he preferred to let them free rather than following the corpos orders to kill them. It was also likely Henry didn't like the corporates either, as the majority of the Heywood citizens loathed them.

Associated Quests

Characteristics
Her Majesty was owned by Alena "Alex" Xenakis. She then gave it to V.

It is a heavily modified version of the standard Unity, sporting a brushed aluminum slide and grips, a laser sight module underneath the barrel, and a unique silencer.

Her Majesty has a unique modifier that increase Crit Chance by 100% and reduces weapon spread to 0% while Optical Camo is active. The added silencer increases damage while shooting from stealth by 150%, but at a cost of 10% reduced base damage.

Heroes is a Side Job in .

Walkthrough
After having recuperated from their injuries in their apartment, V is contacted by Jackie's mother, Guadalupe Alejandra Welles, with the request that V calls her.

:Mama Welles asks that V joins the ofrenda that she is holding at the El Coyote Cojo for Jackie.

:After arriving at the Coyoto Cojo, V speaks with Mamá Welles, who offers them a beer and asks how they are doing. V tells her that they want to take part in the ceremony as well and do it in the right tradition, but that they are unsure about what to place next to his urn. Mamá tells V not to worry and hands V the the key to Jackie's garage, and assures V that they can find something in there from Jackie's past that will be appropriate.

:When V approaches the garage in the alley behind the Coyote Cojo, they find Jackie's girlfriend, Misty, is sitting in front of the garage door. V asks her what she is doing there, and she tells V that she is waiting for Jackie to return, even though she knows that won't happen. After speaking with her a bit more, they both enter the garage.

:Inside the garage, V looks for a suitable offering.
:
::On the desk, V finds the key that unlocks the door in the garage. Upon opening the door, Misty and V uncovered that Jackie attempted to make a mandala. Seeing the mandala improves Misty's emotional state and tells V that she once told Jackie to remove all the "dark energy" from the place by drawing a mandala. V proceeds to look for other objects that could be used in the ofrenda.
:
::V talks with Misty in an attempt to convince her to join in on the ofrenda, before going back to the bar.

:When back at the Coyote Cojo, V talks with Mamá Welles before sitting down next to Viktor Vektor on the couch. Several people will tell a short story about Jackie, before V has a chance to say their say.

:After the ofrenda, V speaks with Mamá Welles.
:
::Mamá Welles will mention that she noticed that Misty joined the ofrenda. V will tell Mamá to be nicer to Misty and to invite her for dinner.
:Mamá Welles offers V the key to her son's ARCH. After talking with Mamá Welles, V is able to talk with several other people and reminisce on Jackie's life.

:Three days after the initial message, Mama Welles will send V a follow-up message, telling them that she sent a package to V's apartment. When opening the package at their apartment, they obtain the key to Jackie's ARCH.

:
::Viktor will explain that Jackie's body was taken by the Arasaka Corporation, and that that is all he knows.

Journal Entry
:I don't usually give advice, but... fuck it, here goes. Don't make the same mistake I made - say goodbye to the people you love. You know what I mean, right? Jackie Welles was your best choom, and you don't find a lot of straight-up peeps like that in NC. Best thing you can is remember them. Oh, and one more thing. If anyone asks, I didn't just say all that to you. Got it?

Objectives

*Talk to Mama Welles.

## Heywood (2077)
- type：District
- city：Night City
- appears_books：

引文：Heywood is a neighborhood of contrast—from modern skyscrapers and parks in the north, to dangerous, inhospitable slums in the south. It's "the biggest bedroom in Night City," where gangs like Valentinos and 6th Street get down to business—legal and illegal alike.

Heywood is one of the major districts of Night City, located in the central portion of the metropolis.

Overview

In 2077, Heywood is seen as a district of complete contrasts. The north borders the City Center and is where you'll find lush parks and modern skyscrapers towering high above. However further south, the district changes drastically, with dangerous and unwelcoming slum-like areas dominating the urban landscape. The Valentinos and 6th Street gangs have control over this district, and are constantly fighting for it, though if you keep your head low they won't bother you, usually. Known by the locals as "the biggest bedroom in Night City," Heywood houses more people than any other portion of the city. The richer parts of Heywood are primarily occupied by corporate types, while the rest are just happy they get to live in Heywood.

Wellsprings, the safest part of Heywood, is full of working stiffs and underpaid corporate employees, being one of the most touristic destinations of the district. The Glen is the state-owned sub-district, with the city hall, justice court, and a large NCPD presence. Vista del Rey is the poorest part of the district, being heavily underinvested, crime-ridden, and slowly descending further into chaos, with many residents moving to other locations and more gang members moving into the empty void.

History
Early history - 2060s
During the Fourth Corporate War, many refuges from the devastated districts to the north fled to the to the neighboring suburbs of central Night City, where they would overflow them with city tents. Originally an industrial area, this district was known as South Night City, and during the Time of the Red it soon fell into disarray, turning into a vicious Combat Zone infested with dangerous gangs and residents trying to survive in any way they could. The original Heywood was in a different location to the southeast, packed with refugees and divided between a poorer south area known as Santo Domingo, and a wealthier portion known as North Heywood. Over time, the residents of Santo Domingo and Heywood began to clash, while at the same time, a group of reclaimers started to clean up South Night City.

In the following years, the reclaimers improved the former Combat Zone so much that when the residents of North Heywood realized South Night City had much better homes than their own, they decided to move in, kicking the reclaimers out in the process. The new residents then renamed the district to Heywood, since to them that name was who they really were, not where they lived.

2070s
During the 2070s, after the Unification War, Heywood was considered a district of contrasts. The northern neighborhoods adjacent to City Center were modern and well-maintained, with skyscrapers, nice parks, and public service buildings. Further south, however, it began to look worse and poorer, especially in the southeastern areas, where the architecture turned more suburban. The Glen was its heart, showcasing the refined and well kept northern and central areas with Reconciliation Park or the notorious City Hall, while more to the south it showed the reality of Heywood. No sub-district exemplified this contrast more than Wellsprings. Occupying the western neighborhoods, the areas bordering City Center provided reasonable safe housing for the small middle class of Night City, and its waterfront (especially the middle and northern parts) was well-adapted for tourists, keeping an overall aura of class. However, the further away to the south and east, the more old shabby buildings dating back to when the district was called South Night City appeared. The poorest and most dangerous area of Heywood was Vista del Rey to the east. The unceasing conflicts with the affluent areas north and west of Vista del Rey occasionally turned violent, and it was just a matter of time before the megacorporations decided to engineer a gentrification of the area for "the good of the city."

In the following years, Heywood stayed relatively the same with the exception of a gang war between the local Valentinos, who had a major influence over the district, and the growing 6th Street, both fighting over the control of Vista del Rey. Despite their gang status and multiple illegal businesses, the Valentinos usually didn't bother other residents as long as they were left alone, though sometimes "shit" happened, especially in dangerous areas like Vista del Rey. Other times, they even helped any tourists that got lost with directions back to City Center or the more touristic areas of the district. Although Heywood was not known to be the best looking part of Night City, it exuded a subtle, yet unmistakable charm, boasting a broad variety of shops and restaurants, from bougie boutiques and seafood restaurants along the waterfront, to colorful open-air markets and taco stands in the more urban neighborhoods. The predominant ethnicity of Heywood were the Latinos, but other ethnicities from around the world lived here as well. Above all Heywood was a bedroom district, offering a plethora of residences, such as towering skyscrapers to the north, neat rows of low-row houses to the south, residential megabuildings, and humbler dwellings, allowing everyone in Night City a choice for housing.

By 2077, the war between Valentinos and 6th Street was intensifying.

Database Entry

Sub-districts

*The Glen
*Vista del Rey
*Wellsprings

Other Areas
*Moto Cielo
*Welles' House

Behind the Scenes

引文：In some ways, Heywood is the Westbrook of the southeast: a bedroom-and-bar borough in a semicircle outside the City Center. Heywood trends decidedly more down-market, true, but it has the same basic ingredients. Japantown's role as neon-lit money sponge is played by the strip of restaurants and shopping malls near the coast in Wellsprings. Charter Hill's offer of aspirational-yet-achievable real estate is echoed by Heywood's modest middle areas. North Oak's villas are... well, Heywood has some nice townhouses. In most ways, though, Heywood is unique. By 2077, the middle-class has mostly disappeared, forced into poverty as the ridiculously rich got ridiculously richer. Yet somehow, Heywood manages to approximate a middle-class district all the same: here live those who can scrape together enough to get out of Watson, Pacifica or the wastelands outside town, but not enough to buy their way into Charter Hill. These lucky few cling tightly to their recognizably decent standard of living. It is no surprise, then, that Heywood's residents love their district, warts, violent gangs and all, with fierce pride.

## Highway 101
Highway 101, also known as the New Pacific Highway, is a north-south freeway that runs along the Californian coast.

History
During the 2040s, ground transit from Night City to San Francisco was about 4 hours long due to road gang activity and neglected roadways; while to Los Angeles was about 6 hours. A portion of the freeway went through the Night City suburb of Rancho Coronado. The most notorious organization patrolling the freeway in 2045 was the NorCal Marshal Service and its Highway Patrol units, who travelled along its full length until the state's border.

Following the construction of the border wall between NorCal and SoCal in the aftermath of the Unification War, Highway 101 was divided by a border crossing. Despite the animosity between both states, 101 still saw frequent use by 2077.

Layout
Starting somewhere in Northern California, Highway 101 stretched along the Pacific coast south until it reached Night City, crossing through a portion of the oil fields outside of the metropolis, and eventually merging with Industrial Street in Watson. After reaching the end of Ulysses Street in Santo Domingo, Highway 101 reappeared, running south across the Badlands outside of Night City until it reached the border crossing with Southern California, where it continued into Los Padres County. As pointed out by the signs around Night City, the highway led north to San Francisco and south to Los Angeles.

Notable Locations
2045
These were notable locations along the highway near Night City in 2045:

*The Signboards
*SovOil Fuel Station

2077
These were notable locations along the highway near Night City in 2077:

*Fuel Station
*Las Palapas Motel
*SoCal Border Crossing

Notes
*Based on direction, the southern portion of 101 could be the old Highway 126, while the northern portion could be the old Highway 928, both from .

Biography
Hilary McKenna is a member of 6th Street, a gang on a quest to "bring justice" to Night City, and runs an auto repair shop on Mission Street in Arroyo, Santo Domingo.

In 2077, race car driver Jimmy Kreutz brought his broken Mizutani Shion MZ1 sports car to McKenna's auto shop for repairs. Kreutz was extremely nervous about the broken car and urged McKenna to hurry, as he had a race coming up soon.

McKenna later notified Kreutz that the Shion's repairs were complete, despite the owner's request for a significant number of modifications, and allowed him to pick up the car from the shop within an hour. She also insisted that for safety reasons she needed more time to inspect the car, but the troublemaker refused to listen.

Later, Kreutz's car broke down during the race, and he lost. The enraged driver again threatened McKenna with violence. McKenna politely tried to reason with Kreutz, reminding him to check the car and asking him to watch his language, which only further inflamed the driver and hurled insults at her. Kreutz arrived at the workshop to carry out his plan, but the "sixers" were already waiting for him and quickly dispatched him.

Hilary McKenna and her accomplices will die as a result of a confrontation.

The Ho-Oh (Japanese: 鳳凰，lit. 'Phoenix') is a casino and club located in Kabuki, in the Watson district of northern Night City.

Overview
The Ho-Oh is owned by Jotaro Shobo, an infamous member of the Tyger Claws gang. This casino and nightclub has a notorious number of illicit dealings and criminal activities, most of which are conducted out of sight on the club's upper floors. Only the lower floor is accessible to costumers.

After Jotaro Shobo is dealt with, the Ho-Oh bartender will tell V that the club is under new management.

Database Entry

Layout
1st Floor/Ground Floor
The ground floor has the main entrance to the club. Here one can find arcade and vending machines, several blackjack tables, storage rooms, toilets, the VIP area, several rentable private rooms and the main bar. When you first arrive at the club, there are a number of innocent bystanders mixed in with the Tyger Claws, so starting a shootout here is not a wise option if you want to keep the former safe.

To the left of the entrance, there is also a garage where several Tyger Claws can be seen working on hardware, and a locked door that requires a Tech attribute of 7 or higher to get through which connects to the rest of the club.

2nd Floor
The second floor mainly consists of one large center casino area with a small bar, with several smaller employee facilities, such as beds and changing rooms surrounding it. The casino area has a surveillance camera that you will need to watch out for, as well as several Tyger Claws acting as security.

3rd Floor
The third floor consists of the office and personal braindance studio of Jotaro Shobo. In addition to the surveillance cameras, the Tyger Claws and Jotaro himself, you will also have to contend with a turret on the ceiling of one of the rooms, which needs to be either destroyed or otherwise shut down. There are also several surgery tables behind a door that needs to be forced open near the third floor landing, where you will find several of Jotaro's victims, as well as a bloodstained circular bed.

Associated Quests
*Gig: Monster Hunt

Trivia
*The name is derived from the mythical Fenghuang (鳳凰) birds. In Japanese, it is pronounced as "Hōō".

## Holdin' On
Holdin' On is a Side Job in .

Walkthrough

:After the disastrous date with Rogue Amendiares at the Silver Pixel Cloud, Johnny Silverhand asks that V goes to the North Oak Sign in North Oak.

:After talking with Johnny at the Northern Oil Fields, he asks that V goes to the North Oak Sign in North Oak.

Johnny says that he wants V to go to Kerry Eurodyne's villa so that he can talk to his old friend, since he heard news that he is depressed and attempted suicide.

When V enters the villa, Kerry is taking a shower and V can give control to Johnny near the guitar displays.

After giving control to Johnny by taking the Pseudoendotrizine, Johnny picks up a guitar and plays some of his old tunes. Alerted by the music, Kerry hastily jumps out of the shower with his revolver in hand, but almost immediately recognizes Johnny from the way that he plays the guitar. The two catch up and talk about their past lives.

Johnny asks Kerry if he'd be interested in getting the old Samurai back together to do a gig, which Kerry agrees to. Johnny is asked to get Nancy Hartley on board while Kerry arranges everyone else.

When V calls Nancy, her assistant, Steven, picks up instead and tells V that she has been missing for two days after having gone to the Totentanz to investigate a story.

Journal Entry
:The whole time I was flat on my digital ass in Mikoshi, Kerry was out there forging his glittering solo career. He'd better be real fucking chill after all these years, right? But something tells me deep down, he's still the same. Anyway, come on, guy's gonna shit himself when he sees me.

## Honduras
Honduras is a Central American country in the universe. With Caribbean Sea coastlines to the north and the Pacific Ocean to the south it has a wide range of land. In the tropical rain forest near Guatemala, the ancient Mayan ceremonial site Copán has stone-carved hieroglyphics and stelae, tall stone monuments. In the Caribbean Sea are the Bay Islands, a diving destination that's part of the 1,000 km-long Mesoamerican Barrier Reef.

 History
Honduras entered into a major conflict with the US along with Panama, El Salvador, and Nicaragua in what was known as the First Central American War.

 Resources
Honduras is known for its rich natural resources, including minerals, coffee, tropical fruit, and sugar cane, as well as for its growing textiles industry, which serves the international market.

 Cities

 Tegucigalpa
Tegucigalpa is the capital city of Honduras. Set in a central valley surrounded by mountains, it's known for its well-preserved Spanish colonial architecture. The main Plaza Morazán is dominated by the 18th-century Cathedral of St. Michael the Archangel, with its baroque interior. The Museum of National Identity traces the country's history. It includes a virtual tour of the Copán Mayan ruins of western Honduras.

 San Pedro Sula
San Pedro Sula is a city in the Sula Valley of northern Honduras. It's known as one of the country's main transport hubs. The San Pedro Sula Anthropology and History Museum has exhibits on the region's past, from pre-Columbian times to the present. To the west, in the Merendón mountains, Cusuco National Park has trails through cloud forest rich in wildlife, including many species of bats and the rare quetzal bird.

 References
MACDONALD, M. Home of the Brave. 1st ed. Berkeley CA: R. Talsorian Games. 1992

## Hong Kong
Hong Kong (香港), now known as Ghost World, was a special administrative region on the eastern side of the Pearl River estuary in southern China. With over 9.12 million people of various nationalities in a 1,104-square-kilometre (426 sq mi) territory, Hong Kong was one of the most densely populated places in the world.

By 2025, the region was completely destroyed by a plague, but regained life in the form of Alt Cunningham's digital consciousness forming an artificial intelligence society within the remnants of the NET in the region.

History
In 1997, control of Hong Kong reverted from Britain to China, though unfortunately China was in the middle of a civil war against the Maoist Loyalist Cabal which by 1995, controlled the Guangzhou Special Economic Zone. In 1999, agitators from the MLC took to the streets in what became known as the Hong Kong Riots, fighting against the Triads and corporate security firms. Martial law was declared across the city and almost anybody that could do so hastily abandoned it.

In 2010, the remaining corporations and Triads in the city banded together against the MLC. In 2013, MLC leader Hua Yuchi was assassinated, which served as the cue for the alliance to storm the mainland and help retake it alongside the CCP. After the war, the Triads and the corporations were granted precedence over the city, with the former controlling the west side of the peninsula while WNS, Arasaka, EBM, and WorldSat were given portions of the city.

By this period, Artificial Intelligences had begun using Hong Kong's sprawling computer network as a safe haven of sorts, infesting both abandoned and active computer systems. The Chinese couldn’t afford to cut off power to the Net due to how important it was to their commerce, so they were stuck with it. Over time, the AIs began to develop their own culture.

During the Fourth Corporate War, a bio-engineered plague was unleashed in Hong Kong which reduced it to a wasteland uninhabitable by life. The Chinese government responded by putting a 100-foot wall around the city to contain the disease. In 2025, an Engram of Alt Cunningham decided to use the still-functional servers within the city as a haven for AI's to exist without human interference. Presumably, the pre-existing society was a base.

Military
After Hong Kong was liberated from the Maoist Loyalist Cabal in 2013, the Ghurkas who had defended the city since they were under the British, privatised and founded the Neo-HK Merc Force. Every year, they recruit 200 teen-agers from their native Nepal, training them in their unique fighting.

Ghurkas are small, fast, and fierce as pitbulls. There have been many recorded cases of Ghurkas practically shredded from shrapnel and bullets still killing people in hand-to-hand combat, beheading them with their Kukri knives.

Currently there is one battalion (450 troops) on HK island, under the command of Col. Gurung. Another 1500 are on assignment around the world as bodyguards, in small tactical units (in Cambodia and Australia), and even a full battalion guarding the Sultan of Brunei. Ghurkas are known for their short stature, their cybereyes which turn red in battle, and the Kukris they use.

## Hotel Pistis Sophia

- city：Night City
- district：Pacifica
- sub_district：West Wind Estate
- street：Santa Maria St.

Scavengers

Hotel Pistis Sophia is located in West Wind Estate, on the Pacifica district of southern Night City.

History
Early history - 2040s
The Pistis Sophia was built during Night City's early years, some time before the Second Central American War. When Robert John Linder deserted from the US Army in 2003, he returned to Night City and rented a room at the Pistis Sophia Hotel. He spent several weeks contemplating his life and the corruption in the world, trying to find a purpose for himself. Eventually, he adopted the persona of Johnny Silverhand, then hid his army dogtags somewhere in the room and left the hotel. Soon afterwards, the rockerboy started the music band Samurai with the intention of using his voice to rebel against the corporations.

Over the following decades, the Pistis Sophia endured years of tumultuous events, including the firefights of the Fourth Corporate War, the Night City Holocaust of 2023, and the reconstruction period of the city during the Time of the Red.

2050s - 2070s
During the 2060s, there were the plans of transforming Pacifica into a luxurious seaside resort, though the old Pistis Sophia was not replaced by any new structures. On top of that, the hotel also survived the economic damage and armed conflict caused to by the Unification War that ended in 2070, which soon after turned the whole district into a combat zone.

By 2077, the Pistis Sophia was one of the oldest surviving buildings in all of Night City, although that it was still standing was more luck than a testament of its construction. Nevertheless, the hotel was no longer a functional establishment. It had become a decaying derelict husk occupied by local gangers and squatters, with some of the rooms having been left empty for years. It was around this time when a mercenary by the name of V awoke in the Pistis Sophia following a Relic malfunction and after being guided there by the engram of Johnny Silverhand. The rockerboy showed V where he had hidden his army dogtags decades ago, and had V take them as a token of his promise to do right by them.

Associated Quests

Trivia
*Pistis Sophia is a Gnostic text in which the resurrected Christ tells his disciples the story of Sophia's fall from the higher realms into chaos and her redemption through the intervention of Christ himself.

Hotel Tropique (also referred to as Hotel Haiti) is located in Coastview, in the Pacifica district of southern Night City.

Overview
During the 2060s, Hotel Tropique was intended to be built as a five-star luxury hotel in Pacifica, part of the Grand Imperial Mall facilities. During the Unification War, the building was abandoned. By 2071, Hotel Tropique was shadow of what it was supposed to be. The neon signs had long since gone dark and dirty, while the smog-smudged windows had been power-washed by acid rain for over two years.

In 2071, a braindance studio known as Brainwave moved into the lower floors of the hotel in order to record their next project.

## Human Nature
Human Nature is a Side Job in .

Walkthrough

After recovering in their apartment from the aftermath of Konpeki Plaza heist, V receives a message that their car—the Archer Hella EC-D i360—was returned to the Megabuilding H10's parking lot.

Upon entering the car, it is immediately rammed by a divergent cab from the Delamain Corp, wrecking V's car. This incident causes Johnny Silverhand to appear before V, and they have an exchange of words.

Upon exiting the car, V receives a message from the Delamain Corporation to visit their headquarters in Vista del Rey.

Some time after the incident, V receives another text message from Delamain, this time to let them know that their car has been repaired.

Journal Entry
:When a person dies, the world keeps chugging along without skipping a beat. Eventually, all traces of that person fade into nothing. Long story short, that's why your wheels were towed. Want my opinion? The best way to convince the world you're alive and kicking is to get your wheels back. Hell, maybe it's not the most ambitious goal, but for a minor-league merc like you, at least it's a start.

## Hungary
- capital：Budapest
- population：11 million
- language：Magyar *German *Rom
- ethnic_groups：Magyar, Gypsy, German, Serb, Bosnians, Croats, Slovak, Rumanians, and 15 others
- literacy_rate：99%
- military：80,000

Hungary is a landlocked country in Central Europe.

History
Hungary was quick to find investors after becoming independent from the Soviet Union, and by the Crash of '94 they had enough capital to keep themselves afloat. This prosperity was cut short in 2002 when a mysterious plague swept through the country and killed all their wheat. Hungary's people remained fed thanks to the European Economic Community.

The Hungarian government bought up this depleted farmland, with hopes of growing alternative crops, but the old farmers were disenchanted and happy enough living on the ECC's pension. SovOil, however, was happy to buy up all the farmland to be used to grow CHOOH2. However, the people of Hungary hated this development, tensions escalated as SovOil applied force against protesters, and civil war seemed inevitable.

In June of 2012, General Todorov, the leader of the Hungarian military, finally had enough. He ousted the parliament and gained the backing of the EEC. On July 23, he officially nationalised all of SovOil's investments, with the compromise that they would be payed back the assets that had been destroyed by protesters over a 10 year period.

Government
General Todorov still remained in power circa 2020 and was beloved by the people of Hungary. He had established a new parliamentary system, but essentially he was still the supreme leader of the nation.

Major Cities
* Budapest

## I Don't Wanna Hear It
I Don't Wanna Hear It is a Side Job in .

Walkthrough
Some time after blowing up the Us Cracks equipment van, Kerry Eurodyne will contact V, telling them that blowing up the Us Cracks equipment van didn't work, and that their concert is still going to happen. Kerry wants to meet at Riot, a club in Little China, Watson.

:V waits on a stool at a stall outside the club until Kerry arrives.

At 7:00pm, Kerry arrives, and talks with V.

:When V suggests that buy tickets to gain access, Kerry gets annoyed, saying that he doesn't want Us Cracks to get his money.

Kerry and V walk away from the stall and investigate the exterior of the club to find possible ways to enter.

:V and Kerry purchased tickets from a fanboy waiting outside for €$45,000 to gain entrance.

:V encountered two VIP guests on the west side of the club, and scanning them using their Kiroshi's allowed them to obtain two VIP tickets to enter the club after talking with the bouncer.

:V and Kerry investigate the exterior of the club and find a locked door that V was able to open using their Intelligence.

:V and Kerry find an open door on the west side of the building. V kicks down the ladder, so that Kerry is able to climb up and join them. After entering through the door, V found an Employee Badge that granted them backstage club access.

Having managed to gain access to the club and going inside, they find their way to the backstage dressing room.

:V was able to convince the club's huscle that they're a Techie working backstage and gains access to the VIP area. Kerry will ask V how they managed to do that, and V will answer that he used to work backstage for an artist named "G-Hung" for a while.

:V and Kerry gained access to the VIP area after showing their VIP passes to the club's huscle.

V and Kerry manage to find their way backstage, and V follows Kerry to a VIP room where they encounter the three Us Cracks members, Blue Moon, Purple Force and Red Menace, and speak with them.

:Us Cracks' members will tell about the deal signed with MSM Records. Kerry does not believe it initially, but the members tell Kerry and V that the collaboration wasn't their idea, but that of Kerry's manager, L. B. Kovachek, and that their cover of User Friendly is an expression of their love for him. Kerry will be annoyed with Kovachek, but calms himself down. Johnny comments that Kerry must be blind if he doesn't recognize the girls' potential.
:They settle their feud and become friends, and Us Cracks decide to postpone the rest of their tour in disagreement with their contract. The girls request a photo opportunity with Kerry as a souvenir, and ask V to take a photograph. After snapping a picture, Kerry will continue to hang out with the girls, while V goes their own way again.

:Kerry and the Us Cracks do not come to an agreement.

:And the crisis continues! Though Kerry might be barking mad up the wrong tree - those Us Crack girls are a symptom, not the cause. Could wipe 'em off the face of the earth, and those MSM bastards would still find some other two-bit gonk to sing his song. We're a dime-a-dozen whores to them, all of us. Chew up, spit out, rinse and repeat. On the other hand, world's crazy enough that even Eurodyne might be right. You're about to find out.

## I Fought the Law
I Fought the Law is a Side Job in .

Walkthrough

At some point after Life During Wartime, V will receive a call from an Elizabeth Peralez, wife to mayoral candidate Jefferson Peralez. She doesn't wish to discuss anything over the holo so requests to meet in person.

Once V reaches the meeting point, they are instructed to enter the car so they can then talk more freely with the couple, who note their suspicions that they believe Night City's late mayor, Lucius Rhyne, was murdered rather than dying from heart complications. They then ask V to edit a braindance from an attempted attack on Rhyne shortly before his death to see if they are able to get any clues from it. V learns a few key pieces of evidence from it, namely that an NCPD detective by the name of River Ward showed up needing to talk with their security just before the attack and took out the would-be assailant Péter Horváth; that a place called the Red Queen's Race was mentioned; and that Weldon Holt, the deputy mayor, is running as the mayoral candidate now in Rhyne's place.

After discussing these details with Peralez, they'll then give V River's contact information to call the detective. Call River up who'll agree to meet with V to discuss the case at Chubby Buffalo's BBQ in The Glen. When V arrives, they'll find him talking with his fellow detective Harold Han, who sounds like he's told River more than once to stop digging into Rhyne's case and that even his superior has told River to let it go. River dismisses this and Han will leave so that V and River can talk.

Investigating Leads

After a short conversation in the diner, V follows River to his vehicle and gets in to have a more private conversation where River reveals that he suspects that someone in the precinct let Péter Horváth loose, as he was apprehended earlier that day. The conversation eventually turns to how to find the Red Queen's Race and he'll gives V two possible leads to follow up on: check with one of his informants and check with Péter's employer.

At the store, the informant, Neil White, will run as soon as you use the Igor line, but River corners him before he can get very far in the alley. Neil will eventually reveal the location of the club, but also notes when asked they closed it shortly after Rhyne's death.

At the Cherry Blossom Market, V and River look for Christine Markov, Péter's employer in Japantown. They split off to ask the other vendors where she is and eventually V learns of her location via one of them or River will learn of it and text you. Regardless, head to the back left area of the market to find her.

Unfortunately, she won't be able to reveal much, only that Péter was always off his rocker and making erratic speeches about the late mayor before showing up one day with all the latest implants, having been sponsored by someone who "finally saw his worth". Follow River back to his vehicle to find some Tyger Claws poking around it, having recognized it as River's. You can choose to intervene or stay quiet here. If you stay quiet, they'll leave peacefully. If you intervene, one them asks how high you can jump. Jumping will get them to leave quietly, otherwise they become hostile. If things stayed quiet, or they were dealt with non-lethally, River will be pleased as it means less paperwork for him, and you will be able to go with him.

Once you've done both leads (or did the informant first) you can then head out to the club's location in Charter Hill.

Investigating the Club
As River is NCPD, he can't enter the premises without a warrant, so V has to go in alone here. V can try talking to the Animals member at the entrance gate, but she'll basically tells the place is closed and they're not allowed in, so they'll need to find another way in.

The club's entrance is hidden in one of the large shipping crates inside the warehouse. Open the crate's doors and head down using the elevator to enter the club where more Animals are roaming. The office and boss you're looking for is in the back, on the second floor and can easily be grabbed from behind in a chokehold to interrogate if you wish to go that route. If so, she'll reveal the Animals were hired to smash up the place and the only reason they're still hanging out is the one who hired them, Weldon Holt, still hasn't paid up. Once she's dealt with, you can check the computer where the messages confirm this. However, also check the files to see Ward's partner, Han, is also behind the coverup. River will then tell you to get out of there so you guys can confront Han but if you haven't already, go check the booth where Rhyne died to find the braindance wreath he had on. Interact with it and you'll pass out and River will break in to get to you. After a short conversation, you'll reveal what you learned from the wreath: someone spiked it and that's what killed Rhyne, not a heart attack. With that, you can choose to look around some more or leave with River, which will fast forward you to Chubby Buffalo's to confront Han.

Wrapping up the Case
River will ask who gave Han the orders to cover everything up, but Han won't say who and, with a few small conversations from you, Han will just note this is how Night City works and he's just doing his job in protecting his "family", that is the NCPD. This will allow River to deduce he knows who gave the order and he'll have to file it with Internal Affairs, but Han notes it won't do anything good, other than put River in their sights, before he drives off.

You can then talk to River about what he plans to do and eventually have the option to tell him to do it or not, but regardless what you say River is set on trying to re-open the case with the new information. With that, call Elizabeth and she'll ask you to visit their apartment to discuss it in person. When you get there though and start to head up in the elevator, Johnny will give some advice to not tell them anything, that whatever is going on is much deeper than they realize. However, you can choose to withhold the information or tell the couple what you learned, but regardless they'll be happy and conclude on their own what's going on and will pay you your fee.

Journal Entry
:Initial entry:
:Look, if a job starts like a classic whodunit - some femme fatale calls you up, refuses to give deets and just calls a meet - one of three things is going down: you're dreaming, you're scrollin' a shit BD or someone's hazing you good. Think you can scratch the first two.
:Later entry:
:First rule of "top secret" jobs - don't take 'em.
:First rule of working with politicians - don't do it.
:First rule of contacting the police - avoid it.
:And what do you do? Break 'em all at once. Gotta say, V, I'm a little impressed.

Objectives
*Meet with Elizabeth Peralez.
*Get in the car.
*Listen to the offer.
*Watch the braindance and look for clues.
*Exit the braindance.

## I Walk the Line
- type：Main Job
- quest_giver：Placide
- district：Pacifica
- sub_district：Coastview
- location：Batty's Hotel
Grand Imperial Mall
- enemies：Animals
- previous_quest：M'ap Tann Pèlen
- next_quest：Transmission
- reward_item：(missable)

I Walk the Line is a Main Job in .

Walkthrough

Approach

Two of Placide's sentries can be found near the Grand Imperial Mall standing by an old vehicle. Upon speaking to them they will direct V to enter the mall via the garage.

The Garage

There are about three Animals enemies standing directly in the garage entryway and a further five further inside, two of which will leave the complex and the other three are grouped together in the left corner.

The Atrium
Placide will warn V before entering the atrium.

The atrium is a large open space on the lower level, with a gallery surrounding it on the upper level. There are around six Animals in the gallery, and 12-18 more on the lower floor, along with a turret.

V must enter the atrium in one corner of the gallery. The van, which is the objective, is parked roughly in the middle of the far side, on the lower floor. Immediately in front of V upon entering are a pair of escalators down to the lower floor.

This takes V to a side room on the lower level. If one exits this side room, they will soon reach another side room which can be entered. In this room is a server which is connected by a thick cable to the van, which is parked just outside another entrance to this room.

There are three Animals standing immediately outside this second entrance by the van, who are on high alert.

The Van
When jacking into the computer system in the van, V will discover that the NetWatch netrunner is in the cinema on the upper level. Unfortunately, this will also make him aware of V's presence.

The Cinema

V proceeds up to the cinema. If V fought in the atrium, Placide will open a route to it. Following this route, there is one opponent at the top of the escalator going up, Then go round a corner to the movie theater entrance where Sasquatch is keeping guard.

If an alert had been triggered or V are detected by an Animal in the Grand Imperial Mall before, the Netrunner will have preemptively shut the gates to the movie theater and Sasquatch will be waiting for V. Sasquatch will attempt to rush at them and attack with her , her attacks are powerful but slow, and will take several seconds between each swing.

However, if V remained undetected throughout the GIM, the gates to the movie theater remain open and it is possible to sneak past Sasquatch without a fight. Being detected by her causes the gates to automatically close and the fight will proceed normally.

While V are fighting with Sasquatch, the Netrunner is trying to spike V's brain and kill them, but with Placide's help, he cannot kill V immediately. V should defeat Sasquatch quickly before the Netrunner manages to kill them. The weakness of Sasquatch is a shining implant on her back, once destroyed, she will get hurt significantly and can no longer recover her health.

Once Sasquatch is defeated, V finds the NetWatch netrunner Bryce Mosley, in the projection room. He will tell V that the Voodoo Boys are planning to double-cross the merc. One can choose either to side with him and have the virus removed (and thus prevent the breach of the Blackwall) or knock him out, in which case the virus that Placide uploaded to V earlier will wipe out many Netwatch facilities across the continent, and attempt to kill V as well.

Back to Batty's Hotel
After exiting the Mall, Placide's sentries will be waiting outside. They will be shocked to see that V have survived, and nervously offer to take them back to Placide, which can be accepted or declined.

Once in Batty's Hotel, V must then talk to Placide and Brigitte.

Journal Entry
:I'm sick of this Placide motherfucker as much as you, but at least the fog has lifted, the goal is clear. You find a netrunner in the GIM and the Voodoo goons will set up a meet-n-greet with their queen. Pros? Maybe I'll actually get to see a legit netrunner, 'cause it's sure starting to feel like an extinct species these days. Someone who's got the guts to square off against the Voodoos has given me some hope, at least. But the cons? Damn near any minute your brain could start dripping out your ears. Afraid we won't have time to make pilgrimmages to the monuments of Pacifica's Golden Age.

Objectives
*Leave Batty's Hotel.
* Meet with Placide's people.
*Enter the mall.
*Find the van in the lobby.
*Reach the van.
**Deal with the enemies near the van (if hostile approach).
*Connect to the van.
**Talk to Placide.
*Find the agent in the cinema.
**Deal with Sasquatch (optional if sneaking).
*Confront the agent.

*Jack into the agent.

*Talk to the agent.
**Take the shard.
*Talk to Johnny (if not making a deal with the agent).
*Leave the Grand Imperial Mall.
**Talk to Placide.
*Head to Batty's Hotel.
**Get into the back seat. [Optional]
** Talk to the guards (if ride not taken).
*Meet with Placide in Batty's Hotel.
*Talk to Placide.
*Talk to Brigitte.

Notes
*During the dialogue between Brigitte and Placide, they conclude if V is a "ranyon" or not, based on the scans Placide did on V.
**The dialogue depends on whether or not V accepted the deal with the NetWatch agent. If so, Placide will call V a "normal, filthy ranyon"; otherwise, Brigitte will defend V as being "no ranyon".
**"Ranyon" is Haitian Creole for "rag" or "floor rag", as the agent says, meaning "useful disposable outsider".

Trivia
