## Laguna Bend
- caption：Judy's picture of the submerged ruins
- type：Town
- state：North California (formerly)
- county：San Luis Obispo (formerly)
- region：Badlands
- subregion：Laguna Bend Reservoir
- location：Submerged by the eponymous reservoir

Laguna Bend was a small suburb on the outskirts of Night City, located on the rising Badlands to the southeast. Originally found near Laguna Reservoir, the township was flooded in 2062 following the construction of a new one. By 2077, its ruins could still be found submerged under the toxic waters.

History
Early history - 2040s
Established at the edge of Laguna Reservoir, on the rural outskirts of Night City, Laguna Bend became a symbol to reclaimers in the region of what was possible when perseverant communities came together to create something new. They managed to build a township with an atmosphere that hearkened back to the pre-Collapse life in America, with real houses, neighbors that worked together and trusted each other, and a town square where regular community events were held.

By the 2040s, despite its relative size, Laguna Bend housed its own church and public school. One of its notorious locations was Flo's Diner, considered by the locals to be the most famous and only eatery in the town. In 2044, however, there was a school shooting at the local education center, a study case that became commonly taught in NCPD academies. This event was so dire that some residents were still recovering years later.

By 2045, despite being a symbol to many reclaimers, Laguna Bend still endured many hardships, as tragedy struck with disturbing frequency. The community was always well-armed, ready to fight off gang members from Night City or raiders from across the Badlands that were looking to raise hell, and illnesses were common among the population, especially due to the pollutant-carrying dust storms that regularly swept through the area.

2062
Around mid 2062, the rent prices in the township of Laguna Bend rose drastically to the surprise of its residents. Soon after, they were informed that the land their houses stood on had been bought out by NC Dam — a corporation who planed to turn the region into a reservoir.

During the following months, some of its residents relocated to temporary housing the company had built as compensation. However, those who ignored the municipal directives and stayed became victims of a corporate smear campaign which identified them as "agents of public unrest" — people who were preventing necessary construction in order to secure access to clean water for all of Night City. As a result, public opinion quickly turned against the residents of Laguna Bend and few paid attention to the change in police tactics and open violence against them.

The townsfolk of Laguna Bend kept protesting, usually in front of the town's church building, but to no avail. In the meantime, the company had already declared all of their houses as construction areas and ordered their workers to begin construction immediately to prevent further financial loses due to delays; all this while the residents were still living in their homes. Things begun to escalate, which eventually led into a fatal accident. On Friday, July 14, 2062, one resident climbed a crane in order to stall construction. Its operator responded by throwing at him objects found in the crane's control room, however, the operator subsequently lost control of the suspended load, which collided into a home and killed a family who was still inside. This incident marked the turning point which the townsfolk had already lost. Eventually, the residents left the town, and the few who still wanted to stay were forced out by the police. They even had to drag out a neighbor — who was hell-bent in staying — moments before the water reached his house. By the time the newly constructed dam was operational, the whole town was already submerged.

Aftermath
The multimillion-eurodollar structure turned Laguna Bend into a reservoir of two million hectoliters, and any memory of the struggle of its former residents was quickly forgotten. By 2077, the ruined town still remained underwater, almost completely undisturbed.

Database Entry

- transcript：Laguna Bend's evolution has taken it from a quaint, sleepy town, to a suburb of Night City, to a reservoir. Why? Because NC Dam Ltd believed it was the ideal spot to build (surprise!) a dam. They flooded Laguna Bend and its surrounding environs while the town residents' protests served only to add color to local news stories. In many cases, homes were flooded the very day they had been evacuated. Given what the rest of the Badlands looks like, Laguna Bend is a welcome sight from the outside. Still, it's worth bearing in mind that the water is highly toxic and will most likely remain so for the foreseeable future.

## Laguna Bend Dam
- type：Gravity dam
- owner：NC Dam Ltd.
- region：Badlands
- subregion：Laguna Bend Reservoir
- appears_books：

Laguna Bend Dam is a gravity dam located in the Laguna Bend Reservoir, on the southeastern Badlands of Night City.

Overview
Found southeast of Santo Domingo, around 2077 the structure prevented Laguna Bend from emptying its waters on the drained basin to the north, which was occupied by part of the overfilled municipal landfill and the old Coronado Dam. An asphalted road run above the structure itself, all the way to a collapsed tunnel to the east.

Personnel keept this facility in pristine condition, and it had at least three more additional edifices; one located on the western side, made of of two buildings, another one on the eastern side, made of of a smaller single structure; and a large facility on the reservoir's shores east of the dam proper. Despite no water flowing out of the structure, two of its five gates were open when inspected at that time.

History

Around mid-2062, the terrains around the township of Laguna Bend were bought by NC Dam Ltd. — a corporation who planed to turn the surrounding region into a reservoir. Some of the townsfolk left while the ones that ignored the municipal directives and stayed became victims of a corporate smear campaign which identified them as "agents of public unrest," people who were preventing necessary construction in order to secure access to clean water for all of Night City. As a result, public opinion quickly turned against the residents of Laguna Bend and few paid attention to the change in police tactics and open violence against them. In the end, all residents were forced to leave the town, and the few who still wanted to stay were forced out by the police. By the time the newly constructed dam was operational, the whole settlement was already submerged.

Eventually, the project did not work out, as the the waters of Laguna Bend Reservoir were deemed too contaminated. However, fifteen years later in 2077, the water was not as toxic, and with good diving equipment it was possible to safely dive into its depths.

Associated Quests
*The Beast in Me: Badlands

Notes
*The map included in the physical edition of shows the tunnel to the east connecting to a road that goes around the basin north of the dam, leading to the right side of Coronado Dam, right next to the parking lot found in the videogame.

## Laguna Bend Public School
- type：Public school
- region：Badlands
- town：Laguna Bend

The Laguna Bend Public School was an educational institution located in the small town of Laguna Bend, on the southeastern Badlands of Night City.

History
During the Time of the Red, the public school of Laguna Bend was a building distributed among two wings. Elementary and middle school students went to class at the eastern wing, while high school students went to the western wing.

In 2042, the school won first place in an interscholastic wrestling tournament. Two years later, in 2044, there was a school shooting that took the lives of four students and two teachers. Ever since, this case was added to the curriculum studied in NCPD academies. By 2045, due to the shooting from the previous year, the local community decided to employ 6th Street to guard the facility. Around this time, Anthony Harris was attending the school.

The public school, like the rest of Laguna Bend, were flooded in 2062 after the construction of a dam that turned the whole valley into a reservoir.

Associated Quests
*The Hunt

Notes
*In , the school building visited during The Hunt is physically found west of the Biotechnica Flats, outside of the playable boundaries.

## Laguna Bend Reservoir
- type：Reservoir
- region：Badlands

Laguna Bend Reservoir is located on the hills of the southeastern Badlands of Night City. It is named after a small suburb whose remains can still be found below its waters.

History
In 2062, NC Dam flooded the valley around the township of Laguna Bend with the construction of a large dam, a multimillion-eurodollar project that turned the area into a reservoir of two million hectoliters. Unfortunately, it didn't work out as planned, since the water of the reservoir was contaminated. One of the original residents decided to build a small cottage on the lake's shore, as close to his former home as possible. Due to his proximity to the highly toxic water, he got sick and was forced to move out.

By 2077, the reservoir's water was not as toxic as it had been fifteen years prior, and with a good diving equipment it was possible to safely dive through its depths and explore the remains of the submerged township.

Database Entry

- transcript：Laguna Bend's evolution has taken it from a quaint, sleepy town, to a suburb of Night City, to a reservoir. Why? Because NC Dam Ltd believed it was the ideal spot to build (surprise!) a dam. They flooded Laguna Bend and its surrounding environs while the town residents' protests served only to add color to local news stories. In many cases, homes were flooded the very day they had been evacuated. Given what the rest of the Badlands looks like, Laguna Bend is a welcome sight from the outside. Still, it's worth bearing in mind that the water is highly toxic and will most likely remain so for the foreseeable future.

Locations
*Abandoned Lake Dwelling
*Laguna Bend Ruins
*Laguna Bend Dam
*Poppy Farm

Lana Prince is a character in . The character is modeled after and voiced by Australian video game writer and journalist Alanah Pearce.

Biography
While looking for a way to leave the city and its surrounding wasteland, Prince stumbled across an abandoned Thorton Galena and hoped get it up and running in order to begin her new life.

After tinkering with the car and managing to start it back up, the vehicles sent a notification to its former owner, the mercenary V, with its then current location. Upon V's arrival and inspection of their former car, Lana approached, telling them to keep their hands off her car.

:V had enough of the conversation and tells Prince to leave. Upon refusing, V will tell her that if she doesn't scram now, they will pull out a gun on her. Lana will get angry at V and call them an asshole, but will ultimately leave.

:V transfers over a large sum of eddies to Lana, so that she can buy another car, as V has grown attached to their Galena.

:V will mention about other repairs that Lana can make, to restore more of the car and make it more viable. With this suggestion V aims to tell her she can keep the car so she can leave Night City. ## Laos
appears_books
- aka：Lao People's Democratic Republic
- population：1.5 million
- language：Khmer
Lao
- ethnic_groups：Laotians
Khmer
- literacy_rate：<20% (and falling)
- military：KHMER Rouge (95,000)

Laos is a Southeast Asian country traversed by the Mekong River and known for mountainous terrain, French colonial architecture, hill tribe settlements and Buddhist monasteries.

History
Laos has been backwards and isolated since independence in 1953, preoccupied with infighting between various factions. During the Vietnam War, it had more bombs dropped on it per capital than the entire world during WW2, making it the most bombed country in the world to that point. After the war, it became a client of Vietnam. The laid-back communist government could even explain how Buddhism and Communism were compatible. The Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP) formalized private trade and started inviting foreign companies to help exploit the natural resources. The Lao People's Democratic Republic (Sathalanalat Pasathipatai Pasason Lao) was set to try and enter the 21st century.

In 2003, the Khmer Rouge invaded Laos after being ousted from Cambodia, with the hopes to continue on to invade Vietnam. They haven't been able to cross the Vietnamese border very often due to the squadrons of American mercenaries guarding it. The haven't been able to invade Myanmar either, due to the intervention of Khan Pa.

They have predictably started wiping out the Vietnamese and moved as many people as they could find down into the 1/3 of the country that is farm-able. They've also wiped out as many temples as they could find. In the hills, the hiding tribal Thai and Hmong Sayasat (folk magic) priests are being hunted by the KR. Anyone caught using English or French is also executed. The KR has taken control of the Laotian drug trade in the Golden Triangle, and trades with Myanmar, Thailand, and the Maoist Loyalist Cabal. KR and the MLC helped each other fight their mutual foes. but now that the MLC is in remission, the KR are bracing for an attack from the Chinese in the next few years, and are buying all the weapons they can.

Government
Laos is controlled by the Khmer Rouge, with the surviving former Vietnamese-installed government having fled back home. The KR is rumored to be led by Pol Pot still, but since this would make him about 95 years old, only the KR toadies buy it. Orders come from a central source, but nobody knows who that person is.

The Khmer Rouge are sane enough to know that Thailand is the only country who will supply them, and try to stay on good terms. Therefore, they let Khan Pa and the other KMT druglords ship down the Mekong river with no interference. What they don't know is that Khan is smuggling out Laotian citizens as well, for a hew price.

Economy
The sole form of economy in Laos is that the Khmer Rouge sell rice to Thailand in exchange for guns.

## Las Palapas Motel (Highway 101)
- type：Abandoned motel
- owner：Las Palapas
- state：North California (formerly)
- county：San Luis Obispo (formerly)
- region：Badlands
- subregion：Biotechnica Flats outskirts
- street：Highway 101
- gangs：Wraiths

Las Palapas Motel is located alongside Highway 101, on the southern Badlands of Night City.

Overview
The motel can be found on Highway 101 south of Night City. It is heavily guarded by Wraiths, a clan of the Raffen Shiv nomad outcasts, who use it as a hideout for their victims.

The motel is visited during Gig: Trevor's Last Ride, where a contract is open for the rescue of Aldecaldos nomad Trevor Brass.

Layout
Entry
The motel grounds has two ways of entry. The main entrance by road is blocked off with concrete barricades. To either side of the road there are mines planted. On the right, there is an alternative entrance that leads through a passage covered with car wrecks, that leads to the back side of the office building.

Office
Inside this office building, there is a Ghoul patrolling, that carries a shard, and a computer terminal that can be hacked using 8 Intelligence. On the roof, one can find an Access Point that can be hacked without any attribute requirement.

Grounds
In front of the office, you can find Trevor's Villefort Cortes V5000 Valor.

Rooms 1st Floor
Across from the office, you can find the motel rooms. On the ground floor's first room, one can find a door that is locked behind 5 Technical Ability, that contains an armory. In the second room, one can find the body of Trevor Brass inside a ice-cooled tub, and another door that is locked behind 5 Technical Ability. This room has a cache with a or quality Wraiths rally bolero jacket.

On either side of the building, one can find a staircase leading to the second level. On the south side, there is also an Access Point that requires 8 Intelligence. On the back there is a ladder leading to the roof.
Rooms 2nd Floor & Roof
On the second floor, there are some containers that can be looted, and a large gaping hole in the roof. On the roof itself, one can find a Sniper patrolling, and there is another Access Point that does not have a requirement.

Associated Shards
*Reward: Benedict McAdams

References

## Lauren Costigan
- status：Dependent
- gender：Female
- hair_color：Black
- partner：Bradley Costigan (husband)

Lauren Costigan is a character in .

Biography
Lauren Costigan is the wife of Bradley Costigan, who after being imprisoned was contacted by the Tyger Claws to shiv Bigs, an informant in a Militech prison, under the orders of Kon Imai.

However, Brad refused, so the Tyger Claws kidnapped Lauren to ensure his compliance. Lauren spends at least thirty days in confinement at Monokatana Workshop, having to be put onto nutrient drip after refusing food twice during her captivity.

Meanwhile, Brad hires V to rescue his wife through fixer Wakako Okada. After her rescue, Lauren is traumatized by the ordeal, and V advises her to lay low with a loved one, lest the Tyger Claws come looking for her. Lauren then departs to her mother's house to recover and keep a low profile.

Walkthrough

You will find yourself in a car with Reed and Songbird, driving to the border checkpoint. There, a helicopter with a medical team will receive Songbird before President Myers arrives to see you.

:Myers will thank you and award you with a medal of , which you can refuse. You will also receive $30,000 when you find yourself in your apartment after the conclusion of this job.

:Myers will offer no thanks but a token reward of $5,000.
After dealing with Myers, you can sit down with Reed to talk about the events that transpired. Reed will walk into the dusty waste and the Phantom Liberty credits will roll, concluding this job and leading automatically to Four Score and Seven.

Journal Entry
:Well, you've gone and got her. The netrunner-agent-friend-traitor- chick who bet on herself, fought against all odds and lost it all... Who was Songbird, really? Who was she to you? I think I already know the answer. You were never helping her out of the goodness of your heart, were you? Fuck, I just hope... Never mind. In a second you'll hand her body over to Myers. That'll be the end for you, for Reed. Only question remaining is when shit'll complicate itself again. Because trust me, it will.

## Life During Wartime
Life During Wartime is a Main Job in . It automatically starts after completing Lightning Breaks.

Walkthrough

After taking out the Satwave Power Plant, Panam Palmer and V chase after the crashing Kang Tao AV deep into the Jackson Plains of the southern Badlands. While chasing the AV, communications on the radio frequency have Mitch and Scorpion approach the AV first. Panam attempts to warn Mitch and Scorpion, but the EMP interferes, and she is unable to do so.

Panam and V are attacked by three Kang Tao Griffin drones which have to be taken down. V does so by jacking into Panam's truck and taking control of its machine gun. However, while V takes down the drones, the gun malfunctions, forcing Panam to put the truck on autodrive and fix the machine gun. She does so after several seconds, but a bullet ricochets into her back. Regardless, she goes back to driving, and V takes down the drones.

Panam and V arrive at the site of the AV crash. Panam takes an expired injector to deal with her wound. V agrees to go to the AV, while Panam stays to cover V with Mitch's gun.

:V leaves Panam and single-handedly retrieves Hellman from a nearby gas station that he and his bodyguards sought refuge in. Panam then shows up with Aldecaldos reinforcements, saying that she managed to rescue Mitch herself and that unlike V, she does not bail. Her subsequent text messages will be very frustrated about her life outside the clan and include a remark about Mitch, who gave Scorpion an Aldecaldos-style funeral by himself.

:Nearing the AV's crash site, Panam instructs V to use a surveillance drone to identify any remaining Aldecaldo survivors and scan for enemies in the area, and the AV. After scanning the AV and Mitch, V can exit the drone. Panam provides overwatch while V takes out the hostile forces. As a last stand, the remaining Kang Tao operative takes Mitch captive and locks them both inside the AV. When opened by V, the operative can be intimidated (dialogue options "only looking for Hellman" and "I'm losing my patience"), causing him to reveal Hellman's whereabouts. This allows Panam and V to immediately head for the gas station to the west that Hellman and his guards took refuge in.

:Alternatively, V or Panam (if one waits too long) can shoot the soldier holding Mitch, the latter will tell the pair that Scorpion died during the assault, and that Kang Tao escaped using Aldecaldo vehicles. The group then has to follow the tire tracks around the wreckage to pursue find Hellman. Scanning the tire tracks allows V to see a simulation of where Kang Tao went. However, this delay will result in additional Kang Tao reinforcements present at the gas station.

:V and Panam will subsequently head to the gas station via motorcycle. In the end, Aldecaldos reinforcements will arrive and Panam and V part ways after a short talk.

Regardless, once in the gas station, V searches for Hellman.

:V finds the gas station owner locked in a room behind the counter. He tells V that he is unarmed, and can tell V that Hellman is on the second floor.

V finds Hellman being attended to by a Kang Tao medic. Hellman panics about Arasaka being sent after him, but V knocks him out. They call Goro Takemura, telling him to meet them at the Sunset Motel. They then carry Hellman outside, where they meet with the Aldecaldos. After V and Panam talk, she allows V to take Scorpion's Apollo, and V takes Hellman to the motel.

V wakes Hellman up once there in a motel room. V tries to get Hellman to help them with their biochip, doing so by explaining the biochip, how they have it, and what they've tried to do about it so far. He tells V that the biochip was experimental, and that the biochip was in its trial phase. After some conversation about the biochip, Hellman jacks into V to examine the biochip. He then tells V that they cannot function independently of the biochip, as their neural network has deteriorated too much for that to be possible. He also says that all he can do is to send V to a clinic in Sweden, and help V minimize their pain. He can then ask V about how they deal Johnny Silverhand's engram, although V can choose to not to talk about it. V threatens Hellman, and he offers to help them if they come with him to Kang Tao, which V refuses.

Takemura walks into the motel room, interrupting the conversation. Hellman gives V a chip containing a blueprint to V's brain and the biochip. V exits the motel room, leaving Hellman with Takemura. As V leaves, however, their relic malfunctions, and V talks with Silverhand's engram. Once V is finished talking to Silverhand, the mission will end.

Journal Entry
:An AV full of corpo-rats drowned in the dust and sand - a beautiful sight. Sucks for the nomads though, especially Panam. Looks like our dame keeps losing everything she loves. Correction - almost everything. In other news, Hellman's surely shitting his pants knowing that the game's up. He's all yours. Just be careful - those Kang Tao pissheads won't be going down without a fight.

:Finally doing things my way: we grab that 'Saka son-of-a-bitch by his corposuit collar, leave a bloody trail of destruction in our wake. Toss in a swipe at Kang Tao, too. Look at you, V. Just might make something of you yet. Anyway, one thing's for sure - we're close. Sure hope Hellman spills what he's got. And that what he's got is answers.

Objectives
*Chase the AV.
*Take out the drones.
*Reach the AV.
*Wait for Panam to tend to her wound.
*Check out the crash site.
*Scan the crashed AV.
**Scan the area for Mitch.
**Scan the area for signs of the Aldecaldos. [Optional]
**Scan the Kang Tao operatives. [Optional]
**Scan the combat drones. [Optional]
*Disconnect from the drone.
*Check out the crash site.
**Take out the turret.
**Defeat the Kang Tao operatives.
*Wait for Panam.
*Get in the AV.
*Talk to the pilot.
*Talk to Mitch.
*Talk to Panam.
*Scan the tracks.
*Get on the Motorcycle. [Optional]
*Follow Kang Tao.
*Follow the Kang Tao's tracks.
**Defeat the Kang Tao Operatives on the Airstrip. [Optional]
*Follow the next set of Kang Tao tracks.
*Go to Gas Station with Panam.
*Get inside the Gas Station.
*Find Hellman at the gas station.
*Get to the upper floor of the gas station to find Hellman.
*Confront Hellman.
*Knock Hellman out.

## Lightning Breaks
Lightning Breaks is a Main Job in . It becomes available after completing Ghost Town.

Walkthrough
Panam Palmer asks V to meet her again during midnight at the garage near the Sunset Motel in Rocky Ridge, to discuss their plan on how to take down the Kang Tao AV.

When V meets her there, she will be working on her truck. She quickly finishes up, and she and V will discuss a plan to use an EMP launched from a power station to take down the Kang Tao AV, and enter the AV to take Anders Hellman.

After they discuss the plan, V rides with Panam to the location where they plan to take down the AV. While on their way there, Panam stops the car, and lets V calibrate to the machine gun attached to her car, requiring V to jack in and shoot at a few abandoned vehicles with it. Afterwards, they discuss how they plan to launch the EMP using the power station.

V and Panam then wait a few hours for the AV to fly over before making their way to the power station. Upon arriving, V jacks into Panam's machine gun mounted to her car, and they are chased down by a few drones that V must shoot down. Once the drones are shot down, V jacks out of the gun, and Panam drives her car into the entrance of a control station. There, V overcharges the terminal, and rushes back to Panam's car, and they drive out of and away from the power station to a cliff looking over it, as to ensure the pulse from the EMP does not interfere with them.

Panam gives V the detonator for the EMP, and they wait a brief period of time before they spot the AV flying over coming from Pacifica. V triggers the detonator, which does not work immediately, and sends the EMP too late to take the AV out of the sky. Panam steps out of the truck, and uses a missile launcher to shoot down the AV herself. This does not take it down either, but does force it to lose altitude. This leads directly into Life During Wartime.

Journal Entry
:Panam Palmer. Gotta say, I like her. Girl's got a pair - and clearly a plan, too. Let's see if it's enough to grab Hellman. Honestly, V, never thought I'd ride with the nomads again. I know, I know she left the Aldecaldos, but you can feel it too, can't you? Clan's in her blood and bones. In her heart. Don't think she'll let us down.

Objectives
*Meet Panam at midnight.
*Talk to Panam.
*Take the passenger seat.
*Talk to Panam.
*Shoot the target using the turret. [3]
*Go to the Satwave Power Plant.
*Take out the power plant security. [4]
*Get to the terminal.
*Overheat the terminals.
*Take the passenger seat.
*Go to the hill with Panam.
*Wait for the AV.
**Shoot down the AV.

Trivia

引文：Yuh, the Time of the Red is almost biblical sometimes. A lot of big stuff went down and the world was changed even more than it had been by the Collapse. Me; I see myself as a modern day Homer — you know, the Greek poet. He wrote about how his entire world was blown apart. Well, I do the same thing, only instead of using a harp, I got a synth deck.（Lilayah）

Lilayah is a Rockerboy and a close friend of Trace Santiago, both whom during the Time of the Red were part of a group of six edgerunners. She is one of the main characters of the Black Dog story from .

Biography
Like a lot of Rockerboys, Lilayah used to call Seattle home; that is until she moved to Night City. She sticks to her roots, though, and plays a style she likes to think of as cybergrunge. Her music pays homage to the greats from her hometown but adds in new styles and sensibilities.

Always looking for inspiration, Lilayah hangs with a group of edgerunners, sometimes helping them pull jobs. After all, she knows she won't change the world if all she does is smile for the camera and make music vids.

Black Dog

2045

At some point in 2045, Lilayah could have been contacted by Grace Steel, who called in a favor in exchange for the rockergirl to play during the opening night of the Forlorn Hope, as Lilayah played the drums as well as her keytar. This only if Legacy was not available.

Development
Lilayah was created by Mike Pondsmith with the help of [https://twitter.com/Lilayaah Amelia Kołat], one of "The Cyber6" - as Pondsmith likes to think - and community manager for .

While writing the story, Mike realized it was missing something. Specifically, it was missing a Rockerboy. As a way to help create a new music legend for a new era, the writers of turned to Amelia, who was already an influencer in real life by being the video game's community manager.

:As Mike Pondsmith was working on this story, he realized he needed a Rockerboy to bring it together. That's why he asked Amelia Kołat, a friend whose posts influence hundreds of thousands of people daily, to help him make Lilayah. The grunge was entirely her idea. She's a big fan of it as well as of WoW. Amelia lives in Poland with her gorgeous cat.

Lina Malina is a braindance actress in .

Appearance
Lina Malina is a woman with green eyes and pink/purple/orange/red gradient dyed hair. She is wearing a pair of rimless round glasses, and has several golden piercings adorning her head, of which are: a circular barbell septum piercing, a left nose ring, a pair of cross earrings and various other ear piercings. Around her neck she wears a silver choker that is decorated with red gemstones, and two golden necklaces of which one has a golden cross.

Her outfit consists of an orange/pink/purple gradient ballistic vest with black tiger stripes, that is accessorized with a black shoulder holster holstering two gold-plated Militech M-10AF Lexingtons.

On her hands she wears a pair of purple and gold gradient fingerless gloves that reveal her orange fingernails, and a pair of gold and black sleeves that extend up to her upper arms. The number "26" is tattooed on both of her shoulders, which are accompanied by a portrait tattoo of a woman on her left shoulder and a tattoo of a rose on her right shoulder.

On her lower body she wears black and purple MaxiWear panties, with a black and purple gradient stockings and garter with black tiger stripes. On her feet she is wearing a pair of black and purple slip-on sneakers with orange tongues and black tiger stripes. Because she rides a motorcycle, she is also wearing black knee sliders.

Biography

:After acting out a scene where Edgar Tool and Lina Malina play long lost sisters, Lina is pleased about the results. The pair of them sign a contract with Fourth Wall Studios and move to Night City where they will record a new series of braindances. They will be sightseeing Night City together and post updates for their TruFans followers.

:Lina and Edgar can subsequently be found outside of the Fourth Wall Studios in Japantown, Westbrook alongside Shank. Their future plans involve taking over Night City and possibly the rest of the world.

## Little China (2077)
- type：Sub-district
- city：Night City
- district：Watson
- gangs：See Gangs
- appears_books：

Little China is one of the sub-districts of Watson, located in northern Night City.

Overview
Parts of Little China used to be an extension of Downtown, during the Rebuilding in the 2040s there were plans to make it a second City Center. The corporations built some skyscrapers and top-quality medical clinics known as the Med Center. It used to be the best place in Night City to spend money on body augmentations legally. In the late 2040s the sub-district flooded with Asian immigrants, mostly from Chinese diaspora, hence the name change. During the next few decades, Little China became overpopulated and its exclusive tone to the current more ethnic feel.

In 2077 Central Little China resembles the poorer areas elsewhere in Night City; however the food, shops, neon lights, lingo, and flavor are all distinctly Chinese. The castes are all mixed up now with living blocks beside affluent condo buildings, and illegal gambling dens next to the offices of legitimate business. Low and mid tier come here on occasion for cheap fun in the casinos and strip clubs, and to mix with the poor and homeless on the streets. No gang claims territory of Little China, but the Tyger Claws often come here to have fun.

Database Entry

- transcript：In the 40s, this part of Watson aspired to be the next City Center. Corps invested heavily in the area, putting up towers and cutting-edge clinics such as the Med Center. That's where you slapped down your credchip for implants - that is, if you wanted to get them legally. But soon enough this neighborhood became populated with immigrants, mostly from China, hence the name. Over the next few decades, the district became increasingly more populated and diverged from its original plans. Today Little China is considered a poor district, but its food, smells, neon lights, tucked-away little shops and overall atmosphere draws the crowds. Even low-ranking corpos drop in to gamble and put eurodollar bills into thongs. The sight of suits strolling past the homeless also shouldn't take anyone here by surprise.

Behind the Scenes

引文：Little China is a vibrant town-within-a-town grafted onto the remains of Watson's abandoned business center. When big money bailed, immigrants poured into and remodeled the now-affordable structures. The result is a bustling, chaotic space, a skeleton of early-century corporate architecture spliced with elements of mid-century Kitsch. Little China, to the south especially, remains vertical, but its office buildings have been repurposed for housing and small-scale industry, with new additions plopped on top or extended over them. Its residents live out their entire lives in the district, or even in one building: one might sleep on the balcony, repair cyberlimbs in the former supply closet and get grub from a noodle chef working out of the kitchen of a single former corporate office. There is plenty of entertainment on offer in Little China. It is crammed with restaurants and gambling dens that cater to tighter budgets than Downtown or Japantown. When night falls, suits share its streets with fixers, mercenaries and gang members, united in their search for cheap thrills. Yet it is primarily a district run by and for locals, a place whose vibrant-yet-grimy Kitsch style emerged organically, not for the benefit of tourists.

引文：Mindfuck just gained a new meaning.（Slogan seen in ads around Night City）

Lizzie's Bar is a braindance club located in Kabuki, in the Watson district of northern Night City. It is also the headquarters for the Mox.

History
This bar was owned by Elizabeth "Lizzie" Borden, a strip club owner and ex-prostitute who treated her workers fairly and defended them from violent clients. On May 13 2067, one of Lizzie's girls was brutally raped and murdered by Tyger Claws gangers. Lizzie avenged her by killing three of the assailants with an axe and displayed their bodies in front of her bar, proclaiming that the same would happen to anyone else who hurt a prostitute. That same night, Tyger Claws raided and demolished her establishment before killing Elizabeth.

These actions created an uproar of protracted riots all over Night City. Her ideological successors commemorated Borden by rebuilding her place, naming it "Lizzie's Bar," and forming the Mox, a gang that brought together those who felt threatened and oppressed, especially among sex workers and sexual minorities.

Over the years, the bar was transformed into an exclusive braindance club, becoming the main source of income for the Moxes.

- aka：Lizzy Wizzy Liz Wiz
- status：Alive

Celebrity
BD star
- role：Rockergirl

引文：We are who we pretend to be, I've pretended to be everything - that's why I've found the truth.（Lizzy Wizzy）

Elisabeth Wissenfurth, known professionally as Lizzy Wizzy, is an artist par excellence and one of Night City's top celebrities. Her work includes award-winning albums and concert tours, film appearances, and conceptual performance art.

Lizzy changes her looks frequently, having a detachable cybernetic jaw and utilizes a full-body replacement in order to become her signature chrome form, including Midnight Lady accessories. As of 2077, she lives in the North Oak sub-district of Westbrook, in Night City.

Biography
Lizzy Wizzy, born Elisabeth Wissenfurth, became a renowned artist and successful celebrity.

The turning point in her career came in 2069, when she unveiled herself in her true cybermodified form. To Lizzy, it was an erotic re-imagining of Snow White.

As her concert ended, Lizzy ate a synthetic apple laced with specially-prepared poison that induced cardiac arrest. For a full minute, the LED screens showed a close-up of the flatline on her electrocardiogram while her body was motionless on the floor. For five and a half hours the concert was on hold as a team of ripperdocs swapped out her biological organs for the latest generation of MoorE Technologies implants. Lizzy was eventually revived after the implants were put in place and once she got up off the floor she began to sing "Re-start, Re-heart, Repeat" a single that sat at the top of the world charts until 2072.

Lizzy's anarcho-terrorist "performances" were inspired by her frequent stylistic transformations. Before them, she was known for giving away her clothing - to friends and people who needed it - but afterwards Lizzy wanted to give out implants, though it turned out that top-tier cyberware was linked to its user, and couldn't be simply given away.

Lizzy is known for her views against homogenization, and at some point she mounted an armed assault on a BioDyne Systems factory, during which she and a group of mercenaries took full control of the building and stole approximately 1,200 different implants. The stolen items were shortly later given away at an improvised concert. The heist and concert were broadcasted live, as she knew no corporate soldier nor police officer would dare to kill or harm her on live T.V. In the years following, the media argued that the heist had been arranged beforehand with BioDyne and that Lizzy paid for the implants and the renovation of the factory. The theory is seemingly supported by the fact that BioDyne never pressed charges against the artist. Lizzy still denies these speculations, claiming that the corporation co-opted her heist as free advertising.

2077
Her latest artistic obsession by 2077 featured the medium of braindance. Lizzy wondered about the boundary between our documentation of reality versus of our active shaping of it. Due to this, fans speculated she was planning to scroll her own BD.

That year, her boyfriend Liam Northom plotted behind Lizzy's back to make an engram copy of her personality and starts regular meet-ups with an Arasaka contact at the Riot club. Lizzy gets suspicious, initially thinking Liam is having an affair, and hires the merc V to investigate. Through the club's surveillance system, Liam can be heard saying that Lizzy's personality has changed since she fully converted her body to chrome. Liam adds that he is beginning to get scared by her and that this is the actual reason for his attempt to create a "backup" of Lizzy. V secures the surveillance footage as proof and has the option to directly confront Liam before calling Lizzy, which can earn V a generous bribe (€$35,960) from him.

:Lizzy thanks V and the mission is concluded. She will not contact V again.

:Lizzy is hesitant to believe V at first, but then just says "Fuck" and hangs up after she gets the footage to prove it. Later she calls V and asks to meet in the No-Tell Motel. There, V finds her in a room along with Liam's corpse, whom she claims to have accidentally killed as she wanted to break up and had only pushed him earlier. She moves on saying that she feels empty, helpless, and not really herself, but V notices that she must have actually strangled Liam slowly, breaking his spine. Lizzy then collects herself and starts formulating an idea of exploiting the tragedy by feeding it as a tale to the media. She tells V to do "whatever" with Liam's body, offering extra pay for it. She bids farewell by expressing her gratitude to V for giving her "something beautiful" and that she loves what she is turning into.

Phantom Liberty
Lizzy Wizzy attended Kurt Hansen's party at the club atop the Black Sapphire, where she had a stage performance singing Delicate Weapon. Prior to leaving the party, V had the opportunity to talk to her. Depending on the outcome of Violence if V had completed the quest, she either dismissed the merc or rewarded them with the unique Amikiri Sound Cutter headgear she had used in her performance. Someone recorded the concert and the only bootleg braindance of the event was obtained by Alena Xenakis, who sent it to V's apartment as a memorabilia of their first FIA job.

Logan Garcia is a character featured in .

Biography
Logan Garcia is a heavyweight boxer and a member of the Animals, a gang devoted to establishing themselves as a new human subs-species. Logan was the owner of an Animal fight club in the Old Paint factory. Logan was sparring with a young man named Lenny Steiner and severley injured him in the sparring match by denting his skull. Disgusted by Lenny's "weakness" he had his body dumped in the bay with a cinderblock tied around his neck. Lenny's mother, Monica Steiner, contacted Logan about her son but he just rubbed his death in her face. Monica hired the fixer El Capitan to avenge her son. The fixer hired V to take care of it.

V can kill Logan or knock him out and put his body into the trunk of a car of one of El Capitan's employees. An Assault in Progress reveals Logan was avenged when his fellow Animals found out Monica had ordered the hit on him. Monica and Nina, a friend of hers, were killed when they were ambushed by Animals beneath an overpass.

Longshore Stacks is a neighborhood located in Dogtown, in the Pacifica district of southern Night City.

Overview
Occupying much of western Dogtown, Longshore Stacks is a large community made up of cargo container housing and a notable number of unfinished buildings that were abandoned during the Unification War. Although BARGHEST has an influential presence in the neighborhood, this part of Dogtown is more autonomous, with Briana Dolson acting as the chosen local representative. The border with Golden Pacific to the east is marked by a walls of cargo containers, with entrances on both Elizabeth Kress and Herbert Hoover streets.

The most notable part of Longshore Stacks is a marketplace centered around the Tree of the Lost, which includes a variety of businesses and homes. Other important areas include a smuggling tunnel used by BARGHEST as passage to West Wind Estate, or the Scraper, a large unfinished building occupied by a gang of scavengers.

## Los Angeles
- type：City
- country：NUSA
- state：Southern California
- region：West Coast
- location：Los Angeles Basin
- population：3.9 Million (2020)

Los Angeles, also referred to as the Metroplex or simply the Plex, is a city located in the NUSA state of Southern California.

History

Sometime after the appearance of what would become known as Nomad Families in 1993, constant gang harassment of the early Aldecaldos family in the South Central district led Juan Aldecaldos, the family leader, to plead for federal government assistance. Upon being ignored, Juan insulted the President's maternal heritage on national television.

In 1998, a 10.5 earthquake destroyed L.A., with the Pacific Ocean inundating 35% of the city. Approximately 65,000 were killed in the disaster.

The Los Angeles Quake resulted in the military becoming crippled in the city, with a massive lack of manpower and support of the federal government to resolve any of the matters brought on by the earthquake. To resolve this, the government hired the Jodes, an Oklahoman Nomad family, to negotiate a manpower contract and repair the damages caused by the quake, despite protest from the Aldecaldos, who would later begin harassing and later warring with the family. The repairs were completed by 2001, when the Jodes left the Los Angeles area, having completed their contract.

In 2019, Network News 54 showed that Los Angeles and Detroit's murder rates were nearly the same, with Detroit later becoming known as the most dangerous city in the United States after the comparisons were shown.

By 2020, the city had become known for its incredibly hazardous weather, consisting of acidic and poisonous air, being a daily part of a resident's life. These weather conditions were dealt with by the use of specialized clothing, gas masks and vended clean air, as well as clean air booths.

By 2045, the hazardous weather continued to plague the city, making water the most sought-after resource in the region. Connecting flights from Night City to Los Angeles were made from the Jackson Plains Regional Airport and via the Folk Nation Sky Queen Omaha, with sea connections through the Thelas Nation ferry. The Steel Vaqueros hauled cargo to and from Night City. The main west coast World News Service studio was located in the city.

Layout
The Los Angeles Metroplex covers the entire coast from Santa Barbara to San Diego, stretching as far east as San Bernardino. With the rise in average temperature during the early-mid 21st century, the eastern part of the state was considered all but uninhabitable, with many having migrated into the cities, leaving Death Valley, the Devil's Playground, and other such areas as empty wasteland, patrolled only by the occasional Nomad group.

## Love Like Fire
Love Like Fire is a Main Job in and functions as the introduction to Johnny Silverhand and the interlude between Act 1 and Act 2.

Walkthrough

Following the events of The Heist, wherein V is killed by Dexter DeShawn, the former's brain is repaired by the biochip's nanites, and they begin to relive the memories contained on it, specifically those that occurred on August 20th, 2023.

Now in the perspective of Johnny Silverhand, the Rocker makes his way to The Hammer, where Kerry Eurodyne has already begun to perform due to the former being late. Johnny is accosted by the bouncer, who angrily pushes Silverhand aside. Johnny continues inside until he is on stage, where he states that he is saying goodbye to his fans.

Before Johnny makes his eventual exit, he is stopped by Kerry, who hopes to dissuade him from marching towards his eventual death. Johnny brushes this off and depending on player choice, tells Kerry to pursue his own career instead of living in Johnny's shadow, or insults him.

Outside, Johnny meets with Rogue Amendiares, and the two board a helicopter destined for Arasaka Towers along with Shaitan and Spider Murphy. Upon reaching Arasaka Tower's roof, Shaitan begins to open fire on soldiers before being shot. Johnny takes over and clears the rooftop of all hostiles, he quickly checks the payload, revealed to be a miniature nuclear device to be planted inside of the building.

Johnny, Rogue, and Spider fight their way through the tower until they reach an elevator, which Johnny to send the nuclear device inside further down. Rogue motions for them return to the rooftop to make their getaway, though Johnny protests, stating he had another objective in mind: uploading a virus into Arasaka's systems which would free Alt Cunningham. Rogue gives him four minutes to secure Alt and make for the helicopter.

Johnny makes his way to Kei Arasaka's office, fighting soldiers in the garden area, before eventually uploading the virus under the direction of Spider Murphy. After completion, Johnny attempts to leave before being ambushed by Adam Smasher and his team. From there, there is a gap in Johnny's memories during which he evidently escaped Smasher, meeting with Rogue on the rooftop. Johnny rushes to reach the already-ascending helicopter, briefly getting lifted by Rogue before they are hit by an explosion, causing Johnny to fall be left behind. Smasher appears and shoots a dying Johnny, causing his consciousness to fade. He briefly reawakens on a stretcher being carried off by Arasaka employees amidst the chaos. Johnny wakes again, this time to an interrogation by Arasaka agents. Johnny can either stay silent or toy with the interrogators.

The interrogation is joined Saburo Arasaka, who after a brief interrogation, orders Johnny to be subject to Soulkiller.

Journal Entry
:It often happens that our memories are superseded by people's stories. Someone presents us a beginning, middle and an end, and soon enough we start believing that we really were there – that WE did all those things. But who we are is built on the past, and the past is built on lies.
:In 2023 Johnny Silverhand carried out an attack on Arasaka Tower. Fifty years later, those events became the memories of a certain V.

Objectives
*Go on stage.
*Grab the microphone.
*Go outside.
**Talk to Kerry.
*Get in the helicopter.
*Defeat Arasaka's forces.
*Wait for the helicopter to descend.
*Exit the helicopter.
*Follow Spider Murphy.
*Wait for the virus to upload into the network.
*Find the elevator.
**Defeat the Arasaka guards.
*Wait.
*Deploy and arm the bomb in the elevator.
*Exit the elevator.
*Wait.
*Shoot the elevator mechanism.
*Tell Rogue about your plan.
*Find an Access Point to the network.
*Defeat the Arasaka guards.
*Connect to the Access Point.
*Wait for the virus to upload into the network.
*Return to the rooftop.
*Get to the chopper!

Notes
*The memories relived in this quest are not accurate to what really happened in 2023 as per the lore. See Flashbacks for more information.

Trivia
*The title of the job comes from the Generation X song "Love Like Fire", from their 1979 album Valley of the Dolls.

## Love Rollercoaster
Love Rollercoaster is a Side Job in .

Walkthrough
Head behind the Grand Imperial Mall to find a group of locals hanging out at the rollercoaster, which they're trying to get working again. Offer to help, then scan the ride's car to locate the control panel nearby. Go fix it and let Jean know it's done, but the group will have second thoughts about actually riding the old thing. Johnny, on the other hand, is all for it. If you agree to do the first test run, don't worry as it'll go fine, and you can do a few interactions during the ride.

Journal Entry

Lucius Rhyne was the Mayor of Night City from 2070 until 2077. After Rhyne's unexpected death, the focus of Night City politics turned to who would replace him: Deputy Mayor Weldon Holt or Councilman Jefferson Peralez.

Biography
2017 - 2030s
Lucius Rhyne was born on October 12 of 2017 in a Trauma Team clinic in Night City. His father worked at Arasaka, and his mother was a NetWatch officer. His early childhood was eclipsed by the Fourth Corporate War and its tragic effects. When Lucius was five years old, his father was killed during the Night City Holocaust of 2023. Growing amidst such devastation made his lifelong commitment to fight for his city.

Just a few years after the nuke, Lucius's mother was captured by one of Rache Bartmoss's rogue AIs while on a mission in the Net. In spite of the financial hardship of providing care for his mother's body, Lucius enrolled at the Night City University and graduated in Cybernetic Law, deciding to embark on a professional career.

2040s - 2070
During the early 2040s, Lucius was a community organizer in the Watson Development, being one of the few idealists in Night City working to make the world a better place. He was well-known for his inspiring speeches and calls to action. In 2044, Rhyne led a district-wide work strike that prompted the Night City Co-Prosperity Sphere businesses to organize a vote for City Manager, convinced that Lucius was the perfect man for the position. With this, Rhyne's efforts were rewarded when in 2045 he was elected to become the Watson city manager, representing the district in the Night City Council.

In 2060, Lucius Rhyne was elected to have a seat in the Council as a member of the Devolutionist Party, still acting as a representative of Watson. During the Unification War (2069 - 2070), while the rest of the Council was debating on what to do, Rhyne led the city's defense effort against the New United States of America. Using his contacts made during the last decade of service at the City Council, Lucius was able to convince Arasaka to come to Night City's aid, which brought the war to an early close in June 2070. Night City secured its independence and Arasaka's ban was lifted, welcoming the corp back to the city and permitted too construct a new office building. Right after the war, Rhyne had his own vision for a new form of municipal governance, which would also allow the corporations even more freedom. With this backing, an election took place, and Rhyne's popularity allowed him to become the Mayor of Night City, which hadn't had one since 2023.

Over the following years, Rhyne's time in politics made him a wealthy man, but it also appeared to have dulled his ideals. By 2076, public opinion on him had split, and he was either respected as the city's savior or reviled as its most crooked politician.

2077
In 2077, Lucius Rhyne was gearing up for re-election and his main opponent was Councilman Jefferson Peralez from the Federalist Party. Over the following months, Rhyne was comfortably leading Peralez in the polls and boasted a job approval rating of 60%. Lucius scheduled a press conference to speak about Night City's recent 3% drop in crime rate, an accomplishment only made possible by the mayor re-designating Pacifica an "independent district" of the city to exclude its crime statistics from official numbers. Shortly before the start of the press conference, a cyberpsycho named Péter Horváth breached City Hall on the heels of NCPD Detective River Ward and moved to kill the mayor with his mantis blades. Ward gunned Horváth down before he got close enough to hurt Rhyne. In gratitude, Rhyne presented Ward with the Medal of Merit. When news of the failed assassination attempt broke, Rhyne's lead over Peralez surged from 12% to 19%.

On the day of the Konpeki Plaza heist, Rhyne and Deputy Mayor Weldon Holt met with Arasaka reps at Konpeki Plaza to discuss Arasaka's plans to buy up low-income housing in Watson for corporate re-development. Rhyne was reluctant to approve the land grab because Watson was his main constituency and it would hurt his image. Unbeknownst to the meeting's participants, the merc V remotely controlled a cloaked Militech MT0D12 drone through the room while preparing for the theft of the Relic in Yorinobu Arasaka's suite and eavesdropped briefly. Rhyne and Holt wrapped up the meeting and departed the hotel before the heist took place three and a half hours later.

At some point soon after Konpeki Plaza, with Rhyne looking to unwind after a long day, Holt arranged a private booth for the mayor at an invitation-only sex club known as the Red Queen's Race. However, whoever was behind Horváth's attack was not finished trying to end the mayor's life and had a lethal virus inserted into Rhyne's braindance wreath, killing Rhyne after he activated it at the club. His body would be discovered a few hours later by the club's manager who immediately contacted Holt; the Deputy Mayor in turn had Detective Harold Han personally investigate the matter. Han confirmed Rhyne's death, though the lethal braindance went unnoticed; instead, the senior Detective concluded that Rhyne's heart had given out during a session, attributing it to his age and health, and informed Holt of such. Holt, not wanting the circumstances of Rhyne's death to affect his own political ambitions, ordered Han to cover it up by sneaking Rhyne's body out of the club and back to his residence and to state he died from heart complications. Nonetheless, this abrupt nature of Rhyne's passing fueled a number of conspiracy theories which alleged that Holt either had Rhyne assassinated or helped Rhyne fake his death. The culprit was never discovered.

Legacy
Lucius remains were incinerated and interred in a niche at the North Oak Columbarium with the inscription: "Lucius Rhyne. A great man of the people."

Lyle Thompson is a character in the universe.

Biography

Thompson, a seasoned media and leading reporter for World News Service, had previously served covering various conflicts across the globe. His work covering Arasaka is suspected to have lead to the death of his wife, to which now he will stop at nothing, putting anyone, including himself, on the line to get revenge.

During the Never Fade Away mini adventure, he observes the kidnapping of Alt Cunningham in the alleyways behind the Hammer club after a Johnny Silverhand concert kicks-out. During the encounter Johnny is seriously wounded by the punks that kidnapped Alt, and Thompson steps in and uses his Trauma Team card to save Johnny from the brink of death. Afterwards at the hospital, Thompson reveals Alt's role in developing Soulkiller to Johnny, as well as Arasaka's involvement in her subsequent kidnapping. The pair head for the Atlantis bar to hire Rogue and Santiago for the rescue mission. The group are ambushed and make a hasty getaway before moving on to plan the mission.

Later Thompson works his street connections to find any information on the whereabouts of Alt. When the operation gets underway, Thompson, armed with his FN-FAL and video-rig, and Rogue infiltrate the Arasaka facility disguised as Iron Sights gang members - known Arasaka collaborators. When the group makes it to the office of Toshiro Harada and discover the fate of Alt, Thompson starts to live broadcast the scene in hopes of bringing down the corporation. A defeated Johnny tells Thompson to cut the feed, before shooting Toshiro dead.

Thompson was present at the AHQ Disaster of 2023.

In 2077, Thompson wrote an essay about the condition and state of society in Night City. However, none of the major news corporations were willing to publish it due to its critical and bitter nature. With this in mind, the Night City Inquirer contacted Thompson and bought the rights to publish it alongside more basic information about megacorporations.

Associated Quests
*Love Like Fire
*Never Fade Away

Walkthrough

Right after completing Double Life, V will need to call Mr. Hands, the fixer for Pacifica, for assistance in getting in touch with the Voodoo Boys. He'll note it'll be almost impossible as they keep to themselves but will check for the merc. Sometime later he'll call with an update: as expected they're not interested in whatever V has but incidentally they have a job that needs to be done and so Mr. Hands volunteered them to assist the gange which, if done right, will then allow V an audience with their leader, Brigitte.

Journal Entry
:Well, we know the Voodoo Boys were behind all this, so that's one step forward. Problem is, now we have to reach them somehow - two steps back. There are a lot of things to be found in Pacifica, just usually not what you're looking for. Good news is you already got your fixer: a man without a face to help you find this fart in the wind. Sounds like a fun fuckin' delight.

## Maglev Train
- caption：A Planetran maglev train
- type：Rail transport
- group：Transportation
- manufacturer：Numerous
- top_speed：200 (2020) / 300 (RED)
- sdp：80 per car (2020) / 100 per car (RED)
- appears_books：

The Maglev Train is a type of vehicle in the universe. The light rail variant is called Light Rail Lev Train.

Overview
Cyberpunk 2013 & 2020
Superconductor magnets have made it possible to build extremely cheap and durable "levitation trains." Riding on magnetic cushions, these "levs" have become one of the major transportation resources in the 2000's. financed by corporations or city governments, they are present in most major cities.

Levs are usually underground within city limits, running on high pillars out in the suburbs. Usually one line, headed out to the corporate suburbs, is sealed off and requires entry code or pass to get into that station. Corporate lev stations are always clean, well lit, and well guarded by corporate security. City lev-stations are usually not up to these standards, although most cities run police patrols on the line to control crime and vandalism.

Lev-tickets are charged at a rate of 50c per station passed; a trip passing through three stations, for example would cost 1.50eb. Tickets may be purchased from automatic ticket machines, using credit cards or cash. These machines are located in the stations themselves and in local convenience store outlets.

Both NCART and Planetran use different types of maglev trains. The first one was for urban city transportation, and the second for intercontinental travel. NCART maintained and repaired their trains out of the Transit Center.

Cyberpunk RED
In the 2040s, maglev trains were mostly the same though they had been upgraded for further top speeds and structural integrity of train cars. City tickets cost more, with 1eb per station passed, so a trip passing through three stations cost 3eb.

Cyberpunk 2077
During one of the main jobs called Transmission you follow Brigitte into the Voodoo Boys den which is located inside of an abandoned lev-train station, where they appear to have their computer attached to a Planetran maglev train.

NCX Spaceport has its own internal maglev line.

Cyberpunk V3.0

For the economy-minded (i.e., punks with no money), magnetic levitation trains carry goods and people throughout most urban zones (although the intercontinental Maglev line was obliterated during the War). Tickets cost as little as $50 per intra-city station ticket. Note that most mag-levs are locally sponsored and maintained, which means that proper identification is necessary in order to disembark at certain stops, namely CorpZones, Enclaves and other secure centers.

## Maglev Tunnel Construction Site
- type：Construction site
- owner：Night Corp
- region：Badlands
- subregion：Rocky Ridge Plains
- city：Night City outskirts
- security_provider：Militech SiteSecure

The Maglev Tunnel Construction Site is located on the northeastern Badlands of Night City.

Overview
Relatively close to Night City proper, this construction site was embedded in a hill in the upper reaches of the surrounding Badlands, bordering on the northern parts of the North Oak district. The maglev tunnel itself goes underneath Night City, leading directly to Corporate Plaza to the southwest, and being located pretty close to foundations of the new Arasaka Tower.

History
The old Maglev Network once connected Night City to many other metropolises in North America, but due to the economic crisis following the unrest and conflict of the Fourth Corporate War, it had been crippled and mostly unused for the next fifty years.

In the mid-late 2070s, Night Corp had begun to revitalize this portion of the network by constructing a new tunnel to Night City's Corporate Plaza from the Badlands in the northeast, where the line would one day connect with the rest and continue east towards the East Coast of the New United States of America. Night Corp planned to build the western terminus of the revitalized network in Corporate Plaza's Memorial Park Station. The exit of the tunnel to the east was a large Night Corp construction site which had employed extra help from the Aurochs and Biotechnica companies. In order to ensure and protect the construction of the tunnel, Night Corp hired a subgroup of Militech called "Militech SiteSecure."

In 2077, the construction site could have been assaulted by an Aldecaldos nomad pack led by Saul Bright, Panam Palmer and mercenary V. They attacked the facility in order to gain access to the tunnel and use a TBM to reach the sub-levels of Arasaka Tower, where their objective, Mikoshi, was located.

The MT28 Coach is an automated vehicle manufactured by Mahir in .

Overview
The Mahir MT28 is an autonomous passenger coach supposedly made from up to 70% recycled material. It is used for short and long state and interstate journeys across North America.

In , the MT28 is a rare sight in Night City as they do not spawn in traffic. Three coaches are found at the abandoned Bus Depot off Benko street in Wellsprings, that has claimed by the Valentinos.

During the main quest New Dawn Fades, V will board an MT28 at the Columbarium in North Oak. They also spawn in the roundabout of NCX Spaceport.

Database Entry

- transcript：In the past, approximately 4.5 million Americans worked as cab drivers, truckers or bus drivers. Today, that number has fallen to less than 300,000. Of course, one major factor to this was the catastrophic drop in North America's population due to wars, epidemics and climate disasters. Yet, even in the face of population drop-off, driving as an occupation for freight and passenger transport was nearly made extinct with the advent of self-driving vehicles. Vehicles such as the autonomous Mahir MT28 Coach are now a common sight along major highways and interstates. For passengers, it has been a welcome change. Unlike human drivers, the Mahir MT28 Coach never needs to take bathroom breaks and is far less prone to causing traffic accidents. That said, autonomous vehicles bring their own set of risks. In 2068, on a non-stop route from Dallas to Tucson, a partial failure in the MT28 Coach's operating system caused the air-conditioning unit and door locks to malfunction. The bus reached its destination, but all the passengers had been cooked to death in their seats. Of course, the Board of Mahir doesn't believe the success and glowing reputation of the MT28 Coach's primary function should be marred because of the occasional minor error in its secondary systems.

*The Killing Moon

引文：Rated F- in crash testing. One expert described it as "part guillotine, part meat-grinder" in high-speed collisions.（Supron FS3）

The Supron FS3 is a vehicle manufactured by Mahir in .

Overview
The vehicle is unremarkable in almost every way, being slow and unwieldy, but is a cheap and practical transport if necessary. The Voodoo Boys and Scavengers utilize these vehicles for their practicality. The only gang to have customized Suprons is the Mox. Their custom pink and blue versions can be found near Jig-Jig Street and the Cherry Blossom Market, where Mox Cleavers and Inciters guard the joytoys of Westbrook.

Database Entry

- transcript：Everyone wants a Rayfield or a Herrera, but not everyone can afford it. It's with those customers in mind - the ones with big needs and limited means - that the Mahir Supron FS3 was built. Its biggest selling point? If you hadn't guessed from its look, sound, or feel - it's cheap as borscht. The Mahir Supron was constructed from cheap plastic, textiles and wishful thinking. It breaks down often, but on the flipside it's easy to fix. It's large size suggests it can carry a heavy load, but it's better not to get too "carried" away - the anemic engine under its hood might just give up on you.

Acquisition
It can be acquired from the AUTOFIXER netpage for €$16,000.

Mahir Supron FS3 V Message CP2077.png

Notes
*Prior to the introduction of AUTOFIXER, Muamar Reyes sold the car via a text message: "Hey hey, got a Mahir Supron I need to get rid off. Now, I know I shouldn't talk smack about my own stuff, but... jesus, what a pile of shit. It's like someone welded an old tub and dumpster together, then stuck it in a cardboard cutout and taped some wheels on it. Look, I know not everyone's got enough €$ to blow on an Aerondight, but if you need something heap, and fast - this is it."

Bugs

Maiko Maeda (Japanese: 前田 舞子) is a character in .

Biography
Maiko Maeda is an associate of the Tyger Claws and works for them as the "unofficial" manager of Clouds. She used to be a doll there, but got promoted. Maiko used to be the output of Judy Álvarez when she worked there. Judy crushed on her hard and Maiko was implied to be borderline manipulative which led to a nasty break up. The two have been estranged and cold to each other ever since, though Maiko stills cares about Judy in some way.

The two would reunite when Judy and V sought to emancipate the dolls from Clouds. Maiko refused to comply but gave them the choice to kill Oswald Forrest for torturing Evelyn Parker and indirectly causing her death. Maiko later agrees to help Judy and her crew by staging a meeting with Hiromi Sato and his bosses, Jun Azegami and Marcus Ichida, in order to kill him. Maiko changes the deal when she and V encounter him with his bosses. Maiko wants to be the new owner of Clouds and rule it autonomously along with providing payments to the Tygers.
If V chooses to go along with the deal, Jun will kill Hiromi and the bosses make her the new owner of Clouds. If V does not go along with the plan, the bosses and Hiromi will see them as weak and attack V. After killing them, depending on the dialogue, Maiko might attack V for ruining her plans and V can choose to kill or incapacitate her, or she can accept the new situation though not being happy about it.

If Maiko is alive, she will attend the party at the Black Sapphire alongside high-ranking Tyger Claws.

## Malaysia
- capital：Kuala Lumpur
- population：27 million
- language：Bahasa Malaysia (Official) *English *Mandarin Chinese *Arabic *Borneo tribal languages
- ethnic_groups：Malay *Chinese *Indians *Middle Easterners *Borneo tribes
- literacy_rate：80%
- military：206,000

Malaysia is a country located in South East Asia.

History
Malaysia for awhile was in a conflict between its Malay and Chinese population as the Chinese were dominating (and still dominate) the economy. Because of this Malaysia enacted laws giving Malaysians preference for employment, education, and housing, though they never went as far with it as Indonesia.

The Mideast Meltdown caused thousands of Muslim refugees to flood into the country. The government tried to force them to settle in the untamed jungle areas, but they resisted and were forced out of the country, many going to Indonesia.

During the Second Corporate War, Malaysia allied with Petrochem and lost, forcing them to give SovOil the rights to build refineries along the North Borneo Shore and East Coast, causing heavy pollution in those parts of the country and leading to a rise in radicalization of many of the people there whose traditional livelihoods it had destroyed.

Government

The Malaysian government is a grouping of 13 states, 9 of them being run by Sultans. The Sultans run the largest companies and are immune to persecution. Every five years, the government elects a "king". Due to the concessions made after the Second Corporate War, SovOil has a great amount of control over the country.

Economy
Malaysia's Chinese immigrants run the economy. They run the stores and supply oil refineries, and most Fixers in the country are Chinese. A faction of the Triads called the Red Spear Gang has a strong influence over Malaysia's economy.

Kuala Lumpur
* Kuala Lumpur

## Mars
Mars, otherwise known as the Red Planet, is the fourth planet from the Sun and the second-smallest planet in the Solar System after Mercury.

Background

 2020s
NASA was the first to set up a permanent base on Mars in 2021 called "Chryse Base", with the ESA and SovOil following suit and building "Isidis Base" in 2022 as well as establishing a Martian colonial government. In 2023, NASA had started offering regular flights to Mars every 14 months.

As the planet which most resembles Earth within the Solar System, Mars still presents major differences, Its outer crust is solid, and a large portion of the inner mantles appeared to have coiled, resulting in extremely low magnetic activity. Mars is still actively volcanic and the lack of moving tectonic plates allows volcanoes, once they occur, to reach sizes many times larger than on Earth. Many of these volcanoes arise in an area known as the "Tharsis region" and the largest, Olympus Mons, is over 550 km across and 24 km high. By comparison the largest volcano on Earth is 120 km across at its base and rises 9 km above the ocean floor. Valles Marineris at 4000 km long, 600 km wide, and 6 km deep, is a gully that would stretch from LA to New York City on Earth.

Many surface areas of Mars show clear signs of water erosion and suggest that huge volumes of water once coursed across the planet's surface; however, there are now few visible signs of this water. Mars has little remaining atmosphere as most of the atmospheric gases were long ago absorbed into carbonated rocks and, as the planet cooled, the water was deposited as ice within the thick outer crust. Because there is no shielding ozone, the surface receives more solar UV than Earth, despite its greater distance away.

The Martian surface is thick with dust which is, at times, raised into dust storms that can cover the entire planet's surface and make travelling extremely hazardous, cutting off the sun for days at a time. Some areas are highly volcanic, while others consist of huge craters from meteor impacts which cause sections of the surface dust, lubricated by trapped water ice, to flow outward forming large depressions.

During winter the polar caps consist of large areas of frozen C02. During summer the carbon dioxide escapes into the atmosphere to leave a residual cap of polar water ice, a clear indication that much water (and atmosphere) is trapped within the planet's surface. This fact has long excited scientists and, with the construction of two major colonies on the Martian surface, several teams are studying the feasibility of gradually releasing more of the trapped gasses to revitalize the Martian atmosphere.

Mars is accompanied by two small moons, Phobos and Diemos. Both ESA and NASA have installed small, manned installations on these tiny moons to monitor orbital communications. Use of space on the moons has become an early point of conjecture between the major players in the Martian colonization efforts, with ESA, NASA and JAB all claiming rights to some or all of the moons' surfaces. So far the issue hasn't been contested too hotly; however, with only a limited amount of room available, the battle may still be joined.

Mars is on its way to becoming a stable human outpost and its orbital space is becoming cluttered with dozens of man-made satellites and autofactories. The colonies at Chryse and Isidis Planitias are both expanding rapidly and a constant stream of new arrivals bolsters their numbers.

There is one further aspect of the colonization of Mars: Early unmanned probes and NASA "fly-bys" showed several curious formations which appeared somewhat "unnatural." The two most obvious artifacts were the "Cydonia Face," a strangely shaped mountain which appeared to the cameras to be shaped like a human (or near-human) face, and a series of highly regular formations which suggested they may have been shaped purposefully. It was expected that closer inspection would show both of these, and other, phenomena to have been formed naturally. However, research teams from both colonies have studied the formations in detail and have been unable to provide convincing evidence of either natural or intelligent mechanisms having created them. Indeed, NASA's file on these reports remains classified.

 2077
In 2077, Militech announced plans to build a new colony on Mars, and offered the first ten residential modules for €$100 million each.

## Mateo Thiago
- gender：Male
- voiced_by：Antonio Alvarez
- status：Alive
- home：Night City
- affiliation：The Mox
- occupation：Bartender

引文：Afraid I don't get paid to talk. Opposite, actually.（Mateo）

Mateo Thiago is a mox working as a bartender at Lizzie's Bar within Night City's sub-district of Kabuki.

Biography
Whether a resident or tourist, one may easily perceive that tending a bar in Night City, in the most densely-populated of its districts, is not quite for the faint-hearted. To withstand such adversity, an abundance of character, nerves of steel and a broad understanding of the night life psychology is mandatory. Sprinkle that with a shimmering layer of charisma and you have Mateo Thiago. For all intended purpose, at least the side he'd allow to show. Maintaining customer relations on a rather warm and personal, yet fairly professional level, he can be trusted by both patrons and fellow Moxes not to prattle, gossip or grace the unwanted ears with valuably unintended information. Antithetical to the common inhabitant of the city he works in, Mateo will not succumb to financial gain. Information cannot be bought from him, regardless of the amount offered. He does however appreciate the gesture of a big tip, although holds moral principle beyond capital and would rather sell you a drink for it.

Throughout the the afternoon, up until the clock hits 6 in the morning, Mateo will service all customers in need, proficiently deescalating any heated situations and advertently reminding those being the cause of where they actually are. No matter the client, there's surely something this establishment can offer in aid of composure and unwinding. Once settled down, a drink is always on the menu. He remains on first-name basis with the patrons, making sure he is well-informed of any social or business ventures taking place on the premises, although he will not indulge in details.

Should he get the opportunity to mention the old days, before the Tyger Claws, back when Lizzie's bar was owned by Lizzie, his couthy voice receives a thoughtful, blue undertone. Whether due to nostalgia or longing to connect with the past, he will not tell, but it is obvious that he regrets the violence which had transpired. Without ever saying a bad word about the current state of affairs, he carefully chooses words highlighting things that were indeed better then, for the girls at least. Being run like a proper commerce, Lizzie's bar manages to stay afloat, but the foreboding shadow of the Claws lingers, always keeping the Moxes on their toes.

While off the clock, this prominently fashionable bartender does not appreciate the infrequent visitor nosing around, dismissing any invalid or potentially harmful assumptions. Avoiding the broadcast of personal information, he does mention that gender is not relevant when joining the Mox. At least in terms of staffing the bar. All one needs is knowing how to make drinks or have additional talents. Which of the two landed him a job, is a particular he does not produce.

Associated Quests
*The Corpo-Rat
*The Information

Notes
*Mateo remains available as a bar vendor throughout the entire game during the working hours of Lizzie's Bar, without dialogue changes as of 1.21.
*Scanning the QR code on the bills he carries attached to his shirt shows a single line: "The Moxes will take care of your money"
