Matilda K. Rose, also known as Sasquatch, is the pack leader of a group of Animals in .

Biography
Early life
Matilda has been the alpha animal of her pack since 2075. Her expertise includes heavy melee combat and her weapon of choice was an oversized unique sledgehammer by the name of Sasquatch's Hammer, created specifically for her.

2077
In 2077, Matilda was known well enough throughout Night City to attract contractors as big as NetWatch. Under their employment, her group of elite fighters settled in the Grand Imperial Mall in the Pacifica district as private security for agent Bryce Mosley. Due to the operation's direct conflict with the Voodoo Boys, Matilda's pack's duty was to protect the agent as he executes it.

The job turned out to be more than the pack could handle once the opponent sent V, an up-and-coming Night City mercenary to infiltrate the GIM. Only after all of her associates had been overwhelmed, Matilda faced V in an opening akin to a small arena. She was assisted in battle by her client who could periodically hack V in order to hinder their efforts.

:The remaining Animals will incite hostility and fight V on their exit from the GIM.

:The pack guarding the GIM will allow V a safe passage out of the building and will remain less hostile.

:A deal with Mosley would count as a job well done for the hirelings even if their leader had been killed. However, they hold a grudge and will be reluctant to allow V to leave while being hostile on further meetings.

Abilities
Sasquatch's abilities are hidden but determined through game files.

Associated Quests
*I Walk the Line

Notes
*Matilda has a €$15,000 bounty on her.
*If V defeated Matilda, they can mention her during their conversation with Angie during the quest No Easy Way Out and intimidate her into leaving Aaron alone.

Matt Liaw is a Cyberpsycho in .

Biography
Liaw is a former solo who worked for Militech and later became a merc working for Mercenary Solutions Inc.

During his time at Militech, he was deployed during the Second Central American War, where he stepped onto a mine in Panama.

After being laid off, he also lost his health insurance policy PTSD SHIELD. Later, he would also be evicted by the Bank of Night City from his apartment on 12 Milagro Terrace after repeatedly not meeting payments.

Without eddies and without a roof over his head and still having obsolete cyberware installed, he started the early stages of cyberpsychosis. In a desperate attempt he reached out to a friend by the name of Dan for medication. What happened afterwards is unclear.

Eventually, he went full cyberpsycho and was assaulting NCPD forces on an unfinished highway bridge in Northside, close to the All Foods Factory. Regina Jones would employ a mercenary to put an end to it.

## Max Jones
- status：Dependent
- home：Night City
- gender：Male
- equipment：M-10AF Lexington
- affiliation：WNS (formerly)
NC Inquirer
Regina Jones (dependent)
- role：Media
- voiced_by：Alec Newman

Max Jones is a Media in .

Biography
Max specialized in the unveiling of corporation scandals. One story involved a veteran named Hunter Hyland, who was involved in war crimes committed by Kendachi in South America in 2068. However, Kendachi eavesdropped on Hyland's communication with Max and eventually hired the Tyger Claws to kill the veteran.

While investigating the war veteran programme "In Blood We Serve", Max had received an anonymous tip that the entire campaign was not in fact based on helping veterans but receiving publicity. The help that the soldiers have received in form of high quality cyberware, was only on a six-month basis, after which they were expected to return them to the corporation. The period of their use has also been charged, taking away their veterans' allowance. Evidence in form of files has been sent within a period of two days and attracted some rather powerful enemies, leaving Jones in the crosshairs of an unknown bounty hunter. His emails prove that he fully ignored Regina's warnings and decided to instead take his last stand in his office.

In lack of better options, Regina Jones contracts V to bring him to reason and send him on his way to her - she remembers him fondly from the days they worked together - mentions a successful podcast project on the topic of Biotechnica's exploitation of farmers. She knows that losing him would be a loss not only for journalism but for the city as well.

Despite ignoring Regina's messages, Max still expected a hitman knocking on his door and equipped his entire studio with military equipment, from mines to turrets. As soon as V has been noticed arriving, he used the sound system to play recordings of war veterans sent in as evidence of the scam the corporations have executed in attempt to, along all those mines, perhaps will the assassin into some understanding. V will need to be rather careful in approaching him, as he is more than willing to end his own life should the terms he is faced with not be acceptable. Once he finds out that Regina is in fact the one sending for him, he is disappointed and upset, refusing her offer immediately. He explains that he would rather end life on his own terms than become a sellout like she has. While it does look like he is starting to realize the pointlessness of his own statements as he hears them, he still insists that his mentor is the one who needs help and wills V to take a look from his perspective, pointing out the constant struggle of facts being covered up by PR machines and corporate lies. Times have changed, as he finally notices through his own monologue, where no amount of truth would make the people care of their own ill treatment by politics.

Each lifepath will have a specific persuasion dialogue, although regardless of chosen option, Max will refuse the offer as he still takes his responsibilities as a journalist very seriously and has no intention of stopping what he is doing. The only way he will follow is by calling up on his curiosity - he spent so much time away from Regina, avoiding her, ignoring her, he had no chance of actually learning what she is now and what she fights for. Upon accepting, he will gather his files and follow V to the car, which he will be rather annoyed with, as it looked like a vision of luxury, but he will eventually enter and conclude the job. Regina will express her gratitude by getting him back alive with an ample bonus.

In case of saving Jones' life, he can be found in one of the rooms of Regina's Den in Watson, being upset with his predicament and scorning his friend as a supposed sellout.

Database Entry

- transcript：There aren't that many real journalists in Night City. Sure, there are those plenty who can cobble together a text-synthesizing algorithm that'll make a Top-10 Laundromats in Town list or rank the 15 best tricks to get flatter abs (Spoiler: #15 - If all else fails, install a MYABS core muscle implant). But there's a handful of medias out there who are willing to risk their own skin by popping the bubbles of the city's elite. Max Jones is one such media. He knows no fear and salivates at the first whiff of a scandal.

Associated Quest
*Gig: Freedom of the Press

Associated Shards

Notes
*Despite sharing the same surname, Max is not a relative of Regina Jones.

DJ

引文：They haven't shut me up yet, and they never will, as long as you keep listening.（Maximum Mike in 107.3 Morro Rock Radio）

Maximum Mike is the radio host and DJ of Night City's 107.3 Morro Rock Radio.

Biography
By listening to Mike himself, it is possible to pick up on a few details regarding his life, which cannot quite amount to biographical matter but add value to the history he's been through and his current way of life.

For his way of talking about past events, Mike was present around Night City during the Fourth Corporate War. Among other things, he will state that he lived in one of the first megabuildings ever to be built in Watson. He also appears to enjoy the visual arts, exclaiming his love for Klimt in particular, although believes that anything displayed in museums is a forgery due to real artwork being shipped to the Moon.

At some point during or prior the 2040s, an NCPD contact gave Maximum Mike a police badge so he could go past low-ranking officers guarding a crime scene in order to grab the story and publish it later.

Mike infrequently mentions having friends in high places that reveal the truth of matters to him, among which are those that work for Biotechnica. According to him, when they get drunk, they cannot lie anymore and tend to expose the inner works of the corporation. On another subject, while commenting on cyberpsychosis and possible machinations regarding its occurrence, he admits witnessing some attacks and therefore no longer doubting that they actually happen.

The final and conclusive detail he reveals of himself is a warning to the listeners — he is protected. Hidden. Nobody is able to lay a hand on him. However, this does not apply to those listeners still in the street, who should remain wary of their surroundings.

Radio Show
Mike's talk show investigates major political actors and events, fueled by listener reports, attempting to advocate the development of critical citizen thought and doubt of the media through the spread of ideas which don't differ much from common conspiracy theories. While he does occasionally insert details from his private life, who he truly is remains a mystery, likely for the better, considering the amount of data presented publicly which could potentially be damaging to big corporations - if true.

Mike's monologues will often draw roots from hard truths, containing information only the actors of certain events might have known, although, as if intentionally, he spices it up with a bit of absurdity. The careful listener or those familiar with the mentioned affairs, might be able to discern fact from fiction, going as far as anticipating things that have not yet happened.

Quotes

引文：Life in 2020 isn't just all guns and drugs, if it was, we woulda named the game Dungeons & Drug Dealers. The best Cyberpunk games are a combination of doomed romance, fast action, glittering parties, mean streets and quixotic quests to do the right thing against all odds. It's a little like Casablanca with cyberware...（Maximum Mike）

Notes
*Mike Pondsmith, in character as Maximum Mike, claimed that he used to date Rogue Amendiares on and off while she was still hurting for Johnny Silverhand, before the two drifted apart because of their jobs.

Trivia
*Maximum Mike is the persona of Mike Pondsmith and in various books gives the reader advice directly. Another nod character to Pondsmith is Mike Puddleforge.

## Mbole Ebunike
- aka：Judson Freeman
- status：Alive (2045)
- home：Night City
- gender：Male
- hair_color：Black and grey
- eyes：Brown
- cyberware：See Cyberware
- partner：Rachel Becher (wife)
- relative：Zohara Freeman (daughter)
- affiliation：Mayor's Office (formerly)
- occupation：Mayor of Night City (formerly)
- appears_books：

Mbole Ebunike, born with the name Judson Freeman, is a character in the universe.

Biography
Early Life - 2010s
Judson Freeman was elected the mayor of Night City in 2012, after the infamous Mob War of the previous years. He had been groomed to become a well-behaved puppet of the corporations, and acted according to their will. As such, he was a favorite among them, and with their support, Judson managed to win the reelection of 2016.

This time, however, the mayor had become rather intransigent, very different to how he was during his first term. Judson was tired of being a simple puppet, and during his second term he tried to rebuild his self-esteem by vetoing anything that was proposed, acting against his former masters. This stance angered the corporations around the city. Judson had also become heavily involved with the Pan Neo-African political party, to the point that he changed his own name to Mbole Ebunike to reflect his change in politics.

2020s - 2040s
By 2020, despite being reelected into office, Mbole was very unpopular and usually spent most of his time out of office, leaving the day-to-day operations to his Assistant Mayor, Garven Haakensen. During the few times he was at his office, Mbole maintained the door locked, preferring to remain unavailable and leaving his hapless secretary to deal with the furious visitors.

By July of 2023, during the Fourth Corporate War, the Arasaka Corporation had taken control over much of Night City, using the metropolis against Militech. Mayor Mbole Ebunike, who had recently protested against the actions of Arasaka, "suffered a nervous breakdown" and stepped down, with Assistant Mayor Haakensen taking the reins.

Following the AHQ Disaster that decimated a sizable portion of Night City, Ebunike stepped down from the politics. In 2044, Zohara Freeman — daughter of Mbole and Rachel Becher — became the city manger of the Glen district.

Stats & Equipment

Notes
*Ever since the mid-late 2040s, a freight ship named after Ebunike had been moored at the eponymous docks in northern Night City.
*In the unreliable flashbacks of Johnny Silverhand in , Ebunike was mentioned by a news anchor in decrying the ongoing terrorist actions against the Arasaka Towers, something that could not have happened as he had recently stepped down due to health reasons.

## Meetings Along The Edge
Meetings Along The Edge is a Side Job in .

Walkthrough
The Zen master can be found just south of Muamar Reyes's usual location, overlooking a westward facing cliff just off the paved road in Jackson Plains. V can open conversation with different questions, though the Zen Master will only answer one, and may indicate he is aware of V's predicament with Johnny. He will then offer a meditation BD, with his usual payment condition. V can pay either nothing, or 610 eddies for the practice. The final meditation is on the element of air, and like the previous sessions, the Zen Master will disappear after it ends. A shard, his robes, and his altar-necklace are left behind, and V can take his altar as an apartment decoration. Johnny will be seated next to the Zen Master's robes and through conversation, implies he did not see the Zen Master at all, and suggests V speak with Misty about the experience.

Journal Entry
:Ok, this Zen master guy of yours is literally everywhere. He's gonna fall ass first out of your fridge tomorrow. This meditation's doing the trick for you? Listen, if it's the whole poetic aspect of it, I understand. But in that case just throw on one of my albums, dig into the lyrics, and leave this scam artist out of it.

Objectives
*Approach the Zen master.
*Talk to the Zen master.
*Talk to Johnny.

Notes
*Completing this mission opens up a new dialogue option with Misty.

Trivia
The title of this job comes from the song "Meetings Along the Edge" by Ravi Shankar and Phillip Glass released in 1990.

## Megabuilding H10
- type：Megabuilding
- city：Night City
- district：Watson Dev. (2045)
Watson (2077)
- sub_district：Northside (2077)
- street：Ellison St. (2077)
- gangs：G3 (2045)
- appears_books：

Megabuilding H10 is located in Little China, in the Watson district of northern Night City.

History
2040s
The first modern residential megabuildings of Night City started construction in 2040, and while H10 and H11 were not the first planned by the Night City Council, thanks to a lucrative and heavy petitioning from the NCCS, SovOil, and Petrochem, both jumped on the list of priorities. Over the following years, unlike H11, Megabuilding H10 was able to be finished in time, being fully operational by 2045. A year prior, in 2044, H10 had also opened the Watson Community College, becoming a notorious educational institution in Night City.

After its inauguration as the first completed megabuilding in the metropolis, H10 became a much-promoted symbol of Night City's recovery, which included brochures mentioning that being able to reside in the megablock meant that you had triumphed in live, as residents had a place to sleep, food to eat, and a future worth looking forward to. Only time would tell how truthful those advertisements were. H10's rooftop was notorious for the DJ parties held there every Saturday by 98.6 Shiv FM, who broadcasted from the top of the megabuilding. Although these parties were usually chill, some had been embroiled in violence, and there were rumors pointing out that a gang known as G3 was trying to put Shiv FM out of business through sabotage. In fact, members of the gang could usually be found hanging out on the lower levels while dabbling in illegal ventures, much to the irritation of the NCPD officers who regularly patrolled the area.

2070s
In 2077, after having had spent six months with Jackie Welles, a mercenary known as V gained enough to rent an apartment in the megabuilding.

Database Entry

2045 Layout
Residents on the lower levels of Megabuilding H10 lived in cube rooms. These were cleaner and newer than most cube hotels in Night City, but at the end of the day, they were still cubes. The higher you traveled in the megastructure, the nicer the accommodations were. First units equaled in size to cargo container housing, then simple conapts and studios, and finally spacious apartments. The luxurious suites at the higher levels of H10 rivaled with the best ones in other wealthier districts, having access to exclusive fitness areas and private bars.

Notable Locations
*98.6 Shiv FM Broadcast Station, the broadcasting station office for 98.6 Shiv FM.
*Big H Casino, a pachinko parlor.
*Data Inc, an electronics store.
*Hammer Me Nails, a beauty salon also operating as a bar.
*Highwall Club, a members-only club located on the top floors.
*Oasis Mart, an Oasis store.
*United Martial Arts, a dojang.
*Watson Community College, an educational institution.

2077 Layout
There are two accessible elevators for the player. One in the lobby which leads to floor 07, and one in floor 08 which leads the parking.

Floor -03 to -01: Garages
Despite having a negative number, these parking levels are in a separate building which begins at street-level, up to the third floor. The first level has an elevator to 8th floor of the megabuilding, and an exit to lower street-level. The two further levels can be found above, as well as another exit to the upper street-level highway.

Floor 01: Entrance
This floor contains a few food vendors, the main entrance, and an elevator to floor 07.

Floor 06
This floor consists of just a few locked doors and some minor loot.

Floor 07: Services
This floor contains food stalls and a variety of vendors and services, including a weapons store, a fighting ring and a gym, as well as rentable apartments.

*Apartment 0608 to 0629.
**Apartment 0613 - Barry Lewis' apartment. At the start of Act 2, NCPD officers Nadia Petrova and Juan Mendez will be waiting outside of it.
*2nd Amendment - Robert Wilson's weapons store.
*Fighting ring - Coach Fred sells melee weapons here. His Training Bot is also found on the ring.

Floor 08: Apartments
This floor contains mostly apartments, a fast travel point, and a drop point.

*Apartment 0712 to 0729.
**Apartment 0716 - V's apartment. If adopted, Nibbles and the iguana will also live here.

Floor 09
This floor consists of just a few locked doors and some minor loot.

Notable Residents
2045
*Byeol Jeong, head instructor at the United Martial Arts dojang.
*Dahlia VDB, manager of the local Data Inc store.
*Tabitha "TSpooks" Evanovich, she was one of H10's custodians and an occasional paranormal reporter.
*Zillah Zane, the regional manager for Hammered Industries was better known for throwing parties at her high floor suite in H10.

2077
*V
*Barry Lewis
*Anita (formerly)
*Mark

Associated Quests
Main Jobs
*The Rescue
*Playing for Time

Side Jobs
*Beat on the Brat
*The Gun
*Human Nature
*Happy Together
*Shoot To Thrill

Notes
*Around 2045, a basketball team known as the H10 Hammerheads resided in this megabuilding.
*On the sides of the building and above its entrance there is "LC896" - "Little China 896" - which is likely to be the building's address.
*In the Database Entry it is also referred to as "V's Megabuilding".

Megabuilding H11 is located in Northside, in the Watson district of northern Night City.

History
2040s
The first modern residential megabuildings of Night City started construction in 2040, and while H10 and H11 were not the first planned by the Night City Council, thanks to a lucrative and heavy petitioning from the NCCS, SovOil, and Petrochem, both jumped on the list of priorities. The corporation that managed to secure H11's contract was Future BuildWorks, a construction company closely tied to the Kanzaki yakuza family.

After lying the foundation of the megastructure, which was rumored to have been practically built from the corpses of those that had crossed the Kanzaki, Future BuildWorks rapidly moved into one of the first completed offices, establishing their new headquarters there. Over the following years, while H10 would manage to finish construction first, H11 would struggled for a bit more. In the meantime, a nearby Mexican restaurant soon became a favorite with the construction teams working on the project.

By 2045, most of the overall structure of Megabuilding H11 was completed, with a functioning broadcast radio station on the top, but there was still some work to be done. On contrast, all the lower levels were already finished and occupied by families of workers needed to staff the nearby factories and docks, as well as by a myriad of businesses.

2070s
In 2077, a netrunner known as b@d planned to attack some Arasaka subnets while using the one in H11 as a smokescreen.

2045 Layout
Notable Locations
These were notable locations in 2045:
*106.2 KCP2 Broadcast Station, the broadcasting station office for 106.2 KCP2.
*Delta 777, a braindance parlor.
*Divine Tastes, a West African-inspired restaurant.
*Future BuildWorks Headquarters, an office housing the headquarters of Future BuildWorks.
*Iron Spirit Boxing Gym, a boxing gym considered the best one in the district.
*Savage Docs North, a ripperdoc clinic.

2077 Layout
Floor -05: Server Room
Contains the servers of the megabuilding's subnet.

Floor 01: Ground Floor
Main entrance of H11.

*Data Term - Fast travel point.

Associated Quests
*Gig: Catch a Tyger's Toe

Notes
*Around 2045, an intramural basketball team known as the H11 Cazadoras resided in this megabuilding.
*On the sides of the building and above its entrance there is "WN185" - "Watson 185" - which is likely to be the building's address.

## Megabuilding H2
- type：Megabuilding
- city：Night City
- district：Heywood
- sub_district：Wellsprings
- street：Benko, Ford & Skyline South

Megabuilding H2 is a megablock located in Wellsprings, in the Heywood district of central Night City.

Overview
Megabuilding H2 is located on southwestern Heywood, and it differs from other megablocks due to its main entrance, which is found on a sizable terrace above Benko and Ford streets. This area can be accessed via a staircase from Benko Street, or three elevators found at street level. The terrace acts as a small park with some greenery, as well as a number of stores and outdoor restaurants. From time to time, H2's entrance and the terrace are patrolled by an NCPD unit.

Instead of the typical parking garage door found on other megabuildings, H2 has an additional staircase that goes down to a back alley.

Notes
*On the sides of the building and above its entrance there is "WS708" - "Wellsprings 708" - which is likely to be the building's address.
*Beneath the megablock, on Ford Street, there is a unique Macroware building entrance.

## Megabuilding H4
- type：Megabuilding
- city：Night City
- district：Heywood (2045)
Santo Domingo (2077)
- sub_district：Santo Domingo (2045)
Arroyo (2077)
- street：Wilde St.
- gangs：Rat Kings (2045)
- appears_books：

()

Megabuilding H4 is located in Arroyo, in the Santo Domingo district of southeastern Night City.

History
2040s
During the early 2040s, the Arroyo Concern petitioned the Night City Council to construct a megabuilding in old Heywood. The representatives accepted, but the project was pushed down in terms of priority. At the insistence of the Concern, however, construction on the megabuilding in Santo Domingo finally began in 2043.

Over the following months and years, as the lowest sections of H4 were being completed and the area was considered safe, residents began to move in, some establishing their own businesses as well. Among them was El Norte Cartel, who took the opportunity to establish a couple of front shops to further their operations. Additionally, a gang known as the Rat Kings was founded in H4 by a group of youngsters due to their anger of how they had been treated, as they were the result of taking an entire neighborhood and stuffing it into a single gigantic place without proper social or financial support. Ever since, the Rat Kings began wreaking havoc all over the unfinished megabuilding, soon becoming a hindrance to the megablock residents.

By 2045, Megabuilding H4 was about one-third complete, with the lower levels already packed with laborers and engineers who worked in the megastructure itself, or at the nearby Industrial Zone. The Rat Kings were still causing trouble, but if that wasn't enough for the residents, the change of leadership in Santo Domingo had also slowed the megabuilding's construction effort for a bit. The new city manager, Theresa Valentino, had taken several permits from H4 while she negotiated with the City Council to set aside blocks of housing for residents of Ciudad Techito.

2070s
By 2075, David Martinez and his mother Gloria had lived in one of the apartments of H4 for some time. Shortly after David's death in 2076, the megablock was put under strict quarantine by the NCPD due to a plague, which was expected to last "for at least a few weeks."

By 2077, Megabuilding H4 was still in quarantine.

Notable Locations
These were notable businesses in 2045:
*Bar of Gold, a bar and dance club.
*Gatcha Hotel, a cube hotel establishment.
*H4 Clinic, a ripperdoc clinic.
*Heywood Community Bank, a local banking institution.
*Pink Mohawk, a fashionware clinic and grooming salon.
*YoBro!, a gun shop and firing range.

Notable Residents
2045
*Mario Fernandez

2075
*David Martinez
*Gloria Martinez

Notes
*On the sides of the building and above its entrance there is "AR494" - "Arroyo 494" - which is likely to be the building's address.

## Megabuilding H8
- type：Megabuilding
- city：Night City
- district：Upper Marina (2045)
Westbrook (2077)
- sub_district：Japantown (2077)
- street：Poplar & Crescent
- appears_books：

Megabuilding H8 is located in Japantown, in the Westbrook district of northeastern Night City.

History
2040s
During 2044, Night Corp and Ziggurat petitioned the Night City Council to construct a megabuilding in the Upper Marina district. The council representatives accepted, but the local city manager, Kabria Chung, was not pleased with the council's decision to hire the nomad AllNations Construction to build the megastructure, especially after both Night Corp and Ziggurat had brushed aside her bohemian vision, instead preferring a more utilitarian design for the building.

The following year, in 2045, the groundbreaking ceremony for H8's construction was celebrated. During her speech, City Manager Chung mentioned the new project was to become "affordable housing for the hard-working people of our district." Her fixed smile afterwards, however, suggested she was hoping for the whole thing to burn down. The construction site was protected by members from the Aldecaldos, and a man working on the site known as Swinger was willing to let outsiders borrow some of the big machines in the area for a quick gig in exchange for money. The megabuilding's construction also created a division among the district residents, with two groups known as Not In My Backyardigans and Gee, Wouldn't Affordable Housing Be Niceians willing to pay for violence to ensure their point of view was the last one standing.

2050s - 2070s
At some point, a dollhouse operated by the Tyger Claws known as Clouds became the most notorious establishment in H8.

Layout
Floor 01: Ground Floor
This floor contains a few food vendors, the main entrance, and the elevator to the rest of floors.

Floor 03: Maintenance
This floor consists of a maintenance area, some minor loot, and another elevator to the roof. It is only available during the quests Ex-Factor and Pisces.

Floor 12: Clouds
This floor contains some apartments, a number of stores, and most notably the entrance to the dollhouse Clouds. It also has some minor loot, and an elevator to the rest of floors.

*Clouds

Floor 55: Roof
This floor consists of just a few apartment locked doors, Hiromi Sato's penthouse, and the rooftop of the megabuilding.

*Apartment 8602 to 8610.
**Apartment 8610 - Hiromi Sato's penthouse.

Associated Quests

*Ex-Factor

*Spray Paint

Notes
*On the sides of the building and above its entrance there is "BW324" - "Westbrook 324" - which is likely to be the building's address. The letters "BW" are wrongly on the other's place.

引文：They're my... reminder. When I see them, I see what they've sliced... Muscle, tendon, bone... even implants. Like a hot knife through butter.（Melissa to V about her Mantis Blades）

Melissa Rory is a NCPD lieutenant in the MaxTac division.

Biography
Sometime before 2069, Melissa had herself implanted with the Higurashi 20-13 Mantis Blades, recognized to be of high quality, though with a certain flaw: they interfaced poorly with neural processors and a certain section of the prefrontal cortex. The Higurashi 20-13 line was discontinued in 2069 because of that flaw.

On January 10 2077, Rory was likely driven into cyberpsychosis from her implants, and killed 14 people while seriously injuring 4 others. She was a rare case of MaxTac apprehending a cyberpsycho alive for reconditioning.

During the reconditioning, it was revealed that she suffers from relapses into antisocial behavior. Treatment with limited environmental stimulation and increased doses of neuroleptics was recommended by Dr. Taryn Doggett.

Melissa kept her Higurashis as a reminder of her actions.

Melissa met a mercenary by the name of V later in 2077, by which time she had already obtained the rank of lieutenant, and held a senior status in MaxTac. Rory's squad arrived at the Jinguji store in Downtown Night City just moments after a cyberpsycho had burst into the store, killing its two guards and attacking V.

After taking the survivors' statements — V and the owner of the shop, Zane Jagger — she commented to V if they had also felt the life of the psycho leaving his body. The merc asked instead if there wasn't a better way than just killing them, like taking them alive, to which Rory responded it only happened in extremely rare cases. V could also recognize her discontinued mantis blades, commenting that MaxTac preferred the Arasaka model instead. For Melissa though, those blades reminded her of the things she had done. Trying to rail back the aforementioned topic, Melissa asked V once again if they liked it when the cyberpsycho was killed, though the merc commented they were not as eager as her. After stating that she and V were not that different, Melissa tried to recruit them to MaxTac, V would either outright refuse or mention that they would think about it.

## Memorial Park
- type：Park
- city：Night City
- district：City Center
- sub_district：Corporate Center
- location：Corporate Plaza
- appears_books：

Memorial Park is located in the middle of Corporate Plaza, in the City Center district of Night City.

Overview
Memorial Park is Corporate Plaza's main feature, acting as a huge ring between the corporations' headquarters. This roundabout park was built as a tribute to the countless victims of the Fourth Corporate War. Beneath the park is located the main metro hub of Night City, which includes an NCART station, and the Night Corp maglev project will have its western terminus in the structure as well. Memorial Park and its surroundings are secured by the NCPD.

The park itself is divided between different sections. The main one is right on the top of the structure, with lots of greenery, including plants, flowers and trees. Roses are one of the flowers mentioned to be found here. A couple of large holographic Koi fishes float in circles around the park. Surrounded by gardens and a couple of elevated passageways, a huge crystal dome dots the middle of park's upper area, allowing view to the two major roads (MLK and Lincoln Boulevards) that cross through the structure. Other than the metro hub, there are three sub-levels below, each accessed through the roundabouts' sidewalk. These areas include indoor parks with shops and other closed-off areas.

There are six bridges that lead from Memorial Park to the main entrances of the surrounding corporate headquarters. Clockwise from the top: Arasaka Tower, Petrochem Tower, Kang Tao Building, Militech Offices, Biotechnica Building, and an unknown building with a large antenna.

Notable Locations
*Memorial Park Station

Notes
*In , can be found within some bushes in the park's upper area.
*In , this area was the center of the old Corporate Plaza and was mostly occupied by greenery and five structures; the Petrochem Offices, West City Tower, Plaza Business Tower, the Infocomp Building and the Plaza Center Station.

## Mercury
Mercury is a planet in the Sol System of the Cyberpunk universe.

The closest planet to the sun, Mercury is a virtually airless ball of rock. It is so close to the sun that its surface temperature reaches 2000C. However, as its axis is nearly perpendicular to the sun, some areas of the pole may be freezing. Mercury rotates slowly, taking almost 59 Earth days for a single rotation, and has only a weak magnetic field which temporarily catches a small amount of the intense ionizing radiation streaming from the sun.

Mercury is unlikely to be viewed as a potential planet for colonization given the extreme temperatures and high levels of radiation. Along with Venus, however, it is a potential location for unmanned mining operations, especially near the poles. It may be a rich source of less volatile elements, although mining operations within the Belt may provide a much greater return with less expense and risk involved. There is also a suggestion that a large-scale solar power collector/emitter might be assembled in orbit here.

Meredith Stout is a corpo and the senior operations manager for Militech in .

Biography
Meredith Stout worked for Militech as a senior operations manager. In 2077, a company leak led to a Militech convoy being hijacked by the Maelstrom gang and, with the corporation suspecting inside knowledge, tasked Meredith with finding the leak. Shortly after she found evidence leading to her prime suspect, Anthony Gilchrist, who was summarily caught and interrogated by her team. However, Meredith did not receive the information she needed or the right amount of evidence. With her job and life on the line, she began to desperately search Watson for any possible leads.

:During this time, Meredith was contacted by a local mercenary named V via holocall and the two decided to meet to discuss the information V had regarding the stolen convoy from Militech. However, Meredith suspected V to be working with Anthony Gilchrist and took the merc by surprise and interrogated them with a quick lie-detector test. Once the test revealed V had nothing to do with her suspect or Militech, Meredith then decided to discuss terms. V explained that they knew who had stolen Militech's convoy and could help lead Meredith to them if she was willing to help. After listening to V, Meredith decided to work with the mercenary by giving them the money they needed for the purchase of the Militech Flathead and in exchange, she would let V take the Flathead. This came with one caveat though: V had to use the money chip she supplied as it had malware installed on it to track the group down, though she conveniently left this detail out when talking to V.
:
::After an unsuccessful investigation, Anthony Gilchrist took over the investigation from Meredith and disposed of Meredith's team, replacing them with his own. Meredith was tortured, bound and then thrown into the Watson waterfront with concrete shoes. After Act 1, her body can be found off a pier in northern Watson between the Ebunike Docks and Oil Fields fast travel points. Swimming up to the body allows it to be scanned, and Johnny Silverhand and V will have a quick conversation where V informs Johnny that Stout was from their past life.
:
::The Militech shard was able to successfully destroy Maelstrom's systems and gathered all the information she needed. Finally having confirmation of her suspicions of Gilchrist, she had him killed and left his body in Watson. After the firefight in the All Food's Plant, Meredith reached the site with her team to greet V and their fellow mercenary, Jackie Welles. Meredith acknowledged that she and V worked well together and maybe in the future they could possibly work together on other assignments. Having the Nomad lifepath, V can also reveal how Gilchrist was compromising Militech's convoys by finding his message to Maelstrom on a computer in a side room of the first larger hall you enter after leaving the initial negotiation room in the All Foods Plant (only as a Nomad you can comprehend the full meaning of the message). You will then be able to relay the information to Meredith, who will be impressed and leave a crate containing Militech equipment at V's Apartment in Act 2 as an extra reward.
::Meredith later appeared on N54 News as Militech's Government Relations Executive during a ceremonial partnership signing between the corporation and the NCPD at City Hall.
::
:::At some point later in Act 2, Meredith messaged V stating that everything worked out as she had hoped. Despite Meredith not wanting the public to know about what they did, V replied stating they were fond of her. Meredith, unable to resist, told V to meet her at the No-Tell Motel. The two later met there for some intimate alone time.

Associated Quests
*The Pickup
*Venus in Furs

Notes
*During the one-night stand in Venus in Furs, Meredith is more dominating towards male V and more submissive towards female V.

Trivia
*Meredith's voice actress, Erica Lindbeck, also voiced Misty Olszewski and Spider Murphy.

MetaKey is a drift city located in the Gulf of Mexico, North America. It is also the headquarters of MetaCorp.

History

MetaKey was originally founded in 2011 in the Gulf of Mexico as a small flotilla of ships and one oil rig that were hijacked by a large group of "renegade civilian contractors" under the leadership of Jonathan Meta. Four years later, in 2015, MetaCorp was formed. The flotilla would eventually be turned into a mobile artificial island and the headquarters of the corporation/nomad group, becoming a Drift Nation.

In 2018, MetaKey was temporally moved over to Tampa in order to salvage the city ruins.

By early 2020, construction of MetaKey was finalized and opened to the public.

By 2077, the island was still around the Gulf of Mexico. Victoria Meta — granddaughter of Jonathan Meta — could be found in the corp headquarters within the city.

Notes

Metal Heaven is a music store located in Night City in the -universe.

History
Metal Heaven was advertised as the audiophile's nirvana, with the building housing supplies for every musical need. The store's reputation was soo good that, despite the large number of chromers in the area, corporates were willing to come here regularly to pick up their classical TiCDs. The store included a trio of ceremet robo-dobermans to ensure these well-paying customers were not harassed.

On the first floor of Metal Heaven, there was a full line of domestic, imported, and garage discs. Though they were more expensive than normal. If you didn't find the album you were looking for, the store could put an order for you. It was rumored that the employees at this establishment were able to find any recorded music, no matter from where.

Downstairs there was a small recording studio, which the store's owners rented out at exorbitant prices. The quality was good, but not excellent. On the good side, they would produce and package your album for you.

The second floor was the one that deserved all the attention. This space housed the best musical instruments you could imagine. Did you ever dream with a twelve-string bass with active pickups, fruitless neck, fully-programmable drum machine, parametric equalizer and nine other optional effects, hand-carved and painted with the pigment of a rare Australian plant that caused the instrument to glow under certain lighting conditions? For the right price, it could be belong to you. Metal Heaven specialized in custom instruments, though they also had many of the major brands for sale as well. With specialist technicians on hand at all times, they were able to take your dream and turn it into an instrument you could play.

The D.J.'s, a chromer gang, occasionally extended their protection to Metal Heaven in hopes they would get some hi-tech handouts in return. And from time to time they stalked the building's entrance to see if they could approach any famous musical artist that happened to be there. On the northeastern corner of the block there was also a badly-abused dataterm.

2040s
After the Fourth Corporate War, the owners of Metal Heaven were forced to abandon their original premises due to rising rent prices and moved into a renovated warehouse on the edge of the Hot Zone.

Metal Heaven is still considered to be the greatest music store in all of Night City. It carries every music track ever released or bootlegged, can find parts for instruments of any brand, and can build any kind of custom instrument for the right price.

The store is considered by music fans to be neutral ground, though the Prime-Time Players have a longstanding beef with the establishment. Edgerunners are contracted to guard the place, and payoffs to Maelstrom keep the trouble away.

2070s
By 2077, Metal Heaven moved to Crunch Plaza, in Downtown, City Center. At some point a section of Crunch Plaza, including Metal Heaven, was closed off by the NCPD.

Development
In , Metal Heaven is located on top of an unfinished parking garage that is closed off to the player character.

At launch it was possible to reach this location by using double jump and reaching an elevator, but that has been subsequently been patched out. However, the area is still reachable via more elaborate parkour.

The sign of Metal Heaven was depicted alongside other Vendor Hub signs on Artstation of Concept Artist Marta Leydy. This implies that the store originally could have had multiple vendors.

Mexico is a country in the universe.

History

After the Central American wars, the US and Mexican relations have soured, this is showcased when the Mexican government denied aid to fleeing US citizens during the Long Walk.

Drug cartels in Mexico during the years of the conflict turned into real corporations - now they control and share the market for sex services, counterfeit goods, weapons, software. In the government and the media large cartels have their lobbyists and agents who work on public opinion. The cartels war over drug traffic became secondary, and now they are fighting among themselves for control of the communications: major highways, ports and border cities. Government forces are losing the war in the first place because of widespread corruption and mass transfer of the armed forces on the side of the drug cartels. In some regions, particularly criminogenic population formed a people's militia, because they do not trust the local police.

Prior to the Long Walk, the Aldecaldos worked in Mexico City.

By 2045, Ortiz Automotives had become the largest vehicle brand in the country.

Notes
*Lasombra and All Foods are corporations based out of Mexico.
*Brandon Holt, cousin of Weldon Holt, likes to visit Mexico from time to time.

Mike Galleck was a netrunner and a friend of Ted Collins. At some point he rented Unit 1242 at the Motel on Martin Street, Northside, and converted it into his hideout and netrunning den.

Mike later had an argument about it with Ted, as he was worried for the netrunner's safety. However, their call got cut short when somebody arrived at Mike's hideout. That day he disappeared without a trace and his fate remains unknown.

Ted was soon forced to leave Night City because of unclear reasons and was unable to search for Mike. Some time later his unit was available for rent again.

引文：I remember the day my whole world changed. I kind of knew in a vague way that there was a war going on, but it was very remote. My father never wanted to talk about it. And then, suddenly, my father was gone, my world was gone, the City I'd grown up in was gone — everything was gone. And it was all our fault.（Michiko Sanderson (née Arasaka)|citation）

Michiko Sanderson (née Arasaka) (Japanese: 荒坂 美知子), is the head of the Hato faction of the Arasaka corporation and founder and CEO of Danger Gal. Unlike the rest of her family and corporation, she allied with the US government after the Fourth Corporate War.

Daughter of Kei Arasaka, most of her life was kept secret from the rest of the family, especially her grandfather Saburo. Born in the United States, she held a dual citizenship for both Japan and the US, however her descent is pure Japanese. She also had access to Kenichi Zaburo, one of Arasaka's top solos and her personal bodyguard since she was four. By 2077, Michiko was on the board of directors of the Arasaka Corporation.

Biography
Early life
Michiko Arasaka was born in Night City in the late 2000s as the daughter of Kei Arasaka and an American citizen mother of Japanese descent. Due to Kei's status as CEO in the Arasaka Corporation, she and her mother were kept secret and hidden in Night City to avoid them becoming a target. Kei also wanted to avoid Michiko from meeting her grandfather Saburo, who would be displeased that his granddaughter was half-American. At the age of four she was assigned a personal bodyguard, Kenichi Zaburo, a highly trained Arasaka solo. Due to all this, Michiko had a sheltered early life, being unaware of her family's darker side and the company's schemes while growing up.

2020s
After the death of her father in 2023 during the Fourth Corporate War, Michiko was suddenly faced with her family's company being hated worldwide due in part by being one the instigators of the a terrible war, as well as having a reputation for mass-murder based on the accusation that they had detonated a nuclear device in the center of Night City. As a result of this, after the war ended in 2025, Arasaka was not welcomed to the Americas, and the sheltered seventeen-year-old high schooler Michiko faced deportation to Japan, a distant nation that, as an American-born and raised teenager, was utterly alien to her. To prevent this, Michiko, utilizing her youth, cuteness, high IQ, and thousands of fans who believed in her innocence, traveled to Washington, D.C. to meet with President Kress and apologize for her family's participation in the conflict, as well as pleading her case to remain an American citizen. It is unknown exactly what both discussed, but Michiko's meeting proved successful and she was able to remain in Night City and finish her studies.

After finishing high school, Michiko was admitted into Stanford University, where she majored in criminology. When she graduated three years later, she started her own business as a detective, establishing Danger Gal, a private investigation firm.

In late the 2020s, when Arasaka broke into three factions, a small group of the corporation chose Michiko as their figurehead in hopes of giving them legitimacy and started the Hato 鳩 (Dove) faction, even though she did not want to affiliate herself with her family and the corporation at the time. The faction was the liberal wing of Arasaka, and unified those who sought deeper reforms. They were the least powerful among the three factions (Hato, Kiji and Taka) within the corporation.

2030s - 2040s
Over the following years, Michiko's company increased in size and influence. On the surface, the firm specialized on cases for socially prominent clients. As the perky, unstoppable head, Michiko was a staple of parties and events from New Hollywood to the hotspots of the recovering European continent. Her visible naivete and irrepressible charm disguised the fact that she was also a highly competent criminologist. It also obscured the fact that behind the scenes, she was fulfilling one of the directives she agreed to perform as part of her deal with Elizabeth Kress to remain in the United States; locate and dismantle any Arasaka operations in and around her country. To help her, Michiko had access to both a slush fund provided covertly by President Kress, and much of the covert databases left behind in the Arasaka estate in New Westbrook. Additionally, her bodyguard Ken Zaburo kept working under her directive, the only man who was rumored that could take on Morgan Blackhand himself.

Michiko married detective Marc Sanderson, her partner, after a "particularly exciting case," and took his surname. While in her thirties, Michiko kept her bubbly, enthusiastic charm, and was a constant sight at almost any important social gala. She also grew Danger Gal into a highly successful firm with her string of successful cases, making the headlines of many important news outlets. Michiko had grown into an elegant, lovely woman who could read a room like a book and yet never revealed anything to her suspects other than her happy, cheerful facade she kept up. If you ever saw her wink at you, it was advised to run away.

At some point in the Time of the Red, Michiko heard the movement of the intact Arasaka nuke that had been salvaged from the wrecked Arasaka Towers by Samantha Stevens. She followed the group of edgerunners tasked with moving the device for some time, but had to delay meeting them to deal with a group in Night City who wanted to recover the device from the edgerunners. Finally catching up with them, who were facing a panzer tank, Michiko and her escort helped them by destroying it with two attack AV-9s. She then met with the group and explained to them the nuke's backstory, and how responsible she felt about everything despite not considering herself part of the Arasaka family anymore. Her girlish voice changed into a sharp staccato after being shown the trigger codes. She wanted to make sure no one would use that bomb, and since all of them wanted to dispose of it, Michiko offered the edgerunners her help, following their vehicle with her AVs to their destination of Los Alamos Labs in New Mexico. Once she was sure they had reached the facility's gates, Michiko wished them good luck over the comms before returning to Night City.

Michiko tasked Puma Squad to be the company's public face in Night City to faster the goodwill of Danger Gal, though they were also her personal spearhead in covert operations against Arasaka. By 2045, Puma Squad was one of the most famous groups in the metropolis, and Danger Gal was well established in Night City. Michiko had also partially dyed her hair blue.

2050s - 2070s
At some point, Michiko became an official member of the board in the Arasaka Corporation, although her faction still held the least amount of power of the three.

After the death of her grandfather in 2077, Michiko, like the rest of the Arasaka board, was quick to accept her uncle Yorinobu as the new CEO, who wanted to sabotage the corporation from the inside. In the memorial parade for Saburo during the Aratama Matsuri at Night City, she complied with her uncle's wishes.

:Michiko attended the board meeting setup by Yorinobu at Arasaka Tower. The meeting was interrupted by her aunt Hanako, who brought V, a witness of Saburo's murder. The mercenary testified to the board of directors of Yorinobu's betrayal. Michiko was reluctant to believe V, until Hanako showed the board the engram of Saburo, who explained the situation and scolded them for their cowardice. Michiko asked Saburo for his orders, who told the board to follow Hanako's orders as if they were his own. Yorinobu's troops interrupted the meeting, killing most board members with the exception of Michiko who managed to hide behind one of the chairs. After V and other Arasaka soldiers handled the attackers, Michiko stayed behind with Hanako while V left to confront Yorinobu.

Development
Mike Pondsmith first mentioned Michiko Arasaka while in a Poland panel where he had a live session. Later, when asked about the scenario on Reddit, Mike answered it was known as "Michiko's Night Out."

:The name of the scenario is "Michiko's Night Out." It involves the granddaughter of Saburo (Kei's youngest daughter) leaving the Arasaka compound on her 18th birthday in the company of her personal bodyguard, the super solo Kenichi Zaburo (Morgan's Arasaka nemesis). While she's out barhopping in Night City, she runs into (and causes) enormous amounts of chaos, culminating in a wild fling with --get this--Adam Smasher, the cyborg.
:I ran this scenario for my own players and extended it over several months. It's a favorite of mine, because the external threats are far less troublesome that the ones the players bring with them to the table. And Michiko is a wonderful NPC to play--she's like Battle Angel Alita crossed with a mad Girl Genius. You will meet a somewhat older Michiko in the Time of the Red, and she might be showing up in 2077.
:We're holding off on publishing [the scenario] since Michiko continues to exist in the 2077 timeline. Have to sort all that out first.

Upon release of the Jumpstart kit, it was finally made clear that Michiko had become a canon character in charge of a faction of the Arasaka Corporation and also had her own company, Danger Gal.

Since the date event has not been added to the story, it's not considered canon for the time being.

Trivia
*Mike Pondsmith described Michiko as Battle Angel Alita combined with a mad Girl Genius.

## Midwest
Midwest is region of USA.

Overview
Formed after The Collapse, the Midwest is made up of the states of Michigan, Wisconsin, Missouri, Illinois, Indiana, and Ohio.

History
The Midwestern Region's states are near the bottom of the list of livable places in America, being edged out only by those in the Northeast. It's here, in the Midwest, that acid rain has really earned its reputation as an environmental catastrophe. There is no Department of Ecology in any of the Midwestern st a t es, as there is no ecology left for someone to be the department of.

Certainly the Midwest is most famous for Detroit and Cleveland, which are consistently rated first and third of the Most Dangerous Places to Live, according to Net 54's You Decide! poll. It is only the presence of these two hell-holes that overshadows the difficulties of cities like Milwaukee, St. Louis, and Cincinnati.

These situations are of course underplayed by the state governments. Indiana, Michigan, and Ohio are dominated by business concerns. Wisconsin and Illinois are similarly dominated, although to a lesser extent. These states incorporate a new advisory board made up of the PR people from various corporations. This board controls the dominant portion of the constituency, and therefore can put the governor out of a job on short notice.

The other major feature of the Midwest is the Great Lakes system. Superior, Michigan, Huron, Erie, and Ontario, while the lifeblood of Midwest industry, are no longer the lifeblood of anything else. The lakes are uniformly polluted beyond belief. There are no fish in them. They are so acidic that vessels plying their trade in these waters must get their hulls treated once a year to avoid being eaten away. In fact, the only life supported in the lakes are a few noxious strains of algae which cover the surface with a sickly brown color and phosphoresce in the freighters' wakes.

The lakes are so bad that Canada, at its own expense, installed a major lock and water recycling system on the Saint Lawrence waterway to keep the U.S. pollution from contaminating Montreal and the Maritime waters.

The freighters which cruise the lakes transport the Midwest's raw materials and industrial goods out and their food and other necessities in. The vast majority of shipping for the Midwest is done by freighter; trucks are used to ship elsewhere. In fact, 95% of the trucks which run on Midwest highways are heading across the region to other parts of the country. The Midwest, of course, taxes these shipments and uses most of the proceeds to maintain the highway system to the best of their corrupt ability.

Politically speaking, the Midwestern senators are generally considered the 'bad boys' of politics. With its industry, the Midwest has its fair share of power, yet the Midwestern states have, over the last fifteen years, earned reputations as being shortsightedly selfish and dogmatic. Thanks to their influence, any environmental bill put before the national government is sure to acquire at least one firm rejection from among the regions. Likewise, the Midwestern states will not pass any bill that cannot be demonstrated to have an immediate and positive benefit for their region.

It's not that they don't need the help. The Midwest used to be covered with thick pine forests, wide verdant fields of grain, and picturesque rolling hills. Of these, the hills remain, although they are not picturesque any more. The pine forests of Michigan and Wisconsin stand as vast acres of dry, black wooden spires, washed by acid rain and painted by the corrosive smoke from the cities. The ground is covered, at best, by a scrubby brown crabgrass which, against all odds, continues to survive and spread. Many of the smaller interior lakes are covered with a scum of unknown origin, an agglutination of non-volatile airborne waste accumulated over the years.

Of course, hardly anyone ever sees all this any more, because few people actually leave the cities. The cities are where the jobs are, where money pumps in the heart of the average beaver. With no environment left to worry about, let alone earn a living from, the Midwest has turned to industry to keep itself alive. And since the acid-washed metropolises are the only future for the inhabitants, tempers tend to run a little short.

Midwest Combined Operational Group

Mike is a mechanic and the owner of the Yucca Car Repair Shop in Yucca in .

Biography
If V has the Nomad lifepath, they are forced to stop in Yucca when their car breaks down on the way to Night City. Mike sneaks V inside his repair shop to fix their car, promising it will be a quick job, but soon finds the car will need more extensive repairs. In a rush, V bypasses the car's broken coupling to hotwire the car long enough to reach Night City. Mike grudgingly agrees that fix will suffice, but remarks it is inelegant and will not last long. Before V can leave, the local sheriff, Andrew Jones, arrives and demands a word with the stranger. Mike insists he was unaware that V had not visited the sheriff before coming to his shop, but Jones dismisses him and says he will hash things out with V.

## Mikhail Akulov
- aka：Misha
- status：Dependent
- dod：2077 (dependent)
- place_of_death：Hotel Raito, Night City (dependent)
- home：Soviet Union
- gender：Male
- affiliation：Soviet Union
- role：Fixer
Diplomat

Mikhail Sergeievich Akulov (Михаил Сергеевич Акулов) is a fixer of the Soviet Union who travels to Night City in 2077.

Biography
Mikhail Akulov rose to fame as the top fixer in the Soviet Union. He traveled to Night City in 2077 under the pretext of a diplomatic business trip, but he was rumored to have been seduced by the freedom and capitalism the city brings. Neither story turned out to be true. Instead, Akulov's arrival in Night City was related to the Soviet Union and China competing to secure a major arms deal with Arasaka that would put the losing country at a severe military disadvantage. The secretary general of the Soviet Union had hired Akulov to personally spearhead negotiations with Arasaka on his behalf.

Akulov and his assistant, Nadezhda Tiurina, stayed at Konpeki Plaza for negotiations with Arasaka representatives. When the hotel was placed on lockdown after the death of Saburo Arasaka on the premises, they moved to the penthouse suite at Hotel Raito. The negotiations continued for several weeks, and when they stalled, Akulov asked the secretary general for permission to sweeten their offer to Arasaka.

While this was going on, Akulov covertly brought a netrunner named Shelma to monitor Chinese activity on the local Net, conceal his purpose in Night City, and check the status of China's talks with Arasaka. The Chinese were prepared for this and burned Shelma without Akulov knowing, leaving him exposed.

An unnamed colonel in the Chinese military also hired Regina Jones, a local fixer in Watson, to install a bug in Akulov's car to monitor his conversations. Regina delegated the gig to a mercenary named V. After the car was bugged, the client hired Regina for a second gig: stealing an encrypted datashard that held records of Akulov's negotiations with Arasaka from his suite at Hotel Raito. V retrieved the shard, either without Akulov's awareness or after incapacitating or killing him, and delivered it to Regina's client in person.

## Mikoshi
- owner：Arasaka
- location：The Net (servers on orbital stations around Earth)

Mikoshi (Japanese: 神輿, lit. "spirit/god litter") is a piece of cyberspace infrastructure in .

Overview
Mikoshi is one of Saburo Arasaka's main projects. It is a data fortress located within a part of cyberspace controlled by the Arasaka Corporation, with servers found on orbital stations around the Earth. It contains the digitized personalities of clients from the "Secure Your Soul" program, as well as the victims made by Soulkiller.

Information regarding their access point locations or technical specifications is classified, and any request to know about them is denied. However, access points can be found in every major Arasaka HQ found worldwide.

Izanagi
Izanagi is the name for the Mikoshi access point located right under the Arasaka Tower in Night City. To access the facility, an Arasaka employee must first have an active "Kisen" authorization level, followed by a registration and granted permission for the requested session. If said employee also wants to use the facility for research purposes, they will require input of the grant or a permit number issued by the acting head of the Arasaka Research Operations. Additionally, all sessions will be recorded.

Database Entry

Trivia
*In real life, a Mikoshi is a sacred religious palanquin in the Shinto faith, essentially a portable shrine. It serves as the vehicle to transport a deity in Japan while moving between main shrine and temporary shrine during a festival or when moving to a new shrine. Oftentimes, the mikoshi resembles a miniature building, with pillars, walls, a roof, a veranda, and even a railing.

## Militech Basilisk
- aka：XT 451 Basilisk
- type：Hovercraft
- group：Military
- style：Neomilitarism

引文：According to the manufacturer, this vehicle took part in twenty-three armed conflicts across five continents over a period of ten years - with overwhelming success.（Military Basilisk）

The Basilisk is a dual seater hovertank manufactured by Militech in .

Overview
The Basilisk is a cargo ship by design, though weapons can be added. Thanks to enhanced modification, it handles effortlessly in extreme weather conditions such as sandstorms.

The combat version's primary and only weaponry include a mili-40L 20mm recoilless autocannon. It also comes equipped with a CC04 Defense System, which basically is an electromagnetic missile countermeasure. Additionally, this tank has reactive armor, a life support system that can last up to 4 hours, an autopilot mode and a passive IFF radar-based identification system.

With the inclusion of a twin neural interface its pilot can connect with the Basilisk, being able to move it by neural impulse. To use full functionality during engagement, a second pilot is needed in order to handle the sensory overload. While one pilots, the other manages the weapons. This causes the pilots' nervous systems to link, allowing them to work in harmony.

Aldecaldo Basilisk: Rouge Raxxa

引文：Thanks to enhanced modification, it handles effortlessly in extreme weather conditions such as sandstorms.（Nomad Basilisk）

A small group of Aldecaldos - led by Panam Palmer - stole a disassembled Basilisk from a Militech transport convoy so they could better defend themselves from the Wraiths, bolster their own smuggling operations, and devalue the appeal of possible employment of Aldecaldos by Biotechnica (which many Aldecaldos believed would be one-sided and exploitative in Biotechnica’s favor). In the following days, Mitch Anderson and other clan members had reassembled the Basilisk and modified the vehicle to be fit it for battle.

Even after defeating the Wraiths with the Basilisk, the Aldecaldos kept tuning it. Although they left much of what it already had, they added a few improvements. For starters, they replaced its primary weapon with a QianT twin-barrel 25mm autocannon, and added a secondary weaponry through a thermal missile launcher and 2x HATGM-Quad Optic. In addition to the combat features the Basilisk had, they added a Jumi5 duplex cyclone nitro injector. To finalize, they named the panzer "Rouge Raxxa" and painted on Aldecaldo decals.

During The Star ending, V and Panam used it to breach the Militech defenses around the Maglev Tunnel Construction Site in order to access the lower levels of Arasaka Tower and eventually Mikoshi. Later Mitch dangerously used it solo to help the rest of Aldecaldos in the battle. After this venture, V and the Aldecaldos used the Basilisk to cross the border to Southern California through one of the "famous Aldecaldo tunnels".

Database Entry

Trivia
*The Aldecaldo panzer name "Rouge Raxxa" is a tribute to the Polish TV series "Four Tank-Men and a Dog", which follows the adventures of a tank crew and their T-34. The tank is named "Rudy" which can be translated to "red", thus the word "Rouge". "Raxxa" is probably a reference to an actress in the same show known as Pola Raksa. Another Basilisk - this time named Rudy and with four men and a dog - can be seen in a photo Panam Palmer sends to V's computer.
*Vehicles and robots manufactured by Militech are named after mythological creatures, with the Basilisk being a serpent-like monster.

## Militech Griffin
- type：Combat
- group：Drones
- style：Neomilitarism
- manufacturer：Militech

The Militech Griffin is a combat drone manufactured by Militech in Cyberpunk 2077.

Overview

Database

- transcript：With its reserves of active boots on the ground, Militech's leadership believed it was always burning money and resources on the same old problems. Soldiers have to be trained. They have to be equipped, fed and paid. Then, after absorbing all that capital, one quick bullet to the head is enough to send the investment straight down the drain. As a result, Militech executives salivated at the prospect of using machines to replace a portion of their unreliable, "soft" human assets. Thus, the Griffin combat drone was born. Cheap, obedient and durable, the Griffin never posed a risk of desertion or demanded a pay raise. And if one ever committed a war crime? Militech could blame it on a "software bug" caused by a sloppy third-party contractor. Managing an army had never been easier.

Trivia
*Vehicles and robots manufactured by Militech are named after mythological creatures, with the Griffin being hybrid of lion and eagle.

The M-10AF Lexington is a Power Pistol manufactured by Militech in .

Characteristics
Designed sometime around the 2030s, the Lexington is a fully automatic 9mm handgun, with a 20-round magazine. To decrease recoil, Militech partnered with Tao Industries to create a custom weighted muzzle. It has few moving parts, making it more reliable and durable.

As with all official law enforcement sidearms, the Lexington is designed to be "less than lethal" as a last resort in confrontational situations, and, as such, is the official sidearm of the NCPD.

Alongside the Ticon model, the M-10AF Lexington was the inspiration for the M-76e Omaha.

It is possible to install a Short Scope and a Muzzle attachment.

BARGHEST
This weapon has a BARGHEST variant modified by Hansen Armory, increasing Armor Penetration by 25%. Additionally, it has a 25% increased attack speed and slight damage increase, at the cost of reduced weapon handling and 25% reduced Headshot Damage Multiplier.

Behind the Scenes

引文：A simple nine-millimeter power handgun with few moving parts. Fully automatic, extremely reliable and durable. To minimize recoil, Militech entered into a partnership with Tao Industries, the world's leading producer of weight compensators. No slide is present for chambering rounds; instead, a special compartment pulled out of the back of the gun is used for this purpose.

Notes
*It was originally named the Federated Arms "Vindicator" and Militech RKD-12 in the 2018 E3 Gameplay showcase.
*Despite not being able to switch between firing modes in Cyberpunk 2077, the Lexington has a switch right above the trigger that would allow it to change between automatic and semi-automatic.
**In , the Lexington is shown to be able to fire in semi-automatic mode.

Trivia
*Pistol-caliber weapons by Militech appear to be named after events in American military history. In the case of the Lexington, it appears to be named for the Battle of Lexington, an early battle of the American Revolutionary War.

The M-76e Omaha is a Tech Pistol manufactured by Militech in .

Overview
The Omaha is a semi-automatic, simple and compact, yet reliable Tech pistol which was based upon the already established M-10AF Lexington and Ticon. Each round fired will split up into three smaller projectiles that are arranged in a triangular pattern.

While the weapon can be used normally, holding down the trigger will charge the magnets in the barrel and fire three rapid shots with three smaller projectiles each, for a total of nine projectiles.

Due to the Tech mechanism in place, it is not possible to install a Muzzle, but there is an option to install a Short Scope.

The M221 Saratoga is a Power Submachine Gun manufactured by Militech in .

Characteristics
In production since the 2040s, and intended for corporate security forces, the Saratoga is a lightweight, compact assault carbine ideal for close quarters' urban combat and suppressive fire whilst providing a "less than lethal" option for security operators intent on protection as opposed to lethality. It is a "spray and pray" weapon by all combat standards, rattling off an entire magazine in the blink of an eye.

It is possible to install a Short Scope and a Muzzle attachment.

Hansen Armory
This weapon has a BARGHEST variant modified by Hansen Armory, increasing Armor Penetration by 25%. Additionally, it has 25% increased Headshot Damage Multiplier and 10% increased base damage, at the cost a 10-round reduced magazine size.

Database Entry

- transcript：Everyone in Night City knows the characteristic rattle of this submachine gun. Designed in the 2040s, Militech intended the Saratoga to be versatile piece in their corporate security arsenal. However, its several undisputed advantages – small frame, light weight, relatively cheap price, ease of use and modifiability – also rendered this SMG a major hit outside the glass towers of Corpo Plaza. Gangs, in particular, took a liking to it. This SMG is the ideal weapon for vehicular and urban combat. But as the average Joes and Janes gain greater access to the Saratoga, corporate security forces will need to equip themselves with a more powerful deterrent...

The Militech MT0D12 "Flathead", commonly abbreviated to Flathead, is a robot in .

Overview
The Flathead is an experimental military grade unit for surveillance and reconnaissance missions, manufactured by Militech. As described by Maelstrom gang member Dum Dum, it is state-of-the-art, coming without a standard port and with titanium-fiber actuators. It has dynamic camouflage armor and motor impulses rivaling that of the human nervous system. When demonstrating it, Dum Dum remotely pilots the spider-like bot around the room, having it scale walls.

Normally, the robot would be controlled by Militech software, but because the Maelstrom hijacked this specific robot from a transport, they had to replace the software with an alternative version by Raven Microcybernetics and placed it on a control shard. Dum Dum mentioned that if they had left the software intact, it would automatically reconnect to the Militech network and expose their location.

Acquisition
*The Pickup - Obtained alongside the Raven Control Shard.

Notes
*The Flathead was intended to be used as a companion.
*In the E3 2018 trailer Dexter DeShawn is seen finishing the deal on the Flathead.
*The bot is named after Flathead County.

Trivia
*The Flathead appear as a back bling in Fortnite Chapter 6, Season 1 alongside V, Johnny Silverhand and several other cosmetic items as part of the Night City Denizens Set.

引文：Rated #1 in 2066 by the "Private Army Solutions" agency. "The perfect choice for dictators that value their safety."（Manticore）

The Manticore is an aerial vehicle manufactured by Militech in .

Overview

Database Entry

- transcript：Night City's police have complained to their superiors for decades that their lives are in constant danger. They fight criminals who are equipped with combat cyberware, high-caliber weapons, high-grade explosives and military hardware traded on the black market. Each officer suits up for work every day never knowing if they'll be the next badge-wearing fly splattered against a wall. The issue of officer safety is often revisted between NCPD leadership and city politicians. Every now and again, a plucky, young aide to a city councilmember suggests that the city implement stricter gun control measures. Once the laughter in the room subsides, the meetings typically conclude with the city commissioning Militech for a new fleet of Manticores, their line of armored AVs designed for military operations. Everyone walks away pleased. The NCPD gets fancy new toys, the City Council announces another public safety success, Militech pockets another billion-eurodollar arms deal, and they all live happily ever after (until the next year).

Notes

iconic

The Mk. 31 HMG is a Power Heavy Machine Gun manufactured by Militech in .

Characteristics
The Mk. 31 HMG is a large, fully automatic, heavy machine gun which is often mounted on a Militech Aegis X2 turret or a Minotaur, though it is possible to carry it if one has the strength. The weapon can hold up to 300 rounds, which are laden with a small explosive charge. It cannot be reloaded, and after dispensing its belt-fed magazine, is automatically discarded. The weapon is prone to overheating.

Wielding one imposes a movement penalty on its user, slowing them and disabling their ability to run or dodge. It cannot be stowed or stored in the stash or inventory and, upon switching to another weapon or riding a vehicle, the HMG will be dropped. While carried, it is still possible to perform a double jump or charge jump, as well as grab on to ledges.

Database Entry

Acquisition

*Can be ripped off of any Militech Aegis X2 ground turret, requiring a varied level in the Body attribute, unless the turret has been destroyed.

Crafting
:This weapon cannot be crafted.

Behind the Scenes

引文：A massive weapon originally meant only to be used mounted, the Mk. 31 was modified for portability when advances in cyberware made carrying it possible. The grips were moved from underneath to the left and right and an advanced recoil system inspired by artillery cannons was added. Also cannon-like is its barrel, which flies backwards when shooting to chamber the next round. A mechanism on top of the barrel sprays gas downwards to cool metal temperatures when they get too high.

## Militech Offices (2077)
- type：Regional HQ
- owner：Militech
- city：Night City
- district：City Center
- sub_district：Corporate Center
- location：Corporate Plaza

The Militech Offices is a massive office building located in the Corporate Plaza of Night City. It acts as the regional headquarters for Militech.

Overview
This impressive building is Militech's regional headquarters in Night City. Like the other major office buildings in Corporate Plaza, it is accessed via a bridge from Memorial Park. These offices are located right in front of Arasaka Tower, on the opposite site of the Plaza.

History
When reconstruction of Corporate Plaza begun in 2052, many megacorporations around Night City planned to move their new headquarters there.

During the 2060s, Militech was planning on building a new regional headquarters in the redeveloping district of Pacifica, on the southern side of Night City. The office complex would have been comprised of three buildings that when looked from above pictured the Militech logo. To the public, it was designed as an urban renewal effort directed to curb the growing influence of Arasaka in the West Coast. Under cover, it was for military infrastructure development. Nevertheless, this complex never went beyond the planning stage.

In 2077, the Militech offices in Corporate Plaza shined as one of the most impressive buildings in Night City.

Notes
*In Cyberpunk 2077, if you are at street level in the roundabout area in front of the building, you'll find a couple of barred off elevators. If you manage to access them, they will go up to an unfinished small area of the building. There is nothing noteworthy other than a few randomized items to collect.

The Svalinn 9-F Thermaskin is a syn-skin Cyberware implant manufactured by Militech in .

Overview
The Svalinn 9-F Thermaskin was released in 2077 as a synthetic skin which can be applied to the surface of any cybernetic implant, to give the appearance of human skin. It is able to withstand temperatures ranging from -220 °F to 700 °F and is abrasion resistant, making it a good choice for motorcyclists or firefighters.

This syn-skin was featured by Karina Lee on her cyberware and tech review show Chip In. She gave the product 4 out of 5 stars, praising its excellent damage resistance qualities, but noting that as a result of these qualities, the user is unable to apply body piercings to it.
