The Ticon is a Tech Pistol manufactured by Militech in .

Characteristics
By 2077, the Ticon was considered an old Militech pistol. This model, alongside the M-10AF Lexington, were the inspirations for the M-76e Omaha.

When firing from the hip, the weapon will fire a burst of three rounds. Holding down the trigger while aiming will charge the magnets in the barrel and fire a three round burst which each benefit from the Charge Damage Multiplier stat. The weapon's spread radius is small, but it's still possible to miss with some of the rounds, requiring more careful aiming than usual for handguns.

Due to the Tech mechanism in place, it is not possible to install a Muzzle.

Database Entry

- transcript：Haters will say it looks antique, connoiseurs will claim it's a classic. Thanks to its simple construction, it rarely jams and is unlikely to fail you when you need it most. Its compact size guarantees it can remain hidden when tucked away behind your belt, which frankly makes it the ideal ally in heated arguments or when uninvited guests come knocking on your door. The best thing about it? It just works.

The Wyvern is a combat drone manufactured by Militech in Cyberpunk 2077.

Overview

Database

- transcript：In the second half of the 21st century, business is a battlefield - both figuratively and literally. Arbitration, lawsuits, settlements - these measures carry less weight in a world where corporate disputes are often fast-tracked to resolution through sabotage and assassination. For the prudent corporate employee, it's wise to arrive at any arranged business meeting in a suit made from reinforced polymers with a pistol tucked in the belt. Even then, most expect that the other side likely hasn't shown up empty-handed either; such naivete is often enough to get you killed. For those business people seeking an edge in negotiations, Militech offers the Wyvern drone. When deactivated, it fits conveniently into a briefcase which can be concealed easily under a limo seat or in the corner of a conference room. When activated, it can turn a stubborn business partner into an obedient lapdog... or a bloody heap on the floor.

Notes
*The Wyvern has also been used by the NCPD in recent years as a first response unit to crimes in progress, under the infamous drones-for-cops replacement program.

## Minefield

- region：Badlands
- subregion：Eastern Wastelands
- location：Vasquez Pass

This Minefield is located on the eastern Badlands of Night City.

Overview
Delimited by danger signs, this minefield spans a large area of Vasquez Pass, also occupying portions of the Wind Farms and Sierra Sonora. A railway and Interstate 9 safely cross a small portion of the field.

The explosives were manufactured by Militech and are labelled as PDU-5 Mine.

History
During Unification War, a portion of the border between Northern and Southern California was dotted by a large number of mines. After the conflict, this minefield remained as a leftover that was never cleared up and which acted as a "natural" border protection.

The mines near the border with Night City were "claimed" to have been disarmed in 2071, but after people were injured by these "disarmed" explosives, most decided to steer clear of the area. All except the smuggling types, who managed to make a number of their routes run through these dangerous fields. It was risky, but worth it too, as due to the mines, no one seriuosly guarded this portion of the border. However Militech still patrolled the area from time to time, sometimes sending Griffin drones to monitor the area.

## Mint
- status：Alive
- home：Night City
- gender：Female
- hair_color：Brown
- eyes：Brown
- cyberware：See Cyberware
- equipment：See Equipment
- relative：Jeremy Taylor (father)
- partner：Tiff (girlfriend, deceased)
- occupation：Mercenary
Street racer
Car thief
- role：Techie

引文：Said I'm nothin' like 'im, every last one. Damn straight.（Mint）

Mint is a character in .

Biography
Early life
Mint is the daughter of famous Night City street racer and carjacker Jeremy Taylor. He taught her how to steal and drive vehicles. While Mint was a kid, Jeremy was caught by the NCPD and spent two years in prison, leaving his daughter to fend for herself. It was there where he met Gorilla and Caliber, and after leaving prison, a techie known as Kickdown joined his crew as well. At some point afterwards, Jeremy was brought to the Badlands, where he was executed, leaving Mint an orphan.

Mint grew up following in her father's footsteps, and at some point met fellow techie Tiff.

2070s
Mint and Tiff spent two years rebuilding a Yaiba sports coupe, replacing many of its pieces by new ones. This process was put on hold after Mint disappeared. She and five other members of a merc crew were confronted by the NCPD, with Mint being the sole survivor. After being arrested, Mint didn't provide any information about her companions nor the chips she had been using to improve her driving skills. The NCPD, who had been looking for Jeremy's old crewmate Kickdown, knew her chips had been created by him, and locked her in a cell. After six months of investigations, the NCPD decided to offer Mint a deal with the condition of finding him. With no other choice but to accept, she was free to return to Night City. Over the course of those six months, Mint had been labeled a snitch who got her crew killed.

To find the whereabouts of Kickdown, Mint decided to contact an old crewmate of the techie, Gorilla. She knew him from the old days, but to pick his interest Mint stole the Mizutani Shion of Tyger Claws member Green Dragon — whom Gorilla had beef with — then drove it to Kabuki, where the Demons of Kabuki car race was brewing up. As expected, she found Gorilla there and while he was looking at the Mizutani's engine, Mint told him that she wanted to meet Kickdown. He told her no one knew where he was and dismissed her inquiries. He also told her to leave as the race was about to start, but if she was thinking of joining, she'd better not get herself killed. Mint decided to participate, planning to win by using Kickdown's chips to gain the upper hand.

Despite the difficulty of the race, Mint won at the last second, but right after was cornered by Green Dragon's people. To protect her, Gorilla threatened the gangsters to leave and told her to follow him. While in a diner, Mint convinced Gorilla to let her talk with Kickdown after she promised him the name of an NCPD mole among his people. He said he would discuss it with Caliber as long as she told them the name of the mole. As a extra, Gorilla also took Dragon's Shion. After leaving the diner, Mint encountered her two undercover contacts from the NCPD, who were making sure she was on-track.

Mint returned to Tiff's home in Watson, where she found out she was not there at the moment. She decided to break into the building and spent the night in a bed. The next morning, Tiff returned home and found her, angry at Mint for trespassing and disappearing for six months. After mentioning she needed the Yaiba car, Tiff asked her where she had been for all that time, with Mint saying she didn't want to drag her in, but that she was involved with the NCPD, and with Gorilla and Caliber. Tiff was worried about her, warning that someone like Caliber was dangerous and unpredictable. She also mentioned Mint's bad reputation in the city, but that she didn't want to believe any of that. For Mint it wasn't that simple, as she was playing both sides trying to come out on top. After both finished installing the new engine to the car, Tiff gave Mint her handgun and asked her to not get killed.

Mint took the Yaiba for a spin in the Badlands, where she could test how good the car was at drifting, the only reason they had upgraded it for. She went to the Serpent, a place where her father set up a record for a consecutive drift, though she didn't mange to beat it. At that time Gorilla contacted her, giving Mint information about Riot, a boxer who had changed gang sides and who Gorilla wanted to teach a lesson. He would vouch for her meeting with Kickdown if she managed to bring that guy to him.

After following Riot for a day, Mint failed at her original plan to capture him. She eventually had to ask for Tiff's help about a garage in Watson where Riot was heading. To stop him from getting there, Tiff left her workshop and crashed her car into Riot's, allowing Mint to capture him after first checking up on Tiff first. Mint put the unconscious Riot on the backseat of her Yaiba and drove to a building in the middle of the Badlands. That ride made her remember on how her father had been killed. After delivering Riot to Gorilla and figuring out what was going to happen to him, Mint asked Gorilla if Riot had any kids. He responded that he didn't know, asking her if it mattered, to which she responded with a no.

After returning to Tiff's place, Mint found a Tyger Claw car parked in front of her building. She panicked, grabbed her gun and went to the car only to find Green Dragon and another gangster dead. Suddenly, Mint's NCPD contacts appeared, commenting that was a gift from them, as the NCPD always took care of their people as long as they showed results. Their cold-blooded behavior shocked Mint, who was left without any words as they both left.

Mint would approach Caliber, the leader of the Maelstrom, at the Totentanz to convince her to setup a meet with Kickdown. Initially, Caliber would ignore her due to her reputation as a snitch for the NCPD. Mint would proceed to break the wrist of a racer Caliber was planning to hire, forcing Caliber to employ her instead. Mint was tasked with winning several street races around Watson, a task she would excel at. During one of the races, Mint was ordered by Caliber to aim for second place and set the match, a final test to earn her trust. After coming in second, Caliber agreed to setup a meet with Kickdown.

During the meet, Kickdown, Caliber and Gorilla interrogated Mint and her connections to NCPD. Mint convinced them that she was only working with NCPD to clear her name, even giving them an NCPD transmitter, which when activated brings NCPD to location. This confession cleared Mint's name as a snitch and convinced Caliber and Maelstrom to carry out a retaliatory strike against NCPD, using the transmitter to setup an attack. Mint made her plan known to leave Night City with a nomad crew in the outskirts of the city. While Caliber and Maelstrom planned their attack, Kickdown decided to leave Night City along with Mint. However, Mint had double crossed everyone, the NCPD transmitter was in reality a signal to both NCPD and MaxTac to launch an ambush on Maelstrom. Several Maelstrom members along with Gorilla would die in the assault and Caliber would be assassinated by an unidentified sniper, possibly from MaxTac or NCPD. Mint and Kickdown would travel to the outskirts, Kickdown would express his admiration of Jeremy, who as per his belief was a man whose luck simply ran out. In the outskirts of the city, to the surprise of Kickdown, they were met by Mint's MCPD contacts who apprehended Kickdown. One of the NCPD officer asked Mint if there were any witnesses left, to which Mint replied in the negative, heavily hinting that she killed her own girlfriend Tiff.

## Miriam Night
- status：Unknown
- gender：Female
- partner：Richard Night
- affiliation：Night Corp
- role：Corporate

Miriam Night was the founder of the Night Foundation, the CEO of Night Corp, and the widow of Night City's founder, Richard Night.

Biography
Before the construction of Coronado City, now known as Night City, in the 1990s, Miriam met and married an ambitious entrepreneur and businessman by the name of Richard Night. She was at his side while her husband built the city of his dreams. In 1998 Richard was assassinated, leaving her all his money and possessions, including Richard's own corporation, Night International.

A year later in 1999, Miriam restructured her husband's company and founded Night's Foundation, with the primary goal to protect and promote her husband's vision of the perfect city. For the next years, Miriam led the foundation onward, until the infamous Mob War occurred. She attempted to gain the support of the MegaCorps to end the reign of crime in the city, but to no avail. After the conflict, Miriam allegedly realized that to have any power in the city, you have to play by the rules of big businesses to get ahead. And so Night's Foundation was restructured, returning to its corporate roots, and renamed Night Corp, with Miriam becoming its CEO.

After the Night City Holocaust she would pour money into reconstruction efforts on the city, kick starting its reclamation and revealing herself to the public for the first time. She'd do so by bringing various fiefdoms throughout the ruins together under a new city charter and then luring in nomads and the megacorporations with attractive contracts. According to news reports she herself "braved the war-ravaged wilds of the world" to secure these deals.

Since then, Night Corp remained a constant presence in Night City, expanding its field of activity, but avoiding power struggles with other major corporations. Although Miriam stepped down from the role of CEO long before, her legacy and ideals were upheld by her successors.

## Misty Olszewski
- age：26
- status：Alive
- dob：April 30, 2051
- place_of_birth：Heywood, Night City
- home：Night City (formerly, dependent)
- gender：Female
- hair_color：Blonde
- eyes：Green

- voiced_by：Erica Lindbeck
- appears_books：(mentioned)

引文：Some believe uncertainty is an evil that should be dispelled through divination. Others claim it's change that is evil. But that isn't true either. Every minute of every day, we each become someone new. We shouldn't fear change itself, but only who we might change into. Knowing one's path is most important.（Misty to V）

Misty Olszewski is a new age spiritualist and the owner of Misty's Esoterica, a store located in Urmland Street, Watson. She is a good friend of Viktor Vektor and V, and the girlfriend of Jackie Welles.

Biography

Early life
Although she has family in Warsaw, Misty grew up in Night City's Heywood district, and was a childhood friend of Jackie Welles. When she was a young adult, Misty opened her own shop on Urmland Street in Little China, Watson - called Misty's Esoterica.

At some point she was approached by ripperdoc Viktor Vektor, whom rented a basement she owned, behind her shop, to use as a clinic. Since then both became close friends. Not long after, Misty regained contact with Jackie, and in 2076 they entered into a relationship, however Jackie's mother was not supportive of the relationship, preferring a previous girlfriend of Jackie's.

In late 2076, Jackie introduced V to Misty and Viktor, who then became friends.

2077
In 2077, Misty and Jackie had been going out for nearly a year. After Jackie Welles managed to set up a meeting with Dexter DeShawn, they visit Misty's Esoterica.

After V is brought to Viktor's Clinic by Goro Takemura after the Konpeki Plaza heist, Misty takes V back to their apartment and provides them with omega blockers and pseudoendotrizine; the former would suppress the engram of Johnny Silverhand, while the latter would give him more control over V's body. V can talk to her about Jackie's death, and afterwards Misty leaves. While V is searching for a way to remove the Relic, Misty can give them tarot readings of their journey.

:During Heroes, Misty is waiting in front of Jackie's Garage when V comes to look for something for Jackie's ofrenda. They search through his belongings, reminiscing about his character and his past with Misty. After finding a suitable item, V can convince Misty to attend the wake in spite of Mama Welles' disapproval of her. V can also convince Mama Welles to talk to Misty. Later on, Misty can comment how their relationship is progressing positively.

After meeting with Hanako Arasaka at Embers, Misty takes V to the rooftop of Misty's Esoterica where she and Jackie used to sit often before a big job. She leaves V to think about their next move.

: Misty gives V one last tarot reading before their driver arrives to pick them up. If V sided with Arasaka, Viktor reveals that she left for Warsaw.

2079

:After having the Relic surgically removed at Langley, they return to Night City and discover that Misty's Esoterica had been bought over by Zetatech, who transformed the shop into a ripper clinic. Viktor comments that Misty was unhappy with the changes and left. Later on, after V is harassed by two thugs, Misty appears and reveals that she is leaving for Poland. They have a short conversation regarding V's future, and later part ways.

Database Entry

Associated Quests

Notes
*Her last name would be considered incorrect in Poland, as Olszewski is a masculine form. The correct feminine form would be Olszewska. However, this does reflect how Polish last names are treated in countries whose native tongues don't differentiate between feminine and masculine forms of last names, and it's not uncommon among descendants of immigrants.
*Misty was referenced in an interview with CDPR's story director Marcin Blacha. She was described as "...a clever girl who stands behind the counter in an esoteric shop half the time, while also working as a nurse."

Trivia
*Misty's appearance is an homage to Pris Stratton, one of the escaped replicants from the 1982 movie, Blade Runner.
*Misty also closely resembles immortal tarot card reader Pamela from Sang-Sun Park's 2004 manhwa The Tarot Cafe, down to the latter wearing a spiked choker.
*Misty's voice actress, Erica Lindbeck, also voiced Meredith Stout and Spider Murphy.
*Misty makes a voice only cameo in Wuthering Waves as part of the Wuthering Waves × Cyberpunk: Edgerunners crossover event.

Misty's Esoterica and Chakra Harmonization is a new-age business located in Little China, in the Watson district of northern Night City.

Overview
The store is located on Urmland Street and belongs to Misty Olszewski.

Layout
The main entrance can be found in a pedestrian area just opposite the Gomorrah strip club. Inside are a variety of new age products, the main counter, on which Misty's computer is located, and a statue at the rear. To the left of the statue is a door leading to a small stock room and another exit leading to a back alley where some stairs lead to Viktor's clinic. There is an elevator behind the building leading to the 9th floor of the building, providing access to the roof.

Associated Quests

Mitch Anderson is a member of the Aldecaldos nomad nation and a veteran of the Unification War. He's good friends with Scorpion and Panam.

Biography
Mitch and his friend Scorpion served with other Aldecaldos as panzerboys for the Free States during the Unification War. He and Scorpion faced many hardships during the war, including straining combat and were forcibly given drug cocktails that could cause cyberpsychosis in order to keep their synapses strong to control their tanks. They both developed severe PTSD as a result. Mitch and Scorpion eventually recovered and returned with the Aldecaldos, helping them with their smuggling operations. He became good friends with Panam Palmer and currently is one of the most respected and loyal members of the Bright Aldecaldos.

When Panam asked for his help to recover her truck, Mitch couldn't go as Saul Bright, the Aldecaldo group leader, had said so. Instead, Mitch gave her his old rifle, the Overwatch.

When V and Panam attacked the Kang Tao transporting Anders Hellman with a EMP; Mitch, Scorpion and a few Aldecaldos saw it from afar and decided to go to the crashing site expecting to help any injured and scarp anything useful. Unbeknownst to them, the transport was armed with droids and soldiers. Panam tried to warn them but to no avail as the EMP had unabled the radios. The Aldecaldos were wiped out, with just a few survivors who were promptly gunned down. By the time V and Panam reached them, only Mitch was still alive, but had been taken hostage shortly thereafter. He was rescued by his friends, though, and stayed with Panam's car while the other two went after the Kang Tao members.

Mitch returned to the Aldecaldo camp and explained what had occurred to Saul, who took much of the family and alongside Mitch went to help Panam and her friend. Once Hellman had been captured by V, Mitch and Saul went to talk with them. In the ensuing argument between her and Saul, Mitch sticks up for her, also stating that Saul cared about her wellbeing.

Mitch and the rest of Panam's friends helped her steal a Militech Basilisk to help defend the clan.

:Mitch helped the rest of the Aldecaldos plan for their assault on Arasaka Tower, flying a drone over a construction site which would serve as their entry point into the tower. When V, Panam, and Saul entered the site, Mitch elected to stay behind and pilot the basilisk, in order to help the rest of the Aldecaldos outside against Militech forces. Panam protested, fearing that the mental overload of piloting the basilisk solo would kill him, but eventually relented. Following the assault, Mitch survived, which Panam attributed to his synapses being toughened due to his experience of piloting panzers during the Unification War. Mitch will ultimately survive the battle, albeit suffering heavy injuries, and join V and Panam when they cross the border.

Database Entry

- transcript：Mitch is a member of the Bright family, a group of nomads in the Aldecaldos nation. During the Unification War, along with a number of other Aldecaldos, Mitch fought on the side of the Free States with the panzerboys - a division of elite combat AVs and armored vehicles. After coming back from the front, Mitch helped the Aldecaldos with their smuggling operation - a much better fit for him than fighting on the battlefield. He's good friends with Panam and is one of the most respected members of the family - loyal to his friends, uncompromising with everyone else.

## Mongolia
- capital：Ulaanbaatar
- population：5 million
- language：Mongolian
- ethnic_groups：Mongols *Kazakhs
- literacy_rate：56%
- military：2 million

Mongolia, a nation bordered by China and Russia (Soviet Union), is known for vast, rugged expanses and nomadic culture. Its capital, Ulaanbaatar, centers around Chinggis Khaan (Genghis Khan) Square, named for the notorious founder of the 13th- and 14th-century Mongol Empire. Also in Ulaanbaatar are the National Museum of Mongolia, displaying historic and ethnographic artifacts, and the restored 1830 Gandantegchinlen Monastery.

Despite the climate change and energy crises, Mongolia was left untouched from many chaotic world events. Becoming buffer zone between SovOil and Chinese government Mongolia plays neutral ground for both technological giants.

History

During the late 2000s the Food Riots broke out.

Geography
Mongolia is a landlocked country in Central Asia and East Asia, located between China and Russia. The terrain is one of mountains and rolling plateaus, with a high degree of relief. The total land area of Mongolia is 1,564,116 square kilometers.

## Moon

- type：Natural satellite
- owner：Highrider Confederation
Euro Space Agency
Arasaka

Other space-able corporations
- location：Earth's orbit

The Moon, also known as Luna, is Earth's only natural satellite. A lunar "day" takes approximately two Earth weeks.

Background
Fueled by Earth's collapsing ecosystem and late-stage capitalist society of corruption, warfare, and lack of viable resources, Luna was first colonized in 1997, with the foundation of the Euro Space Agency (ESA) colony Tycho. It has since become home to various permanent bases, founded and maintained by allied nations of the ESA. With the creation and existence of gravity-based technology and ability to soft-land machinery, alongside heat drills to form glass-like tunnels, Luna was far easier to colonize than open space. Buried ice was mined for air and water, plants were brought to create a viable ecosystem, and the Tycho mass driver was modularly dropped and reassembled to construct and later utilized to catapult raw materials towards the Crystal Palace construction at the time. While the original bases were simple pressure domes and workshacks planted by Orbital Transfer Vehicles (OTV), by 2020, this had far expanded via nuclear and solar laser drill-created subterranean tunnel networks. Water is mined through lunar ice and recycled heavily, while air comes through underground hydroponic gardens which recieve solar light via large surface shutters.

Luna is mined heavily for raw materials utilized in orbital colony constructions at the Lagrange points. Three mass drivers allow a stream of lunar material to enter Earth's orbit.

By 2077, both Arasaka and Militech have mining operations over the Moon's surface. The ESA maintains a formal, yet callous relationship, with corporate interests on Luna.

Locations
Regions
*Mare Nubium (Sea of Clouds)
*Mare Vaporum (Sea of Vapors)
*Oceanus Procellarum (Ocean of Storms)

Major Cities
Two known permanent cities exist on Luna: Tycho and Copernicus, both formerly controlled by the European Space Agency, and are now part of the Highrider Confederation. As both cities were built underground, their construction required blasting and nuclear-powered heat smelters to form park-like caverns, eventually being topped with smelted lunar sand pressure domes to provide air and recycling.

Notable Corporations

*Arasaka
*International Electric Corporation (defunct)
*Militech

Known Moon-Based Corporations
*Deux Gouttes
*Hel Yeah
*Luna78
*Solvind
*Trifolium

Notes
*In it is revealed that in 2025 a one-way ticket to the Moon's surface costs between 5,000 to 7,500 eurodollars.
*In Episode 8 of it is revealed that in 2076 a one-way ticket to the Moon's surface costs 250,000 eurodollars.

 (mentioned)

引文：It used to be that being a 'Solo' meant something. You were a breed apart, a lone hunter in the depths of nighted city streets. Now, every gonk with a big gun and a chipped-in attitude thinks he's a Solo.（Morgan Blackhand|citation）

Morgan Blackhand is a solo with an anodized black-chrome cyberarm. A veteran of the Second Central American War and an avowed pragmatist, Morgan became a mercenary often employed by the Militech corporation.

By 2020, Blackhand was known as a street-smart guy who was constantly looking out for his own best interest. He usually went for the highest bidder and accomplished their gigs however he saw fit for his own benefit. Blackhand's reputation as a top solo was partly due to the fact that he was able to capture targets alive, rather than simply killing them. He was considered to be a "Solo's Solo," with years of experience and ops under his belt. Morgan considered Kenichi Zaburo his rival, though he also had some enmity against Adam Smasher.

Biography
2000s
Morgan served in the Second Central American War, being the second in command of the 102 cyber-soldier unit at only 18 years old, much to the chagrin of his commander.

During this time, an incident occurred where one of Morgan's squadmates accidentally discharged his firearm, with another member catching the bullet with his hand thanks to his boosterware. Despite destroying his hand, he wasn't worried as he could always replace it with cyberware. Morgan found this story quite amusing.

In 2008, Morgan's unit managed to rescue Brenda Melendes from the massacre that took her family's lives. Ever since, Morgan vowed to make sure she would always have work when she needed it.

In 2009, Morgan lost his right arm in the war and his shattered stump was amputated by field medic Mike McRae. Morgan never forgot his deed, and maintained occasional contact with him throughout the years. After leaving the Army, Blackhand returned to the United States, but he felt misplaced. He was a highly trained killer with a background in demolitions and not many people wanted to hire him for a mundane desk job. After surviving on the streets of New York City for a few months, Morgan fortuitously ran into a notorious boostergang leader who apparently took a strong dislike to him. Morgan promptly dispatched that man with such finesse that it impressed a Militech recruiter who happened to observe the scene. The recruiter made Blackhand an offer he could not refuse and subsequently, Morgan became a mercenary who took care of problems for Militech and other clients.

2010s - 2021
At some point, Morgan became the bodyguard of Dexter Dobbs, a young genius who worked on revolutionary applications in technology. While on the work, Blackhand taught him a little in self-defense. Ever since, Dexter maintained contact with the solo, assisting Morgan from time to time and helping him fine-tune his gear. Morgan also befriended Dexter's new bodyguard and tech assistant, Race Chapel.

Mercenary Andrew "Boa Boa" Weyland, while working for Petrochem, was brought into conflict with Blackhand more than once. That Boa Boa managed to survive those encounters spoke of his notable combat skills. At some point, Morgan had a brief romantic relationship with Rogue Amendiares, though it was not known by many.

Morgan earned his street cred over the years by teaching many professionals all the tricks he knew, and by resolving high profile incidents, such as the attempted kidnapping of Kerry Eurodyne in 2019; a former member of Johnny Silverhand's Samurai music band. In this particular scenario, all five of the kidnappers were captured by Morgan alone and turned over to Federal Authorities. While bruised, battered and beaten, they were still alive. Anyone could have killed them, but only someone as skilled as Blackhand could eliminate a threat and embarrass the group's sponsors at the same time.

Adam Smasher, another notorious solo merc from NYC usually employed by Arasaka, developed a quiet rivalry with Morgan, seeing him as a threat to his metal-is-better-than-meat worldview. Adam repeatedly tried to challenge Blackhand to a face-off, but he only ignored the borg at every possible confrontation. For Morgan, his rival was Kenichi Zaburo, an Arasaka bodyguard and one of the best solos in the world.

In 2020, Blackhand was rated as the number one solo professional in the business by the "Solo of Fortune Annual 2020 Awards." Morgan had also written "The Enforcer's Handbook", which sold over one million copies audited in that year. The entire solo profession was improved by its release. Blackhand was a well-known customer of Eran Malour, owner of Malorian Firearms.

2022 - 2023
In January 2022, during the Fourth Corporate War, Militech coaxed Morgan into the fray to lead its "Ocean War Special Ops" team, although no details were provided of his missions other than he had to oversee the security operations of OTEC. His funding from Militech allowed Morgan to subcontract a group of highly skilled and motivated freelancers, making them answerable only to him: Dexter Dobbs, Race Chapel, Fade, M&M, Dash Panther and the Faceless Man. Most of them had worked with Blackhand in the past in some way or another. Additionally, Militech SpecOps agent Anastasia Luccessi was placed under his direction. While she was not officially part of Morgan's covert operations team, she worked closely with him, keeping an eye on him at all times in case she had to eliminate the solo if he threatened Militech's campaign in any way. Due to the nature and dangers of the assignment, Anastasia decided to try a different approach and seduce him. It's unknown whether this worked out or not. It was during this war that Eran Malour gave Morgan one of his finished prototype projects, the Malorian Arms Assault Cannon.

In March of that same year, Arasaka completed their research on Soulkiller 2.5. When Militech found out, they tried to contact netrunner Rache Bartmoss to help them destroy the new Soulkiller. Bartmoss was not only against helping a corp, but he had to be stopped by Morgan when he wanted to retaliate against Militech. The American corp then asked Alt Cunningham, who accepted and convinced Rache to join her team alongside Blackhand. In the following month, Rache managed to find the location of the master program. In May 6, Arasaka managed to locate Bartmoss and proceeded to send a strike team in order to eliminate the netrunner. Blackhand found out, sending a team to intercede them and protect Rache. Unfortunately for Morgan, Arasaka managed to complete their objective.

In mid-August of 2023, Militech gathered together a team consisting of the best operatives, including Morgan Blackhand and Johnny Silverhand. The mission was to assault the Arasaka Towers of Night City to eliminate any information on Soulkiller and retrieve or destroy the Reliquary Database Project of Arasaka. For this last one, a small tactical-nuclear device was brought. Morgan's role was to lead Strike Team Omega (which also included his covert operations team) alongside a group of Militech's elite soldiers and a combat borg unit. They were supposed to act as support if Strike Team Alpha — Johnny's — and Beta failed in their objectives. Morgan knew that Johnny's team was a decoy, but was unaware that General Eddington was planning on destroying the building as well, though he had some suspicions.

No one knows what role Morgan played in the end, though he was last seen by Strike Team Alpha while going down into the building's staircase with a heavy suitcase. During the assault, Morgan realized the enemy had figured out their positions and were moving to intercept them. While warning the rest of the teams about it, Morgan also led a strike force to the rooftop to deal with the laser uplink and prevent Arasaka from creating a backup of the database.

After Alpha's objective was completed, they began their evacuation process, soon after joined by some of their allies, including Blackhand. Once they were boarding the evac AV on the top of the Towers, Adam Smasher appeared inside an Arasaka DaiOni power armor, waving at Morgan with the biopod head of Shaitan, still alive. This took the solo by surprise, who stepped down from the AV to confront the borg. Smasher provoked Blackhand by mentioning that Silverhand was dead, and Shaitan would soon be as well unless Morgan recovered the biopod from Smasher's hands. An angry Blackhand ordered his people to evacuate without him, making sure Spider and the rest of the team made it out safe and sound. Once the AV had lifted off, he turned to the borg with a remark about testing Smasher's "meat vs. metal" philosophy for itself shortly before the two launched themselves at each other in a last desperate attempt to kill the other, while trying to rescue Shaitan at the same time. The outcome of the duel was never known, and soon after the building began to shake from the detonation of a nuclear device.

2023 - 2040s
Morgan Blackhand's status was unconfirmed after the Night City Holocaust, as well as who was truly responsible for it. In the following years, people started to pin the blame on Militech, the United States government, Arasaka, Johnny Silverhand, Morgan Blackhand or other parties present in the assault. Rumors began to circulate that Blackhand had returned to President Kress to report the failure of the mission and continued work as a secret government asset.

Between the 2030s and 2040s, more rumors persisted that Morgan Blackhand had been spotted in several First Wave cities — places that needed little reconstruction and resources to rebuild after the Fourth Corporate War. Morgan returned to write the "Newbie Corner" section of the Solo of Fortune 2045 yearbook, providing advice to those looking to become solos, noting for Rogue not to look for him at the end of the section.

2070s
Despite being decades away, people in Night City in the 2070s still shared their own theories of what must have happened in the Arasaka Towers more than fifty years ago.

By 2077, according to Claire Russell, Blackhand's fate remained a mystery and for that reason he did not have a drink at the Afterlife named in his honor. Other rumors included a WNS news report which mentioned a shootout in Night City's Japantown where several Lazarus agents were found dead. The only survivor of the massacre described the attacker as "a portly man with a black cyberarm."

Development

引文：Morgan Blackhand (my archetypical Solo character), is not alive because he's the best around. He's the best because he's alive. Simple. Even though I wrote the rules, I don't have to bend them to play Morgan. I just play him smarter; I always play him as though he were a personal character I've nurtured for years and that I really don't want to lose. [...] Morgan, for all of his now formidable abilities, would never think of taking the sharp end for a bunch of wet-eared squeeb Players. He wouldn't have lived this long if he just acted as a hired gun. He's far more likely to let the players walk into the sharp end first, see how many fall, and then make his judgements accordingly. He might save them if there was some reasonable chance it fit into his agenda. He might walk out on them just as easily.（Mike Pondsmith）

Mike Pondsmith has commented that Morgan is alive during 2077 but has been occupied with some important work. He survived the destruction of the Arasaka Towers by using a piece of Adam Smasher as a shield. The character is also aware of the events that occur in .

Pondsmith has mentioned that Blackhand has lost weight since 2023 and is thinner than ever. He also commented that Morgan, in order to survive and succeed in his line of work following the Fourth Corporate War, made sure to become as boring and not memorable as possible to not stand out. To people, Blackhand could look like your typical clumsy accountant with no notable remarks other than looking mildly handsome. The character would then use that opportunity to stealthily strike and kill their target before disappearing in the multitude. Morgan knows he is good at killing individuals, but he prefers to choose who his target is going to be.

Notes
*In , Jackie Welles mentions Morgan Blackhand as one of the most notorious solos alongside Andrew Weyland and Susan Forrest, with Blackhand being the most famous solo. If V starts the Path of Glory or All Along the Watchtower epilogue quests, the reputation stat will mention V has become a new NC legend, and that people prefer to talk about them rather than old legends like Morgan Blackhand.
*According to the game files, Mr. Blue Eyes' hair is labeled as Morgan Blackhand. Nonetheless, there is no connection between the characters.

Trivia
*Blackhand was Mike Pondsmith's archtypical Solo player-character in .
*Pondsmith mentioned that Morgan Blackhand looks similar to George Clooney.

Morocco is a country in North-West Africa.

History
The Wasting Plague devastated the country in the early 2000s and killed King Hassan II, leading to his son, King Muhammad IV, rising to power in 2001.

Muhammad IV continued his father's policy of closening ties to the EEC, and worked with Tunisia to force Algeria into becoming a European satellite state as well.

This was not, however, without backlash, as the Voice of the Wastes began to preach a jihad against the Westernized Moroccan and Tunisian governments. The Moroccan administration was strong enough to crush the fundamentalist movement in the country for the most part, but many in the younger generation still has sympathy for it, and anti-Europeanism has grown dramatically amongst them. Europe has some support for Morocco's secular government, but without real sovereignty and independence, the problem is unlikely to go away.

In 2077, Morocco was still considered an attractive holiday destination, although heavily competed with outer-worldly destinations.

Major cities
*Rabat
*Casablanca
*Marrakech

## Morro Canal
Morro Canal is a large body of water located in the Night City area.

Overview
Originally a part of the broader San Morro Bay in southern Night City, after the Fourth Corporate War, the metropolis would be once again dredged and filled, changing the layout, and making San Morro Bay less broad but longer. By the 2040s, the eastern portion of the bay had already been turned into the Morro Canal — constructed by the Thelas nomads — with at least two bridges spanning over it; the Pacifica Bridge and San Morro Bridge. The corporations made use of this infrastructure to establish the Heywood Docks.

Sometime in 2045, a member of the underwater scavenger group, the Perdivers, revealed in a drunken stupor that a pre-4CW Hydrosubsidium submarine was allegedly buried under the dirt in the canal.

By the 2070s, the canal was already narrower but longer, with an excavated portion connecting with the bay to the north, thus rending central Night City as an island.

## Morro Rock
- caption：The island in 2045
- type：Volcanic plug (formerly)
Artificial island
- city：Night City
- location：Del Coronado Bay
- appears_books：

Morro Rock is an island in Del Coronado Bay, off the coast of the City Center district of Night City.

Overview
Although the original Morro Rock was small, this island is big enough to hold a fully fledged spaceport and airport. A bridge connects Morro Rock to City Center on the east; accessed by going through Union Street or the Night City Ringroad.

The island has some of the best views of Night City, especially for contemplating fireworks, as such it is a popular touristic destination.

History
Early history - 2020s
Morro Rock was a volcanic neck that was formed 23 million of years ago. It became a sacred place to the local Native American tribes. In the 19th century, the area near the Rock was chosen to build a settlement named Morro Bay. Unfortunately, in the last decades of the 20th century there was much violence in the surrounding region, with the town ending up occupied by gangs of violent bikers. Not long after, a businessmen known as Richard Night managed to buy all the terrains surrounding Morro Rock and expel the local gangs. With this, after rearranging the terrain, the volcanic plug was turned into a small island west of the new project Night was about to start.

In 1994, Coronado City was founded on the place of the former Morro Bay town, though after Richard's death in 1998 it was renamed to Night City. During the next decades, the Rock survived the Collapse, the Mob War, and even the Fourth Corporate War and the 2023 AHQ Disaster that destroyed much of the neighboring metropolis.

2030s - 2070s
In the 2030s, Morro Rock was still an unsettled small island off the shore of a rebuilding metropolis. In consultation with a group of investors, the Government of Night City agreed to sign a contract to establish an orbital spaceplane mass driver after the old metropolitan airport had been neglected ever since the war. Orbital Air was contracted for this project, with Franklin M'bolu, a developer of many of OA's leading technologies, being in charge of building the company's forthcoming development. The location for such a massive project was chosen to be Morro Rock due to its geological stableness, planning to build it within the majestic Rock itself. When finished, the mass driver would allow spaceplanes to be launched into LEO (low Earth orbit). Morro Rock Radio, located on the island, primarily served as entertainment for the Orbital Air workers at the future construction site.

Construction started in 2035, though many decisions were scrapped during the following decade. For starters, the geological engineers that flew from Kenya halted the construction of the mass driver by citing concerns about the stability of the area's bedrock. At the same time, Orbital Air management was skeptical that rocket-free launches could take place without corporate backing ensuring its profitability, as such, OA proposed to build a civilian spaceport as well. Over the following years, OA managed to take advantage of loopholes in order to cancel the mass driver's construction and its rusted, incomplete remains were eventually dismantled. This way the megacorp's monopoly on space colonization remained intact. It was also decided to demolish Morro Rock itself in order to build the new infrastructure. This time, however, it was not Orbital Air who gave permission to demolish the Rock, but rather the Night City authorities.

In 2044, someone painted "Save Morro Rock" all over M'bolu's Estate's outer walls, though this didn't stop the corp from tearing it down. By 2045, Morro Rock was a flattened island west of the city.

With the island's terrain rearranged and greatly expanded to accommodate NCX Spaceport, it was finally inaugurated in 2047. Now, Morro Rock was a sizeable island west of Night City, with installations capable of transporting people and merchandise across the globe and outer space.

By the 2070s, ground transportation into Night City was only advised if you were accompanied by corporate or military personnel. Instead, visitors to the metropolis were strongly encouraged to travel by plane, using the installations on Morro Rock as the safest solution.

Locations
2045
*Morro Rock Radio Broadcast Station
*Night City Spaceport
*Orbital Air Housing Blocks

2077
*Night City International and Translunar Spaceport (NCX)

Development
Morro Rock was first introduced in Countdown to the Dark Future and . The formation was not in the original and because in the lore it had been covered up with fill. If the original maps had shown elevations, it would have been possible to see the city rise to the northwest. After 2023, the fill above the Rock was used to cover parts of the bay and the crater left by the nuke, leaving Morro Rock in full view for the citizens. This explanation has been presumably omitted following the subsequent releases, considering that already shows Morro Rock in 2020 as an island. As a side note, this elevation would correspond with West Hill, an elevated area in the northwestern side of Night City.

In order to match with the world, Morro Rock was moved to the west in Cyberpunk RED, and it's in a different location than its real counterpart.

Trivia
*Before being turned into an island, this was the same Morro Rock as in real life, albeit, not in the exact same location. In , the only resemblance is in the name.

## Mr. Blue Eyes
- aka：Mr. B
- status：Alive (2077)
- home：Night City
- gender：Male
- hair_color：Black
- eyes：Blue
- affiliation：Undisclosed
- voiced_by：Martin McDougall

Mr. Blue Eyes is a mysterious figure involved in the politics and life of Night City.

Biography
Dream On
Through the tasks given to V by Elizabeth and Jefferson Peralez, it is possible to find that a certain "shady" organization has inserted itself into the life of the up and coming mayoral candidate. By the time some layers are peeled off, V will receive a direct holo warning from an unknown caller, stating that no matter what V tells to Jefferson nothing will change, and also warning them not to keep meddling in their affairs. The unknown caller will make it clear that they know about V's true nature and goals, referring to their Relic problem. Mr. Blue Eyes will be present just across the meeting spot, on a terrace of a building watching over the exchange.

Phantom Liberty
Mr. Blue Eyes can also be found at the NCX Spaceport. When V is sneaking through Tycho Terminal, he can be spotted looking out of the window that overlooks the construction area. Later, Songbird reveals that her flight to the Moon was handled by an unknown proxy which she described as corpo everyman for the ages with an expensive, understated suit, dark hair, and blue eyes. He had asked her questions only she knew the answers for, including about the Blackwall, her past, and the NUSA.

Lastly, Mr. Blue Eyes can also be spotted when V and Songbird take the monorail to the rocket, standing on the platform to the right and holding an umbrella.

Path of Glory
In the ending in which Johnny Silverhand and Rogue Amendiares — or a solo V — assaulted Arasaka Tower to reach Mikoshi, V became Night City's most famous mercenary. Mr. B surveyed V during the assault and sent his people to steal equipment and information during the chaos.

After these events, Mr. Blue Eyes contacted and hired V to steal a cache of data which should contain the information of a client from one of the casinos located in the Crystal Palace, the most famous space station orbiting the Earth. Sometime after getting ready for the operation, V finally met the mysterious man in person at the Afterlife. During the meeting, V made it clear that they had nothing else to lose, as this was a very dangerous operation which no one had ever done before but expected Mr. B would hold his side of the bargain, who assured the merc that he never forgets a promise.

While V was in the shuttle approaching the Crystal Palace, Mr. Blue Eyes ordered his people to turn the station's sensors off in order for V to sneak inside. He also commented to V that if they managed to pull that heist off, they would gain more than they could ever imagine.

Associated Quests
*Dream On
*Path of Glory
*The Killing Moon

Identity
People in the streets of Night City may be heard commenting on Mr. Blue Eye's existence through random banter. The common assumption is that he is always there, watching.

V tasked Viktor Vektor to find information about him or his people, but the ripperdoc answered what he had already told V. That no one knew anything about him, and this could very well mean he was from some place high enough that nobody could even fathom to get some intel, and that he was too much of a shady figure, given that Night City didn't abide the nameless.

Songbird described him as a proxy.

Notes
*He cannot be properly interacted with or harmed.
*Garry the Prophet mentions how "Blue Eyed People" live in space and come down to Earth to control politicians.
*Mr. Blue Eyes can be seen in the reveal trailer. Being among the passengers of a space shuttle, someone across him catches on fire while he is pleasantly drinking a beverage and smiling on the event. In this trailer he doesn't have his iconic blue eyes yet.
*According to the Cyberpunk 2077 game files, Mr. Blue Eyes' hair is labeled as Morgan Blackhand. Nonetheless, there is no connection between the characters.

## Muamar Reyes
- aka：El Capitán
El Cap
Mu
- status：Alive
- place_of_birth：Santo Domingo, NC
- home：Night City
- gender：Male
- role：Corpo (formerly)
Fixer
- voiced_by：Alec Newman

引文：Don't care for the word "biz"... I call it work. Hard work, honest work.（Muamar Reyes）

Muamar Reyes, commonly more known by his nickname El Capitán, is a prominent fixer in the Santo Domingo district of Night City.

Biography
El Capitán used to be a corpo but went out on his own as a fixer once he realised he'd rather be the one setting the rules of the game. He claims to have earned the nickname by helping people enough to achieve a commanding title worth of admiration, although his street reputation indicates it might actually be a reference to the difficulty of his character.

He admires Santo Domingo due to the persistence of the people living in it. No matter who attempted to take over the area, whether corpos or gangs, it hasn't succeeded since, in his own words, the people are real and do not allow to be deceived. He counts himself among them as well, claiming to be the blood and guts of Night City. With this said, he does often end up resolving familial conflicts, so, such as they are, resolutions themselves both boost him financially and morally, creating the image of someone who truly cares for what happens to the people in his district. Whether just a manner of speech or a personality trait, or simply irony, it is hard to tell but he also speaks of his clients as if they are closely entwined.

His efforts appear to be directed at one goal alone - getting the power back into the hands of the people. That too, at the expense of corporations. He doesn't care much for the news due to thinking all of it as not more than common technique for spreading propaganda, nor the everlasting corporate rat race but he will not refuse clients from either field if their aim matches his own or if they are paying enough. Similar to this, he is not keen on NCPD either, stating they do the people a disservice by always intruding where they don't belong, but, once there's an advantage to be had, he will easily take it, regardless if it meant aiding an enemy. Should gangs attempt to take over his territory even if working towards a common goal, El Capitán will not stand for it, showing a rather vengeful side when it comes to dealing with whoever comes between him and potential gain.

He is one of the few who still has contact with the remnants of David Martinez's Edgerunner crew, namely Falco. When V contacts Reyes regarding questions about David's and his teams whereabouts, Reyes gets in touch with Falco to inform him of V's investigation. As a result, Falco reaches out to V, briefly talking about what happenned to the crew before telling V not to look for them, as their "15 minutes are up". Falco then leaves David's Jacket with Reyes and instructs V to go pick it up—as one final parting gift from one Edgerunner to another.

After V finishes every gig for El Capitán, the fixer messages the merc to thank them for all the work they have done. Muamar also mentions that he has some personal affairs to focus on, and thus will leave behind his position as fixer of Santo Domingo.

Phantom Liberty
Muamar started an autofixing business ontop of being a fixer. After V had boosted a car from Dogtown back to Muamar's garage, he began explaining the scheme with the cars to V when an NCPD squad car showed up. Despite Muamar's distrust for dealing with the badges the officer turns out to be Ayden Daniels, an old friend who Muamar grew up in Santo Domingo with. He then tells V Daniels is in the scheme too, and Muamar invites V to continue helping him in "procuring" vehicles for his autofixing business by delivering said vehicles to his contact.

After boosting a few more vehicles for Muamar, Muamar would call V up for a meeting at the dam about an important gig only for V to witness Ayden arguing with Muamar beforehand. Muamar would then tell V that the gig involves infiltrating an Arasaka dockyard and stealing a truck with medical supplies in it. Johnny, sensing that Muamar was feeling uneasy, pushed V to ask what was wrong. Muamar then revealed that he had been born in Rancho Coronado, and growing up his greatest fear was the tap water. Watching other children dying or developing crippling illnesses due to the toxic waste that's dumped by Arasaka into their drinking water disgusts him. Now he plans on robbing Arasaka's medical equipment to save the people of Rancho Coronado, especially kids, from suffering the same fate that he and Ayden witnessed. After the mission's success, Muamar thanks V for the effort and gifts V a Herrera Outlaw "Weiler" as a reward.

V would also find out on the Autofixer webpage about a rare Porsche 911 Turbo Cabriolet that was supposedly to be sold on his website. However, just after V bought it, Muamar gave V a call and mentioned that somehow, both the car and the supposed seller who was a diehard fan of Johnny had fallen off the grid together. Muamar then gave V the last known location of where the car was tracked to and requests V to find out what had happened to it.

## Myanmar
appears_books
- population：3.5 million
- language：Burmese *English
- ethnic_groups：Burmese *Tribes
- literacy_rate：35%
- military：300,000
- capital：Naypyitaw

Myanmar (formerly Burma) is a Southeast Asian nation of more than 100 ethnic groups, bordering India, Bangladesh, China, Laos and Thailand.

 Overview
Sad to say, Myanmar is a hole. In SE Asia, it is the 2nd poorest only behind Khmer Rouge Laos, simply because the SLORC doesn't wholesale slaughter the populace and send them to slave farms. However, it does oppress the hell out of them.

The SLORC (State Law & Order Restoration Council) has been running the show since 1988. At that time, the old government which had won independence from Britain was ejected because of widespread corruption, The Army took over in a military coup, created the SLORC, and 'promised new elections. When it looked like their pet Ne Win party might lose, they did everything from repainting Yangon to moving entire villages around to screw with the process. When SLORC lost, they arrested the winners and many of them "disappeared". The current atmosphere in the capital, Yangon, is just quiet desperation and resignation to fate.

As for culture, the Myanmar people are Theravada Buddhists to the core. The hill tribes are mainly Animists, and the communists are, well, Maoist Communists.

 Government
The SLORC and Army (Tatmadaw) run everything they can. This is a martial law state - Government workers risk getting fired or even arrested for talking politics with each other. Yangon has a 10 pm curfew, and terror tactics and/or torture are freely used. The media is Strictly controlled. Foreign medias and pirate broadcasters are messily executed. Bribes are required to get anything done. SLORC makes the Dixie governors look like Amnesty Int'I activists.

The only real opposition is from the Maoists on the Lam border, and the ex-KMT drug warlords and ethnic tribes in the north. See Myanmar map. These two groups control most of the remaining timber areas and gem mines. SLORC fights them for control of these resources so they can by more guns and tanks to control the people; the rebels sell the resources so they can buy more guns and rockets to fight the government. Khan Fa and his friends pay both to let him bring guns, drugs, whatever, through Myanmar, and down the Mekong river.

By the way, the SLORC gets their weapons at "friendship prices" from the Chinese. This keeps the Myanmar government from arming the Japanese, and keeps the Khmer Rouge busy with Myanmar rather than south China.

 Economy
In one word - screwed. SLORC controls the big monopolies: oil, rice, timber, and gems. Unfortunately they are corrupt and incompetent. When the world food crash hit. Myanmar exported all the rice it could at the higher prices, starving the populace. With the cash in hand, they restocked their armories with the latest Chinese and American weapons-the latter having been routed through Thailand. The commanders also bought new Japanese cars to be driven around in. However, outside of SLORC offices, there is a nationwide shortage of light bulbs? The government is so incompetent that they thought having everyone drive on the right would bring in foreign companies, never mind the fact that most of the surrounding Countries drive on the left.

The official currency is the Kyat (pronouned "chat"), and the government values it at K5 for one Eb. They also randomly change the designs of the large denominations, figuring that if you have a bunch of big kyat bills stuffed under the bed, you got it illegally, so it's your own fault if you lose everything.

## NCX Spaceport
- aka：NCX
- type：Spaceport & airport
- owner：Orbital Air
- city：Night City
- location：Morro Rock
- street：Spaceport Boulevard
- appears_books：

引文：Orbital Air welcomes you to NCX — Night City International and Translunar. Don't wait! Leave your earthly worries, ulcers and tumors behind and take off for the stars. Taste true freedom, be who you want to be, pursue your heart's desire at the destination of your dreams. Because the stars are just your springboard. Orbital Air wishes you flights of fancy.（Orbital Air announcer）

Night City International and Translunar Spaceport (NCX) is a space-airport located on the island of Morro Rock in Del Coronado Bay, to the west of Night City.

Overview

Owned by Orbital Air, NCX is one of the largest spaceports on North America. With more than 100 million passengers a year, it offers more than 80 destinations around the world, as well as flights to the Moon and the nearby space stations. The spaceport is outside of the Night City jurisdiction and is considered a neutral zone, as such, only international laws apply.

Ground transportation into Night City is only advised if you are accompanied by corporate or military personnel. Otherwise, visitors to the metropolis are strongly encouraged to travel by plane. Daily connections from major American cities and orbit are available here.

The NCX inauguration plaque inside Terminal B includes the motto: "Astra Inclinant, Sed Non Obligant," which is Latin for "The Stars Incline, But They Do Not Oblige."

History
2030s - 2060s
During and after the Fourth Corporate War, most of the regular air transit to and from the Night City Metropolitan Airport was disrupted. With the old infrastructure inoperative, plans were made improve the situation, and in consultation with a group of investors, the Government of Night City agreed to sign a contract to establish an orbital spaceplane mass driver launch site on Morro Rock, an off-shore volcanic neck island and the most geologically stable area in the region. Orbital Air was contracted for this project, with Franklin M'bolu, a developer of many of OA's leading technologies, being in charge of building the company's forthcoming project. Planned to be built within the majestic Morro Rock itself, the mass driver would allow spaceplanes to be launched into LEO.

The massive construction project started in 2035, though many decisions were scrapped during the following decade. Orbital Air management was skeptical that rocket-free launches could take place without corporate backing ensuring its profitability, as such, OA proposed to build a civilian spaceport as well. Over the following years, OA managed to take advantage of loopholes in order to cancel the mass driver's construction and its rusted, incomplete remains were eventually dismantled. This way the megacorp's monopoly on space colonization remained intact. It was also decided to demolish Morro Rock itself in order to continue building the new infrastructure. This time, however, it was not Orbital Air who gave permission to demolish the Rock, but rather the Night City authorities. Finally, in 2047, the spaceport was inaugurated. The loss of the mass driver infuriated Night Corp (whom OA had frequently collaborated with in the past), as the city had lost its chance to become a "frontier to conquer space." This caused the local corporation to cut all ties with Orbital Air, starting a sort of cold war between them.

Over the following decades, NCX would be considered one of the largest spaceports on North America, with facilities capable of transporting people and materials around the world, as well as to the Moon and nearby orbital space stations. Night City International and Translunar was OA's flagship in this part of the continent, and was completely owned by them, who maintained a large security presence throughout the infrastructure. Moreover, since the spaceport was outside of Night City's jurisdiction, it was considered a neutral zone, where only international laws applied.

2070s
During the 2070s, despite being considered one the local technological wonders, NCX was still neglected by Orbital Air. Since the spaceport's construction, the megacorporation had not invested any significant amount of resources into it, and after more than twenty years, the infrastructure was starting to become outdated. While OA's spaceports in Africa were growing by incorporating mass drivers into their facilities, OA still refused to do the same for NCX. This caused many rumors about the true reasoning behind this decision, with local residents wondering if Night Corp would try to push OA out of Night City.

In 2077, the high demand of spaceflights caused Orbital Air to begin developing a project to renovate Terminal B and its launchpads in order to accommodate the high influx of passengers, allowing for 1300 to depart and 1300 to arrive. This meant a better service and expansion of the number of flights, including the cargo shipments that supplied the lunar colony of Tycho. OA contracted Corp-Bud for this task. Due to this renovation, Kojo Kariuki — OA's North American Developments Senior Manager — travelled from the corporation's headquarters in Nairobi to Night City to inspect the new infrastructure project. Despite these renovations, some considered it was not nearly enough to update the spaceport to the modern times.

:The armed conflict at NCX was considered a terrorist attack which took the lives of many innocent people. Orbital Air promised to continue the investigation and find the perpetrators. A condolence message board located near Terminal B was left to allow employees and travellers to express their grief for the event.

Database Entry

Layout

NCX is accessed via a bridge from the City Center of Night City. There are also bus, AV, taxi, and NCART connections.

The bridge leads to a roundabout which is surrounded by the spaceport terminals and the access to the underground parking structure. The middle of the roundabout consists of a green area full of trees and rocks, and glass windows that allow view of the central area of the subterranean parking lot. The rooftops of the main buildings are dotted by many solar panels, and the infrastructure includes AV landing pads on the roofs as well. An internal maglev train tunnel allows for quick transport between the different areas of the spaceport.

Terminals
NCX has three terminals and handles more than 100 million passengers a year. Each terminal has daily connections to more than 80 destinations around Earth, with major cities such as Anchorage, Beijing, Berlin, Caracas, Guangzhou, Hyderabad, Libreville, MetaKey, Nairobi, New Mumbai, New York, Paris, Seoul, Singapore, Sydney, Tokyo, Warsaw, among others; as well as to space stations such as the Crystal Palace; or to colonies on the Moon such as Tycho.

Terminal A
Terminal A is responsible for low-cost LEO international and national flights, which depart and arrive every day at different times. Airline access is granted to OA TerraLines.

Terminal B
Also known as the Tycho Terminal, its main hall has a variety of shops, including Avante, Ji-Head, Saeko's, Dynalar, Fuyutsuki Electronics, Giovanni Brizzi, Cybermatrix, and an Orbital Air Medical pharmacy. There is also displayed the 2047 NCX inauguration plaque.

Terminal B is responsible for orbital and translunar flights, which depart and arrive every day at different times. Airline access is granted to OA TychoLines and OA Crystal Palace Direct.

This terminal gives access to three launch platforms, all located southwest of NCX. They are accessed via monorail.

Terminal C
Terminal C grants access to two airlines. OA HighLines is responsible for luxury LEO international and national flights, which depart and arrive every day at different times. Additionally, passengers can opt for a more expensive option that allows them to chart a spaceplane for a private flight of their convenience.

OA Black is responsible for private orbital and translunar flights. The purpose and destination of these flights remain mostly unknown, consequently, this discretion is reflected on the exceedingly expensive tickets.

Development
Cyberpunk RED
In the core book, the project in construction was simply known as the Orbital Air Massdriver, with no mention of a spaceport. The sourcebook changed the name of the project to Night City Spaceport to merge the original mass driver story with the future spaceport seen in .

Cyberpunk 2077
Early versions of Night City for included an underwater tunnel that went from Watson to Pacifica, going right under the spaceport and connecting to it. This was eventually scrapped, though the northern entrance of the tunnel still remains in the game. It can be found to the southeast of Konpeki Plaza, accessed by two closed roads that originate from the Night City Ringroad.

The spaceport was originally known as the "Orbital Air Space Center" in some sources outside the videogame, such as . There was also a shard that mentioned the "Richard Night International (RNX)" that was eventually cut from the game in subsequent patches.

Prior to Patch 2.0 and , the installations found on the island had two runways and just one pad-launcher for rocket-built spacecrafts. There were also game files of a structure resembling a mass driver that perfectly fit the northeastern runway.

Although the spaceport could not be visited in the original Cyberpunk 2077, it was heavily overhauled and made accessible in Phantom Liberty, giving it a final name as well.

Behind the Scenes

Notes
*In , rockets can be seen launching into space at around 9pm every night.
**In , it is possible to see the rocket launches from Lucy's apartment building rooftop in Japantown. The building can be found in the game, but due to the spaceport overhaul in Phantom Liberty, it is no longer possible to clearly see them from this part of the city as the launch pads were moved southwest and are hidden by the skyscrapers.
* states that NCART's Line 2 starts at the spaceport station and goes east where it ends at Rancho Coronado. Despite this, there is no visible metro line in the videogame.
*In 2077, Dexter DeShawn booked a premium seat in a shuttle some time prior to the heist at Konpeki Plaza. After it failed, that same night DeShawn called to depart, and was directed to go to the terminal four, but his plans changed and eventually stayed in NC.

## Nadia
appears_books
- status：Unknown
- home：Night City
- gender：Female

- eyes：Brown

Trauma Team uniform

Nadia is the main character of .

Biography
Nadia was an Assistant EMT in a Trauma Team extraction unit led by EMT Zander, that also included Dodds, Mason, Simmons and Adson. While working with Dodds, Nadia and he became romantically involved.

Their squad was tasked with a rescue mission after receiving an emergency call from Westbrook. During the mission, Dodds and the rest of the squad were killed, with Nadia being the sole survivor. Losing the entire team, including her boyfriend, put Nadia into depression and an identity crisis. She struggled between wanting to help people and the need to serve the company to the best of her abilities. She was eventually allowed to return to work, and was assigned to a new unit, Squad Bravo, that included Knapp, Stratter, Gordon, Dean and Withers.

Shortly after Nadia joined, the squad was tasked with a rescue mission after receiving an emergency call from Pacifica. They were supposed to rescue a Platinum member known as Apex. Upon arriving in Pacifica, the medic group found Apex trapped in an unfinished skyscraper after he killed a boss of the Animals. Nadia recognized Apex as the man responsible for the deaths of her former team.

The squad's lead EMT, Knapp, proceeded to help the client and requested Nadia's immediate attention. Meanwhile, the Security Specialists, Stratter and Gordon, held the line against oncoming hostiles. The latter sustained a gunshot injury to the neck. Nadia, reluctant to help Knapp tend to Apex's wounds, attempted to save her colleague's life instead. She failed and was reprimanded.

Stratter called Dean and Withers for fire support, but their AV was shot down by gang members. Taking advantage of the ensuing chaos, Stratter and Knapp charged at the attackers fiercely, though it was Apex who finished off the last two of them. Once the threat had been dealt with, Nadia put her pistol to Apex's head.

She was stopped by Stratter. Haunted by the memories of her deceased boyfriend, Dodds, she revealed the truth about the massacre of her former teammates.

As the group were walking down the stairs towards the exit, Apex explained that the extraction wasn't going to be easy because he had previously infuriated the gang by killing their beloved boss. He taunted Nadia, urging her to end him. Knapp tried to comfort her, but suddenly got shot as they were ambushed. Desperate to save Knapp, she carried him out of the scene with Apex's aid. The team barged into a nearby apartment and laid Knapp on a couch. Nadia was then asked for help from the apartment's residents, a mother and her sick daughter. Stratter ordered Nadia to focus on Knapp, but the injured medic bled out shortly after. Devastated, Stratter shouted at Nadia, blaming her for his death, but was interrupted when he realised that Animals had found their hiding spot.

Apex asked Nadia for stims, promising to help them get rid of the gangoons. As he went on a killing spree in the corridor, Stratter attacked Nadia, grabbed her by the neck, and asked her to give him one good reason to let her live. Nadia managed to take his sidearm and threatened him. Upon being released, she gave some antibiotics to the mother, and the squad left.

Soon after the three managed to reach the exit, Stratter confronted Nadia again, saying that she was obviously not ready to return to active duty and threatening to end her career at Trauma Team. In that moment Apex snapped his neck. He claimed to have done Nadia a favour by killing the person who wanted to ruin her life.

Then another group of Animals emerged from the building and chased Nadia and Apex to a dead end. Nadia engaged in close-quarters combat, enduring a knife stab between the ribs and ultimately being able to get ahold of her gun, with which she barely fended off the attackers. Meanwhile, Apex had lost a fight against one of the gangers, but was saved by Nadia. More Animals eventually arrived, but so did a rescue Trauma Team AV. It opened fire at them, killing most in the span of seconds.

The AV landed and several Trauma Team members were dispatched to assist Nadia and the client. Then she once again aimed her pistol at Apex. He didn't resist, seemingly content with the turn of events. Nadia saw a vision of Dodds, telling her not to ruin her life, as she hesitated to shoot, just as the other Trauma Team members were about to fire at her to save the client.

## Nairobi
affiliation

- country：Kenya, Pan-African Alliance
- demonym：Nairobian
- appears_books：

Nairobi is the capital city of Kenya.

Overview
Nairobi is the most prosperous and technologically advanced city in New Africa and is the birthplace of Orbital Air. Almost every corporation and agency with interests in space exploration has offices in Nairobi.

Economy
While Nairobi, being one of the most important and powerful cities on the continent, is the home to regional offices for many of the world's MegaCorps, the city's economy primarily revolves around the space industry. In addition to the more explicitly space-focused Orbital Air and European Space Agency, the International Electric Corporation is also a major player in the city, with its office in the city having a military force on call to defend their rocket assembly plant located a few miles west of the city, which supplies both the Orbital Air and the ESA.

History
1st Corporate War
In September 2004, EBM hired a Coriscan team to kill the Orbital Air team in Nairobi that had been negotiating to aquire Transworld Airlines, helping to launch the First Corporate War.

4th Corporate War
Unlike most of Africa, which was spared from much of the fighting due to mostly being controlled by monopolies, Nairobi was an important battleground of the Fourth Corporate War.

It started in June and July of 2022 when Nairobi, along with several major cities in other parts of the world, had its Militech's offices targeted by what seemed to be an impossibly large force of Special Forces operatives (although in reality their apparent numbers were bolstered by many free lances, edgerunners, and other mercenaries wearing corporate uniforms).

Further clashes began on August 16th, with Arasaka and Militech forces in the city fighting each other, directly. In the chaos, Nairobians began rising up and killing the warring soldiers of both companies to take the equipment which was wrecking havoc in their city.

The following day an Arasaka air strike, which the company insisted was intended to target Militech, destroyed several ESA-owned buildings at the Nairobi launch site, leading to the ESA and Orbital Air panicking and moving several Delta squadrons that'd previously been part of their space squadrons to defend their launch facilities on the ground from potential further attacks.

The weakening of their space-based forces ended up being a major factor in the Seven Hour War, which began on September 29th when the Highriders of the then-ESA controlled O'Neill Two space station revolted and declared independence, quickly gaining control of the station. The ESA immediately launched what little Delta squadrons they had left in orbit, but the two squadrons were not nearly enough, and despite their superior equipment the Highriders were quickly able to repel the ESA forces and, with a bombardment of several key ESA and EEC sites on Earth, forced the ESA to concede the war and secured their independence, which quickly became recognized by the government of O'Neill One, together with which they'd go on to form the beginning of what would become new Highrider Confederation. After the war, the US and Japan rushed to acknowledge the new government, with the US promising emergency supplies and support in the hopes of securing a powerful ally in the war.
