The Night Corp Solar Farm is a photovoltaic power station located on the Jackson Plains, on the southern Badlands of Night City.

History
Early history - 2040s
At some point during the Time of the Red, once the dust thrown into Earth's atmosphere during the Fourth Corporate War settled, Night Corp built a joint project alongside PacCon Electric on the southern outskirts of Night City. Located on the Jackson Plains, they constructed a large solar array to utilize every bit of energy shining down through the planet's patchy ozone layer. Once finished, this solar farm began fulfilling a substantial amount of the city's energy needs. For this reason, Night Corp hired Lazarus to protect the installations, with squads patrolling the area at all times, alongside drone surveillance.

During the 2040s, despite various energy sources providing power to the metropolis, it never seemed to suffice, with blackouts being a common occurrence across Night City.

2060s - 2070s
The solar farms of Northern California were shut down some time prior to 2077, with the last ones in North America shutting down in Nevada and Utah that same year. Although solar farms were once seen as the future of clean energy, the extreme climate changes proved too costly to overcome, especially due to the more regular occurrence of hurricanes and sandstorms; natural disasters that were becoming too frequent and caused too much damage to most solar farms around the continent. Lastly, the layer of dust suspended in the atmosphere as a result of the Himalayan Wars had limited the amount of solar radiation reaching the surface of the Earth.

By 2077, this sizable area of inactive solar arrays could be found neighboring much of the functional Satwave Power Plant.

The Nighthawks Rehabilitation Center, later known as Hansen's Armory, is a section of the EBM Petrochem Stadium located in Dogtown, in the Pacifica district of southern Night City.

Overview

During the construction of the EBM Petrochem Stadium, a section of the complex was intended to become a rehabilitation center for the Night City Nighthawks.

After Kurt Hansen assumed control of the district during the Unification War and rebranded it as a Dogtown, the facility got a new purpose as the home of his personal armory. Here most of the weaponry used and sold by BARGHEST is developed and modified to suit buyers' needs.

:In 2077, the mercenary known as V, was hired by Nele Springer to retrieve a bomb from the facility.

## Nina Kraviz (Ripperdoc)
- age：30
- status：Alive
- place_of_birth：Soviet Union
- home：Night City
- gender：Female
- hair_color：Blue (dye)
- eyes：Blue
- relative：Unnamed uncle
- role：Ripperdoc
- voiced_by：Nina Kraviz

引文：Words - we think we know how to use them, but then there is context...（Nina Kraviz）

Nina Kraviz is a Ripperdoc operating in the Westbrook's luxury residential part of Charter Hill. She currently works in her uncle's clinic.

Biography
Nina is an experienced, if not globally-acclaimed Ripperdoc who, in her own words, moves around in the business. Prior to arriving to Night City, she ran shops in Irkutsk, Leningrad, Vienna and Glasgow. Further dialogue reveals that she simply gets bored staying in one place and moves on, which also feeds into her great love of travel. Her uncle was the one to rent her the existing shop in Westbrook for her thirtieth birthday, and she plans on running it up until getting bored.

She is, so far, very fond of the Night City culture, describing it as very different from the USSR. The manner of executing aggression in the street and inevitable need of medical help after every encounter makes it very interesting for Nina.

When first entering the Medical Assistance shop, V may notice that the face in charge has changed, unkindly describing the previous Ripperdoc as having oozing flesh and being rather unpleasant to look at. As it turns out, this "slimy gonk" is in fact Nina's uncle, who she does not deny looking off, although it works in his advantage, being something that is not easy to forget. She will defend her uncle's lack of diplomatic habit as well - being rude towards V in the situation in which they were in when arriving was nothing more than speaking the truth, which is, by all means, hurtful or not, an admirable trait.

Trivia
*Nina is a virtual cameo of musical artist and producer Nina Kraviz, who has not only lent her voice for the character but also her talent for a number of tracks being played on the Samizdat Radio and notably within the clubs of Night City, under the name of cyberpunk music legend Bara Nova.
*[https://www.instagram.com/p/CJpAi4sLWLf/ Ripperdoc's model] has been created by [https://www.artstation.com/hossein_diba Hossein Diba], directly borrowing features from Nina.

## Nix
- status：Dependent
- dod：2077 (dependent)
- place_of_death：Afterlife (dependent)
- home：Night City
- gender：Male
- affiliation：Afterlife Mercs
Arasaka (formerly)
- role：Netrunner
- voiced_by：Ako Mitchell

Nix is a former corpo, and a netrunner in service to Rogue, operating from the Afterlife.

Biography
Nix is a well-known underground netrunner, spreading his reach through the fixer Rogue, consequentially exchanging services for influence. He will express particular interest in Old Net netrunning tech, particularly those used by Rache Bartmoss. Depending on the life path chosen, it is possible to pry out a bit of personal information from him, such as his involvement in the corporate world, which led, possibly inadvertedly, to abandoning his old life. In as few words as possible, he admits to being part of the negotiations between Arasaka and N54 regarding a cyberpsycho scandal in the defense department. Precisely, he was the very leak. However, he managed to not get flatlined and instead now lives and works independently of either group.

In their first conversational exchange, Nix asks V to purchase a package for him, specifically a Spellbook from before the DataKrash. If V accepts, Nix provides the contact info of the seller, R3n0, who in turn texts them where to meet for the transaction. V ends up obtaining an exceedingly rare piece of tech: a Zetatech XPR tablet from 2020. If V hands over the Spellbook as agreed, Nix is pleased that things went smoothly. If V has enough Intelligence to recognize that Nix misled them about the true value of the antique tablet, they can insist on being paid more. Nix concedes V's point and provides a bonus, but he warns V not to press him like that again.

A second business encounter with Nix is possible once V heads far southeast into the Badlands, whether by randomly-obtained coordinates or simply by free exploration. An unusual freezer will be sitting in the garbage, awaiting for V to investigate, and, by doing so, they may obtain a very interesting cyberdeck. Bringing it to Nix to decode is the next step on this mysterious path, and be warned, the cyberdeck contains RABIDS. Once the netrunner starts decoding it, his life will be in danger and up to V to save his life. Two choices are available, simply shutting the power down or hacking into his computer. The second is more favorable due to the possibility to both save the data and his life, for which he will be extremely grateful.

## No Easy Way Out
- quest_giver：Coach Fred
- district：Pacifica
- sub_district：Dogtown
- location：Montezuma's Throne
Digimmortal
Dream Gig
- previous_quest：Spider and the Fly
- reward_item：(dependent)
- reward_eb：5000

No Easy Way Out is a Side Job in .

This job can be started after completing Spider and the Fly.

Walkthrough

Coach Fred messages V with a request to help a fellow boxer named Aaron. V meets with Aaron at the boxing ring near Montezuma's Throne, who explains he needs their help to reach a particular ripperdoc, Damir Kovac.

Aaron and V decide to meet at 9PM at the Digimmortal exposition in Terra Cognita. Here, Aaron confesses that he is in hot water with the Animals. The gang supported his fighting career but, along with his implants, saddled him with a chip that could be remotely triggered to render him unconscious, thus throwing his matches. Aaron suspects that Angie, a pack-leader of the Animals, is out to get him, which is why he needs Damir to remove the implant.

The duo makes their way inside Digimmortal. When they reach Damir, Aaron undergoes a procedure to have the chip implant blocked, while V passes time in a nearby chair until the procedure is finished.

After some time passes, the procedure completes, but Angie arrives at the clinic while Aaron is still under sedation. She offers V a cut of the winnings if they agree to leave and let Aaron take the fall.

:A few days later, Angie will ask to meet V at the boxing ring in Dogtown, where she will reward them 22,000 eurodollars. Coach Fred will message them, lamenting they couldn't help Aaron.
:
::V extorted Angie for an additional 4,400 eurodollars.

:If V refused to cooperate with Angie, they'll have to fight her and the two Animals accompanying her. If they manage to do so, Aaron and V will be able to leave freely. Angie will also drop Cheetah, an iconic Unity pistol. However, a few days later, Aaron will request that V meets with him at the Dream Gig bar in Dogtown. When V arrives, a server will mention that they spotted Aaron with some Animals in the alley out back. There, V will find Aaron's dead body near the dumpster. Johnny will appear and speak his mind, and Coach Fred will send a final message to V, concluding the job.

:V intimidates Angie, mentioning their run-in with Sasquatch and its outcome, causing Angie to flee and leaving Aaron unharmed.
:
::Aaron throws the fight and remains in Dogtown, where he will become a boxing coach for local children.
:
::Aaron loses the fight, but afterwards travels to Costa Rica, where he will attempt once more to become a professional fighter.

Regardless of choice, V is able to leave Digimmortal safely and will receive 5,000 Eurodollars. However, the Scavs are not marked as friendly and they can turn hostile if V strays too far from the path to the exit.

Journal entry
:Look, V. This Aaron choom is a big-handed bastard who knows how to handle himself in hot water. Sure, we gotta help each other out and all that, but watch your back. You're about to walk into the lion's den. I know you're all about helping lost souls and walking elderly ladies across the street, but please, PLEASE don't get killed assisting some lesser Dogtown boxer.

Objectives

*Find Aaron.
**Talk to the bookie. [Optional]
**Wait until the fight ends.
*Talk to Aaron.
*Meet Aaron at Terra Cognita.
*Wait for Aaron.

*Talk to Aaron.
*Reach Damir's clinic with Aaron.
**Defeat the Scavengers.
*Talk to Damir.

## No-Tell Motel
- type：Motel
- city：Night City
- district：Watson
- sub_district：Kabuki
- street：Titan
- appears_books：

The No-Tell Motel is located in Kabuki, in the Watson district of northern Night City.

Overview
The No-Tell is a five story motel operated by an Artificial Intelligence located on Titan street in Kabuki. This large, automated hotel is known for being used to conduct illicit rendezvous, clandestine meetings between individuals, and is frequently used by joytoys and their clients.

The hotel is rundown, dirty, and covered in graffiti both inside and out. It offers few amenities other than a couple of vending machines located in the lobby where guests can purchase refreshments. The layout consists of a large atrium topped with a glass ceiling, allowing the room to be filled with natural light. The staircase on the first floor leads to balconies on each upper floor surrounding the atrium, following these balconies around the atrium leads guest to a single corridor where rooms are located on each side.

Rooms at the No-Tell Motel can be rented for 10eb a hour or 100eb a day. If a guest overstays their welcome, gas sprayers will fill their room with a sedative.

History
In 2077, room 204 of the hotel was designated as a safe house for V and Jackie Welles — a place where they could regroup and meet with Dexter DeShawn if the Konpeki Plaza heist didn't go as planned.

## Nocturne Op55N1
- type：Main Job

- district：Heywood
- sub_district：The Glen

Nocturne Op55N1 is a Main Job in .

Walkthrough

After having exhausted all other options, V has no choice but to meet with Hanako Arasaka at Embers. After having been cleared by security and taking the elevator to the 13th floor, V meets with Hanako in person.

As V approaches Hanako, she stands up from behind the piano and tells V that she knows the location of Mikoshi, beneath Arasaka Tower. Johnny will interrupt V as they sit down at the bar, after which Hanako will state that her brother should be held accountable for the murder of their father, and the Arasaka Corporation should learn the truth of the situation. She suggests a trade in which V confronts Yorinobu at a meeting and testifies to the actual events, and in exchange she will help to rid them of the construct.

After heading back to the elevator and pressing the button to return to street level, Johnny will stop the elevator and suggest that if V gives him control of the body, he can find Mikoshi without Hanako's assistance, by teaming up with Rogue and blasting into Arasaka Tower, like they did in 2023. After talking with Johnny the Relic malfunctions and V blacks out.

V awakes to find themself in Viktor's clinic once again. Viktor explains that Johnny had to drag V back from Embers, and once V is able to sit, he'll give his prognosis: that one more Relic malfunction will likely kill you. After standing up, V will take the last of the pills and a Unity Handgun from the nearby table and, as V goes to leave the clinic, Misty will suggest a better place to decide what you should do next - a place which Jackie once visited when he had an important decision to make.

She leads V to the elevator behind her shop, which they take up to the 9th floor, then up a few more stairs onto the roof of the building. V sits next to Misty as she briefly reminisces about Jackie, then leaves V alone to talk with Johnny to decide on what comes next.

:Instead of getting help from any of their allies, V opts to put things to rest, and throws away the pills. V and Johnny have one final conversation before V grabs their pistol and commits suicide.

:Johnny will be upset with V's decision but ultimately says he doesn't care and that V'll regret this decision. V calls Hanako but she says Yorinobu already invited her to his estate and his people are watching her; and that she'll send someone to pick up V and bring them to the estate so so they can rescue her. Upon going downstairs Misty talks to V and offers to do a reading, when she finds out you're working with Arasaka she's upset because they caused Jackie's death and she leaves. When the driver enters the shop it turns out to be Anders Hellman and he talks with V about an prior conversation.

:Johnny asks if V is sure about this decision and says he thinks they'll regret it. V calls Panam and tells her that they need into Arasaka tower and tells her about Mikoshi. V says if they don't get access to Mikoshi that they are going to die. so Panam agrees to help V and tells them to wait for her to pick them up. Upon going downstairs Misty talks to V and offers to do a reading. Panam shows up and says that everyone is waiting at camp.

:Johnny asks if V is sure about this decision and V says they trust him, Johnny assures V that they're gonna be fine and says he'll see them on the other side.

:Johnny asks if V is is sure about this decision and V says that this their best shot at survival. After V calls Reed he asks if V's at the meeting point and sends an AV to pick up V; V then thanks Reed for everything and hangs up. Johnny is initially very angry at V, but once they apologize, Johnny says he understands and just needs to think. V waits for the AV's arrival.

:Johnny suggests another option, in which he and V storm Arasaka Tower together.

Journal Entry
:We both knew this time would come. If we don't think of something quick, you will die - and I'll go with you. It's time for our final meeting.

The D5 Copperhead is a Power Assault Rifle manufactured by Nokota in .

Characteristics

The D5 Copperhead is a mid range, fully automatic assault rifle with a 30 round magazine. Reliable, cheap and easy to maintain, the Copperhead can be found on almost any corner in Night City's neighborhoods. It is utilized by any and all, from gangoons to corporate security to Solos, as the go-to assault rifle for practicality.

It is possible to install a Scope and a Muzzle attachment.

Hansen Armory
This weapon has a BARGHEST variant modified by Hansen Armory, increasing Armor Penetration by 25%. Furthermore, it has a 20% increased fire rate and an increased magazine capacity of 50 rounds, at the cost of 15% damage and 40% effective range.

Database Entry

- transcript：Once upon a time, in the second half of the 20th century, the world's most popular assault rifle was the AK-47 – also commonly known as the Kalashnikov, in honor of its inventor. Today, these rifles can only be found museums as their market niche was replaced by the Nokota Copperhead. This mass-produced assault rifle sticks to the basics of functionability and reliability. There's no finesse or ingenuity to fall in love with, but many people find its dependable stopping power an endearing trait.

The Osprey is an Power Sniper Rifle manufactured by Nokota in .

Characteristics
The Osprey is a shoulder-mounted sniper rifle which fires explosive rounds that deal area-of-effect damage on impact. While aiming down the scope, it fires a three-round volley, while being fully automatic from the hip.

The Osprey has an iconic modifier that causes headshots with the weapon to increase damage dealt while hip-firing by 200% for 10 seconds. Neutralizing multiple enemies increases the chance to apply a Burn by 30%. While total Burn chance is equal to or higher than 50%, also reduces reload time by 15%. Both effects last 5 seconds and can stack twice.

Classified as a Heavy Weapon, the Osprey reduces movement speed and jump height by 15% when equipped.

Nolan Frakes is a character in .

Biography
Nolan is a senior member of the 6th Street gang. And the father of Martha Frakes.

At some point in 2077, Nolan ordered the execution of Gustavo Orta, the Valentinos' interim leader. However, unbeknownst to Nolan, Martha was secretly dating Gustavo and would be present during the attack, causing her to get shot in the head and slip into a coma. Gustavo would survive the attack unscathed.

After the incident, Nolan believed Gustavo to be entirely responsible for his daughter's critical condition, and contacted Padre to open up a contract on Gustavo's life.

 (mentioned)

引文：Guns. Guns and cyberbikes. That's how we hold the line. We don't have any home except the Caravan. We don't have any rights except what we take. We get run out of town by the cops; we get raided by the roadwarrior packs, and we survive because we've got guns and bikes...
There's kids, old men and women - families here. This ain't no boostergang. These people are my family.（Nomad Santiago）

Santiago, commonly known as Nomad Santiago or Santiago Aldecaldo, was the leader of the Aldecaldos nomad clan. He was a mostly reserved and quiet man who also often came across as a slightly crude nomad stereotype. To some degree, Santiago cultivated this image, in part to fool the statics and in part because it gave him an excuse to pursue fast women (and even faster bikes), but he was nevertheless a hard worker and a skilled negotiator.

Biography
Early life
Santiago was born in an army hospital near Berlin, Germany. His family traveled often during his life, and the young kid was always on the move. Culturally, Santiago's mother was a woman of mixed Native American and Hispanic descent, while his father was a second-generation Filipino-American. His first family was large and diverse, with many cousins and other relatives.

Santiago's father briefly served overseas performing consul work for the U.S. Department of State Department (during which Santiago was born), but a career in consul work in those days was unsafe. Santiago's family thus returned to the States. To their great misfortune, their return home coincided with the Lawyers Purge of 1996, an event that forced them underground and ultimately into an early nomad community.

Santiago had his share of troubles growing up. By the time he was sixteen, his family had changed so much as to be unrecognizable. However, having been raised in a constant state of flux, Santiago was not fazed by these changes.

Santiago was small for his age through much of his childhood up until he was almost eighteen years old. This caused him much hardship and rejection. Just before his nineteenth birthday, he decided to leave his half-formed clan and to work jobs that were less respected in nomad culture, ending up as a hired soldier, a bodyguard, and even a roadie for several different employers.

2010s
While living life on the road, Santiago met a solo named Rogue Amendiares. The two quickly became business partners, doing gigs together around the area of Night City. Whatever Rogue's motivations for working with the man, Santiago himself chose to team up with Rogue often largely because she was the one woman he had yet to score with.

Santiago was a simple man: he liked girls, guns, and fast cyberbikes. He usually hung out in Night City, seeking out gigs as a hired gun, but soon realized that life in the city as a young merc was chaotic. Edgerunner life could quickly descend from super slick and glamorous all the way down to miserable and downright homicidal before once again bouncing back up.

Santiago's true test as a man came in 2013 during a fateful business meeting with Rogue at the Atlantis Club. As the mercs discussed biz , they were interrupted by Rogue's former flame and infamous rockerboy, Johnny Silverhand, who explained that he needed them for an important job. Although Rogue was hesitant to take a job from her ex-lover, Santiago wasn't, reminding her as he had before that business always comes first.

The job was to rescue Johnny's on-again, off-again girlfriend, Alt Cunningham, from the Arasaka Corporation. After hearing that Arasaka was to be the target, Santiago became even more interested. Rogue did not like the sound of the job, but Santiago shook hands with Silverhand after negotiating Rogue's and his payment.

Both mercs, the rockerboy, and a media named Lyle Thompson successfully assaulted Arasaka Tower. In the end, however, they were unable to save Alt's life, a possible consequence of Johnny's rash decision-making. After this, they all went underground with the nomads to escape Arasaka.

During the next two years, Santiago and Silverhand stayed with the Aldecaldos clan, who at the time were situated in the neighboring Mexico. While working with the Aldecaldos, Santiago began to earn a solid and widespread reputation within the clan. His fellow nomads could see what he sought and envisioned, and through his words and actions, he was able to show them what they should truly be fighting for.

Admiring what they saw in Santiago, the Aldecaldos began to change and model themselves after his actions and ideas. It was at this time Santiago finally met their leader, Juan Aldecaldo—shortly before the old man's death. The young nomad was given a mission: help the Aldecaldos so that they could help others.

Soon thereafter, Santiago was elevated as the clan's new leader. It was not a responsibility he took lightly or even easily, but he did take it. Shortly afterward, Santiago led the Aldecaldos back to the US.

During this time, Santiago decided to assume the surnname Aldecaldo out of respect for the clan's former leader. For many years he had been just Santiago, but finally finding himself among people he could truly call family, he had in fact become a fully-fledged Aldecaldo.

At the great nomad meeting in Omaha in 2017, the diverse nomad clans created what came to be known as the Seven Nations. There at the meeting, Santiago called for others to join him and his clan. Nomads answered the call in vast numbers, thus forming the Aldecaldos into one of the most numerous and powerful nomad nations.

2020s - 2040s
When the Aldecaldos returned to the US, Santiago saw a great deal of conflict. As leader of the clan, he considered it his personal duty to ensure his nation become as immune to the effects of these conflicts as possible. In pursuit of an end to both the Fourth Corporate War and Arasaka's grip on Night City, the nomad leader sent the Aldecaldo Lobos to aid Johnny Silverhand, Rogue, and the rest of their strike team in their 2023 assault on the Arasaka Towers, which resulted in the AHQ Disaster.

At some point, Santiago fathered a son, Trace, who would become a well-known media in Night City. As he raised Trace, Santiago would tell the boy stories about the old days. This earned him the nickname "Old Man."

By 2045, Santiago was still the leader of the Aldecaldos.

2077
As of 2077, Santiago's legacy remains strong within the hearts of the Aldecaldos. Many of Aldecaldos venerate their former leader and view him with great importance. Despite this, if Saul Bright is asked about Santiago after relocating to the clan to a new camp, Saul will claim that splitting his life between Night City and his family made Santiago less of a nomad.

During Never Fade Away, V witnesses a flashback in which Johnny interrupts a meeting between Santiago and Rogue to enlist their aid in freeing Alt from Arasaka. In the flashback, Santiago and Rogue join Johnny as he battles through Arasaka Tower. Alongside Thompson, the two are present for Toshiro Harada's murder and Alt's death.

This leaves Santiago—who had been trying to hook up with Rogue for some time—as Rogue's rebound.

## NorCal-SoCal Border Wall

- appears_books：

The NorCal-SoCal Border Wall is located between the dividing line of North and South California, as well as Night City.

History
2000s - 2020s
California became a Free State in 2002. Over the course of the following years, the relations between the northern and southern areas of the state deteriorated. The increasing control exercised by the Los Angeles Metroplex, as well as the reoccurring number of pro-urban and anti-rural laws and regulations being put forward led the northern counties to vote to secede after they had grown tired of the unequal treatment from the counties on the south. This friction ended up with the Northern Separation War of 2011, in which major roads, highways and other crucial infrastructures connecting both regions were destroyed. This conflict ended in 2012 with the Northern Separation Treaty delimitating the border between both Californias, and allowing the counties in the north to form the Free State of Northern California (NorCal). With its capital in Sacramento, this new state became the most recent addition to North America. Thus, the old California became the Free State of Allied Southern California (SoCal), centered around the Los Angeles Metroplex and with its capital in San Diego. Although many roads and highways (such as 1 or 101) had been destroyed in the process, the border was not physical. Highway patrols from both states tried to maintain the roads as secure as possible, but road gangs were a common presence.

Initially, the United States of America did not accept Northern California, but a number of deals and treaties eventually led to the recognition in 2016. Among these deals was the construction of the NorCal Military Base, a local center of operations for the US Armed Forces near the border with SoCal. The location for this facility was decided to be in the greater Night City area. Soon after, a number of roads were repaired, including Route 1, though the old Highway 101 portion connecting to the south was not recovered. Other major roads between the states were Route 99, connecting NorCal's Fresno with Socal's Bakersfield, or the Interstate 5, whose border was so transited that a new settlement known as Stateline was formed along the highway.

2060s - 2070s
Between 2069 and 2070, the status-quo would be changed when SoCal rejoined the New United States of America and fought against NorCal during the Unification War. Portions of the border were filled with mines, creating dangerous minefields that would be left abandoned and a menace to anyone approaching them. After the war, a concrete border wall between both Californias was built by the NUSA. Even though Night City had gained its independence from the North, the metropolis was considered to be inside disputed territory, thus the border was extended through the Badlands south of the city. Once finished, the wall prevented smuggling and illegal crossings between the south and the north. The southern section of the wall was tasked to be guarded by the SoCal Border Patrol, with the occasional help from the Militech corporation. NorCal took care of parts of the northern section, and firefights were not uncommon with either state, Raffen Shiv or other nomad groups. Much of the wall was inside an AWACS Zone warning (Airborne Warning and Control System), which was patrolled by Militech drones. If the area was not cleared in time, any vehicle or person was targeted by missiles. Over the years, this perimeter would become filled with smoldering wrecks.

By 2077, tensions between both states was still high, and hearing warning gunfire from both sides was common occurrence. Nomad families like the Aldecaldos had built a number of hidden tunnels to cross from one side of the border to the other. One of the first ones was a smuggling tunnel near the Night City border.

Layout
The border extended from the Pacific Coast, all the way to the Free State of Nevada. Major settlements near the border included Night City or Stateline, as well as multiple checkpoints — such as the one near Night City — dotting it. Important known highways connecting both states in different time periods included Highway 126, Route 1, Route 99, Interstate 5, and Highway 101.

The wall portion south of Night City extended from the Pacific coast in the west, along the Biotechnica Flats, and continued to the mountains east of Rattlesnake Creek.

## Norio Akuhara

引文：Some folks, like Norio, need to know the cause behind everything.（Regina Jones）

Norio Akuhara (Japanese: 悪原典夫) is a Cyberpsycho in .

Biography

Norio, also nicknamed Akki, for single-handedly disposing of a large number of Tyger Claws, started out as an experienced fighter following the ideology of Sota. His meditative approach to fighting had made him a formidable, unpredictable opponent, so it was not difficult for him to join a gang once he wished to do so. He examined and evaluated his bosses in fights, letting them deal with enemies alone to prove themselves and validate his decision to work for them. Never feeling kinship with the gang, he solely used them as a manner of boosting his finances to achieve a single goal, although, very quickly, he became aware that leaving their environment might prove a lot more difficult than he anticipated. He meditated and worked on his zen to provide a better understanding of the situation, and near the dread he was about to suffer, he even noted how his insight became much better and stronger.

Soon after Sota's death, Julia was murdered by the Tyger Claws, who claimed it was an "accident". Norio began suffering blackouts and gaps in his memory. He sought treatment from Dr. Colin Thevaniz, who prescribed him some medication the alleviated the symptoms. However, eventually the medicine started to lose effectiveness and he stopped taking them all together. His mental state completely collapsed.

During his blackout episodes, he had decided to "test" the gang using "sakki", or "Air of Murdered", to see if they could sense the danger of his lethal intent and strike him down before he would do the same. None passed the test. He managed to quickly dispose of gang members in the most brutal ways, without even being seen. This has claimed the minds of some of the survivors that have started insisting how an actual demon was descending upon them.

The stories of the supernatural do not deceive the regional fixer Regina Jones, who manages to recognise the signs of cyberpsychosis in the remains of his actions, so she contracts V to deal with the situation and retrieve Norio alive for further studies of the illness if possible.

Just prior to facing V, Norio will be caught dealing with several Tyger Claws, presumedly the ones who had murdered Julia, in a corridor under renovation, utilising the construction framing to achieve advantage in stealth. Despite suffering mental disturbances, he will not immediately attack V, who doesn't belong to his hit list. Instead he will warn V to leave, and then attempt running away.

The evacuation failed due to an organised ambush at the exit of the passage, so Norio had to deal with multiple gang members at the same time, without the practice of his methods or stealth. V must thread carefully here while fighting the Tyger Claws, since if Norio suffers too much damage, it may not be possible to take him in alive.

Finally, upon being pacified, Regina will bring up a piece of V's message on not giving into the "air of murder" and explain it by paraphrasing Erich Fromm's book "Zen Buddhism and Psychoanalysis" - if someone masters their art of fighting, they'd be able to sense danger before it arrives. Unfortunately for the Tyger Claws, they were not that skilled to begin with and suffered accordingly.

Abilities

Associated Quests

*Cyberpsycho Sighting: Phantom of Night City

Shards
*Archived Conversation: Julia Lee and Norio Akuhara
*Archived Conversation: Norio Akuhara and Dr. Colin Thevenaz

Trivia
*In Theravada, a major branch of Buddhism, Sota means flowing water or water of river or stream.
*"Akki" translated in this case stands for "evil demon" (悪鬼).
*Norio Akuhara's story bears a heavy resemblance to the story of Spike from Cowboy Bebop. He also shares his first name with the Japanese voice actor for Vicious.

## North Oak (2077)
- type：Sub-district
- city：Night City
- district：Westbrook
- gangs：See Gangs

引文：Designed for the super rich: North Oak area, the one area in Night City where gardeners are constantly busy to make it so that plants can grow. North Oak residence use intricate neo-kitsch patterns in their grass that require a lot of money to maintain. Of course, this area is all about showing off to your neighbors :-)

North Oak is one of the sub-districts of Westbrook, located in eastern Night City.

Overview
North Oak is the newest part of Night City. It's the exclusive residential district, free from the poverty and gangs that plague the city. More than 50 years ago, there was nothing here than arid hills framing the north-eastern border of Night City. After the nuke Incident and the destruction of the Arasaka Towers complex, it became the site of temporary refugee camps and favelas for the next 25 years.

This situation persisted until the early 2050s, when the NC government, backed by the megacorporations, decided to clear the area by force. Proclaimed as a "war against crime" by the corporate-owned media, this action became a synonym of corporate brutality and prejudice. The North Oak favelas were pacified and razed by corporate developers, and in a few years the area became the most prized part of Night City. Years of the ongoing corporate-media campaign eventually watered down and finally hushed the whole incident, not only to avoid negative PR, but to raise land value. Many rich individuals were initially reluctant to buy land where some dirty homeless folk had once lived.

These days that history is all but forgotten, and North Oak is home to the untouchable elite: corporate CEOs, hedge fund managers, and investment bankers, but also to the various showbiz figures: BD producers and stars, media personalities and musicians.

Most people are not welcomed here, and private security is tight. I had to rent an aerial vehicle just to catch a glimpse of the famous district. The area consists of vast estates, some of them with their own micro-biome and artificially created landscape. Both the Arasaka Estate and Kerry Eurodyne's villa are within North Oak, because here it doesn't matter whether you're a corporate owner or a renegade rockerboy, the only thing that matters is how wealthy you are. Every Night City citizen dreams of living here.

Database Entry

- transcript：North Oak is the newest district in Night City. It's also the richest. Freedom from poverty and gangs - now that's what you call luxury. It's hard to believe, but fifty years ago this was just a rocky hill hemming the city in from the northeast. After the nuclear bomb went off at Arasaka Tower, almost eight thousand desperate Night Citizens moved to higher ground, putting up corrugated tin roofs and á la shantytown. Over the next few years, the hill became something of an independent district - its poverty and duct-taped houses a grim reminder of the past. Finally, in the 50s, the Night City council - sponsored by corporations - decided to do some spring cleaning, officially waging a "War against crime." The North Oak slum was forcefully evacuated and bulldozed, only to boast the city's priciest real estate soon after. Today North Oak houses the city's wealthiest elite: corpo execs, venture capitalists, actors, musicians living next door to their producers and rock stars such as Kerry Eurodyne. All of North Oak is dotted with spacious villas featuring their own microclimates and manicured lawns. North Oak is the city's very own Elysium and every Night Citizen's dream neighborhood.

Locations

*Arasaka Estate
*Chram Denya Jinja
*Denny's Mansion
*Impala Automatics
*North Oak Casino & Country Club
*North Oak Columbarium

*Silver Pixel Cloud

Notable Residents
*Denny
*Kerry Eurodyne
*Lizzy Wizzy
*Richard Flint

Notable Gangs

Behind the Scenes

引文：In 2077, green is the new gold. Nothing grows unless you shower it with eurodollars. A bonsai tree on your balcony is like a luxurious watch on your wrist today: an attempt to subtly let everyone know you're rich. An entire forest in your backyard? Like carving your name and net worth on the Moon. North Oak is all about such mind-boggling displays of wealth, but the Night Citizens who gape at them from the districts below are only the lesser part of the intended audience. Mostly, the outrageous villas and exotic menageries are intended to cow peers and rivals during invitation-only soirees. Though their effect on visitors is carefully calculated, North Oak villas do not neglect the needs of their owners. After a hard day hoarding wealth in the austere surroundings of City Center, corporate titans find repose in the soothing contours and natural materials of their homes. From infinity pools atop mansions designed by star architects, surrounded by space-harvested metals and organically-bred pets, they take in a curated view of the city in all its varied splendor, knowing they are its masters. Care is taken to blend North Oak's small army of security agents and automated defense systems into the landscape, but some walls and checkpoints stand out nevertheless. Likewise, there is no hiding the ugly brown badlands that abut the estates, or the smoky hellscapes of the oil fields just visible on the horizon.

Notes
*North Oak is clearly inspired after the 2020 Westbrook and the 2045 Executive Zone.

The North Oak Casino & Country Club is a luxury hotel & casino located on the hills of North Oak, in the Westbrook district of northeastern Night City.

Overview
The hotel, casino and country club is a place for the wealthiest in Night City to gather, party and play. Normally, the premises are only accessible via AV, but there is a tunnel in the southwestern portion of the perimeter that leads back to the rest of North Oak, though in 2077 it is closed for maintenance or construction work.

It advertises as an exclusive experience with additional services such as dinning, golf courses, swimming pools and spa areas.

引文：You are standing in a place of eternal rest. Lightning candles and spray painting are strictly forbidden.（Columbarium's speaker）

The North Oak Columbarium is located on the southern hills of North Oak, in the Westbrook district of northeastern Night City. It is a large series of columbarium structures containing the cremated remains of thousands of local residents.

Overview

Around the 2040s in-ground burial became illegal in Night City, as such, the Council built a collection of structures in Charter Hill to inter the cremains of the dead, especially after scavengers kept robbing graves for the cyberware implants. The Tombstone Preservers, who had a campsite nearby, maintained this area secure.

Citizens can be interred, by the choice of themselves or their loved ones, and will be assigned a position where their respective funerary urn will be located. Many residents of Night City travel to the columbarium to pay their respects to family, friends, loved ones, and other notable people interred. The niches are usually marked with a signifying symbol, be it the logo of the interred's work, or something related to them. Open to everybody, the columbarium is guarded by Arasaka security turrets, and holds strict rules whereas lighting candles and spray painting are not permitted. Speakers in English, Japanese, Chinese and Spanish remind visitors of these rules.

## Northeast
Northeast is a region of the United States of America.

Overview
Formed after The Collapse, the Northeast is made up of the states of Connecticut, Delaware, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, and Vermont.

History
For a long time, in fact for most of this country's history, the Northeast has considered itself the heart and soul of the United States. What was fashionable in New York City was fashionable everywhere. If it wasn't New England lobster, it wasn't any good. Everyone watched the New Year roll in at Madison Square Garden.

Sadly, more than fashion was exported from the East Coast. Drugs, crime, pop psychotherapy, gangs, poverty, and a Kitty Jones mentality seeped from the northeastern urban blight like leakage from a toxic waste tank. People got used to, and even claimed to prefer, the mercury-laden atmosphere, the two-hour lemming commutes, and the high-rise closets renting for $2500 per month. By the time the rest of America realized they didn't want the New England metropolitan heritage, it was too late, and many other cities, like Detroit and Los Angeles, were already spiraling down into their own urban nightmares.

Although the United States at large was beginning to realize that the northeastern urban lifestyle was nothing to look up to, it wasn't until the Collapse that the country divorced itself from the Manhattan dream and got on with pursuing their own destinies. During the darkest years since the Great Depression, the New England states were cut adrift.

So what did the average New Englander do?

If possible, he left. No surprise, really. By the time of the Collapse in 1996, the entire eastern seaboard had been turned into a battle zone. Hunger, homelessness, civic bankruptcy, public service strikes, and racial tensions had been endemic in the New England cities, and riots and violence had become the rule of the day. When the Collapse hit, the loss of jobs stripped most people of any reason to stay in the region. Those who could moved, bringing one last export from the Northeast to the rest of the country: lots of unemployed and homeless people.

The Collapse also cut down the arcologies in their infancy; they were the Northeast's last gasp at remaining in the van of American culture. Designed as new model cities, the arcologies were an urbanite's dream come true. Giant crystalline domed cities, protected from the acid rains and harsh winter storms, the arcos were designed for accessibility, beauty and comfort, and to ensure that a high standard of living was available to each resident.

The Northeast also suffers from acid rain, rampant corruption, industrial waste, and an urban/rural dichotomy. It has been washed to the wayside by the tides of the last twenty years, and it doesn't look like it will be recovering soon. Although the Northeast is the largest region in terms of number of states, it is, politically speaking, down at the bottom of the power pole, grubbing around in the mud along with Dixie and, to a lesser extent, the West.

The Seaboard Cooperative
Since the separation of Northern California from Southern California, there has been a movement in the less urbanized states to separate themselves from the rest of the Northeast Region. Maine, New Hampshire and Vermont have vocal minorities loo king for regional repartitioning, or perhaps even secession to Canada. Thus far, the rest of the Northeast Region has been able to prevent their withdrawal.

They have, however, formed a cooperative alliance for mutual support and, not so incidentally, against any possible depravations by outsiders. This is the Seaboard Cooperative, and this is what many would like to see as a new region. As popular support for the Seaboard Cooperative rises in New York State (the remainder of which is largely rural), regional recognition becomes more and more likely.

Maine, New Hampshire and Vermont are practically the only states left in the nation that are neither polluted, urbanized, nor co-opted by agribusiness. As such, they have an immediate interest in preserving that status, and through strict anti-Corporate legislation, they have managed to do so. This has also had the effect of ostracizing them from the technical revolution , giving the states (by most accounts) the lowest standard of living of any in the union. This does not particularly bother the residents, though, as they'd rather not have the extra money everyone else spends on guns, bikes, cybernetics and security. They'd rather hang out on their porches and watch the sun rise over the Atlantic.

One would think that laid-back rural attitudes like this would be crushed beneath the wheels of the twenty-first century. To obviate that possibility, the Seaboard cooperative has a large, well-armed joint police force. Everyone must serve 6000 hours (equivalent to six years part-time) on the Seaboard Police Corps, for which they receive a nominal pay. The semi-flexible hours allow everyone to keep their own life in order. These police have a vested interest in making sure that Nomads don't come burning through their territory, and they are well known as a hard group to tangle with. What they lack in streetwise experience they make up for in camaraderie; after all, practically every cop in a given area knows every other cop, and they don't take kindly to someone trying to scrag their neighbor.

Northeast Combined Operational Group

## Northern Oil Fields
- type：Oil fields
- owner：Petrochem
SovOil
Night Corp
- region：Badlands
- city：Night City outskirts
- appears_books：

The Northern Oil Fields (also known as the North Sunrise Oil Fields) are located on the northern Badlands of Night City.

History
1990s - 2025
In the the early 1990s, Petrochem bought the oil drilling rights for an area located near the township of Morro Bay, which extended into the neighboring sea. This occurred around the same time of the 1992 Morro Bay Massacre that devastated the township and other nearby settlements. Capitalizing of that event, businessman Richard Night patterned with Petrochem and other corporations to form the Coronado Partnership, taking ownership over the whole region surrounding Morro Bay and founding the metropolis of Coronado City in 1994 — later renamed to Night City. While the city was being constructed, Petrochem established a number of oil fields to the north. With no regulations to stop the megacorporation, they occupied a sizable landmass that was soon filled with oil rigs and extractors that extended into the bay itself. Petrochem also built a refinery terminal on the coast of South Night City, where they transformed the oil into different products that were later shipped to other parts of the world. Although this investment never became a major venture for Petrochem, they enjoyed a decidedly relaxed regulatory framework. For these reasons, the company only maintained a small, but sizable office building in what would become the Corporate Plaza of Night City. The metropolis never relied heavily on the oil extraction, but it did contribute to its origins.

In the late 2000s, during the Second Corporate War, Petrochem leased a portion of their local oil fields to the North Californian-based corporation Prudhoe Pride Oil in order to raise funds for their war against SovOil, their NeoSoviet rival. The NorCal company built their refinery in the South City District as well. This deal continued well after the conflict, lasting until 2021, when SovOil managed to acquire Prudhoe Pride. Petrochem tried to terminate the lease, but SovOil insisted on an obscure clause buried deep within the contract that actually granted them full ownership on the leased proprieties. This tension could have led to a continuation of the Second Corporate War, but soon after, the global conflict between Militech and Arasaka interrupted them.

2025 - 2040s
At some point soon after the end of the Fourth Corporate War, Night Corp intervened between Petrochem and SovOil to broker an uneasy peace among both megacorporations. It was well known for all parties involved that the oil fields' resources would not last for long, so at that point any kind of conflict would not be for anything else other than pride. With that settled, Petrochem and SovOil continued their local operations, each using their own oil rigs in order to fully drain the fields.

By the 2040s, both megacorps had their large refineries in Night City at full throttle. Moreover, squabbles between Petrochem and SovOil rig crews at the fields were not uncommon, but these rarely went any further than some minor property damage and the occasional murdered worker.

2070s
By the 2070s, the blackened oil fields expanded on a large swath of land devoid of any life, with some parts inside Del Coronado Bay itself. The active oil drills could be seen from afar, though a few areas had long since been abandoned. These last ones were filled with run down barracks and disused rusted oil drills, giving visitors a ghostly impression of the place; especially during the night, as some oil puddles were lit up by flames that gave the surrounding area an eerie vibe. The smoke-filled and highly toxic fields were often seen as an irreparable scar that simply disfigured the face of Night City. A silent, but telling reminder of the metropolis' shady beginnings.

Database Entry

Behind the Scenes

引文：Though oil was never Night City's main economic driver, it still played a vital role in the city's history. Richard Night chose Coronado Bay as the location for his grand project in part because one of his corporate investors, Petrochem, already owned drilling rights to much of the land. The oil fields north of the city are both testimony and legacy to these insider deals. Pitch-black, smoke-filled and flooded with oil-tainted water, they present a stark contrast both to the dusty, oversaturated, sun-baked feel of other outer districts and the sanitized sheen of City Center visible on the horizon.

Notes
*Johnny Silverhand's lifeless body was said to have been tossed and buried in the oil fields around 2023, though this was never confirmed nor the body was ever found.

## Northside (2077)
- type：Sub-district
- city：Night City
- district：Watson
- gangs：See Gangs
- appears_books：

The Northside Industrial District (NID), or simply Northside, is one of the sub-districts of Watson, located in northern Night City.

Overview
Northside Industrial District (NID) was once Watson's prosperous factory sub-district. Nowadays its desolate and neglected, its factories are mostly non-functional and abandoned due to odd earthquake damage and a lack of investments by Japanese corporations that originally financed this area.

New apartments blocks were built on the edge of the district to hide it from the rest of Night City. They're home to mid-level employees who manage the few operational factories in this area.

Still people need to live here. Many have come here looking for opportunity and a new life. They got a big chance to work in the factory, and now they are stuck in limbo. Some other residents of the NID are much worse. The Maelstrom claim this area as their territory. They use its abandoned buildings as hideouts, illegal braindance studios, and warehouses for the loot they steal from the corporate transports.

Database Entry

- transcript：The Northside Industrial District (NID) was once an important area of Watson with factories employing thousands of Night Citizens. Today it feels neglected and devoid of life. Most of the factories shut down, parts of buildings were damaged by earthquakes and property developments left unfinished. The center of the NID is divided by a row of towering apartment buildings, purposely constructed to shield the wealthy from a pretty depressing view. They're occupied by mid-ranking workers that are still employed by the last remaining industries operating in the NID. With few prospects to cling to, these workers' only hope is that they don't close down, because outside of the NID, there's no future for them. As they say, "You move to northside, you'll die in northside." Often that's just interpreted to mean you'll catch a stray bullet from one the ubiquitous Maelstromers.

Behind the Scenes

引文：In an earlier period, the Northside Industrial District was the workshop of Night City, a mini-Manchesterian cluster of mills abutting the metropolis' heart. Its factories gave jobs to thousands and pumped out the goods that brought in the city's wealth. Now, factories and workers alike have been outclassed and abandoned, leaving behind a skeleton of smokestacks as souvenirs. The buildings are Entropic in form—simple, boxy and horizontal—with tacked-on Kitsch graffiti and advertisements. A wide road winds amongst them and a massive AV hangar fills a whole block—an impressive hub dating from the district's glory days. Yet while one can pass through with relative ease, those left living here have it hard, working eighteen-hour days in the few factories still operational and carving out a life in the rubble with the time that remains.

## O'Neill Colonies
- caption：Typical O'Neill colony
- type：Space stations
- owner：European Space Council
Highrider Confederation
- location：Earth-Moon Lagrange points
- appears_books：

The O'Neill Colonies are three gigantic space stations located at the Earth-Moon Lagrange points, in stable positions around both celestial bodies.

Overview
During the construction of the Crystal Palace at L-1, the European Space Agency planned the O'Neill Colonies as the second step in space colonization. The location chosen was the rest of the Lagrange points (L-2 through 5) around the Earth and the Moon, which occupied stable positions and made them the perfect place for long-duration, self-sustained colonies.

Named after the late space advocate pioneer Gerard K. O'Neill and based on his ideas, these stations were concepted to be built along a cylindrical plan and were about 16–30 km long, and 6–8 km wide. They were composed of lunar rock and metal framing, and the whole interior surface was to be covered in earth, with waterways and huge windows that allowed sunlight to enter.

The first construction was a much smaller technology testbed version built at the Lagrange point 2 behind the Moon, which would later serve as a spacecraft construction and maintenance depot. O'Neill One became the first of these habitat colonies, beginning construction in 2010 and finalizing in 2016. It was followed by the smaller O'Neill Two (2011 - 2017) and the O'Neill Three (2011 - 2018), which was as big as the first one.

Both O'Neill One and Two gained their independence from the ESA in 2022.

O'Neill Colonies
*O'Neill One - Located in L-5. Part of the Highrider Confederation.
*O'Neill Two (Galileo Cylinder) - Located in L-3. Part of the Highrider Confederation.
*O'Neill Three (Paradise Station) - Located in L-4. Owned by the European Space Agency.
*O'Neill Testbed - Located in L-2. Owned by the European Space Agency.

Trivia
*These colonies are based on the O'Neill cylinder.

## O'Neill One
- caption：Typical O'Neill colony
- aka：O'Neill 1
- type：Space station
- owner：Highrider Confederation
ESA (formerly)
- location：Earth-Moon L-5
- population：≈20,000 (2025)
- appears_books：

The O'Neill One is a space station located at the Earth-Moon Lagrange point 5, in a stable position not far from the Earth.

History
During the construction of the Crystal Palace, the European Space Agency planned the O'Neill Colonies as the second step in space colonization. These stations were concepted to be built along a cylindrical plan composed of lunar rock and metal framing, with the whole interior surface covered in earth, and with waterways and huge windows that allowed sunlight to enter.

The first of these habitat colonies was the O'Neill One, which began construction at the Lagrange point 5 in 2010 and was finalized in 2016. This space station behemoth was 33 km long and more than 8 km wide.

In 2019, there was a massive revolt by the highrider ESA colony workers due to overcrowding and the very harsh conditions they were treated. The workers, who made up the majority of the population and saw the O'Neill One as their home, managed to expel their superiors from the space station. The ESA didn't recognize their independence, and not long after, this event caused the equally sized sister colony of O'Neill Three to be placed under martial law.

In 2022, during the Fourth Corporate War, the stations and satellites in close orbit to Earth suffered tremendously. Many highriders were forced to leave and travel to the more secure O'Neill colonies, causing the space habitats to exceed their rated capacity. At the same time, the ESA and Orbital Air began restricting flights to space due to the hazards of the war. The highriders protested for their need to resupply and evacuation of refugees and tourists, but neither space organization provided any support.

In September of that same year, another revolt in the smaller O'Neill Two caused by these events ended with the colony declaring their independence, leading them into a full-on conflict against the ESA. This endeavor was soon supported by their fellow companions at the O'Neill One. Known as the Seven Hour War for its length, the highriders used deltas and mass drivers to attack key sites on Earth. The damage caused by them was enough for governments to recognize their independence, forcing the ESA to officially prescind from both O'Neill One and Two, leading to the creation of the first nation outside of Earth, the Highrider Confederation.

The Galileo Cylinder (also known as O'Neill Two) is a space station located at the Earth-Moon Lagrange point 3, in a stable position not far from the Earth.

History
During the construction of the Crystal Palace, the European Space Agency planned the O'Neill Colonies as the second step in space colonization. These stations were concepted to be built along a cylindrical plan composed of lunar rock and metal framing, with the whole interior surface covered in earth, and with waterways and huge windows that allowed sunlight to enter.

O'Neill Two was the second of these habitat colonies and began construction at the Lagrange point 3 in 2011. Upon completion in 2017, it was given the name of Galileo Cylinder. This space station was smaller compared to the older sister colony of O'Neill One, at around 16 km long and 6 km wide.

In 2022, during the Fourth Corporate War, the stations and satellites in close orbit to Earth suffered tremendously. Many highriders were forced to leave and travel to the more secure O'Neill colonies, causing the space habitats to exceed their rated capacity. At the same time, the ESA and Orbital Air began restricting flights to space due to the hazards of the war. The highriders protested for their need to resupply and evacuation of refugees and tourists, but neither space organization provided any support.

Finally, in September of that same year, the highriders at O'Neill Two had enough and declared their independence, leading the colony into a full-on conflict against the ESA. This endeavor was soon supported by their fellow companions at the O'Neill One. Known as the Seven Hour War for its length, the highriders used deltas and mass drivers to attack key sites on Earth. The damage caused by them was enough for governments to recognize their independence, forcing the ESA to officially prescind from both O'Neill stations, leading to the creation of the first nation outside of Earth, the Highrider Confederation.

In 2077, a solar storm temporarily blinded the radar systems around Galileo, allowing a group of thieves to sneakily dock with the station. They proceeded to breach into an Orbital Air laboratory and steal millions of eurodollars worth of experimental prototypes. The ESA offered a generous reward to anyone willing to assist them in apprehending the thieves.

Biography
Ofelia is a member of the Maelstrom gang, going by the name "Patricia". She warned then-Maelstrom leader Brick of a member named Royce, who she calls a "feral animal", urging Brick to shoot him in the back of his head. In 2077, Patricia acted as contact between Brick and Militech employee Anthony Gilchrist, who started to secretly collaborate with the gang to provide them with details about Militech convoys in order to steal the shipments and get a cut of the profits after selling the goods. Royce would later take over Maelstrom, locking Brick up in a cell.

:Patricia is at the entrance of the Totentanz club and will begrudgingly escort V to Brick. She will stand in front of Brick and frustratingly question his methods until he rebukes her. She quietly sits back and lets Brick and Nancy Hartley finish their business.

:Patricia assumed leadership of Maelstrom. She escorts V to Nancy, whom she had kidnapped and beaten as she believed the media had been reporting to Maelstrom's enemies. Patricia thanks V for getting rid of Royce and making it easier for her to take control of the gang. She and her Maelstromer posse then attack V, who is forced to kill or incapacitate them and escape Totentanz with Nancy.

## Off the Leash (quest)
Off the Leash is a Side Job in .

Walkthrough
V gets a call from Kerry Eurodyne, who invites them to the Dark Matter—an exclusive club in Japantown. When V arrives at the entrance, there is a bouncer blocking the elevator's door, claiming that it is "out of order". V tells the bouncer that he is Kerry Eurodyne's guest and the bouncer grants them access.

:During the phone call with Kerry, V learns that Us Cracks has reneged on their promise to not perform a cover version of Kerry Eurodyne’s song User Friendly and that the band is seeking a restraining order against Eurodyne.

:The Dark Matter is all but empty, and Kerry mentions that he closed the club.

:As V enters the lounge, a promotional event is in full swing. In the scene, packed with fans and journalists, there is initially an anime video about Us Cracks and Kerry displaying on the screen. After the screen raises, Us Cracks and Kerry appear on stage and announce that they are collaborating on a new single. A reporter says that Kerry is "on top of his game" and asks Kerry how the collaboration came to be, to which Kerry replies that rock is once more evolving, adding that Us cracks are "energizing" and "electrifying" and wanted to work on a new song with Kerry. The reporter notes that Kerry's depression is a thing of the past and Kerry denies that he was ever depressed or thought about retiring. Likewise, Us Cracks are full of praise for Kerry, and Blue Moon says that meeting Kerry was "Doki doki. Love at first sight".

:V can approach them by walking through the room among the fans. Kerry will beckon V to come. After V goes there, Kerry lays his arm on V's shoulder and introduces V to the journalists as his "right hand". One of them will ask V what it is like to hang out with Kerry Eurodyne, and V can choose whether to answer. Then Kerry will ask V to leave the scene with him. Before V leaves, they can talk to Us Cracks about the event.

:Kerry introduces V to Spector Cheng, who promises Kerry to give V a "friends and family" discount. Kerry then leads V to the balcony on the building. V and Kerry will talk about his life and career. If V chooses to hear Kerry out, Kerry will eventually admit that he hasn’t been honest with V regarding the Us Cracks situation. Kerry reveals that the real reason why he was uncomfortable with Us Cracks performing a cover version of one of his songs was not that Kerry was afraid of becoming a puppet for corporations. What Kerry really was afraid of was being in someone else’s shadow again just like he had been in Johnny Silverhand's shadow during the Samurai years.

:V is able to kiss Kerry Eurodyne and start a romance event. After kissing, Kerry Eurodyne will stay at the rooftop a little while longer to think.

:V is able to attempt to kiss Kerry Eurodyne, but he politely declines V's attempts, as he prefers male company instead.

V heads back down with the elevator, and departs the club.

Journal Entry
:You know, Kerry's whole escapade makes me think. People do change. He did, I mean - he made it to a crossroads, and now I can see his rockerboy heart pushing him down the right path. The problem, you ask? Kerry might've changed, but the city hasn't. And I think he knows it. Hell, so do you.

Objectives
*Go to the given address.
*Talk to the bouncer.
*Look for Kerry.
*If there's a party at the club:
**Wait for Kerry.
**Talk to Kerry.
*Follow Kerry.
*Talk to Kerry.

 Trivia

* Kerry's introduction of Spector as "An old friend. Met him walkin' in Memphis, off Beale, ages ago," is likely an a reference to Marc Cohn's 1991 song [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Walking_in_Memphis Walking in Memphis].

The Maglev Tunnel of Pacifica is located underneath the Serenity Bible Church in Coastview. The Voodoo Boys use it as a hideout.

Overview
This area is an old abandoned train tunnel which was once part of the transcontinental Maglev Network operated by Planetran. Just like the Net, after the Fourth Corporate War the maglev network crumbled. In the following decades, these tunnels would be used by the homeless and various gangs.

At some point between the mid-late 2060s and the early 2070s, the Voodoo Boys turned this section of the tunnels into a hideout from which they accessed the Net. By breaking a basement wall, they were able to access the tunnels from the Pacifica Serenity Bible Church.

Night Corp, who had taken ownership of the old maglev network around Night City, has plans to revitalize the system by 2078. It is unknown whether the old tunnels beneath Pacifica will be part of their new infrastructure in the future.

## One Way or Another
One Way or Another is a Side Job in .

Walkthrough
This quest only becomes available if Nele Springer was saved from Biotechnica and left in amicable terms with V during Gig: Roads to Redemption. After a few days, you will receive a message from Nele's number asking V to meet her at the designated coordinate within Dogtown.

The mission marker will lead to a closed shipping container, where another message will arrive from Nele stating that she is inside. Opening it will set off a flashbang grenade, blinding you as a small group of mercenaries in the employ of Biotechnica attacks. Defeat all of the mercenaries in order to complete the job.

:Hm, chick's up to somethin'. Hate to break it to ya, but nobody's coming back to Dogtown just to see you. Still, if she wants a meet, fine – use it, get some answers. Just keep your eyes peeled... for both our sakes.

## Only Pain
Only Pain is a Side Job in .

Walkthrough

V stumbles across three NCPD patrolmen, Corey Aldwyn, Keegan Kelly, and William Becker, beating up a man in an alley, but the situation is not all that it appears. V can intervene by speaking with Officer Aldwyn. V can choose to demand that the officers leave the man alone, which turns them hostile, or turn a blind eye and walk away.

If V has a Streetkid background, they have an additional dialogue option to learn more about the beaten man's circumstances. The man, Nigel Hamilton, is a wealthy corpo who showed an XBD to a girl that put her into a coma. That woman happened to be the daughter of one of Aldwyn's friends, and Aldwyn was taking justice into his own hands since Hamilton's status meant he was going to avoid being charged with a crime. V can then persuade the officers to leave peacefully by volunteering to deal with Hamilton for them.

However the officers are handled, V must then wake and confront Hamilton, leaving the area at this point causes the job to fail. In addition to immediately letting Hamilton go, V can also dig deeper or force him to pay for the help.

 V can demand payment. Hamilton hands over €$2280. V then has two more options, either of which will conclude the side job:
*Let Hamilton go.
*If V has 5 Body, they can demand all of Hamilton's money. Hamilton gives up an extra €$2660.

 V can ask Hamilton to tell the truth about what the cops wanted from him. He will claim to not know and insinuate he was attacked for no reason. V then has two more options, either of which will conclude the side job:
*Let Hamilton go.
*If V has 13 Cool, they can demand money. Hamilton pays €$2280.
**If V has 5 Body, they can demand all of Hamilton's money. Hamilton gives up an extra €$2660.

 V can mention that they know Hamilton is showing spiked XBDs to people. Hamilton will confess that he is aware the XBDs are harmful, and he showed one to the girl deliberately. V then has two more options, either of which will conclude the side job:
*Let Hamilton go.
*If V has 13 Cool, they can demand money. Hamilton pays €$2280.
**If V has 5 Body, they can demand all of Hamilton's money. Hamilton gives up an extra €$2660.
V can also kill Hamilton which will also result in the job being completed. Looting his corpse after extorting "everything" from him will result in even more money, indicating Hamilton lied about handing over everything he had.

Journal Entry
:"To serve and protect..." Funny, would've thought "To extort and torture" might fit better. Not sure what this guy's beef is with badges, but if you don't step in, they'll be scrapin' him off the sidewalk. Once they smear him there first, of course. But I dunno... maybe it's for the best? After all, no one's in Night City's dyin' an innocent soul.

Objectives
*Defeat the cops.
*Wake the corpo.
*Talk to the corpo.

Trivia
*The quest is named after Only Pain, a song from the Magma album by Gojira.

Organitopia is a museum located in the Terra Cognita technological park of Dogtown, in the Pacifica district of southern Night City.

Overview
Organitopia is an abandoned natural history museum which was part of the abandoned Terra Cognita technology park. It consists of two exhibition halls, which showcase the natural world, including live plants and fossils.

The complex is entered through a hole in a garage door of the lower hall, which is an abandoned, lush greenhouse showcasing tropical plants such as breadfruit. The hall patrolled by Russian Scavengers in the employ of Boris Ribakov.

At the far side of the hall is a room with a stairwell that leads to the main hall, which exhibits fossilized skeletons of the dinosaur Tyrannosaurs, and the marine reptile Mosasaur, overlaid with a hologram depicting the animals as they appeared in-life. Boris Ribakov is holed up in this hall and V must fight him to get access to Katya Karelina, who is hiding in a secret room as part of the Gig: Spy in the Jungle.

The pool inside the exhibition is connected via a tunnel to one of the rooms locked behind a door requiring authorization.

Associated Quests
*Gig: Spy in the Jungle

The Organization of American States is a federation of independent states, comprising Central and South America.

History
1990s - 2010
The First Central American War took place from 1990 to 1994, the conflict evolved the US invading the nations of Panama, Nicaragua, Honduras, and El Salvador. The Panama Canal treaty had expired, and the Canal was reverted back under the control of the Panamanian Government. The US sent military forces to Panama to retake the Canal, citing national defense issues. A guerilla war began over the Honduran and Nicaraguan borders. A full-scale war began as the US sent large units equipped with heavy machinery into combat, where they unsuccessfully tried to chase down guerrilla units. The conflict was Inconclusive; the US forces withdrew from Central America save for the Panama Canal Zone.

The Second Central American War took place on January 15, 2003 and lasted till 2010. The US invaded Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, and Venezuela. The War was a complete disaster which costed thousands of American lives. The war turned into a struggle for domination of the rest of the hemisphere, with the US pouring almost all of its military force into it, and the European corporations providing aid, training, equipment and money to the indigenous armies resisting the invasion. During this refugees from South America began pouring into Japan, the refugees were originally of Japanese decent who returned to their families original homeland after the devastations of the Central American wars. The US eventually gave up and the war ended.

2020s
After a series of wars with the United States, the Central American nations, under a pact of mutual cooperation, emerged as a strong coalition. US influence was driven out of Central America, other than the Panama Canal Zone, which had managed to continue holding out against fierce guerrilla aggression.

In South America, Brazil, Argentina and Chile became the de facto rulers of the OAS, after expelling the US following the Central American Wars. The OAS continued to hold its place as a major world power, on the same level as the European Economic Community.

Aftermath of the 4th Corporate War
In the time of the 4th Corporate War, nationalist groups in Brazil and Colombia used the opportunities given to them to further expand their borders and influence, resulting in the splitting of the previous alliance that was just beginning to be rebuilt. However, the O.A.S rallied soon after, and with the help of Argentina and a new democratic Brazil, they begun rebuilding their cities and established new trade relations, especially with the highriders and the nomads.

Oriona was a mercenary in Night City. She is one of the main characters in the comic series, and has a cameo appearance in .

Biography

Oriona was born to Aarno and Teresa, growing up in their home in the Badlands, on the outskirts of Night City. At some point she became pregnant and had a daughter, Wayra. Determined to find a better life for her daughter, Oriona became a mercenary to gain eddies and leave NC for good.

While her parents stayed in the Badlands taking care of Wayra, Oriona went to Night City to find gigs. At some point started dating Alina Homma, who worked at Militech. She befriended Kyle J. and Arthur Cormac, who joined her as partners. The three of them were hired by a Valentino known as El Sombrerón, who wanted to expose a man named Jack Lars, a councilman who had been bought out by Militech.

After searching for more information about their target by assaulting one of his locations, Oriona went to a diner in the Badlands, where her mother Teresa worked. During their small talk, Oriona got a holocall from Kyle, who had collected more intel about Lars. She then left in a hurry.

Once at the meeting point, Oriona waited under the rain for about half an hour, freezing and getting angry that Kyle was taking its time. Finally a car appeared, and the driver shouted her name. The merc approached the vehicle—infuriated by waiting—and shouted at the driver to unlock the door. The car's side window was lowered and a voice told her they knew everything, and pulled out a gun to shoot her in the head. She had been betrayed by Cormac, who had sold her out to El Sombrerón so that he could find his sister and Oriona's mother, Teresa.

Osaka (Japanese: 大阪市) is a designated city in the Kansai region of Japan. It is the capital city of Osaka Prefecture and the largest component of the Keihanshin metropolitan area, the second largest metropolitan area in Japan and among the largest in the world with more than 31 million inhabitants.

Overview
Osakans are considered closer to Americans by other Japanese cities, since they speak their mind. Osaka is known for upcoming Rockerboy and Media talent, as well as comedians. A lot of foreign companies moved their offices here as they found Tokyo unwelcoming of them. It’s also the headquarters of the Yakuza.

Osaka expanded throughout the Fourth Corporate War as the city saw no loss from it, while cities such as Tokyo struggled. During this time, Osaka was a peaceful city with lots of new Cyberware breakthroughs being made. During these years, Hanako Arasaka spent most of her time in here away from the war.

In 2077, the up-and-coming light heavyweight Kazuo Kano, a ronin from Osaka, remained undefeated after twenty professional fights, seventeen of which were won by technical knockout. Some accused Kano of doping, others say he had connections with the Yakuza. Wide scars had been visible near Kano's ribs for his last three fights. Local ripperdocs said that the scars definitely do not look like an appendix removal procedure. Many anticipated whether or not he would become the next light heavyweight champion of the world.
