Taylor Gibbs is a character in .

Biography
Gibbs is a former nomad and friend of Jacob Long.

Originally part of a nomad family, he betrayed his clan to the Raffen Shiv at Tipton Peak resulting in the former's slaughter. By 2077, he is a resident of Dogtown who joined Jacob Long in trying to steal an airdrop from BARGHEST, despite having a bad feeling about it. While going up the abandoned hotel with Long on Elizabeth Kress street to get a good vantage point, Long and Gibbs unknowingly stumble upon V and President Rosalind Myers hiding out in the Kress Street Hideout.

:V and President Myers negotiate with Long and Gibbs, they will ask for enough money to escape Dogtown and live comfortably. Myers accepts their terms on the condition that they help her and V to keep the place secure. After sleeping, Gibbs tells V that Myers is waiting for them, and tells them that Long has gone outside to see where an upcoming airdrop will land.

:
::While V meets with Solomon Reed, a BARGHEST unit investigates the Elizabeth Kress street hideout after having found the security recordings. During this investigation, Taylor Gibbs and Jacob Long are both killed by the BARGHEST unit, leaving their bodies in the foyer of the hotel.

:
::Some time later, Solomon Reed will cryptically tell V that Taylor Gibbs and Jacob Long were dealt with.

:Jacob and Taylor are neutralized by Myers and V.

Abilities

Associated Quests
*Lucretia My Reflection

Associated Shards

Notes
*If V decides to negotiate with Long and Gibbs, their fate is ambiguous after the events of Lucretia My Reflection, as Reed messages V mentioning that they have been "taken care of" and not to worry about them again. Nevertheless, based on President Myers' notes it appears she did intend to honor the deal, noting she needed to wire an anonymous payment to "J & T".

The RT-46 Burya is a Tech Revolver manufactured by Techtronika in .

Characteristics
The Burya is a 4 shot, double-action revolver, outfitted with an electromagnetic barrel capable of firing charged rounds that can penetrate cover. It comes with a holographic iron sight as standard. Contrary to other Tech weapons, the rounds do not split up.

It is not possible to install either a Scope or Muzzle attachment.

Database Entry

- transcript：The Burya belongs in a museum as a benchmark for Soviet design. Is it pretty to look at? No. Convenient to use? Nope. Safe? Nuh-uh. But effective? Abso-fucking-lutely. The RT-46 is an electromag pistol that can blast through walls and is practically as dense as a neutron star. On top of that, it doesn't need to be charged – it can be fired at any time. To use it and survive, advanced musculoskeletal cyberware is advised. But even if someone without the recommended implants does manage to lift the Burya, pulling the trigger would almost guarantee a broken elbow... or worse.

The SPT32 Grad is a Power Sniper Rifle manufactured by Techtronika in .

Characteristics
The Grad is a left-handed, bolt-action sniper rifle, manufactured in the Soviet Union. Like most Techtronika weapons, its damage output is devastating, offset by its slow fire rate, low ammunition capacity, and long reload time. Supposedly produced in a limited series of 300 for the exclusive use of Soviet intelligence, it has nonetheless appeared in Night City and in the hands of American military veterans.

The weapon is classified as a heavy weapon, reducing the user's movement speed and jump height while using the weapon.

The Grad comes equipped with a Militech HPO Kanone MAX Mk.77 Sniper Scope that can be replaced but not removed. It is not possible to install a Muzzle attachment.

Database Entry

- transcript：Around the turn of the 21st century, the arms industry faced a pressing challenge. Many popular sniper rifles were increasingly proving ineffective against people heavily modified with cyberware. A shot that would once kill an ordinary person now only makes a dent. The world required a new generation of sniper rifles. The first of this new wave was the Soviet-made SPT32 Grad, considered by many to be the most powerful sniper on the market. It may not possess the same dedication to detail as its counterparts from Arasaka or Militech, but in the hands of a well-trained sharpshooter who doesn't rely on weapon-assisted wind readings, the Grad is a true devastating force. No wall will stop it from hitting its target.

## Ted's Farm
- type：Farmstead
- owner：Ted
- region：Badlands

Ted's Farm is located on Badlands of Night City.

History
This corn farmstead was bought by Ted, promising his wife Mary-Ann a place to build a future for themselves. Soon after, they had a daughter, Liz, who grew up there.

Over the following years, things got complicated, but the family tried to push through. In the end, Liz decided she didn't want to work neither at the farm nor at a nearby fuel station, stating she would leave for Night City. At some point, Ted had also sold his life experience as a braindance for DMS in order to provide for his family, but after his wife found out, she also left for Night City.

By the 2077, Ted was living alone in his farm, which was barely functioning, as most crops were dead and the place was mostly abandoned. Around this time, a merc by the name of Mirek visited the dying farmstead after having seen Ted's life from a braindance parlor in Night City. After encountering Ted, the old man told him how he had not seen his wife and daughter ever since they moved to NC. Ted offered to patch up Mirek's wounded arm in exchange for help in the farm. Following that, Ted gave Mirek a drink while telling him that his family wanted something else for their lives, but him, Ted had everything he would ever need at his farm.

Teresa (formerly Maria) was widely known in Night City by her street name La Llorona (English: The Weeping Woman).

Biography

Early life - 2040s
During the 2040s, La Llorona and her older brother El Sombrerón worked for El Norte Cartel as their enforcers, known widely as an assassin duo called "Los Carniceros de El Norte" ("El Norte's Butchers"). They became very infamous in Night City, with one half fearing their name, and the other wanting them dead.

In 2044, both were assigned as protectors to Theresa Valentino, who was running to become city manager of the Santo Domingo district. After her victory, the siblings officially became her bodyguards, with some wondering who their loyalties really lied with.

In 2047, Maria was ambushed by their enemies and lost her right arm. She took that opportunity to leave her criminal life behind and escape with her boyfriend, a Militech corporate called Aarno. Maria knew that if her brother found about him, he would kill him. Afterwards, they left the metropolis and she changed her name to Teresa. El Sombrerón found the severed right arm and presumed her dead. Soon after she had a funeral.

2050s - 2070s
At some point, Teresa and Aarno had a daughter they named Oriona. They lived in a trailer caravan somewhere in the Badlands.

Terra Cognita is an abandoned technological park located in Dogtown, in the Pacifica district of southern Night City.

Overview

Terra Cognita was established as a technological theme park set to open in June 10 of 2069. The Unification War, however, dried up any investment on this location, which ended up abandoned like the rest of Pacifica. After Serenisands became Dogtown, a number of scavenger groups occupied many of Terra Cognita's buildings.

Locations
Terra Cognita was planning to hold a number of exhibitions prior to its abandonment.

## Thailand
Thailand, officially the Kingdom of Thailand and formerly known as Siam, is a country at the center of the Southeast Asian Indochinese Peninsula composed of 76 provinces.

History
Following the Crash of '94, Thailand faced a dire economic crisis. To solve it, King Rama XXI decided to legalise the production of many things considered illegal in most other countries, such as drugs and smuggling. This successfully turned Thailand into a tourist and criminal hotspot.

Some time after, a bio-engineered plague created by the United States of America killed off all the legal opium fields in Thailand, and the Thai have hated the US ever since.

Government
Thailand has a British-style parliament with both a prime minister and a president, but the king is the one who opens parliament, oversees it, and signs laws with the president. Since they’re not an elected official, the king is free to back things that would be politically controversial.

Culture
The two most important things in Thai culture are the king, Rama XXI, and the Buddha. You can get away with most things in Thailand, but insulting either of them will likely result in you getting beaten up.

Economy
If someone somewhere else wants it, it can be found, made, and bought in Thailand. Fixers run guns to Laos for timber which they sell to the Japanese; they buy Myanmar gems from both the government and the rebels, and order to Vietnam for custom gadgets. Any type of sordid good time can be found here, and some of the best vaccine researchers in tie world are here trying to find cures for the diseases that go with good times. It's a giant open free market.

The official currency is the baht (B), but Eurodollars, New Yen, American Dollars, gold, barter, and anything else is acceptable. Haggling is a way of life, and is done for even the smallest things - Fixers are rife here, of course, and the competition is cutthroat due to the intense free market.

Theft is also common too. Razor artists (bag-slitters) and pickpockets are out in droves, and watch out for drugged food, though most Thaia are friendly.

Major Cities
* Bangkok

## The Beast In Me
The Beast In Me is a Side Job in .

Walkthrough
Sometime after completing Double Life, Afterlife bartender Claire Russell reaches out to V, offering them a job. She tells them that she needs help with some street races, and is looking for a driver, and since V is a reliable mercenary, she approached them. She asks that V meet with her in her garage on Valley street in Arroyo, Santo Domingo during the day.

As V enters the garage, they can hear Claire mumbling to herself about her car. She will slide out from under the vehicle, which she introduces to V as "Beast." As V asks about the race rules, Claire tells them that there aren't really any, other than that you race in pairs; a driver and a gunner. She tells V that she is more of a gearhead and a shooter than a driver, and that is why she needs one.

When V asks if she has raced before, Claire answers that she has, but that her previous driver passed away during a race a year ago.

:V accepts Claire's offer to be her driver during the street races. Claire says that there will be four races in total, and that the first one will start in the City Center district, followed by a race in the Badlands, then Santo Domingo, and a final round in Westbrook. When asked about a payout, Claire tells V that first place will receive some prize money, that they'll split equally. She will also tell V that the decision about which vehicle they will enter with is up to V.

As a final bit of information, she informs V that in order to qualify for the Watson final, they will have to qualify in the top three in at least two of the races. She asks V to wait for her call and meet her at the first race in City Center.

:V declines Claire's offer to be her driver during the street races–despite her efforts to convince them–and forfeits the job.

City Center Race

In the morning of the following day, Claire will text V with the coordinates to the first race held in City Center. The race will start on Martin Luther King Boulevard and Skyline East in Vista del Rey, and go through Corpo Plaza to the finish on the Wellsprings Docks in Wellsprings.

Badlands Race

Two days after participating in the City Center race, Claire will contact V again, this time to give them the the coordinates for the second race on Brooklands street in the Laguna Bend Reservoir, Badlands. For this race, Claire demands that they use her "Beast" instead of V's vehicle, as she wants to test it out in the field.

Santo Domingo Race

A day after competing in the Badlands race, V is contacted by Claire once again, this time for the final qualifying race in Santo Domingo. She tells V to go to Brandon and Wollesen Street in Arroyo. Unlike the previous race, Claire allows V to pick the vehicle they will be competing with in the race.

:Claire and V managed to qualify for the final race, taking place in Watson.

:
::After accepting to help Claire kill Sampson, Claire will reach out to V later for the final race.

:
::V says they just want to compete in the final race, and will put the race over her dispute with Sampson. Claire understands V's decision, and will reach out to V later for the final race.

:
::After refusing to help Claire kill Sampson, V was sacked from the team.

The Big Race

Two days after competing in the Santo Domingo race, Claire contacts V to flick them the details for the final race, instructing them to meet on Pardey street in Charter Hill, Westbrook.

During the final race, Peter Sampson will split off after his vehicle has mechanical issues. Claire wants V to follow him off the highway.

:After following Sampson off the highway, V and Claire witness Sampson collide with another car, and get out of their vehicle. Claire rushes over to Sampson, and starts to mock him for his current situation as he tries to crawl out from under his wrecked vehicle.

:Sampson, begging for Claire to spare his life, claims that he didn't kill Dean, but that he got himself killed.

:
::V tells Claire that they want to hear what Sampson has to say. Sampson will tell them that Dean tried to pass him just before the finish line, but that he lost control of the car when Sampson rammed him, which is according to him not against the rules of the race. After hearing what Sampson has to say, V comes to the conclusion that it was an accident; an accepted risk of racing.

:
::Claire shot Sampson despite V's attempts to spare his life. As a reward for V's help, she will gift V her "Beast", as she has no use for the car anymore.

:
::V prevented Claire from killing Sampson. Despite Sampson living, she gifts V her "Beast" as a thank you, as she no longer has a use for the car.

::After a few days, V receives a text message from Sampson, saying that he wants V to have his car.

:
::V agrees to go back to Claire's place. While driving back, she tells V more about Dean and that she has no desire to race in the future.

:Claire gets mad at V and refuses to service them at the Afterlife bar.

Journal Entry
:No one in Night City is only one layer deep. Take Claire for example - an Afterlife bartender who likes to burn rubber in illegal street races when she's on break. If you get the itch for a little adrenaline, I think you can scratch it at her garage.

## The Beast in Me: The Big Race
The Beast in Me: The Big Race is a Side Job in .

Walkthrough
Approximately two days after the race in Santo Domingo, V is contacted by Claire Russell with the details for the final race starting on Pardey street in Charter Hill, Westbrook.

When V arrives at the starting location of the race, they contact Claire to inform them that they are there. On the phone, Claire asks V which vehicle they'll want to use for the race, and recommends that V picks a car that is fast, as the race will be a highway race. After hanging up, V leans against the wall and waits for everyone to arrive.

As V approaches Claire, they hear heated arguing going on, as Claire and Peter Sampson are butting heads. As soon as Peter spots V, he starts to antagonize Claire even more, and suggests that V should get out while they can, since Claire gets her drivers killed. Sampson continues to verbally attack Claire, claiming that her late husband got himself killed as he took on more than he bargained for and that his ego got the better of him. V, unable to calm the situation down, can do nothing but watch. Sampson gets in his vehicle and gets one more jeer from Claire before she storms off to the vehicle she and V will be competing in.

After starting the race, Claire wants V to stick close to Sampson so they can follow him. Two thirds into the race, Peter Sampson's car will get in trouble and has to veer off from the highway. Claire urges V to follow him.

:They drive off the highway only to watch Sampson collide with another car soon after. Claire and V exit their vehicle and sees Sampson crawling out.

:Claire gets mad at V, claiming it was the one chance she had at giving Peter Sampson justice. After crossing the finish line, she will need a moment to cool off before wanting to talk to V.

:Once the two talk, Claire angrily asks V if it was worth winning the race over delivering justice to Peter. After talking, Claire departs.

You know what I'd do if it were my call, but it's your hands on the wheel, not mine. You know... Claire's not so bad, after all. Kinda feel sorry for her actually. But like I said - your call. Good luck out there, turbo.

## The Corpo-Rat
The Corpo-Rat is a Main Job in . It is one of the three possible starting points and is only available to players who chose the Corpo Lifepath. It features V as a fresh-faced mid-tier corpo working in Arasaka's counterintelligence division.

Walkthrough
V starts out looking into the mirror while stress-vomiting in the sink of a bathroom located in the Arasaka Tower. After briefly speaking with their longtime friend Jackie Welles over the holo, V is called by their superior, Arthur Jenkins, who is upset because of a major data leak in Frankfurt that has put the corporation's operations at risk, and he orders them to his office, though V is able to freely walk into their own office and read emails located on the desk before reporting to Jenkins.

V finds Jenkins ordering a cyberattack against the European Space Agency council to delay their vote on revoking Arasaka's lunar base licenses. Jenkins is called by an angered Susan Abernathy—his superior and rival in the Arasaka Special Operations branch—who berates him for the attack and threatens to discipline him later. Already chafing under Abernathy due to her having smeared his name in Osaka to steal a promotion from him, Jenkins orders V to take her out, giving them a datashard containing all of Abernathy's personal information and a large sum of eurodollars.

Arthur tells V to use their underworld contacts to off her once and for all and provides them with paper eddies to pay for the work. Afterwards, V gets into an Arasaka AV that takes them to Lizzie's Bar in Watson. Landing on the roof, V is confronted by basketball players upset about the court being a landing pad for a corporate AV; V may either subdue them with a lightning attack, or simply threaten them into submission, before approaching the Mox door guard, who lets V in.

Inside the bar V meets up with Jackie, explaining the situation to him and requesting his help, but Jackie, seeing the extreme risk involved in working for Arasaka, refuses. However, before V can convince him otherwise or get an alternate plan started, the pair is interrupted by Arasaka agents. They reveal that Abernathy is already aware of the hit ordered against her and demands them to hand over the datashard given to V by Jenkins. V initially refuses, so they strip V of their corporate privileges and disables their cyberware, forcing them to hand over the shard and finalizing V's termination from the corporation. The Arasaka agents then attempt to take V into custody as well, as a "favor" to Abernathy, but Jackie intercepts them, pointing out that they are isolated from the rest of their compatriots and that a firefight in unfamiliar territory could end badly for them, which convinces the agents to leave V alone. The mission ends with V, still woozy from their disabled cybernetics, losing their balance and falling to the floor, to which Jackie helps them back on their feet, setting off to start their journey together.

Journal Entry
:Sometimes I wonder what it's like to work for Arasaka, y'know? Way I figure it, it's like playin' Russian roulette for a million eddies. Give it a spin, pull the trigger. You hear it click, you strike it rich. And if you don't, well... the mess is someone else's problem.

:So to recap – Abernathy is Jenkins' boss, Jenkins is your boss and he ordered you to off Abernathy. It's a classic damned if you do, damned if you don't situation. You kill her – you're fucked. You tell Abernathy – you're even more fucked. Why? Because for the past few years you've been batting for Jenkins' team. If you get the job done, and do it well, you might get a promotion, but forget sleeping at night, because who knows how soon you'll be in someone's crosshairs. Only proves the wide variety of opportunities Arasaka has to offer.

The David Martinez is a top-quality alcoholic beverage in . It was added in Patch 1.6.

Overview
Crated as an Afterlife homage named after David Martinez, this cocktail was a shot of vodka on ice, topped with NiCola, and served in a glass.

Like other alcohol drinks in , the David Martinez applies the Drunk status, reducing movement speed by 10% and reducing accuracy with weapons by 50% lasting for 30 seconds. The duration of this effect stacks.

Acquisition
*In , it can be purchased from Claire Russell at the Afterlife for €$150.

## The Distance
The Distance is a repeatable Side Job in . It was added in Patch 2.1.

Walkthrough
The gig can be unlocked by finishing The Beast In Me and waiting several days. V receives a message text from Jim Jarry, the organizer of the street races. After agreeing to his offer, there will be four new gigs on the map, marked with crossed flags. Going to one of the flags, V needs to sit on the marked bench and pay €$ 2,000 as entry fee to join the race.

## The Gig
The Gig is a Side Job in .

Walkthrough
While descending on the elevator after rescuing Sandra Dorsett from the Scavengers, V calls Wakako Okada that the gig has been successfully completed. Wakako tells V that they should come by when they have to chance to do so for their reward.

Once V has recovered from their injuries sustained from Konpeki Plaza, the NCPD lockdown in Watson has been lifted, and they will be able to visit Wakako Okada at her Pachinko Parlor on Jig-Jig Street in Japantown, to discuss the reward for the rescue of Sandra Dorsett. She transfers V €$3,380 and instructs them to visit Cassius Ryder's ripperdoc clinic to obtain a Tattoo: Tyger Claws Dermal Imprint for free.

:Whenever we go see Wakako and walk into that pachinko salon of hers, I get this weird, like, tingling feeling on the back of my neck. I dunno, V, she's all knots of weird. Anyway, she promised a special reward for this job with Sandra Dorsett. All we have to do is go see her on Jig-Jig Street.

Objectives
*Wait for the lockdown to end.

## The Glen
- type：Planned district (formerly)
Sub-district
- manager：Zohara Freeman (2045)
- city：Night City
- district：Heywood (2077)
- location：The Island (2045)
- gangs：See Gangs
- security_provider：NCPD
- appears_books：

()

The Glen is one of the sub-districts of Heywood, located in central Night City.

History
2030s - 2040s
During the rebuilding period of Night City, around a decade after the Fourth Corporate War, the City Council struck a deal with the corporations to aid and fund Night City's reconstruction. That project included the Glen, which was planned as the new seat of power for the central government. The Glen's boundaries incorporated areas from South Night City, the University District, and Little Asia.

Over the following years, lots of money were poured into the Glen, which saw massive construction efforts, and by the 2040s, the new City Hall and Hall of Justice were already open to the public. Steadily, the Glen was becoming a burgeoning district with most of Night City's governmental buildings, as well as other corporate and financial facilities. Ongoing development projects included megabuildings to house the displaced population and plans to rebuild the NCART lines above ground and extend them to cover all the districts in the city. Despite being surrounded by Combat Zones on most sides, the Glen was considered one of the safest districts in the whole metropolitan area due to the constant presence of NCPD officers and private security companies.

In 2045, the South Night City Zoners discovered that a portion of their district funds had been redirected by Night Corp to upgrade the NCPD First Division headquarters in the Glen, leading to a massive protest that accessed the governmental district and ended in a massive brawl against the NCPD. This event lasted for hours, resulting in expensive and substantial property damage, and a fire that burned a number buildings.

2050s - 2070s
Over the following years, the citizens of the wealthier parts of old Heywood moved to South Night City and its surroundings, taking their old name with them and renaming the area to Heywood, which the Glen would eventually become part of.

By the 2070s, the Glen was the heart of Heywood and the governmental district of Night City, at least a portion of it. Entering the sub-district from the north showed the Glen as rich, clean, and mostly free of crime, showcasing the refined and well kept northern and central areas with multitude of high-end stores and luxurious restaurants. It also includes Reconciliation Park, one of the Glen's main features, as well as the notorious City Hall and even a large NCPD building. However, just a few blocks away from City Hall, things begun to look worse. Further to the south, the district started to look visibly poorer and more dangerous. The architecture was more suburban, with low-rise row houses, and soon after you were in gang territory; mostly the Valentinos and 6th Street during this time. But as long as you maintained your head low, they wouldn't bother you, most of the time. Excluding the dangerous parts, the rest of the Glen was more like your typical Heywood neighborhood, packed with charming shops and quaint restaurants. The Coyoacan was one of the most popular markets in the Glen.

By 2077, the war between the Valentinos and 6th Street was intensifying, and firefights were starting to become common in the Glen as well.

Behind the Scenes

引文：The Glen is Night City's government district, home to and owned by City Hall. A quick glance at the illustration of this seat of municipal authority compared to those of corporate headquarters should tell you what you need to know about the relative distribution of wealth and power. Then-City Councilman Lucius Rhyne's deal with Arasaka in 2070 gave Night City its independence from the countries around it, but at the price of ceding much control of the city itself to corporations, Arasaka first and foremost. The transfer of power was physically reflected in the rebuilding of Corporate Plaza, which forced City Hall out of the center and into this less than prime piece of real estate. Its northern edge, that closest to City Center, verges on tolerable and even attractive. A peaceful park borders a row of elegant skyscrapers, and behind them, City Hall itself. Heading south, however, the Glen quickly becomes impoverished and crime-ridden. It merges into Vista del Rey, where the Valentinos are the true rulers of gritty, though colorful, streets. For the adventurous, or just those with few choices, there is still fun to be had, but overall life is nasty, grim and short.

The Headsman is an variant of the Constitutional Arms M2038 Tactician in .

Overview
The Headsman is a stockless variant of the Constitutional Arms M2038 Tactician.

It has an iconic modifier which results in it firing slugs instead of pellets, which increases the weapon's range by 33%, Crit Chance by 25% and Crit Damage by 50%. Hitting enemies with headshots will increase reload speed by 25% and accuracy by 10% for 5 seconds. A subsequent headshot will additionally always deal Crit Damage. It also has a Kanetsugu Short Scope which cannot be removed.

The mod also reduces base damage by 10%, ammo capacity from 8 to 6, knockdown chance by 20% and increases reload time by 10%.

The Heist is a Main Job in . The job has Jackie and V infiltrate Konpeki Plaza to steal an experimental biochip from Yorinobu Arasaka.

Walkthrough

After V retrieved the Flathead from Maelstrom and the information from Evelyn Parker, they are now ready to start the job they were hired to do by Dexter DeShawn.

V heads out to The Afterlife to meet up with Jackie. By the entrance, they have a brief chat about Mamá Welles before heading into the club. The bouncer will eventually let them in regardless of the option V chooses. As Dex is still busy, V can look around some but ultimately they'll need to go sit down at the bar with Jackie, where they can talk a bit more with him and the bartender, Claire, before Dex's bodyguard Oleg summons them.

Briefing
Follow Jackie to the booth in the back where Dex and T-Bug are waiting to go over the heist's details. V can converse with T-Bug before placing the Flathead in the case. Once they do, sit and Dex will begin to ask V some questions, particularly about Evelyn.

V is then asked they slot in the shard on the table, to go through the plan for the heist.

V can ask questions about the mission, then Jackie will bring up how the pay is being split. Dex notes V and Jackie get 30% as fresh talents but V can have him bump it up to 35% if V points out that they deserve more; or, after telling Dex it is about more than the eddies, they want to be remembered for something, or the challenge itself, or it is about revenge on Arasaka (Corpo lifepath only). Dex will directly bump it up to 40% if he is told about Evelyn Parker's desire to cut him out of the deal. After Dex heads off, V can then talk to T-Bug some more before she also heads out. Jackie will then ask if V is ready or not.

Infiltrating the Hotel

Once V is ready, they can put on the suit and get in the taxi. After some banter between Delamain and Jackie, Delamain verifies V's and Jackie's undercover IDs and then drive them to the hotel. On the way, V can talk to Jackie some about how he's acting regarding this job. Once they arrive, follow Jackie once he gets the Flathead out and head in through the scanner and then check in. At one point during the convo with the receptionist, they will need to stall her. If V doesn't say anything T-Bug will pose as the receptionist and trick the hotel receptionist. Once the receptionist guides them to the lobby V can continue to the hotel's bar or continue to follow Jackie up the elevator (Jackie will refuse and heads upstairs if you look around).

Once upstairs and in the room, T-Bug will ask V to scan for the entry point for the Flathead to use, which is right in the corner between the terrarium and the window. Jackie will command it initially but eventually V will be asked to control the Flathead as it got stuck and Jackie's optics can not scan. The Flathead fully navigates itself, they just need to tell it where to go, but some rooms V has to interact with objects via the Flathead to progress.

Eventually the Flathead reaches the area outside the hotel's netrunner, where V will have to do a mix of scanning a particular object and then manually switch cams to see inside the netrunner's room to find a way for the Flathead to get inside. Once it's in, T-Bug needs a few hours to get around their security so go sit and it'll fast forward to night.

When V wakes up, Jackie will be questioning why Yorinobu even tried to leave his family as he could want for nothing under the Arasaka name, but instead tried to start a gang. T-Bug will then note it's time, so head out to the elevator, which will give V and Jackie direct access to the penthouse.

Once ready, join Jackie and as T-Bug is uploading to it, they will see some unexpected guests arriving by AVs. To make things worse, as Jackie gets the case, T-Bug warns them that Yorinobu is heading too quickly to the penthouse so they will need to hide fast. Head behind the TV screen where she'll open the panel here, and get in.

A scene will play out with Yorinobu entering with Adam Smasher before they're unexpectedly joined by his father, Saburo Arasaka and his own bodyguard, Goro Takemura. After dismissing the two bodyguards, things go awry between the son and father, and Yorinobu kills Saburo by strangling him to death before initiating a hotel lockdown, claiming someone poisoned his father.

Escape
Taking the elevator is out, so T-Bug will direct V instead to the balcony to try and get to a ladder there. However, just as she gets the doors opened, she's killed on her end. When V gets to the corpse of Saburo, Jackie will say that the AV should still be on the roof, suggesting flying it to safety. Going to the AV and defeat the two guards, there is some loot inside the AV but unfortunately AV will recognize that there are trespassers and lock itself down. The AV's AI will alert more security leaving them to run to the window T-Bug opened. They head out and around and walk across the thin railing to the ladders, but halfway across hostile forces will spot V and Jackie and they will have no choice but to jump. After a short dialogue scene, Jackie will plug the Relic into himself to keep it safe while they both try to escape the hotel.

They will have to go through a number of areas with Arasaka guards. The first elevator they reach won't be accessible as an access token is required. As they reach the second elevator location, they will spot the officer who's carrying it here and they will need to take him out (lethal or non-lethal) to get the token. Once they have it, they access the elevator and can talk a bit before they reach the hotel's lobby area with more guards and if not done stealthily a mech.

Whichever way they manage to get back to the entrance, they take the elevator here to Delamain, which will be under fire, they can ignore the enemies and enter the cab. However, Arasaka sends out Adam Smasher to retrieve them and pursue them with three drones, consisting of one Octant and two Griffins. V needs to shoot them down to progress.

After managing to escape, Jackie's injuries prove to be too severe and after he hands the Relic over to V, he dies. Delamain will subsequently ask where V would like to send his remains, and they can choose from several options:

:Jackie's remains are sent to Mamá Welles by Delamain.

:Jackie's remains are sent to Viktor Vektor's clinic.

V exits the car and meets with Dex inside the No-Tell Motel. Dex is none too pleased with what happened, as the offing of the emperor is all over the news now. Even if V tells him that it wasn't them and Jackie that did it, Dex will tell them that Arasaka and their ninjas don't know or care about that. He'll eventually agree though that escaping Night City is the best option here before sending V off to go wash the blood off their face. Once they do and leave the bathroom though, his bodyguard knocks them down before Dex shoots them in the head.

Journal entry
:There's only one door you gotta open in Night City. And that's the door to The Afterlife. Once you cross into that world, peeps'll step aside for you everywhere. Dex couldn't have chosen a better place to pregame before the heist, am I right? Afterlife's a sign for us, chica/ese.
:Saburo Arasaka murdered by his own son - and in front of our goddamn eyes! Know what, V? Forget what I said about gettin' into the Afterlife - first we need to find a way to get the fuck out of this shitstorm before Arasaka spec ops jump down our throats.
:So that's how it ends... at least for me. In the backseat of a limo with hot corporate lead wedged in my gut. You know, all things considered, that ain't a half-bad way for a Welles to go. Most sons of Heywood top out without all those fireworks. But what can I say, Night City's chewed up names way bigger than mine before. Not you, though - you still got work to do. Cut a fat deal (heh) with Dex in my honor. And don't piss it all away in vain, or I'll be rollin' in my grave until I hit the east coast. I won't give you a minute of goddamn peace, chica/mano. This is the last favor we owe ourselves.

## The Highwayman
The Highwayman is a hidden Side Job found in the game world by V in .

Walkthrough
To begin this side job, V may head over to Woodhaven Street in Rancho Coronado East and travel up the street to the Gun-O-Rama gun shop. Around the back they will find an accessible garage with a decal of a ghost horse to the left of it.

Alternatively, V may find Josie Alcazar's body first and read the shard, 'Bad news'. In this case, the first objective will be to find the garage.

Once inside, V and Johnny will comment on the scrapped Brennan found in there. To officially start the side job, V must read the message on the terminal to the opposite side of the garage. After exiting the terminal, V will pick up a photo of James Ito and Josie. This prompts V and Johnny to look for James to find out more about their situation.

To find James, V must travel to Japantown West and head south along the waterfront four-lane road. There will be a plaza on the east side of the road after Holly Street with a 24/7 stand. James is sitting on the same bench in the photo, in front of the 24/7 stand. Talking to him will begin the investigation into what happened to Josie.

To find out what happened to Josie, V must travel to Ebunike metro station in Heywood. Once there, scanning the surroundings will reveal a trail of dried blood splatters on the ground. Following the trail past the Drop Point there is an alley to the right and Josie's body will be behind a dumpster.

Josie carries a shard labeled 'Bad news', which details the cause of her death as well as information on the location of the bike she had stolen from a Tyger Claw boss. After having an exchange with Johnny, V returns to James in Japantown and confronts him about what they have discovered. What happens to James after confronting him depends on the dialogue choices. After the confrontation, V has to find the Tyger Claw boss' bike in order to complete the job.

The shard found near Josie's body mentions it being stowed on Maelstrom turf near All Foods Factory in Northside, Watson. The 'ghost horse' mentioned in the shard can be found across street from the travel point. The bike is in the nearby garage. Punching the date when James and Josie met (0214) into the keypad next to the garage will open it and V can claim the bike, completing the job.

File:James Location.png|James' location.
File:Josie Location.png|Josie's location.
File:Bike Location.png|Location of the Tyger Claw bike.

Journal Entry

:Another mystery, another missing person in Night City. Used to be the cops would put out a search for people like her. Today, her fate's in your hands.

:That chick, Josie, wrote something about a garage, didn't she? Somewhere near the dam. Not like it's any of my biz, but if I were you, I'd go check it out. Something tells me it'll give you a boost in the right direction. A sixth sense, shall we say. On the other hand, I am basically dead, which would mean I don't think, so don't hold me to that.

:There's a still of some young guy in the garage - the heartbreaker type. Emails on the computer are from a certain James - don't have to be a genius to connect the dots. Might be worth looking for our Romeo - especially in Japantown. Got a feeling the still was snapped there. Wouldn't surprise me - kids go on dates there all the time. Shit... it always starts off so cute, doesn't it? Rarely ever ends that way.

:James said that when things got dicey, the chick hopped onto the subway – red line headed south. Maybe she went all the way to the last station... Or maybe she got off somewhere in Heywood – easier to lay low there, disappear. I know how it sounds – had to pull the same move more than once back in my day.

:Josie... Pretty name. Cute girl. Ugly end. This Tyger from the still... better have a word with him, V. Can't let slide what he did to this poor girl.

:Josie hid the Tyger boss's bike somewhere in the city, near the All Foods factory in Maelstrom turf. Said to look for a "ghost horse." All right then... Think of it like a scavenger hunt, though not the kind fixers in Night City usually pay you for.

Objectives
*Find the garage Josie mentioned.
*Pick up the still.
*Find James.
*Find out what happened to Josie.
*Find James and confront him.
*Find the stolen Tyger Claw bike.

Associated Shards

Notes
*Originally, the A Visitor's Guide to Night City included with the Collector's Edition was required to solve the quest. This idea was eventually scrapped, as it didn't pan out as planned. The job is not explicitly labelled on the map because of this reason.
*When confronting James, the first dialogue choice, "So you had a choice...", results in a peaceful resolution, but the second causes him to attack. So, either avenge Josie or let him live with his guilt.
*James and Josie's graffiti will disappear from the bench after completing the job. James will also never appear again at the bench, despite his claims that he returns to the bench "night after night".
*Unlike many other jobs, the steps can be done out of order. James can be confronted for the first time after having already discovered Josie's body, allowing the player to go straight into the dialogue choices to avenge Josie. Alternatively, V can simply unlock the garage holding the Itsumade without discovering Josie's body or confronting James, skipping the entire job.
*This job is one of the few cases where the acquired vehicle is not the same that can be summoned. They are two different instances of the bike. Another such case is the car from Sex On Wheels.

Trivia
*The Highwayman is a poem by Alfred Noyes published in 1906, with a story arc closely tied to the themes of the quest. The last two stanzas include imagery of a ghostly horse and rider.
*[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Highwayman_%28song%29?wprov=sfla1 Highwayman] is a 1977 song by Jimmy Webb, later popularized by outlaw country supergroup [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Highwaymen_%28country_supergroup%29?wprov=sfla1 The Highwaymen].

The Hunt is a Side Job in .

Walkthrough

Some time after completing I Fought the Law, River will call V, needing assistance and requests them to meet him in person to discuss the details.

After you get to the designated location and wait for him to arrive, he'll pull up in his truck. Get in and talk to him a bit but he's not really in a chatty mood and will instead send you a video clip to watch of a news reel. It'll reveal a man named Anthony Harris who's also the dubbed "Peter Pan" serial killer being apprehended in his car by NCPD as one of his victims falls out of the vehicle. Anthony tries to run but is shot down by police and the clip will note the victim died from septic shock. Meanwhile Anthony, while still alive, is comatose in a hospital so there's no way to interrogate him about where other victims are being held.

After it finishes, River will reveal while Peter Pan was never his case, his nephew, Randy, recently went missing and the victim in the video was wearing Randy's shoes. Furthermore, the detective that is on the case isn't doing much and so it's not looking good in finding Randy in time and River isn't on good terms with his sister so he doesn't know much about Randy's disappearance. But he does have an idea: to try and view Anthony's dreams as a braindance to see if enough clues can be found to find and save Randy.

NCPD Lab
With that, get out of the vehicle and follow River across the street to the lab, but he'll note he doesn't have access to get inside. Head to the left from the entrance to find an alleyway with a door with a leveled Technical Ability requirement. Alternatively, V can head to the right from the entrance to find a door with a leveled Body requirement. Alternatively, one can use a container to get over the wall next to the first door.

River will inform V that the place is empty, so the pair won't be disturbed. Head to the central area and enter the child's room to the side and scan the file cabinets here to locate Anthony's file. While searching them, V and River will be interrupted by Yawen Packard. After some back and forth where River will blackmail Yawen into helping. She will reveal that Anthony isn't dreaming, so they can't get any BDs off him. River will take it upon himself to find a way and heads out.

Go through the front door where Johnny will talk a bit and, if using a female V, he'll note River seems rather interested in V. Get in River's vehicle and he'll start driving out to his sister's place while you can talk to him about his suspension, Randy, and the case.

Visiting Joss
The pair will eventually arrive at Joss', who isn't happy either about seeing River but will agree to let him and V look through Randy's stuff if it means finding something that could help bring back her son. Follow River to the other trailer where Randy was living and look around for clues. In particular, to be successful in saving Randy in time, V will need enough major clues. Some of these clues include:

*In the kitchen area pick up the key on the shelf near the table and use it to unlock the cabinet in Randy's bedroom
*Have enough Intelligence to hack Randy's computer (or scan the record player in the hallway to learn the password)
*Read all the messages and files on the computer
*On the "Net" tab click the image of the red people to find the secret website, then on that site, click the "Join Us" then "Files" tabs, then back to the computer's main files to view the video again. River will then send this to Yawen to see if that gets Anthony dreaming
*While it helps, it's not necessary to find Harris' IP address (high Intelligence required). To do so exit out like normal from the computer but this time one will have the option to tell him V can or lack the skills to do so. V can also find enough clues in the BDs to compensate for this if V does not enough Intelligence to find the IP.

After doing everything one can, follow River back over to Joss to talk to her about the findings. Agree to stay and V can talk a bit to Joss before heading to bed. River will wake them up some time later with good news: the video worked, and Anthony is dreaming. One will now need to scroll the BDs they got for additional clues:

*School
**3 visuals: the teacher, the bulletin boards, and the trophy case

*Childhood Barn
**7 Visuals: Young Anthony, the cow, Anthony's father, the console to the left of Anthony's father, the injection system console Anthony passes, the dietary supplements across the barn, and the cartoon playing
**Note if one found enough clues in this one, V may not be able to scan the last one (the optional objective to find clues may disappear if this is the case)
*Adulthood Barn
**13 Visuals: Solar box, clock, electrical parts, fuel barrels, victims x3, infusion pump, FDNC certificate, computer, crawling victim, number to top left of barn entrance, towers of light (outside the barn)
**Audio: AV sounds (through the ceiling)

If V found enough clues, River will deduce the correct location is Edgewood Farm, or if one has already travelled to the farm before, V will recognise it if they scan the towers of light. Otherwise, one will need to guess, though it is in the list of guessing options so V can select it there if they didn't get enough clues. That said, if V guesses the wrong farm, Randy won't be found in time. If one wishes to romance River, they need to make sure to pick the right farm here, otherwise it'll lock River's last quest out and he won't be able to be romanced.

Finding Randy
Edgewood Farm doesn't have any enemies, but the yard is littered with mines, along with four turrets and several cameras. In addition, leaving the area will result in both River and Randy dying (as River will be killed from the barn's defenses and nobody else will arrive in time to save Randy).

If one does not or cannot turn off the defenses individually, the house nearby contains a desk with a switch underneath. Pressing it to reveals a hidden room with a second computer that will turn off the turrets and cameras. The Tinker Bell can be found nearby as well. If done, V will only need to worry about the mines as they make their way to the left of the barn entrance where a ladder is located. Use it to get up on the roof and enter through an opening here. River will find Randy but needs V to turn off the BD machine in the control room before he can unplug Randy. After doing so, head back around to help the other three victims (two will still be alive). Afterwards, River will call for V for their assistance, so go help him out and then it'll fast forward to where the police have arrived and working on getting the victims to the hospital. River though still has one more agenda: Anthony has to die. Do not select the "count me out" option here if one wishes to romance him. After some more dialogue, River will part with the Trauma Team, ending the quest.

Journal Entry
:NCPD boy in blue gives you a holler and you come runnin' like an obedient dog? This ain't gonna become a habit is it? Well, whatever - sounds like he's got an errand for you, real personal kind. Least it's better than chasing dead politicians. Just do me a favor - don't get used to it.
:Upon completion:
::So some depraved maniac's kidnapping boys, and lo and behold, your badge is caught up in the middle of it. Gotta be honest, this doesn't look good. Peter Pan's just another manifestation of this fucked up city - probably already ended those poor brats. But on the off-chance Randy's still alive... If I were you, I'd go save him. Especially if "breaking the law" is involved.

Notes

*If not enough clues are gathered and V is left with a 50/50 choice between Edgewood and Poppy Farm, choosing the wrong farm (Poppy) will result in the rest of the mission to play out differently (locking out the follow-up mission Following the River). River and V will drive to Poppy Farm where they defeat some Wraiths and quickly see that it is the wrong one. Finally arriving at Edgewood Farm, both find out that they came too late and that Randy is dead. River collapses and later gets angry with V, regretting that he did not hire a professional instead. River vows to kill Anthony Harris with or without V's help. Some time later he will send a text message to V, notifying them that the deed is done and bidding final goodbye. River later gets into a bar fight with someone who was talking badly about Anthony's victims, which lands him in the precinct prison in Little China. From there he leaves a video message played during the end credits and asks V to bail him out.
*During the braindances, there is a chance the interface will display a notification saying "Entering a new area: Edgewood Farm", spoiling where the kids are located, especially if the player didn't gather enough clues
*Once this mission is completed, a report by Network News 54 covering the events can be seen on some TVs in the city.
*The barn is surrounded by lots of mines which can be disarmed. This can be used to level up the Engineer skill.
*It's possible to skip all the clue gathering if V visited Edgewood Farm prior to this job. V will recognize it the moment Night City's skyline is scanned in the third BD, and will tell River the exact location upon exiting the braindance.

Trivia

*In the NCPD Lab, a BB Unit from Death Stranding can be seen and scanned.
*Anthony Harris is a reference to the Hannibal Lecter franchise:
**He is named after both Anthony Hopkins (the actor who played Lecter in the films) and Thomas Harris (the author of the novels).
**Like Clarice Starling in The Silence of the Lambs, V must (literally) enter the mind of a serial killer in order to save someone's life.

## The Information
The Information is a Main Job in .

Walkthrough

After V spoke with Dexter DeShawn, they were sent to Lizzie's Bar on the corner of Kennedy Avenue and Sutter Street to get in touch with the client, Evelyn Parker.

Once inside the bar—between 6:00 PM and 6:00 AM—V approaches the bar and asks the bartender, Mateo Thiago, about Evelyn's whereabouts. As V approaches the bar, Evelyn is sitting on a barstool with Judy leaning next to her, but V doesn't know who they are yet. Mateo refuses to provide any information, and Judy leaves offscreen during that conversation. Evelyn, who was awaiting V's arrival, interrupts their conversation, and introduces herself to V as Mateo pours a drink for them. Evelyn will proceed to ask V to follow her to a more secluded VIP room.

In the VIP room, Evelyn briefly interrogates V about their relationship with Dexter DeShawn, after which she explains her unique gig and its attached strings. Evelyn tells V that the Arasaka biochip called the Relic is in a secure location inside Konpeki Plaza in penthouse. The penthouse is occupied by Saburo Arasaka's son and heir Yorinobu Arasaka, who recently arrived in Night City. Evelyn proceeds to explain that Yorinobu stole the biochip from an Arasaka laboratory, and intends to make a deal with NetWatch in order to sell it. Evelyn reveals that she has scrolled a braindance of Yorinobu's penthouse while she was there as Yorinobu's personal joytoy, as V and Evelyn move further inside Lizzie's Bar towards the workshop. While heading down to the basement, Evelyn tells V about Judy Álvarez and warns V to behave themselves.

Once in Judy's workshop, Evelyn introduces V to Judy, who was just finishing up compiling the Konpeki Plaza braindance. If V has high enough Technical Ability, they can have a short side conversation about Judy's tech setup before Evelyn interrupts. Judy instructs V to sit down in the chair nearby, after which she places the Braindance Wreath on V. Judy returns to her desk to calibrate V's sensory profile and then prepares V for the calibration braindance.

During the calibration braindance, V re-experiences the last minutes of a low-life Scavenger that robbed a Cali Express. The Scavenger was shot and killed by his compatriot, upon which the braindance ends and calibration finishes.

Having exited the calibration braindance, V needs a moment to catch their breath and is unsure if they want to continue. Evelyn reminds them of the importance of the next braindance and that it's crucial for the gig. Convinced by Evelyn's words, V tells Judy that they need to involve the Netrunner T-Bug as well, so that she can study the security of Konpeki Plaza.

Judy resists allowing T-Bug to link in, but Evelyn convinces her to allow it, reassuring Judy that she'd never let harm come to her. T-Bug and V navigate the braindance of Yorinobu's suite, where they identify high-tech security systems and a temperature-controlled vault that contains the Relic. T-Bug is sure that she can override the security systems, and she points out the gun that Yorinobu keeps in the suite, saying that V should keep it in mind.

After V exits the braindance, Judy scrubs V's profile from her system. She's worried that Evelyn and V will get killed, and that if Arasaka finds out about the braindance, they'll kill everyone involved. V and Evelyn reassure Judy, and then Judy tells V to keep the braindance wreath. Before leaving Judy's workshop, V can optionally have a brief conversation with Judy to thank her or express interest in seeing her again.

Before V leaves the basement, Evelyn wants to talk, and V can ask several probing questions about the job and Evelyn's relationship with Yorinobu. Evelyn then asks V to do the job just for her, without including Dex. V protests that hazing Dex will ruin them, but Evelyn dismisses the concern. V can refuse or say that they'll think about it. Evelyn says that she needs to talk to Judy, and V is directed to leave Lizzie's.

Journal Entry
:Either Evelyn Parker's got the best intel in town, the biggest pile of scratch, or the brightest goddamn lucky star twinkling over her at night. Fuck, maybe she got all three. Still, good thing Dex sent you to that meet. You clean up better. Anyway, this goes down right, she'll be a nice new contact for us. And you know the deal – won't get anywhere without contacts in Night City. So don't fuck it up, chica/mano.

:Evelyn knows more than she's willing to spill. Only question is whether she thinks we're worthy of her trust... that's where you come in. Chick's gotta be seriously well-connected to have the kind of intel we need for this op. Make sure to squeeze every last drop out of her, V. And remember – major league's just around the corner.

- type：Bar

The Moth is a bar located in Dogtown, in the Pacifica district of southern Night City.

Overview
The Moth is a bar owned by Alena Xenakis.

Database Entry

- transcript：In the heart of Longshore Stacks you'll find a safe haven for any seeking to quench their thirst with a glass of the good stuff and a place to relax with some classic jukebox tunes. Regulars know that the owner and bartender of this establishment are one and the same person. Seven years ago, the woman they know as Daphe laid claim to this vacant building sitting atop an out-of-service boiler room and transformed it into a godsend for the Stacks community – a bar. To this day, Stacks residents relish visiting the Moth after a rough day, where they're always greeted by a bartender bot or by the owner herself. Daphne's ears are always open to the locals' ramblings and ravings. She has her finger on the pulse of all Dogtown gossip. In fact, if Daphne finds your gossip juicy as all git-out, she might just offer you a round on the house. In other words, if you're an ennyless Dogtown resident without proper access to a therapist, then you head to Moth, order a stiff drink and talk your heart out to Daphe. It should come as no surprise that this bar never lacks clientele.

Staff

## The Needle
- aka：To Our Mothers and Fathers Before Us
- type：Obelisk sculpture
- city：Night City
- district：Pacifica
- sub_district：Dogtown
- location：Golden Pacific
- street：George Washington & Abraham Lincoln

To Our Mothers and Fathers Before Us, also known simply as The Needle, is a monolith located in Dogtown, in the Pacifica district of southern Night City.

Overview
The Needle is a damaged obelisk found at George Washington Street, being the centerpiece of the roundabout that divides traffic around the Black Sapphire, EBM Petrochem Stadium, and Heavy Hearts. Designed by Jared Cox and finished around 2063, it was dedicated to the Presidents of the United States. The sign reads: "To Our Mothers and Fathers Before Us. Jared Cox. 2063."

An underground mall is located beneath the roundabout, where the BARGHEST occasionally hang their executed.

## The Nomad
The Nomad is a Main Job in . It is one of the three possible starting jobs and is only available to players who chose the Nomad lifepath. V grew up in the Badlands in a nomad clan and leaves it, hoping to make it big in Night City. To get into the city, V takes on a risky job: smuggling a very hot item with the help of Heywood native Jackie Welles.

Walkthrough
V starts in a mechanic's garage in the small town of Yucca, just southwest of the SoCal Border Crossing to Night City. While looking into a mirror, V removes the patch of their old nomad clan. While V is removing the patch, a mechanic is trying to repair their car, but needs a part that he doesn't have in stock. V turns to face the mechanic, and moves the mechanic out of the way. They make a short-term workaround that should last long enough to reach Night City. V leaves the garage, but before they can continue, V is hassled by the local sheriff, who asks pointed questions about their presence in his town and makes it clear that nomads, with or without a clan, are unwelcome.

V needs to meet up with their contact, Jackie Welles, to pick up the package they will both be smuggling into Night City. V slips past the patrolling sheriff, and heads south, towards the radio tower. At the radio tower, V climbs the radio tower and contacts Willie McCoy to receive Jackie's location, which turns out to be an abandoned farm close to the border. V drives to the abandoned farm. After making introductions, Jackie retrieves the package and places it in the trunk of V's car, and they both head out towards the border crossing.

At the Border Crossing, V and Jackie are stopped by the border guards and ordered to report for an inspection. V tells Jackie to stay with the car, and they enter the Border Crossing building. V steps into the room with the papers declaring their cargo to be "lost on arrival" - along with a sufficient bribe to "encourage" the guards not to look too closely. The guard accepts the bribe, but V gets a bad feeling that the guard knows more than he is letting on. V returns to their car, where they have Jackie take the wheel and get out of there as soon as possible; as they think something is definitely going on and V doesn't want to stick around. As they leave the crossing, V and Jackie are cut off by Arasaka security, who demands that they halt and hand over the corporate property that they are smuggling, revealing that they were set up. V tells Jackie to gun it, and lead the security team on a chase through the Biotechnica Protein Farm on the city's outskirts, eventually shaking them successfully and hiding in a nearby garage, where V's car finally breaks down for good. Inside the garage, V opens up the package to see what caused all the trouble: a genuine, live iguana. After discussing what to do next, Jackie, deciding he likes V, offers his hand and friendship and partnership as the iguana looks on, leading into the Night City introduction montage.

Journal Entry
: Yo, V, every story's gotta start somewhere, right? Even if it means that "somewhere" is in the middle of nowhere and the most nova place to hang is a dusty-ass fuel stop. You abandoned your nomad family to come find the dude who hired you, to smuggle something for him 'cross the border. This guy will change your life, chica/mano.
: A good kid from Heywood with stolen corporate cargo in hand, border guards breathing down your neck and a brutal heat haze melting the horizon. This is what freedom looks like. And if smuggling's what it takes to live it, then smuggling it is. But if that's not motivation enough, there's a fat stack of eddies waiting at the end of it too. All that needs doin' is moving the package from A to B. Simple.

The Heist
- reward_item：(dependent)
 (dependent, Streetkid only)
- reward_xp：1547
- reward_sc：1727
- reward_eb：3000-13000

The Pickup is a Main Job in .

Walkthrough
After meeting with Dexter DeShawn, V is instructed to obtain the Flathead−a prototype Militech combat bot−from the Maelstromer's led by Royce at the All Foods Factory on Talbot Place in the Northside Industrial District of Watson. V was also given the number of a Militech internal affairs agent named Meredith Stout, who they can contact for more information regarding the gear that was stolen from the Militech convoy.

:V reaches out to Meredith Stout. V knows about the bind Meredith is in and proposes to meet. The parties meet eachother at a storm channel under the overpass near the All Foods Factory in Northside. While approaching Meredith, V is overwhelmed by one of her bodyguards, who jacks into V's personal link to start an aggressive but brief interrogation. Stout asks V if they are alone and if they know if Anthony Gilchrist is the one who leaked information about the Militech convoy. The bodyguard disengages the link and lets V go, who proposes to make a deal with Meredith, information in exchange for the Militech Flathead. Meredith agrees to V's proposition, under the condition that V pays for the Flathead with a Militech Credchip.

:
::V receives a Militech Credchip infected with a daemon from Meredith Stout in order to pay for the Flathead.

::
::;To remove the daemon:
:::V uses Breach Protocol to breach the Militech Credchip, and was able to remove the daemon infecting the shard. This results in 10,000 eurodollars from the shard at a later point.
::;To make a copy:
:::V uses Breach Protocol to breach the Militech Credchip, and was able to make a copy of the infected shard. This causes them to obtain a quickhack.
::;To remove the daemon, and make a copy:
:::V uses Breach Protocol to breach the Militech Credchip, and was able to remove the daemon infecting the shard, allowing them to retrieve 10,000 from the shard at a later point. In the process, they also made a copy of shard which causes them to obtain a , and allowing them to retrieve 10,000 eurodollars from the shard at a later point.

:
::After declining Meredith's offer to pay for the Flathead using a Militech Credchip, V has to come up with an alternative to pay for the combat bot.

Arriving at the All Food Factory, V meets up with Jackie Welles, and together they approach the main entrance gate of the factory. Using the intercom, they speak with Dum Dum−a high-ranking Maelstrom member−and are let inside after telling him that they are there for the Flathead. Making their way to the meeting point inside the factory, Jackie and V evade various deactivated traps.

Entering the meat processing area of the factory, the duo takes an elevator up to the room where they meet face-to-face with Dum Dum.

Path 1 - Instant Death

This occurs if all of the following conditions are met:
*V does not point a weapon at nor attack any of the Maelstrom gang members after entering their hideout
*When Jackie refuses to sit down, V intervenes and asks him to do so
*V takes too long to reply to Royce when he asks how they are going to pay

Royce simply shoots V in the head, necessitating a prior save.

Path 2 - A Peaceful Transaction

This occurs if all of the following conditions are met:
*V does not meet Meredith Stout
*When Jackie refuses to sit down, V intervenes and asks him to do so
*V pays Royce with €$ 10,000 of their own cash

V obtains the Flathead and is led peacefully from the premises by Dum Dum, who will then also give them his Black Lace inhaler if they have the Streetkid lifepath (even if they have rejected to take a whirl earlier). This is the only way to unlock access to the Maelstrom Weapon Vendor, who will appear after completing the job. This is also a guaranteed way to keep Dum Dum alive, which in turn enables V to kill or incapacitate him during a later mission in which he carries his iconic gun that can then be looted.

Path 3 - Fight Militech

This occurs if all of the following conditions are met:
*V does meet Meredith Stout, either taking the credchip or not
*When Jackie refuses to sit down, V intervenes and asks him to do so
*V pays Royce either with a) the chip including its malware but giving Royce a heads-up warning (Corpo lifepath only), b) with the chip after removing its malware, or c) with €$ 10,000 of their own cash

After the transaction, Militech operatives will storm the All Foods Factory and start attacking the Maelstrom gang members. This is one of two options that allows to find and free former Maelstrom leader Brick (see below). If Brick is not freed and Dum Dum survives the mission, he can be encountered during a later mission in which he carries his iconic gun that can then be looted.

After helping Maelstrom fighting off the Militech ambush and escaping the plant, Anthony Gilchrist will appear at the end of the mission, acknowledging that they are now even for saving one another's lives. This will result in Gilchrist eventually having Meredith Stout killed.

Having the Nomad lifepath, V can also expose him as the mole by finding his message to Maelstrom on a computer in a sideroom of the first larger hall they enter after leaving the initial negotiation room in the All Foods Plant (only as a Nomad V can comprehend the full meaning of the message). Confronting Gilchrist with this at the end of the mission will cause him to promise an incentive to keep the information confidential. This will be a crate containing Militech equipment left at V's Apartment in Act 2.

Path 4 - Fight Maelstrom

This occurs if any of the following conditions were met:
*V either pointed a weapon at or attacked any of the Maelstrom gang members after entering their hideout (Royce will appear as a strong boss fight at the end; killing him rewards €$ 3,000).
*V turns off or otherwise does anything that affects the cameras or turrets within the hideout (Royce will appear as a strong boss fight at the end; killing him rewards €$ 3,000).
*V does not sit on the couch or when Jackie refused to sit down, V did not ask him to do so (Royce will appear as a strong boss fight at the end; killing him rewards €$ 3,000).
*V paid Royce with the chip without removing its malware or warning him (Royce will appear as a weakened boss fight at the end; killing him rewards €$ 3,000).
*V knocked out or killed Royce during the conversation (yields no extra money, but they will not have to fight him later).

This is the only way to obtain from Royce (either in the negotiation room or after the boss fight). This is also one of two options that allows V to find and free former Maelstrom leader Brick (see below).

Meeting the Militech operative

After successfully escaping the All Foods Plant, V met a Militech operative at the gates of the plant. This will only occur if V met with Meredith Stout before heading to the All Foods Plant, regardless of whether a deal was made or not with her.

The Militech operative is Meredith Stout if these conditions were met:

*V went to meet with Militech inside the storm channel, either accepting or refusing the deal about taking the credit chip.
*Maelstrom became hostile at some point before getting the Flathead.

If the deal was made with Meredith and Maelstrom were made hostile at any point after meeting Dum Dum in person (such as not asking Jackie to sit down, paying with the infected credchip, or shooting Royce), Meredith reacted impressed and suggested working together again in the future. This is the only way to unlock Venus in Furs, which is initiated in Act 2 when Meredith contacts V again.

If the deal was rejected and V still fought Maelstrom, or a deal was made but V fought Maelstrom before meeting Dum Dum in person, she will act more coldly towards V. This may or may not prevent Venus in Furs from being unlocked.

Both of these outcomes will also result in Stout eventually having Anthony Gilchrist killed. Having the Nomad lifepath, V can also expose him as the mole by finding his message to Maelstrom on a computer in a side room of the first larger hall they enter after leaving the initial negotiation room in the All Foods Plant.

If V did not meet all the conditions for Meredith to appear at the gate, V is met by Anthony Gilchrist instead which precludes Venus in Furs.

Saving Brick

Paths #3 and #4 allow V to find and free Brick. In order to save him, for opening the door, V can either use the "Remote Deactivation" quickhack on the door terminal or find a laptop inside a room next to his cell, and read the message "only you guys know", which contains the code "9691" for Brick's cell door. Then, for the trap, either the detonator device on the table next to his cell door needs to be deactivated or V needs to disarm the mine inside the cell themselves. Although he is of no immediate use, Brick will later retake control of Maelstrom which will allow V to complete Second Conflict in Act 2 without having to fight or sneak out. Deciding to activate the detonator and killing Brick will instead immediately yield €$ 5,000.

After concluding their business at the All Foods Factory, V calls Dexter DeShawn to let him know that they've obtained the Militech Flathead.

:Dexter DeShawn instructs V to proceed to the meeting with Evelyn Parker at Lizzie's Bar.

:Dexter DeShawn instructs V to meet up at the Afterlife to prepare for their raid on Konpeki Plaza.

Journal Entry
:Know what I like about your run-of-the-mill gangoons? They know what they like. Cash, sex, power... maybe just the sight of their enemies' blood. Real rays of sunshine, they are. But these Maelstrom cabrones... shit, never can be sure. They look at you with those creepy-ass toaster faces and you can't get a read of 'em, got no clue what twisted thoughts are racin' through their processors. You ask me, that's why biz with Maelstrom never turns out pleasant. But... sometimes there's just no gettin' around it. Let's grab that spiderbot, yeah? Make Dex proud.

:
::A Militech corpo-c*** lost an arms shipment, and if she doesn't find it, she'll be paddling up shit-creek with stumps for hands. I'm betting it's not even about the weapons - Militech could lose a tank and it'd make no difference to them. It's about principles. One thing's for damn sure - someone's taking the fall for this.

:
::Every corp has a Gilchrist. First he steals from them, turns a fat profit on the goods, lies about it, narrowly avoids the chopping block, gets rid of all witnesses, makes someone else take the fall from him, and to top it all off - he gets a promotion. Can't help feeling sorry for the Maelstrom gonks in this scenario... but only a little.

:
::Turns out Meredith Stout will do anything to stay in the corp's good graces. Unfortunately that means her "colleague" might get demoted... or worse. All in all, Militech recovered their property, putting the Maelstrom freaks in a shittier mood than usual. A day like any other in Night City.

## The Plex
- type：Metroplex
- country：NUSA

The Plex is a massive metropolitan area located on the eastern New United States.

Overview

Commonly referred to as the Plex, this region is made up of interconnected cities around the eastern coast of the NUSA. It streches from Boston to the north, all the way to Washington, D.C. to the south.

Notable Locations
*Boston
*Baltimore
*Delaware
*Langley
*New York City
*Washington, D.C.

Trivia
*The Plex is likely inspired by the [https://williamgibson.fandom.com/wiki/The_Sprawl Boston-Atlanta Metropolitan Axis] (BAMA), a.k.a., "the Sprawl", from William Gibson's, [https://williamgibson.fandom.com/wiki/Sprawl_trilogy Sprawl trilogy] which imagined a similar interconnection between America's older East Coast cities.
*It is also likely based on the real BosWash Corridor.

See also
*The Plex - A Step in the Right Direction?

## The Rescue
The Rescue is a Main Job in . V and their partner Jackie, along with a Netrunner named T-Bug, are hired to find and rescue a missing person, Sandra Dorsett, whose Biomonitor locator implant went dark.

Walkthrough

The quest starts out with a montage of V and Jackie's exploits in Night City. Six months later, V find themselves in their car alongside Jackie, discussing the job they're hired to complete by Wakako Okada.

V learns that the missing woman is probably in a den of Scavengers, in room 1237 of a certain apartment block. T-Bug helps unlocking the main door and disabling the security system.

Upon getting inside, V and Jackie will head through two rooms, the second of which has the corpse of a woman packed with Zetatech repros on a table. The third room will contain your first enemy, which V will need to sneak up to and either kill or knock out before throwing his body in the container in front of him.

There are five scavs in the main room. One will also need to deal with the Scav Leader in the next room.

After getting past the scavengers, V and Jackie enter a bathroom on the other side of the apartment. In a bathtub one will find the missing woman, whose name is Sandra Dorsett, packed in ice with a dead man. While alive, she is medically unstable and requires V to save her using an AirHypo when she starts flatlining. After removing the GPS jammer which prevented Sandra's Trauma Team Platinum alert from activating. V must carry Sandra to the balcony where Trauma Team will arrive via an Atlus AV, order the merc to place Sandra on the stretcher they lay down and then extract her. V and Jackie must then leave using another elevator. Contact Wakako and tell her the job is done.

On the drive back to V's home at Megabuilding H10 in Watson, the pair will be ambushed by a van with more scavengers. There are four scavs to deal with, two of whom open fire from the rear doors, another of whom fires at V upon opening a side door later on during the attack, and the driver. Even if V does not take out all four scavs, the van will eventually crash and kill them all regardless.

The mercs will then arrive at a NCPD blockade at the border of Watson, though Jackie will be able to convince an officer to let the pair pass. After driving a bit further, the V and Jackie will come across a hijacking in progress, only to witness the gangoons getting wiped out by a MaxTac team seconds later. Finally, Jackie will drop V off before leaving to see his girlfriend. V will then head up to their apartment, where one will have the option to check their stash. Lying down on the bed will end the quest.

Journal Entry
:Wakako Okada's got us a gig. Fixer got an SOS call from one of her clients, Sandra Dorsett. All signs point to her having been plucked off the street by scavengers. Motherfuckers are in the biz of carving people up and selling their implants on the black market. Think it's time we paid them a visit. Whaddaya say, ese/chica?

## The Ride
引文：One more thing, V, quiet life, or blaze o' glory? Hmm?（Dexter DeShawn to V）

The Ride is a Main Job in .

Walkthrough
After a brief conversation with Jackie Welles at Misty's Esoterica, he tells V that he's arranged a meeting for them with a local fixer, Dexter DeShawn, about a job. V heads to Dex's limo, which is a short walk from Misty's. During the meeting, which takes place in the limo, V is told about a job to steal an experimental biochip from Arasaka.

Dex mentions that the Maelstrom gang ambushed a Militech convoy and stole the experimental Flathead drone, which will be needed for the job, and that Meredith Stout, a Militech corporate agent, could help V obtain it from the gang. He also suggests paying a visit to the client for the job, Evelyn Parker.

After Dex drops V off at Kabuki Roundabout, V calls Jackie to bring him up to speed about what went down during the meeting, and asks if V plans to visit Maelstrom or Evelyn first.

Journal Entry
:High risk, high reward - as Dexter DeShawn likes to say. First rule of The Afterlife. So this is it, V. Time to go in, grab the bull by the horns and make a name for ourselves. But first, let's hear what Dex DeShawn has to say.

Objectives
*Talk to Jackie.
*Meet with Dex.
*Get into Dex's limo.
*Talk to Dex.
*Exit the limo.
*Call Jackie.
*Talk to Jackie.
